article.articleHeadline: Infografis: Daftar Patogen Mematikan yang Berpotensi Jadi Pandemi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infographic: List of deadly pathogens with the potential to become a pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, Indonesia’s Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI) has compiled a list of priority pathogens, drawing on WHO assessments and Indonesia’s epidemiological context to guide preparedness. The infographic names virus and bacteria families of concern, including Coronaviridae (SARS-CoV), Orthomyxoviridae (Influenza A/H5N1), Paramyxoviridae (Measles and Nipah), Flaviviridae (Dengue, Zika), Filoviridae (Ebola, Marburg), Bunyaviridae (Hantavirus), Togaviridae (Chikungunya), Rhabdoviridae (Rabies), Poxviridae (Mpox), and Retroviridae (HIV). The government advocates a One Health approach, stressing cross-sector collaboration among human health, animal health, and the environment to manage health threats comprehensively. This strategy aligns with WHO, FAO, and WOAH recommendations, reinforcing Indonesia’s readiness for potential pandemics and improving integrated surveillance, risk assessment, and response—without detailing specific cases or outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spreading Exponentially In Congo As Death Toll Tops 2,500, UN Says
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading exponentially, with the death toll surpassing 2,500 as of Aug 22, 2026. The outbreak spans an area larger than France and is the 17th Ebola epidemic in DRC, becoming the country’s largest by number of cases in late July, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis, speaking by video from Bunia in the northeast, said the outbreak is growing faster and wider than the response and is driving huge humanitarian needs. The UN warns that aid funding will run out within weeks unless more resources are provided. The report underscores escalating transmission and the urgent need for expanded international assistance to contain what remains a rapidly expanding crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが指数関数的に拡大、死者数2,500人超えと国連が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が急拡大し、死者数2500人超、国際支援が急務であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 国連が資金不足を警告しており、対応拡大が急務。DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（17回目のエピデミック）。

article.articleHeadline: WOLBACHIA Diterapkan untuk Tanggulangi Penyakit DBD di Cengkareng, Jakarta Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wolbachia Implemented to Combat Dengue Fever in Cengkareng, West Jakarta.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever control in West Jakarta’s Cengkareng district begins using Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti eggs, marking Jakarta Barat’s second Wolbachia deployment after Kembangan. On 21 August 2026, 4,000 Wolbachia-infected eggs were delivered at RPTRA Utama to launch the program alongside ongoing mosquito-control efforts (PSN). Suku Dinas Kesehatan Jakarta Barat Secretary Imron Sjahrin urged broad community and stakeholder support; health officials note Wolbachia complements, not replaces, standard measures. As of 20 August 2026, Jakarta Barat reported 1,591 dengue cases with an incidence rate (IR) of 62.3 per 100,000; eight districts total 1,591 cases, with Cengkareng contributing 563 cases and IR 96.7—the highest in the area. Eight buckets (4,000 eggs) are distributed to Jakarta Barat officials and six foster guardians from six kelurahan, with two buckets placed at RPTRA Utama. Ultimately, 7,669 foster guardians (OTA) across Cengkareng will receive one bucket each.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャカルタ・チェンカレンでデング熱対策のためウォルバキア導入
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例数（西ジャカルタで1,591例、チェンカレンでIR96.7）は一定の規模だが、既知の風土病に対するルーチンの媒介動物対策（ウォルバキア展開）であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地域保健当局による定例のデング熱対策（ウォルバキア感染卵の配布）に関する内容であり、感染症の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。症例数の推移は継続的なモニタリング対象。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / El Niño ya llegó y el dengue acecha con las lluvias que se vienen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño has already arrived, and dengue looms with the coming rains.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Paraguay total 293 in 2026, with three confirmed between weeks 30–32 (two in Asunción, one in Caaguazú); chikungunya remains at 19 cases, including three imported from Bolivia. The epidemiological situation is under control with low dengue circulation and an average of about 148 suspected cases weekly, though notifications are rising in Cordillera, Paraguarí, Alto Paraná, Canindeyú, Amambay, Ñeembucú, San Pedro, Caaguazú and Caazapá. El Niño is established in Paraguay, with forecasts of heavier rainfall from October to December, which could create more mosquito breeding sites. The main defense is household vector control: eliminate or cover any water-holding containers, treat pools with chlorine, and routinely empty, clean, and refill animal drinkers since Aedes eggs can cling to container walls. There have been no dengue hospitalizations or deaths in the past three weeks, and the Limpio outbreak shows no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが到来、迫り来る雨とともにデング熱の脅威
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイのデング熱・チクングニア熱は流行状況下にあるが、症例数は少なく、入院・死亡もなく状況は管理下にある。対象国（フィリピン等）はデータ混入であり実際の発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はパラグアイにおけるデング熱・チクングニア熱の状況報告であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（フィリピン等）は発生地域データに混入しているのみで記事の主題ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Miriam, enfermera española en la zona cero del ébola que preocupa al mundo: "Hay una gran mortalidad infantil"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miriam, a Spanish nurse in the Ebola epicenter that has the world worried: "There is a high infant mortality rate."
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused about 2,500 deaths and more than 5,200 confirmed cases since the emergency was declared three months ago. Spanish MSF nurse Miriam in Ituri-Congo describes the outbreak as the most lethal yet, driven by unprecedented infant mortality and rapid spread. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. About 25% of cases involve frontline healthcare workers, with several fatalities among staff, including a nurse last week. Health systems are weak and prevention in clinics is inadequate, with many transmission chains hidden by community deaths; thousands remain uncounted. Five regions are affected, centered in western Congo, with cross-border risk to South Sudan and Kenya; intercontinental risk considered low due to quarantines. MSF says the outbreak outpaces response and calls for better case detection, safe isolation, vaccine development, and community-engaged strategies. Vaccines in development include Moderna's and another from Oxford University/Serum Institute of India; a Phase I trial began in the UK on July 24 with 50 adults.

triage.headline_ja: ミリアム、世界を憂慮させるエボラ流行の震源地で働くスペイン人看護師：「乳幼児の死亡率が非常に高い」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブジョ株エボラ流行は死者約2500人・症例5200人超と深刻で、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず医療従事者感染や越境リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン、イギリス、インドにも言及しているが、これらはワクチン開発・臨床試験・看護師出身国に関する記述であり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。南スーダン・ケニアへの越境リスクが言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Second deadliest Ebola outbreak on record spreads across the eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak remains the second-deadliest on record, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths as of Aug 19, across 56 of 151 health zones in six provinces. Ituri Province accounts for 84% of cases and 79% of deaths; national CFR is 47.5%, rising to ~70% in the weakest areas (e.g., North Kivu). Week 32 (Aug 3–9) was the worst to date: 579 cases and 304 deaths. Transmission includes deaths at home and in communities outside treatment centers; by Aug 9, 155 health workers were infected and 45 died (≈29% fatality among staff). The outbreak is supported by WHO as a PHEIC since May 17; IHR Emergency Committee met on Aug 18. Vaccination: 70,000 Ervebo doses released, with 20,000 for a Bundibugyo-focused Phase 3 trial and 50,000 for frontline workers; DRC has 2,000 doses in Tshopo and seeks 500,000 more. Two Bundibugyo vaccines entered human trials (PARTNERS). Uganda’s July 28 outbreak closed with 20 cases and 2 deaths for comparison.

triage.headline_ja: 史上2番目に致死的なエボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ東部全域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、致死率約47.5%、医療従事者への感染拡大、複数州への拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は既に終息(症例20、死亡2)しており比較対象として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCではWHOによりPHEICが宣言され、IHR緊急委員会も開催されている極めて重大な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola crisis deepens as deaths pass 2,500 and health workers are attacked
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the nation's largest by case numbers, with deaths surpassing 2,500 as of 22 August 2026, amid rapid spread. The 17th outbreak began earlier this year and expanded from localized pockets into a broad regional spread in the north and east, where government presence is weak and health infrastructure fragile. Authorities warn the epidemic is growing exponentially, threatening neighbouring countries and prompting urgent calls for more funding and frontline staffing. Health workers report rising attacks on responders, community mistrust, and funding shortfalls that hinder response. The response requires sustained, well-funded, and secure support, with international partners urged to reallocate resources and ensure safe transport and logistics to remote areas. If funding and security remain unstable, the outbreak could widen and casualties rise.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機深刻化、死者2,500人超え医療従事者への襲撃も
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最大規模に拡大し死者2,500人超、近隣国への波及リスクや医療従事者への攻撃、資金・治安の不安定さが重なり深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威となっているため。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行がDRC史上最大規模となり、指数関数的拡大と近隣国への波及リスクが指摘されている。医療従事者への攻撃や資金不足が対応を阻害しており、国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela despliega equipos médicos a comunidades indígenas para erradicar la oncocercosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela deploys medical teams to indigenous communities to eradicate onchocerciasis.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela's Ministry of Health deployed medical teams to 14 indigenous communities in Amazonas, including Yanomami and Ye’kwana, to eradicate onchocerciasis, a parasitic worm infection transmitted by blackflies. The effort, with the Amazon Research Center SA-CAICET, aims to reach 944 residents and strengthen local health networks. The plan combines immediate distribution of essential medicines with ongoing medical evaluations to sustain epidemiological control where traditional services are scarce. A rapid-response protocol includes airlift bridges from La Esmeralda to the Puerto Ayacucho airport for emergencies or specialized care. No case counts are given. Onchocerciasis is characterized by severe skin disease and visual impairment that can progress to blindness. The WHO notes endemic foci in Latin America; five countries have been certified free: Colombia (2013), Ecuador (2014), Mexico (2015), Guatemala (2016), and Niger (2025). Venezuela, like some African nations, has suspended mass drug administration in at least one area.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、オンコセルカ症根絶のため先住民コミュニティに医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ政府による既知の風土病（オンコセルカ症）に対する定例的な根絶・医療支援活動であり、症例数の急増や異常な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。対象国（Brazil等）でのイベント発生も確認されない。
triage.notes: 発生国はベネズエラであり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事中に言及されるBrazil等は主題国ではなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Realizan simulacro en Viru Viru ante un posible caso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They conduct a drill at Viru Viru in response to a possible Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Bolivia conducted an Ebola preparedness drill at Viru Viru International Airport in Santa Cruz to assess response times amid an international alert. The exercise mobilized the Ministry of Health, the Departmental Health Service (Sedes), and hospitals across primary to tertiary levels, with municipal authorities from Santa Cruz de la Sierra and El Torno participating. Health representative Arletta Añez emphasized the drill tests authorities' and health workers' capacity to handle a suspected Ebola case and to identify potential bottlenecks. She noted Ebola remains largely confined to Africa, though suspected cases have been reported in the Americas, including Brazil, the United States, and Canada. Bolivia reports no Ebola cases to date and maintains preventive measures to prevent entry and spread. The drill aims to measure reaction times and determine areas needing strengthening.

triage.headline_ja: ビルビル空港でエボラ疑い例を想定した訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: ボリビアでの予防訓練（シミュレーション）に関する記事であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。対象国での確定症例の報告もない。
triage.notes: 記事はボリビア（対象国外）における空港での訓練演習について述べており、実際のエボラ症例発生ではない。ブラジル等は疑い例報告国として言及されているのみで、具体的な感染確認情報はなく、記事の主題でもないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en RDC crece de forma exponencial, advierte la ONU :: Entorno Político
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC grows exponentially, UN warns :: Political Environment
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding exponentially, with Bunia as the epicenter. Declared nearly 100 days ago, the outbreak has caused about 2,500 deaths in the past three months, with half occurring in the last 20 days. It has also seriously affected health workers: 160 infections and 63 deaths among medical staff. Attacks on health facilities, vehicles, and personnel persist, totaling around 260 incidents in six months, about half of July incidents targeting responders. Infrastructure and logistics are major barriers: poor roads slow movement (60 km can take over three hours). Cash liquidity is acutely constrained; the government pays health workers but community workers rely on NGOs, and suspension of Kinshasa–Bunia flights further disrupts cash flow, while mobile transfers are limited by connectivity. The UN warns that rapid, increased funding and resources are needed to reduce transmission and prevent spread to other territories and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、指数関数的に拡大と国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が指数関数的に拡大し、約100日間で2500人が死亡、医療従事者への感染・死亡も深刻で、国連が資金・資源の緊急投入を要請しており、近隣国への拡大リスクも指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC東部（ブニア中心）でのエボラ拡大について報告。近隣国への拡大リスクが言及されているが具体的な越境感染事例は不明。医療施設・要員への攻撃、資金流動性の制約などアウトブレイク対応上の重大な障害も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: 16.250 doses da vacina Ervebo da OMS chegam à RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 16,250 doses of the Ervebo vaccine from WHO arrive in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: 16,250 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as it faces its deadliest Ebola outbreak to date. Declared May 15 as the 17th Ebola outbreak, it is centered in northern and eastern regions with limited state capacity. The World Health Organization allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses: 20,000 for a clinical trial and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain; protection against Bundibugyo, the circulating strain, is unconfirmed, though preliminary data hint at possible protection. The Kinshasa delivery follows the arrival by plane on Friday. The outbreak has caused 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed cases. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warns of exponential progression. On Aug 7, WHO recommended evaluating Ervebo in a trial. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines—Moderna’s mRNA and Oxford’s—are in trials, with a promising rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore). Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and has caused over 15,000 Africa-wide deaths in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOのエルベボワクチン16,250回分がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模とされる第17次エボラ流行が進行中で、致死率が高く指数関数的拡大が懸念されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 流行株（Bundibugyo）に対するErvebo（Zaire株対応）ワクチンの有効性は未確認であり、専用ワクチン開発が進行中。国連エボラ調整官が指数関数的拡大を警告しており、注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura capacita rede privada para combater malária em Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall trains private health network to combat malaria in Porto Velho.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil—On August 21, 2026, the City Hall trained private health network staff and contractors on malaria notification and management to strengthen epidemiological surveillance across the city and districts. Promoted by Semusa's Malaria Program Coordination, in partnership with Oikos, which serves workers at large enterprises including the Jirau and Santo Antônio hydroelectric plants, the training covers correct completion of the Malaria Surveillance Information System (SIVEP-Malária) and SUS protocols. Notifying malaria cases within seven days by public and private services is emphasized. The program also covers diagnosis using thick blood smear and rapid tests, G6PD testing before certain medications, and cure-verification slides at prescribed intervals. Municipal Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso highlighted public-private integration to accelerate case identification and locating transmission areas, enabling timely treatment and vector control.

triage.headline_ja: 市庁、ポルトベーリョのマラリア対策で民間医療ネットワークを研修
triage.triage_reason: 既存のマラリア流行地域における日常的なサーベイランス強化・研修活動の記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の風土病対策としてのサーベイランス能力強化・研修に関する内容で、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Zika Meningkat di Bali, CDC AS Keluarkan Travel Alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zika cases on the rise in Bali, U.S. CDC issues travel alert.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus cases are rising in Bali, Indonesia, triggering a U.S. CDC Travel Health Notice Level 2 on August 7, 2026, after reports of Zika among travelers returning from Bali. On August 10, 2026, the U.S. Embassy in Jakarta reinforced the advisory. Travel Health Notice Level 2 urges enhanced precautions for travelers to Bali and sits below Level 3 (consider delaying nonessential travel) and Level 4 (avoid travel). The CDC emphasizes mosquito bite prevention as Zika transmission persists in the region. Zika spreads primarily through bites from infected Aedes mosquitoes, which also transmit dengue fever and chikungunya; Aedes tends to bite during daytime, especially morning and late afternoon to evening. Zika can also spread via sexual contact and from mother to fetus. Pregnant women are advised to avoid travel to Bali while the notice remains active.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島でジカ熱症例が増加、米CDCが渡航警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: 米CDCがバリ島への渡航健康通知レベル2を発出するなど、国際的な注目と渡航制限措置が生じており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国CDCがバリ島に対する渡航健康通知（レベル2）を発出し、米国大使館も注意喚起を強化。ジカウイルスは蚊媒介に加え性的接触・母子感染の経路もあり、妊婦への影響が懸念される。米国自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള വ്യാപനം ശക്തം  മരണം 2,500 കടന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread intensifies in Congo — death toll crosses 2,500.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has intensified, with deaths exceeding 2,500 and confirmed cases over 5,200. UN officials warn the spread is rapid. The eastern Ituri province saw the outbreak begin by mid-April, and the circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is spreading across the country. There is no vaccine or specific treatment available. Outbreak response funds could run out within weeks. Attacks against health workers fueled by anger and fear are common; about 160 health workers have contracted Ebola, including 43 deaths, with eight health workers killed in mob violence over the past six months. Community resistance to proper burial protocols and rumors about the dead hamper containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染拡大が深刻化、死者2,500人超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC全土で急速に拡大し死者2,500人超・症例5,200人超に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療薬不在、対応資金枯渇の懸念、医療従事者への暴力・埋葬拒否など封じ込め阻害要因が複数存在し、状況は悪化傾向にある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan-tested Ebola vaccine sent to DRC
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) Ebola vaccine are being released to the Democratic Republic of Congo to combat an outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus. WHO and Africa CDC say 20,000 doses will be used in a Phase 3 trial; 50,000 will be offered to frontline health workers under SAGE guidance with informed consent. Ervebo was developed from rVSV-ZEBOV and is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, following Kenyan human trials at Kilifi/KEMRI-Wellcome Trust and broader studies in Kenya, Gabon, Switzerland and Germany; it is not yet proven against Bundibugyo. The DRC outbreak is the largest on record there: as of Aug 12, 2026, 4,665 confirmed Bundibugyo cases and 2,184 deaths across 54 health zones in six provinces; Uganda remains at risk. Gavi provides US$7 million to ship doses and US$6 million to sustain routine vaccination. Global stockpile contains roughly 500,000 Ervebo doses.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで試験されたエボラワクチン、コンゴ民主共和国へ送付
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行は同国史上最大規模（確定4,665例、死亡2,184例、6州54保健地域）であり、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける記録的規模のブンディブギョウイルス・エボラ流行とそれに対するワクチン配布（Ervebo）に関する内容。ケニア、ガボン、スイス、ドイツは過去の臨床試験実施国として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。ウガンダは「リスクあり」とされているが実際の発生は確認されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 16.000 δόσεις εμβολίου Έμπολα έφτασαν στο αεροδρόμιο Κινσάσα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine arrived at Kinshasa airport.
article.articleSummary: 16,250 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived at Kinshasa airport to tackle the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, described as the deadliest in history. The country has 5,290 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,516 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15. The World Health Organization noted a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses available, but Ervebo is approved only for the Zaïre strain, not Bundibugyo, which predominates now. Health Minister Samuel Roche Kamba attended the delivery. Of Congo’s allocation, 20,000 doses are for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials—Moderna’s mRNA candidate and Oxford University’s. A potential rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine, deemed most promising by WHO, is to be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore). Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and is a hemorrhagic fever; the outbreak has cost Africa more than 15,000 lives over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン16,000回分がキンシャサ空港に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（5,290症例、2,516死亡）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性（承認ワクチンが対応しない変異株の流行）が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 現行のBundibugyo株には承認済みErvebo（Zaïre株対応）が効果不十分とされ、新規ワクチン（Moderna、Oxford、Hilleman Laboratories/Singapore開発）が臨床試験中。致死率約47.6%と高く、史上最悪規模のアウトブレイクとされる。Singaporeはワクチン開発拠点として言及されているが、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận 9 trường hợp bệnh dại trên chó tại Đồng Tháp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine rabies cases in dogs reported in Đồng Tháp.
article.articleSummary: Nine canine rabies cases have been reported in Đồng Tháp Province, Vietnam, across eight communes/wards: Tràm Chim, Tân Hồng, Long Tiên, Hồng Ngự, Thường Lạc, Ngũ Hiệp, Tân Hộ Cơ, and Bình Thành. A stray dog entering a pig farm in Long Tiên on August 16 bit a sow (266 kg); the sow’s sample was laboratory-confirmed positive for rabies by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center II, leading to the destruction of the pig. Since the start of the year, nine dog rabies cases have been recorded and a total of ten dogs linked to rabies have been culled. Authorities urge intensified outbreak control, vaccination to exceed 90% coverage, and distribution of free rabies vaccines; address roaming dogs/cats, improve animal reporting, and require daily exposure reporting to the Department by 4 pm until the outbreak ends. Nearby areas requiring exposure tracing include Cai Lậy ward, Nhị Quý ward, Bình Trưng, Vĩnh Kim, Ngũ Hiệp, Hiệp Đức, and Bình Phú.

triage.headline_ja: ドンタップ省で犬の狂犬病9例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物間(犬)の狂犬病発生で、ヒトへの感染拡大は報告されていないが、地域拡大や豚への感染例もあり継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例の報告はなく、動物衛生当局が犬・猫の管理強化とワクチン接種率向上を呼びかけている段階。人獣共通感染症としての狂犬病の性質上、今後の人への感染例発生に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases are rising across Indian cities from Delhi to Bengaluru: Doctors say who is at higher risk and symptoms to watch
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (swine flu) dominates India's influenza season, with Delhi reporting 1,777 H1N1 cases this year among 2,392 Influenza-A infections. Delhi logged 114 H1N1 cases in a day, out of 159 total influenza cases; the city has 2,602 total influenza cases this year, including 2,392 Influenza-A, 37 H1, 138 H3 and 210 Influenza-B. Across Delhi-NCR, labs note a sharp rise in positive H1N1 tests and testing requests; Dr. Dang's Lab reports dozens of positives recently, aided by rapid home-collection/molecular testing. High-risk groups include immunocompromised individuals, the elderly, and young children with comorbidities. Symptoms involve upper respiratory manifestations; precautions emphasize masking, hand-washing, isolation after a positive test, cough etiquette, and avoiding self-medication. Authorities, led by Union Health Minister Nadda, urged enhanced screening, reporting and treatment guidelines; IDSP-IHIP provides daily influenza surveillance. Mumbai also reports rising H1N1; two annual flu peaks occur (Jan–Mar and post-monsoon).

triage.headline_ja: H1N1感染例がインド各都市（デリーからベンガルールまで）で増加：医師が高リスク層と注意すべき症状について解説
triage.triage_reason: インド国内複数の主要都市でH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）症例が急増し、保健省が監視強化を指示するなど政府の関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優勢）の増加であり、例年みられるパターンの可能性が高いが、デリー・ムンバイ・ベンガルールなど複数都市で症例増加と保健当局の対応強化が報告されているため、続報および重症度データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D De Vacinação Combate O Sarampo E Imuniza Crianças No Estado De SP - ABC Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day of Vaccination Fights Measles and Immunizes Children in the State of São Paulo - ABC Agora
article.articleSummary: On August 22, 2026, São Paulo state launches the D-Day Multivaccination campaign to boost immunization, with health posts open 8:00–17:00 to update vaccination status for children and adolescents under 15. In São Bernardo do Campo, amid two measles cases this year, Basic Health Units will administer the measles-containing vaccine (triple viral) to people aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of prior vaccination history, following dose-interval rules; the capital and Guarulhos adopt the same policy. For youngsters, the state offers 20 free vaccines through SUS, including polio, HPV, COVID-19, yellow fever, and tuberculosis; Pneumo 20 adds pneumococcal protection for under-fives. Weekend service targets families unable to visit on weekdays. Health Secretary Eleuses Paiva urges vaccination updates, and the Vacina 100 Dúvidas portal provides schedules, reactions, and efficacy information.

triage.headline_ja: D-Dayワクチン接種の日、麻疹対策とサンパウロ州の子どもへの予防接種を実施 - ABC Agora
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防接種キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、麻疹症例は今年2件と限定的で、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における定期予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本イベントは感染症のアウトブレイクではなく通常の公衆衛生活動のため見送りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases in Delhi-NCR: स्वाइन फ्लू से बचने के लिए क्या करें और क्या नहीं? जानें डॉक्टरों की सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Cases in Delhi-NCR: What to do and what not to do to prevent swine flu? Learn doctors' advice.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1), commonly called swine flu, is rising in Delhi-NCR, with 1,777 cases reported by NCDC as of 22 August 2026. Testing demand has increased alongside upper respiratory symptoms; Dr Dang's Lab notes dozens of recent positive cases. Common H1N1 symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue; illness may be mild but can become severe in high-risk groups. Vulnerable individuals—elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with weakened immunity or other illnesses—should seek medical advice promptly. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, masking in crowded places, and covering coughs. If tested positive, follow doctor’s guidance, isolate if vulnerable household members are present, and avoid self-medication with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: デリーNCRでH1N1症例増加：スワインフルー予防のためにすべきこと・してはいけないこと（医師のアドバイス）
triage.triage_reason: デリーで季節性H1N1（スワインフルー）症例が増加（1,777例）しているが、既知の病原体であり異常性・国際的拡大の兆候はなく、フルRRAに進むほどの緊急性は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例増加報告であり、既知の疾患・既知の対策で対応可能と考えられる。NCDCによる公式報告があり、国内サーベイランス体制下にあると推測される。続報でクラスター拡大や重症例急増があればPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: इस बार क्यों बढ़ रहे हैं स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले? AIIMS के डॉक्टर ने बताए ये कारण, किनको है ज्यादा खतरा?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why are swine flu cases increasing this time? AIIMS doctors explain these reasons, who is at greater risk?
article.articleSummary: Delhi is facing a surge of Influenza A (H1N1) with 1,777 H1N1 cases this year and 433 new cases in the last 14 days, among 2,392 total influenza-A cases (H1N1 1,777; H1 37; H3 138; others 440). Hospitals including AIIMS, Safdarjung, and RML report rising flu-like presentations and swine flu testing yielding positives. Central Health Minister J.P. Nadda reviewed the situation with Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Singh and ordered strengthened surveillance, with ongoing federal support. Contributing factors include virus circulation, waning immunity, and monsoon-induced indoor transmission with poor ventilation and air conditioning. Increased testing may also inflate case counts. High-risk groups are the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with heart, lung disease, diabetes, or immunosuppression. Urgent-care indicators: breathlessness, low oxygen, chest pain, confusion, weakness. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, masking, staying home when sick, and seeking medical advice rather than self-medicating. Delhi reports adequate hospital capacity and ongoing IDSP surveillance via IHIP.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでスワインフルー感染者が増加、AIIMS医師が原因を解説、高リスク者は誰か？
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（スワインフルー）症例が急増（直近14日で433例増）し、保健大臣が状況を確認し監視強化を指示するなど政府・メディアの関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の増加であり、既知の病原体だが、症例急増と政府対応（保健大臣によるレビュー・監視強化指示）が確認されているため注視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола унесла более 2500 жизней в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed more than 2,500 lives in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed more than 2,500 lives, with roughly half of these deaths occurring in the last 20 days. UN data call this the largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history and among the fastest-spreading. The disease has spread across the north-eastern districts, an area larger than France, worsened by weak infrastructure and armed groups that impede and assault health workers. Among medical staff, 160 infections have been reported, with 43 deaths. The outbreak was officially declared in mid-May, though experts believe transmission began earlier. The UN warns that, without additional funding, the epidemic could spill beyond DR Congo; with adequate resources, authorities expect to bring transmission under control within several months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで2500人以上の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模とされるエボラ流行が発生し、死者2500人超・医療従事者感染・国際的拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: フランスは『フランスより広い地域に拡大』という面積比較のための言及であり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo receives 1st batch of Ebola vaccine doses as outbreak kills over 2,500
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received the first batch of Ebola vaccine doses as it battles a Bundibugyo-virus outbreak. Kinshasa's N'djili International Airport received 16,520 Ervebo doses, with 50,120 more expected by Aug 24. The International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision approved an immediate release of 70,000 doses, including 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Transmission remains active nationwide. As of Aug 19, the DRC reported 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths (case fatality rate 47.6%). The outbreak, declared May 15, is the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic in the country and the second-largest globally. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo is uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行で2,500人超死亡の中、初回分のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で5,290症例・2,516人死亡（致死率47.6%）と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 国内最大規模かつ世界2番目に大きいエボラ流行で、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)はザイール株用でブンディブギョ株への有効性は不明。国際的なワクチン供給支援(ICG)が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Pharmacy Academy Urges Nigeria to Prepare Now for Next Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Nigeria must prepare now for Ebola and other emerging infectious diseases, per the Nigeria Academy of Pharmacy. In an Emergency Epidemic Preparedness Webinar, experts urged pre-emptive activation of response systems rather than waiting for suspected cases. The Ebola Task Group called for continuous testing and improvement of outbreak responses, with frontline workers already trained to respond to suspected cases. A consultant physician warned that Nigeria’s weak laboratory capacity and healthcare worker migration threaten preparedness, highlighting that Ebola cannot be diagnosed by symptoms alone and lab confirmation is essential. A pharmacy-based surveillance system was proposed, leveraging accessible community pharmacies for reporting and public education; multidisciplinary training should include cleaners and support staff. Government should begin preparedness training immediately, referencing Ebola in Congo with no vaccine. Lessons from 2014 emphasize stronger surveillance, laboratory capacity, infection prevention and control, public communication, and coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: 薬学アカデミー、ナイジェリアに次のエボラ流行への今すぐの備えを促す
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ発生事例の報告ではなく、ナイジェリアにおける将来的な備えを呼びかける専門家の提言記事であり、現時点での公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアにおける準備啓発活動についての内容で、コンゴ（DRC）のエボラは背景情報として言及されているのみであり、いずれの国でも新規発生の報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi-NCR swine flu: H1N1 cases surge past 1,777 as patients report breathlessness and oxygen drops
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, 1,777 cases of Influenza A H1N1 were registered in the Delhi-NCR region, marking an eightfold rise from 229 cases at the same time last year and linked to persistent humidity and mid-monsoon weather. Patients present high fever, sore throat, muscle pain, and gastrointestinal symptoms such as diarrhea; many develop breathlessness requiring supplemental oxygen. High-risk groups include immunocompromised individuals, expectant mothers, older adults, and those with COPD or asthma. Public health actions involve laboratory capacity assessment, IDSP surveillance, and ensuring oxygenated ICU beds; hospitals are directed to monitor ILI and SARI. Authorities report adequate beds, ventilators, and oxygen to prevent panic. Antiviral treatment with oseltamivir is advised for moderate to severe cases; antibiotics are ineffective against the virus unless a secondary bacterial infection occurs. Preventive measures emphasize mask use in crowded indoor spaces, hand hygiene, and seasonal influenza vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: デリーNCRの豚インフルエンザ：H1N1症例が1,777件を超えて急増、患者に呼吸困難と酸素飽和度低下の報告
triage.triage_reason: デリーNCR地域でH1N1症例が前年比8倍に急増し、呼吸困難や酸素投与を要する重症例が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の急増事例。当局は病床・人工呼吸器・酸素の十分な確保を報告しており、外部支援の必要性は現時点で不明。モンスーン期の高湿度が要因として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 5,200 as Africa CDC warns outbreak may be far larger
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have topped 5,208 with 2,476 deaths and 1,115 recoveries as of August 18, across six provinces (case fatality 47.5%). Africa CDC cautions that official counts cover only about 30–40% of infections, with modeling suggesting the real burden could be 10,000–15,000 and potentially three times larger. Fewer than 10% of detected cases are among known contacts, and fewer than 40% have an epidemiological link to another confirmed infection. Transmission may have begun around February, months before the May 15 declaration. The DRC launched the Congo River Without Ebola initiative to block spread along the Congo River toward Kinshasa (nearly 20 million, no confirmed cases) and across borders to the Republic of the Congo and CAR. Measures include river-port screening, surveillance, early-warning networks, expanded isolation/treatment capacity, mobile floating labs, and possible vessel quarantine, in a three-month initial phase with $9 million UN funding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が5,200人を超え、アフリカCDCは実際の流行規模がはるかに大きい可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.5%、感染者5,208人・死者2,476人に達し、実際の感染規模は公式値の数倍との専門家評価があり、キンシャサや周辺国への拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主題。中央アフリカ共和国（CAR）やコンゴ共和国への越境拡大リスクが言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。UNによる900万ドルの資金提供や河川監視強化など、国際支援を伴う大規模対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Erste 16.000 Ebola-Impfdosen in der DR Kongo eingetroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First 16,000 Ebola vaccine doses arrived in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received the first 16,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine, part of a 70,000-dose package delivered to Kinshasa airport. WHO announced the shipment for limited use among at-risk people and for testing. Ervebo is proven safe and effective against the Zaire strain, but not yet confirmed for the Bundibugyo variant circulating in the country. Of the supply, 20,000 doses are for a third-phase efficacy test against Bundibugyo, and 50,000 for frontline healthcare workers. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 and affects several northern and eastern provinces, with the health system strained by years of conflict. The UN puts deaths at over 2,500. Transmission is via direct contact with body fluids and can cause fever, muscle pains, diarrhea, internal bleeding, and organ failure. In Africa, more than 15,000 have died from Ebola in the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国に最初の16,000回分のエボラワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を2つ以上満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な変異株の流行）、WHOによる国際的なワクチン支援が展開されていることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: 既存のErvebeoワクチンはザイール株に有効性が確認されているが、流行中のブンディブギョ変異株への効果は未確認であり、第3相試験が実施される点に注意。死者数2,500人超と既に大規模な流行となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Περισσότερες από 16.000 δόσεις εμβολίου κατά του Εμπολα έφτασαν στην Κινσάσα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine arrived in Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo received a batch of 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in Kinshasa, amid the country’s ongoing, historically deadly Ebola outbreak declared on 15 May. The DRC reports 5,290 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus cases and 2,516 deaths. The World Health Organization announced 70,000 Ervebo doses available, with 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is approved against the Zaire ebolavirus strain but does not cover Bundibugyo, which dominates this outbreak. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials: Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford University approaches, while a rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) is described as the most promising. Ebola transmits via body fluids and has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa across five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、キンシャサに16,000回分以上のエボラワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で歴史的規模の致死的エボラ流行が継続中(症例5,290件、死者2,516人)であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な支援(ワクチン供給)も行われているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのキンシャサでのエボラ流行とワクチン配布に関するもの。シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点(Hilleman Laboratories)として言及されているが発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。優勢株がBundibugyoでErvebo(Zaire株用)の効果が限定的である点は懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में बढ़े मौसमी इन्फ्लूएंजा के मामले, सरकार बोली- पूरी है तैयारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Delhi, seasonal influenza cases have risen; the government says preparations are complete.

Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh said Delhi is fully prepared after a meeting chaired by Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda. Daily surveillance via IDSP and the IDSP-IHIP portal tracks ILI, SARI, and influenza, with adequate beds, doctors, medicines, and equipment. Training for health workers and intensified IIC activities are underway. Vector-control reports: 320,000 homes sprayed; 91,217 larval sites identified; 74,591 notices issued; 6,724 actions initiated. Dengue 246, malaria 80, chikungunya 19.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで季節性インフルエンザの症例が増加、政府は「準備は万全」と発言
triage.triage_reason: デリーで季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1含む）の症例増加が報告されているが、政府は対応可能と表明しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていない。季節性の範囲内である可能性が高いが、症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1含む）の症例数増加が主題であり、デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの数値も併記されているが、これらは季節性の通常報告の一部と見られる。政府は保健相主導で対応済みとしており、重症度や異常性の情報は明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases rise in Philippine capital amid flooding
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases rise in Manila amid flooding. San Lazaro Hospital, a national infectious diseases referral center run by the Department of Health, reports 50 leptospirosis cases with two deaths as of Aug 22, 2026, after widespread flooding from persistent heavy rains. An express lane for leptospirosis patients has been opened to accelerate care. Nationwide, leptospirosis cases total 3,760 in the Philippines, with numbers expected to climb in the coming days, according to the DOH. The surge coincides with flood-affected urban areas, underscoring ongoing disease burden and the need for prompt triage and treatment at major public hospitals. Further laboratory confirmation details are not provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水の影響でフィリピンの首都においてレプトスピラ症患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: 洪水を背景に全国で3,760例、単一病院で2名の死亡と患者急増が報告されており、症例数増加傾向と重症度（死亡例）から公衆衛生上の懸念があり、国内メディアでも報道されているため社会的関心もあると判断した。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年の洪水期に季節的に発生する疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、死亡例増加と全国的な症例増加傾向から続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Latest News Today on August 22nd, 2026: Master Plan 2047, H1N1 Surge & Major Crime Busts
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a significant H1N1 surge, with over 1,770 cumulative cases and 114 new infections on a single day as of Friday, August 21, 2026. Health authorities, led by Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda, convened a review meeting to address the eight-fold increase and to discuss enhanced public health measures, surveillance, vaccination, and containment strategies. The outbreak's location is Delhi, India. The article also notes broader urban development plans in the capital during the same period, including the Master Plan for Delhi-2047 notified on August 21, envisioning 40 lakh new affordable housing units and a waste management model projecting 25,764 tons of daily waste by 2047. The piece does not provide laboratory confirmation details or infection sources for H1N1, nor mortality figures.

triage.headline_ja: デリー最新ニュース(2026年8月22日): マスタープラン2047、H1N1感染急増、主要な犯罪摘発
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者が1週間で8倍に急増し累計1,770例に達し、保健大臣主導の緊急対策会議が開催されるなど、公衆衛生上の影響と異例性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事には死亡者数や検査確定情報、感染源に関する記載がなく、季節性インフルエンザの通常変動か否かの判断には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phường Ba Đình triển khai 90 đội diệt bọ gậy, kiểm soát sốt xuất huyết từ khu dân cư
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ba Đình Ward deploys 90 mosquito-control teams to curb dengue fever in residential areas.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever control measures are under way in Ba Đình Ward, Hanoi, as the capital enters a dengue peak with rising cases. The ward mobilizes 90 mosquito-control teams, including 3 mobile epidemic squads and 47 surveillance units, to conduct larval source reduction, environmental sanitation, and insecticide spraying in residential areas, schools, offices, and high-risk sites. Strategies emphasize removing water-holding containers, clearing waste, and ensuring household cooperation; inspections cover homes and high-risk zones. After sanitation and larviciding, health authorities will spray insecticide in areas that recorded dengue patients in 2025 and other high-risk locations, targeting 100% participation of surveillance teams and spraying over 95% of nearby households. Ba Đình also hosts free periodic health checks for children from 18 Aug to 4 Sep 2026, at Ba Đình Secondary School and other venues, including physical exams, nutrition, development, and vaccinations, with results stored in electronic health records and student files.

triage.headline_ja: バディン区、90の蚊駆除チームを展開しデング熱対策を住宅地から強化
triage.triage_reason: ハノイ市バディン区における季節性デング熱に対するルーティンの予防・防除活動を報じる記事であり、異常な増加や重症例急増などの具体的データはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節性ピーク期における行政の予防的対策（蚊駆除、環境衛生、殺虫剤散布）を報じる内容で、感染者数の急増や重症化などの異常事態を示すデータは記事中に見られない。ルーチン活動として経過観察の必要性も低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ出血熱「指数関数的」に拡大 死者数は2500人超
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expanding exponentially; death toll exceeds 2,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding exponentially, with deaths exceeding 2,500, about half of them in the past 20 days. UN relief coordinator Julian Harneis warned on Aug 21 in Geneva that the virus is spreading at an accelerating pace, with the epicenter in Bunia and transmission now covering a region larger than France. The outbreak, formally declared on May 15, appears to have begun spreading weeks earlier. Authorities say the response remains slow and poorly organized, and public distrust is hindering control efforts. Severe insecurity and a weak health system in eastern Congo are cited as major obstacles, making field operations extremely challenging. The report underscores the need for intensified measures amid a historic, fast-moving outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱「指数関数的」に拡大 死者数は2500人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で指数関数的に拡大し死者2500人超、国際機関が警告しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 国連やジュネーブでの言及はあるが、発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。フランスは感染拡大地域の広さの比較表現として使われているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情肆虐　首批逾1.6萬劑疫苗運抵 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak ravaging the Congo; first batch of more than 16,000 vaccine doses has arrived
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing the world’s deadliest Ebola outbreak to date, with 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths reported. The first batch of 16,250 Ervebo vaccines, Merck's Zaire ebolavirus-targeted vaccine, arrived in Kinshasa on Friday night as the WHO plans a total of 70,000 doses to curb spread. The outbreak, officially declared May 15 (the 17th Ebola event for the country), has likely been spreading for weeks and is concentrated in the northern and eastern regions amid weak health infrastructure and armed conflict. WHO notes possible partial cross-protection against other strains; 50,000 doses are allocated to frontline health workers, with 20,000 for clinical trials. Vaccines specifically for Bundibugyo virus strain are under development (Moderna, Oxford University; Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore). Ebola transmits mainly by bodily fluids; Africa has seen more than 15,000 deaths in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が猛威、初回分1.6万回分超のワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行（症例5,290件、死亡2,516人）で、WHOがワクチン大量投入を進めており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行とWHO主導のワクチン配布に焦点を当てている。シンガポールはワクチン開発関連（Hilleman Laboratories）の言及のみで発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情爆發將滿百天， 無國界醫生籲加速及靈活應變，遏止疾病蔓延 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak to reach its 100th day; Doctors Without Borders calls for an accelerated and flexible response to curb the spread of the disease — OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: On its 100th day, the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak has become the largest and deadliest, with spread in communities. MSF reports operations in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, running six Ebola treatment centers and isolation wards totaling 400 beds—roughly one-third of the response capacity—with over 1,400 MSF personnel and more than 2,000 patients admitted, of whom more than 800 are laboratory-confirmed for Ebola. In affected communities, urgent training for health workers and community leaders is needed to improve case finding, referral, and infection prevention and control. Last week, Ebola deaths averaged about one every half hour. As of Aug 16, 2026, local health authorities report over 5,000 confirmed cases and more than 2,400 deaths since the outbreak began. At Rho IDP camp near Ituri, housing 50,000 people, leaders collaborate to promote testing, isolation and treatment to curb spread; distrust remains high in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が発生100日目に、国境なき医師団が迅速かつ柔軟な対応強化を呼びかけ、感染拡大の抑止を訴える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で大規模かつ死亡率の高い流行を引き起こしており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、地域社会での持続的曝露が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 5,000例以上の確定症例と2,400人以上の死亡者数が報告され、過去のエボラ流行の中でも最大規模・最も致死的とされる。MSFが人員・資源不足を訴えており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы стремительно распространяется: ООН предупредила об опасности
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly: the UN warned of the danger.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, with the affected area now larger than France and funding sufficient only for the coming weeks, according to UN Ebola response coordinator Julien Harnais, speaking from Bunia in Ituri, the epicenter. Since the May 15 declaration, confirmed cases total 5,290 with 2,516 deaths and 1,152 recoveries; about 840 people remain in isolation or hospital care. The case fatality rate is 47.6%, and 82.9% of contacts are under surveillance, with half of all deaths occurring in the last 20 days. The six eastern provinces affected are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Chopo, and Lower Uele. Healthcare workers have borne a heavy toll: 160 infected, 43 dead, amid attacks on personnel and facilities. Disruptions include a near-nonfunctional banking system and underfunded humanitarian operations, yet UN agencies continue to respond—the second-largest outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大：国連が危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が進行中で、致死率47.6%、医療従事者への攻撃や資金不足も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染拡大地域はフランス国土より広く、資金は数週間分のみと報告されており、緊急性が高い。北キブ州は対象国リストのADM1リストに個別記載はないが、DRC国内として集約。

article.articleHeadline: More than 16,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrive in Ebola-hit DRC
article.articleSummary: More than 16,000 doses of Merck's Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in Kinshasa, DRC, as the 17th Ebola outbreak declared May 15 becomes the deadliest in the country's history. The outbreak has struck the north and east where state presence is weak, health infrastructure is lacking, and armed groups roam, with cases and deaths rising. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire strain but its efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak remains uncertain; early animal data suggest possible protection. WHO announced a total of 70,000 doses for the DRC, including 20,000 for a clinical trial and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The outbreak has caused 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed cases, and is described as growing exponentially by UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis. Two Bundibugyo-targeting vaccines are in trials—Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford; an rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by Hilleman Laboratories is in development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行中のコンゴ民主共和国に16,000回分以上のエルベボワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模となった第17次エボラアウトブレイク（致死率約48%）が拡大中で、国際的なワクチン供給・臨床試験が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言、DRC史上最悪）。Bundibugyo株に対するErveboワクチンの有効性は不明であり、WHOは20,000回分を臨床試験用、50,000回分を医療従事者用として供給。国連エボラ調整官は指数関数的増加と表現しており、既にWHO・国際社会の関心が高い進行中の危機。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले तेजी से बढ़े: H1N1 के शुरुआती लक्षण, खतरे और बचाव के उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu cases have risen rapidly: Early symptoms of H1N1, risks, and preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1), a respiratory infection caused by the influenza virus, is rising rapidly in India's major cities. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets released when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Early symptoms mimic seasonal flu but are typically more severe: sudden high fever with chills, persistent cough and sore throat, body and head aches, extreme fatigue, and shortness of breath; vomiting and diarrhea occur in some cases. Elderly people and children are especially at risk for severe illness. Preventive measures include wearing masks in crowded places, frequent handwashing or sanitizers, avoiding touching eyes/nose/mouth, covering coughs/sneezes with a tissue, staying hydrated and resting, and seeking medical advice promptly for persistent high fever or breathing difficulty to get tested for H1N1. Related reports note Delhi-NCR with over 1,700 cases and rising activity in Mumbai.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフル（豚インフルエンザ）症例が急増：H1N1の初期症状、リスク、予防策
triage.triage_reason: インドでH1N1症例が増加しているとの報道だが、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。デリー等での症例数増加は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、例年発生する流行の一環と考えられる。デリーNCRで1700例超、ムンバイでも増加との記述があり、症例数の動向を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique Centrale: Ebola progresse de façon exponentielle en RDC, selon l'ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: Ebola is progressing exponentially in the DRC, according to the UN.
article.articleSummary: UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harnes warned of exponential progression of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with widespread transmission outpacing the response. The outbreak is described as the largest in the DRC’s history and the fastest-spreading Ebola surge documented, challenging control efforts. By Thursday, DRC health authorities reported 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, with 1,152 recoveries, yielding a case-fatality rate of 47.6%. The epidemic extended across 56 zones in six provinces. United Nations experts emphasize urgent international funding, noting that current funds would only cover the coming weeks. Health workers have been targets of attacks. Congolese authorities have begun compassionate vaccination using Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) in priority zones of Tshopo Province, though no vaccine or treatment is specifically licensed for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ:国連によればコンゴ民主共和国でエボラが指数関数的に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模かつ過去最速拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が進行中で、致死率47.6%、6州56地域に拡大しており、IHR基準に複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 国連がDRC史上最大かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行と警告。ワクチン・治療薬が当該株(ブンディブギョ)に未承認で、資金不足も懸念材料。医療従事者への攻撃も発生しており管理能力に深刻な課題。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Έφτασαν 16.250 δόσεις εμβολίων κατά του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 16,250 doses of Ebola vaccine arrived.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received 16,250 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine, arriving overnight at Kinshasa as the country battles the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history. As of 22 August 2026, the outbreak has 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths since it was declared on 15 May. The World Health Organization has allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses in total, with 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain and has been used during 2018–2020 outbreaks but is not approved for Bundibugyo. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials—Moderna (mRNA) and the University of Oxford—and an rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) is considered the most promising by WHO. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever, with over 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラワクチン16,250回分が到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行が継続中（確定症例5,290例、死亡2,516例）であり、WHOによる大規模ワクチン支援が行われている重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（Zaire株）であり、加えてBundibugyo株にはErvebo未承認のため、複数株混在の可能性が示唆される。WHOはワクチン7万回分を配分済み。ヒトーヒト感染のリスクが高く、国際的拡大の懸念が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: New Zealand Hit by Biggest Flu Outbreak in a Decade as Health System Buckles
article.articleSummary: Influenza A drives New Zealand’s flu surge in years, with Auckland flu hospitalisations at a 10-year high and infection rates at a four-year high, while RSV and COVID-19 circulate. Healthline calls rose about 20% in the past week, from roughly 1,000 to 1,200–1,300; one in five assessed are directed to hospital or emergency services. About 30% of calls concern children under five, prompting Plunket to deploy nurses. Health NZ reports system under intense pressure, with a 27% rise in staff sickness absence. A coordination centre redirects personnel; Winter Plan expands telehealth and urgent-care capabilities, while some elective procedures are canceled. About 1,500 ED visits were redirected to urgent care; 264 extra staff deployed, with 64 in additional duties. Auckland remains hardest hit, with long waits and ward upgrades delayed; wards for Middlemore, Wellington, and Waikato not expected until next year, with Hawke’s Bay capacity next month and Nelson in November.

triage.headline_ja: ニュージーランド、10年ぶりの大規模インフルエンザ流行で医療システムが逼迫
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる医療逼迫の事例だが、発生地はニュージーランドであり監視対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにフィリピンが含まれているが、記事本文はニュージーランドの季節性インフルエンザ流行のみを扱っており、フィリピンへの言及はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plus de 16.000 doses de vaccin Ervebo livrées en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine delivered in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Some 16,250 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo overnight, as the country fights Ebola the deadliest outbreak in its history. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, weeks after it began, affecting northern and eastern regions where state presence is fragile, health infrastructure is weak, and the response is overwhelmed by rising case numbers. The World Health Organization announced that a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses will be available, produced in Germany. Ervebo, Merck's vaccine, is approved against the Zaire ebolavirus strain but not against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain currently circulating in the DRC. The staggered vaccine supply underscores the challenge of controlling a high-fatality outbreak in areas with limited health capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:1万6000回分以上のエルベボ・ワクチンがコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪とされる第17次エボラ流行が継続中で、流行株にワクチンの効果が及ばない懸念もあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: ワクチン(Ervebo)はZaire ebolavirus株に対して承認されているが、現在DRCで流行しているBundibugyo ebolavirus株には未承認であり、対応上の課題となっている。ドイツはワクチン製造・供給国として記載されているが、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: আজ থেকে শুরু হলো বিনামূল্যে ওরাল কলেরা টিকাদান কর্মসূচি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting today, the free oral cholera vaccination program has begun.
article.articleSummary: From 22 August 2026, Bangladesh launches the Preventive Oral Cholera Vaccination Campaign-2026, offering free vaccination nationwide to curb cholera. The first-dose phase runs through 21 September, with the second-dose phase from 26 September to 25 October (14 days apart). The program aims to immunize 5.175 million people aged 1 year and older, excluding pregnant women, across 14 high-risk upazilas and police thana areas. In Dhaka, Dhaka South City Corporation will vaccinate about 1.17 million people at 192 centers across 17 wards (Lalbagh, Gundaria, Kadamtoli, Kamrangirchar). Dhaka North City's Shere Bangla Nagar, Khilkhhet and Tejgaon, plus parts of Munshiganj, Kishoreganj, Narayanganj and Brahmanbaria districts, will also participate. The campaign was inaugurated by Health and Family Welfare Minister Sardar Md. Sakawat Hossain at the DSCC Auditorium, with DSCC Administrator Md. Abdul Salam; Tejgaon program was also attended by State Minister Dr. M. A. Muhit. Full protection requires two doses and should be paired with safe water and hygiene measures.

article.articleHeadline: CDC Keluarkan Health Alert, Wisatawan ke Bali Diminta Waspadai Virus Zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC Issues Health Alert, Travelers to Bali Urged to Be Wary of Zika Virus
article.articleSummary: CDC issues a Level 2 Travel Health Notice for Bali, Indonesia, after rising Zika cases among travelers returning from Bali. Zika is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and is often asymptomatic; when present, symptoms include fever, rash, headache, and conjunctivitis. There is no vaccine or specific treatment. Pregnant women and those planning pregnancy face heightened risk due to possible fetal abnormalities and sexual transmission. Travelers should intensify bite prevention before, during, and for three weeks after travel: use approved repellents, wear long sleeves and pants, ensure screens, and consider permethrin-treated clothing; avoid outdoor activity during peak mosquito hours. For children, DEET 20–30% is acceptable with application first. Pregnant travelers should avoid Bali; otherwise strict protection. Male partners should avoid unprotected sex for the rest of pregnancy, and those planning pregnancy may delay conception for three months for men and two months for women after returning. Seek medical care if symptoms develop.

article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread exponentially 100 days after declaration (as of Aug 22, 2026). article.articleHeadline: H1N1 virus explained: Experts share symptoms, prevention, home care and red-flag warning signs
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR reports H1N1 (swine flu) surge with cases surpassing 1,777, patients reporting breathlessness and oxygen drops. H1N1 is an influenza A strain circulating as seasonal flu. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headache, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhoea, with onset often sudden, aiding distinction from a cold. Rapid or PCR testing confirms H1N1 and guides treatment, especially for vulnerable patients. High-risk groups include pregnant women (second/third trimester), young children (under five, especially under two), older adults, and those with asthma, COPD, diabetes, heart, kidney or liver disease, neurological conditions, obesity, or immunocompromised status. Severe complications can include pneumonia and breathing difficulties. Home care emphasizes rest, hydration, nutrition, prescribed medicines as directed, hand hygiene, masking, isolation from high-risk contacts, and disinfecting surfaces; seek medical advice early if symptoms worsen.

article.articleHeadline: 'H1N1's reach often extends well beyond chest cavity, can affect heart'
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports around 1,777 confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases so far in 2026, nearly sixfold the 229 by this time last year. While H1N1 is primarily a respiratory illness, clinicians warn its reach extends to the heart: the infection triggers systemic inflammation, raises heart rate and metabolic demand, stressing the cardiovascular system. In those with coronary disease, inflammation can destabilize plaques, increasing acute coronary syndrome risk; fever, dehydration, low oxygen and tachycardia can push a weakened heart toward failure. Rarely, myocarditis or pericarditis can occur, with arrhythmias and impaired pumping. The highest risk is among people with pre-existing heart disease, diabetes, hypertension, though young individuals can be affected. Symptoms mimicking flu may mask cardiac issues: chest pain, disproportionate breathlessness, palpitations, fainting, sweating, edema. Most otherwise healthy people recover fully, but myocarditis or heart failure may require follow-up.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola. Ebola: plus de 16'000 doses de vaccin Ervebo livrées en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. Ebola: more than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine delivered in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, the World Health Organization announced a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses for the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), produced in Germany. Ervebo is approved against the Zaire ebolavirus (Zaïre) strain but not against Bundibugyo, the strain currently circulating in the country. WHO experts remain uncertain whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo in humans, though early laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection. A batch of 16,000 doses arrived by air in Kinshasa on Friday. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated to a clinical trial and 50,000 to frontline workers and health professionals in the DRC. The DRC Ebola outbreak has recorded 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, with the epidemic described as growing exponentially, according to UN Ebola coordinator. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever.

article.articleHeadline: 62-Year-Old Woman Dies After Testing Positive For Swine Flu: When Can H1N1 Turn Deadly?
article.articleSummary: 62-year-old woman from Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, died after testing positive for H1N1 influenza (swine flu) following treatment at a private Indore hospital; she was discharged AMA on August 18 and died the next day. The MP Health Department ordered a high-level medical and legal investigation, issued a show-cause notice to the hospital, and assembled experts to review treatment records and discharge circumstances. A positive H1N1 test does not by itself prove the virus caused death. H1N1 is an influenza A virus (A(H1N1)pdm09) spread mainly via respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, fatigue and muscle pain, with vomiting or diarrhea in some. Most recover within about a week, but severe disease can involve pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome, sepsis, or worsening of underlying conditions. Early antivirals help; antibiotics do not treat influenza. The article cites CDC guidance and India’s NCDC protocols.

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: Περισσότερες από 16.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo μεταφέρονται στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: More than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine are being transported to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 22, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a severe Ebola outbreak dominated by the Bundibugyo strain, with 5,290 lab-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. A shipment of 16,250 Ervebo doses arrived in Kinshasa as part of a planned 70,000-dose distribution; 20,000 doses are earmarked for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo, developed by Merck in Germany, is approved for Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo, though it has been used in prior outbreaks. Two vaccines are in clinical trials: Moderna’s mRNA candidate and a University of Oxford program. A third candidate, rVSV Bundibugyo from Hilleman Laboratories, is highlighted by WHO as particularly promising. Transmission is through contact with blood and bodily fluids; authorities aim to curb spread and reinforce frontline protection amid one of the most serious Ebola epidemics in history, with ongoing research for targeted vaccines.

article.articleHeadline: La ONU alerta de la expansión "exponencial" del brote de ébola en RDC mientras se agotan los recursos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns of the "exponential" expansion of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC as resources run out.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands 100 days after the outbreak declaration on May 15, with 5,290 cases and 2,516 deaths, and 1,152 recoveries; 840 patients remain isolated or hospitalized. Case fatality is 47.6%, with contact tracing at 82.9%. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé, and the UN notes the territory is larger than France. Health workers are heavily affected: 160 infected, 43 dead. Attacks on personnel and facilities, and logistics hurdles—three-hour drives for 60 km, limited banking and connectivity—complicate response. The UN calls for immediate international funding and outlines five action lines: enhanced surveillance, community engagement, safe burials, and expanding beds from 900 to 3,000 over three months; partners include WHO, UNICEF, WFP, IOM, MSF. About 50,000 vaccine doses are for frontline workers; a Bundibugyo vaccine trial is planned. Neighboring countries (South Sudan, CAR, Burundi, Uganda) are preparing for spread.

Fever, cough, sore throat, headache, and body pains may indicate H1N1 infection; if these persist or worsen, seek medical advice rather than panic. Practical guidance includes ample rest and hydration, avoiding unnecessary outings, and practicing infection control to prevent spread. For flu-like symptoms, limit contact with others, wear a mask when outside or near people, and protect high-risk groups such as the elderly, young children, and those with preexisting conditions. Cough or sneeze into a tissue, dispose of it properly, and wash hands frequently; hand sanitizer is an alternative. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics, antivirals, or other drugs for fever or cough—treatment should be guided by a clinician, as not all fevers are flu and management varies.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't overlook the symptoms of swine flu; keep these things in mind.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, August 22, 2026 (IANS) – Swine flu (H1N1) infection can present with fever, cough, sore throat, headache, and body aches—symptoms that may be mistaken for a routine viral illness with seasonal changes. People should rest, stay hydrated, avoid rushing out, and protect others by staying home when possible. If flu-like symptoms occur, minimize contact with others; wear a mask when outside and around the elderly, young children, or people with underlying conditions. Practice cough etiquette: cover mouth/nose with a tissue, discard properly, wash hands frequently; hand sanitizer is useful. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics or antivirals; not every fever is flu, and treatment is doctor-guided. Seek medical advice promptly if symptoms persist or worsen, especially for high-risk groups—older adults, pregnant women, infants, or those with comorbidities.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu in Delhi: Swine flu spreading rapidly in Delhi, 114 cases in 24 hours; 1,777 infected so far.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1 influenza) is spreading rapidly in Delhi, India, with 114 new cases reported in 24 hours, bringing the total in the capital to 1,777 infections as of 2026-08-22. RMl's senior expert Dr. Subhash Giri notes the virus can cause pneumonia and poses higher risk to people with lung disease, heart disease, liver transplant recipients, kidney transplant recipients, immunocompromised individuals, those on steroids, and patients with diabetes or cancer. The article highlights ongoing transmission in Delhi and emphasizes vigilance among healthcare providers and the public, particularly high-risk groups. The report does not provide mortality figures or details on laboratory confirmation, and there is no mention of infection sources or imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Surge: Falling Oxygen, Severe Breathing Issues Spark Alarm - Is a Viral Epidemic Brewing?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-22, Delhi-NCR records 1,449 H1N1 cases through 12 August 2026, per the National Centre for Disease Control, more than six times the 229 cases reported during the same period last year. The rise coincides with influenza-like illness presentations and reports of breathlessness with falling oxygen levels among some patients. Health experts say the jump does not automatically signal a fresh viral epidemic, noting that most influenza infections resolve with supportive care and only a subset develop serious complications. The data highlight ongoing respiratory illness within the region and alert clinicians and families to monitor breathing difficulty and oxygen saturation. No details are provided on infection source or imported/exported cases beyond routine surveillance data.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1感染例が急増:酸素低下・重度の呼吸困難が警戒を呼ぶ - ウイルス性流行の兆候か?

article.articleHeadline: Dia D da multivacinação reforça combate ao sarampo em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day of Multivaccination Reinforces the Fight Against Measles in São Paulo
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, São Paulo state in Brazil launches the national multivaccination day focusing on measles control and updating vaccination cards for children and adolescents under 15, while reinforcing protection against over 20 diseases. Measles remains the primary concern, with 24 measles cases reported in 2026, 21 of them in São Paulo state. The federal policy covers people from six months to 59 years in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and the city of São Paulo. Since the campaign began on 3 August, more than one million doses of the trivalent (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccine have been administered across these three municipalities. Health authorities reiterate that vaccination is the main preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹対策強化のための一斉予防接種の日（Dia D）実施
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例が報告されているが件数は少なく（全国24例、サンパウロ州21例）、記事の主眼は予防接種キャンペーンであり深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではないため、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹・おたふく風邪・風疹の3種混合ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する報道であり、アウトブレイク自体の深刻性を示す情報は限定的。症例数の推移を今後注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）收到首批埃博拉疫苗 将评估保护效果
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first batch of Ebola vaccines, and will assess protective efficacy.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo received the first batch of Ebola vaccines for the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, with 16,520 Ervebo doses arriving in Kinshasa on Aug 21 and a further 50,120 doses expected by Aug 24. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus; its protective efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is unproven, though early lab/animal data hint potential protection. The World Health Organization will allocate 70,000 Ervebo doses: 20,000 for Phase 3 trials to assess protection against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The outbreak centers in Ituri province, Bunia, where cases are rising exponentially amid security and access challenges. As of Aug 19, cumulative Ebola cases reached 5,290 with 2,516 deaths and 1,152 recoveries. UN Ebola Chief Julian Haines cautioned that current funding covers only weeks of response while 160 health workers have been infected (43 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチンの初回分を受領し、防御効果を評価へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が指数関数的に拡大し、致死率も高く、WHO・国連が緊急ワクチン配布や資金不足への懸念を表明しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 累計症例5,290例、死亡2,516例、致死率約47.6%と極めて高い。医療従事者160名感染（43名死亡）、資金不足が数週間分しかないとの国連発言あり、緊急のフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में तेजी से पैर पसार रहा स्वाइन फ्लू: OPD में 20% तक बढ़े मरीज, हर चौथा मरीज फ्लू से पीड़ित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu spreading rapidly in Bhopal: OPD sees up to 20% rise in patients, every fourth patient is afflicted with flu.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, swine flu (H1N1 influenza) and seasonal influenza are spreading in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India with seasonal shifts. In major city hospitals—JP Hospital, Hamidia, and AIIMS Bhopal—the number of patients seeking care has doubled, and OPD visits with flu-like symptoms have risen up to 20% above normal. Six swine flu cases have been reported in Bhopal so far, with all patients fully recovered after treatment. In OPD, roughly one in four presentations show cold, cough, or fever-like symptoms. Health officials urge vigilance: anyone with high or persistent fever, worsening cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or decreasing oxygen saturation should seek urgent medical care. Avoid self-medication and crowded places; consult a doctor for proper diagnosis and management.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでスワインフルーが急速に拡大：OPD受診者数20%増、4人に1人がインフルエンザ様症状

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर में भागीरथपुरा जैसा बड़ा खतरा! MY समेत 6 बड़े अस्पतालों के पानी में मिले मानव मल में पाए जाने वाले कीटाणु
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Indore, a danger as big as Bhagirathpura! Pathogens found in human feces detected in the water of six major hospitals, including MY Hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, Indore’s drinking water in six major hospitals—MY Hospital, PC Sethi, Cha Cha Nehru Children’s Hospital, Super Specialty, Mental Hospital, and District Hospital—showed severe biological contamination, with Escherichia coli detected in samples despite a 1000-liter purification unit operated by the Samvedna NGO. Contamination was linked to dirty water coolers, and in several facilities water was distributed via pots due to cooler failures, increasing infection risk for neonates, ICU patients, and those undergoing surgery. Only MTH, Ban Ganga, and MRTB hospitals had water fit for human consumption. The presence of E. coli and coliforms in hospital drinking water could cause life-threatening intestinal infections. MGM Medical College’s nodal officer, Dr. Ashutosh Srivastav, noted that the Hospital Infection Control Committee tests water regularly and directs corrective action when deficiencies are found.

triage.triage_reason: 病院給水設備の大腸菌汚染で院内感染リスクが懸念されるが、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低く、局地的な水質管理問題に留まる。
triage.notes: 病院内の給水設備汚染問題であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。新生児やICU患者など脆弱な患者層への感染リスクが指摘されているが、現時点で実際の感染症例発生は報告されていない。病院感染管理委員会が是正措置を実施中とのことで、管理可能性は高いと考えられるが、続報の確認が必要。
