article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Ebola outbreak accelerates in Congo with 2,500 deaths in 3 months.
article.articleSummary: Julian Harnais, the UN’s chief Ebola coordinator, warned that the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating. In a press briefing, he stated that Ebola has killed 2,500 people over the last three months, with about half of the deaths in the most recent 20 days. The spread has become wide in scope and is advancing faster than response teams can contain. The Democratic Republic of Congo declared on May 15 the start of the seventeenth wave of Ebola, with suspicions that infections had been circulating for weeks before the formal announcement. The development highlights ongoing transmission and the urgent need for scaled-up containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が加速、3か月で2500人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が急拡大し3か月で2500人が死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 国連エボラ調整官が公式にコンゴ民主共和国（第17波）の流行加速と拡大を警告しており、国際的な対応強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर के अस्पतालों में दूषित पेयजल से हड़कंप: चाचा नेहरू और जिला अस्पताल में बैक्टीरिया की पुष्टि, HICC अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in Indore's hospitals over contaminated drinking water: Bacteria confirmed at Chacha Nehru Hospital and District Hospital, HICC alert.
article.articleSummary: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, faces a water-safety crisis as NABL-certified testing found Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Coliform bacteria in drinking-water samples from six major government hospitals: MY Hospital, PC Sethi, Chacha Nehru Bal Chikitsalaya, Super Speciality, Mental Hospital, and District Hospital. Despite a 1,000-liter filtration plant operated by Samvedna NGO, E. coli contamination persisted. Poor maintenance—filth around water coolers and nonfunctional purification systems in emergency wards—contributed to the issue, with some hospitals distributing water via mugs and pots due to broken coolers. Only three facilities—MTH Hospital, BanGanga Hospital, and MRTB Hospital—had water deemed safe for human consumption. Public-health experts warn that contaminated water carrying E. coli and Coliform could cause severe infections in newborns, ICU patients, and surgical patients, including diarrhea, abdominal inflammation, vomiting, and sepsis. The HICC committee is directing regular testing and corrective actions. Date reference: August 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市の病院で汚染飲料水騒動:チャチャ・ネルー病院と地区病院で細菌確認、HICCが警戒
triage.triage_reason: 病院内の飲料水汚染による感染リスクが指摘されているが、現時点で具体的な患者発生や重症例の報告はなく、地域限定の公衆衛生管理事案であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 現時点では病院内水質検査結果のみで、実際の感染症例数や重症度に関する報告はなし。今後の患者発生状況の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Here's data showing Congo's Ebola outbreak is on track to surpass history's largest
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 22, 2026, Congo's eastern Ebola outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for this strain. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is moving at an unprecedented pace and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (>28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths). The outbreak spans 56 health zones across six provinces, including Bas-Uele (two cases) and South Kivu (79 days without a new case). Overall case fatality rate is 46.7%, higher in North Kivu at 68.2%. Only about 10% of cases link to known contacts; authorities may detect only 30–40% of actual cases. Africa CDC notes 19,630 contacts identified (82% traced) but estimates ~100,000 contacts should exist, yielding ~16% of expected tracing. 97% of deaths occur outside treatment centers; 20% of alerts come from communities. Symptoms can be milder, delaying care; misinformation and high mobility worsen spread. The outbreak may have begun in Mongbwalu in February, declared May 15.

triage.headline_ja: データが示す、コンゴのエボラ流行は史上最大規模を超える見込み
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が5,290症例・2,516死亡、CFR46.7%に達し、WHOが史上最大の西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しない株であること、接触者追跡が推定必要数の約16%に留まること、死亡の97%が治療施設外で発生していることなど、対応の遅れと管理困難性を示す複数の重大な指標がある。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surge of Severe H1N1 Infections Across India Possibly Attributed to New Sub-Lineage
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR is the epicenter of India's surge in H1N1 influenza, with 1,449 hospitalized cases in Delhi through Aug 12, 2026—sixfold higher than the 229 cases in the same period last year. National surveillance shows H1N1 making up about 70% of respiratory infections in the ICMR lab network during the prior week, with activity elevated for four to five weeks and a gradual decline in the past two weeks. Most infections are uncomplicated and resolved with supportive care, but some patients progress to the lower respiratory tract, developing pneumonia and oxygen saturation below 90% requiring oxygen therapy, with risks of viral pneumonia, ARDS, sepsis, or respiratory failure. Hospitalizations include younger adults around 35–40 years, though high-risk groups—young children, adults over 65, pregnant women, and those with asthma, COPD, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or immunosuppression—remain vulnerable. No confirmed new H1N1 sub-lineage to date; authorities stress preparedness, surveillance, vaccination, and early management.

triage.headline_ja: インドで重症H1N1感染が急増、新しいサブリネージが原因の可能性
triage.triage_reason: デリーを中心にH1N1入院例が前年比6倍に急増し、呼吸器感染症の約7割を占めるなど公衆衛生への影響が大きく、重症化例や新系統の可能性も指摘されているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 新しいサブリネージの存在は確認されておらず、当局はサーベイランス強化と早期対応を強調している。

article.articleHeadline: Merebak Virus Zika di Bali, CDC AS Imbau Tunda Perjalanan pada Kelompok Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zika virus outbreak in Bali, U.S. CDC urges this group to postpone travel.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus outbreak detected in Bali, Indonesia, prompting the U.S. CDC to issue a Travel Health Notice Level 2 on August 7, 2026, following rising cases among travelers returning from Bali. Zika transmits via Aedes mosquito bites, from pregnant women to fetuses, and through sexual contact. Congenital Zika can cause birth defects. Travelers to Bali should intensify mosquito bite prevention and practice safe sex before, during, and after travel. Pregnant women are advised to avoid travel to Bali; if travel cannot be avoided, strict Zika precautions are required. Those planning pregnancy should delay conceiving after returning from Bali per recommended waiting periods to reduce sexual transmission risk. Anyone experiencing fever, rash, headache, joint or muscle pain, or red eyes during or after travel should seek medical care promptly. Consider travel insurance covering health and medical evacuation.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島でジカウイルスが流行、米CDCが特定グループに渡航延期を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: バリ島でのジカウイルス流行を受け米CDCが渡航健康情報レベル2を発出しており、国際的な渡航者への影響と先天性ジカ症候群のリスクから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。CDCの渡航健康情報レベル2発出は国際的関心の高さを示す重要な指標。妊婦への渡航回避勧告や先天性ジカ症候群のリスクが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Disbunnak Batang Hari Perketat Pencegahan Rabies, Siapkan 250 Dosis Vaksin Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Batang Hari's Department of Plantations and Forestry Tightens Rabies Prevention, Prepares 250 Free Vaccine Doses.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention is intensified in Batang Hari Regency, Jambi Province, Indonesia, with 250 additional free rabies vaccine doses announced by Disbunnak. Acting Head Afrizal said the extra supply accompanies World Rabies Day on September 28, aiming to curb transmission from rabies-transmitting animals (HPR). Free vaccination targets dogs, cats, and monkeys, with access at the Batang Hari Disbunnak office, the Veterinary Public Health Center (Puskeswan), and through district-level teams in Pemayung, Muara Tembesi, Mersam, Batin XXIV, and surrounding areas. Authorities urge pet owners to utilize the program to reduce residential rabies risk. The initiative reflects ongoing preventive measures rather than an outbreak, and aligns with public health outreach ahead of the global awareness day.

triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイクではなく、世界狂犬病デーに向けた予防的なワクチン接種プログラムの案内であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、実際の感染拡大や症例急増を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 16.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo έφθασαν στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the current Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in the country's history—reports 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths as of August 22, 2026, after being declared on May 15. A shipment of 16,250 Ervebo doses arrived overnight Friday-Saturday in Kinshasa, part of a broader WHO-led effort delivering 70,000 doses: 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo, Merck's vaccine, targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain but not the Bundibugyo strain that dominates this outbreak. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials—Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford University—while a rVSV Bundibugyo candidate from Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) is touted by WHO as the most promising. Ebola, which spreads through bodily fluids, has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：エルベボワクチン16,000回分以上がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最悪のエボラ流行が継続中で、確定症例5,290例・死者2,516人に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: シンガポールはBundibugyo株対応ワクチン開発機関（Hilleman Laboratories）の所在地として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。既存の大規模流行であり、WHOによるワクチン配布など国際的対応が進行中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Surge in Delhi: AIIMS Doctor Explains Why H1N1 Cases Are Rising and Who Faces the Biggest Risk
article.articleSummary: In New Delhi, influenza A(H1N1) swine flu cases surge with 1,777 H1N1 recorded in 2026 and 433 new positives in the past 14 days. Major hospitals—AIIMS Delhi, Safdarjung, and RML Hospital—report fever, cough and other influenza-like symptoms, with many testing positive for H1N1. Delhi authorities report 2,392 Influenza-A cases this year: 1,777 H1N1, 37 H1, 138 H3, and 440 other variants. AIIMS expert Dr. Neeraj Nischal notes that rising cases reflect multiple factors beyond cold weather, including monsoon-related indoor crowding, high humidity, and ventilation; increased testing may also identify more infections. High-risk groups include the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and people with heart/lung disease, diabetes, or immunosuppression. Preventive guidance emphasizes hygiene, masks, staying home when sick, avoiding self-medication, and seeking testing for persistent symptoms. The Centre and Delhi government have expanded IDSP/IDSP-IHIP surveillance; no bed shortage is reported and resources are being scaled as needed.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで豚インフルエンザが急増：AIIMSの医師がH1N1症例増加の理由と最もリスクが高い層を説明
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の症例増加だが、専門家により増加要因（気候・検査拡大）が説明されており異常性は低く、重症化や医療逼迫の報告もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デリーにおける季節性H1N1症例の増加を報告する記事。専門家は雨季の混雑・湿度・検査拡大が要因と説明しており、異常事態というより季節的傾向として位置づけられている。病床逼迫なし、サーベイランス体制（IDSP/IHIP）は既に強化済みで、外部支援の必要性は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية تتلقى الدفعة الأولى من جرعات لقاح الإيبولا في ظل تفش للمرض أودى بحياة أكثر من 2500 شخص
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first batch of Ebola vaccine doses amid an outbreak that has claimed more than 2,500 lives.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first batch of Ebola vaccine doses amid an ongoing outbreak that has infected over 5,000 people and claimed more than 2,500 lives. As of August 19, 2026, DR Congo reported 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths (case fatality 47.6%). The outbreak began May 15 and is the largest in the country's history and the second-deadliest globally. 16,520 doses of the Ervebo vaccine arrived at N'Djili International Airport in Kinshasa on August 21, 2026, with 50,120 more expected between August 21–24. The International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision approved the immediate release of an initial 70,000-dose tranche, at the government's request. Of these, 20,000 doses will be used in a Phase III trial to evaluate efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain, while 50,000 doses are earmarked for frontline health workers. Transmission remains active nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、2500人以上の死者を出したエボラ出血熱の流行下で最初のワクチン供給を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行（感染者5,290人、死亡2,516人、致死率47.6%）が全国で継続中であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 国際ワクチン供給グループ（ICG）による7万回分のワクチン放出承認、フェーズIII試験実施など国際的対応が進行中。Bundibugyo株に対する対応も含まれ、変異株の脅威も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية | السلطات تتسلم أول دفعة من لقاح "إيرفيبو" لمكافحة تفشي الإيبولا - قناة المنار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo | Authorities receive the first batch of the Ervebo vaccine to combat the Ebola outbreak - Al-Manar
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo received the first batch of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine—over 16,000 doses—arriving at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa as part of a 400,000-dose order to counter the worst outbreak in the country's history. Earlier, 2,000 doses had been sent to the Chobo region. Authorities report more than 2,300 deaths and about 5,000 infections, with UN figures putting fatalities above 2,500 in the past 20 days. UN Ebola chief Julian Harneis warns the outbreak is growing faster than the response and now spans six provinces, larger than France. MSF warns of an alarming spread. The WHO will deliver 70,000 additional Ervebo doses; the vaccine is effective against Zaire ebolavirus, but efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains unconfirmed. About 160 health workers have been infected, 43 of them fatal; international support is urged to deploy more staff to eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行対策で「エルベボ」ワクチンの第1便を受領 - アルマナール
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たす大規模エボラ流行（死者2,300人超、6州に拡大、医療従事者感染）であり、国際的拡大リスクと重篤性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 国連やMSFが対応の遅れと感染拡大の加速を警告。医療従事者感染率が高く、ワクチン効果が一部エボラ株（ブンディブギョ）に対して未確認である点にも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Περισσότερες από 16.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo μεταφέρονται στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine are being transported to the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 16,250 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine are being shipped to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as Ebola cases climb. The outbreak, declared May 15, has 5,290 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,516 deaths in the DRC. The World Health Organization outlined 70,000 Ervebo doses: 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV) strain and is not approved for Bundibugyo, which dominates the current outbreak. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials: Moderna’s mRNA vaccine and Oxford University’s candidate. An rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine, touted by WHO as the most promising, is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore. Ebola, transmitted via body fluids and causing hemorrhagic fever, has killed over 15,000 people across Africa in the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：エルベボワクチン16,000回分以上がコンゴに輸送中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認済みエボラ症例5,290件・死亡2,516人という大規模アウトブレイクが継続中であり、既存ワクチンが主要流行株（Bundibugyo）に非対応という異常事態も存在するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: シンガポールはBundibugyo株対応ワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 奪2千多條人命！剛果伊波拉疫情瀕臨失控 7萬劑疫苗送抵金夏沙救援
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 lives lost! Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak teeters on the brink of spiraling out of control as 70,000 vaccine doses arrive in Kinshasa for relief efforts.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak accelerates with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths since May 15 declaration of the 17th outbreak; violence and weak healthcare infrastructure in the northern and eastern provinces hinder relief and surveillance. First batch of Merck's Ervebo vaccine, 16,250 doses, arrived Aug 20 at Kinshasa's airport and was received by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba, signaling a relief push. WHO plans to supply a total of 70,000 doses, with 50,000 prioritized for frontline healthcare workers and 20,000 for clinical trials. Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus; efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains unconfirmed, though early animal data suggest partial cross-protection. Additional vaccines (Moderna mRNA, Oxford candidate, and Singapore Hillman Laboratory) are in development and trials; Ebola is primarily transmitted via body fluids, and the international community is intensively monitoring and assisting control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 2000人以上が死亡！コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が制御不能寸前、7万回分のワクチンがキンシャサに到着し救援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ出血熱流行が拡大しており、確定症例5,290例、死亡2,516例と甚大な公衆衛生影響があり、暴力紛争と脆弱な医療体制により国際的拡大リスクも高い。WHOによるワクチン展開など国際支援が既に行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案である。
triage.notes: 致死率が約47.6%と非常に高く、紛争地域での対応の困難さが強調されている。ワクチンの株特異性（Zaire型に対しBundibugyo型への効果は未確認）も今後の評価で考慮すべき重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: 川普促減兒童疫苗美急尋反饋　剛果伊波拉疫情失控 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump urges cuts to children's vaccines; US urgently seeks feedback; Congo Ebola outbreak out of control
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding exponentially, with the death toll surpassing 2,500. The UN warns that funding for the response is nearly exhausted, while local authorities report movement restrictions imposed by M23 rebels to limit travel in affected areas. Separately in the United States, the Department of Health and Human Services is urgently seeking public feedback on federal vaccine recommendations following President Donald Trump's order to reduce children's vaccines, including consideration of whether certain vaccines should not be administered in infancy or should receive conditional recommendations. The parallel health policy move underscores tensions between outbreak response needs and vaccination policy debates while the Ebola crisis drives international concern.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、児童ワクチン削減を促す 米が緊急に意見募集 コンゴのエボラ感染拡大が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が2500人を超え指数関数的に拡大しており、資金枯渇や武装勢力による移動制限も加わり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 米国のワクチン政策議論は本疾患イベントとは別文脈であり、対象国リストにも該当しないため検証対象地域から除外。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर के 6 बड़े अस्पतालों के पानी में मिले मल-मूत्र वाले कीटाणु, NABL की जांच रिपोर्ट में बड़ा खुलासा - indore hospitals water contamination ecoli and coliform risk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fecal-urine-origin pathogens found in the water of six major hospitals in Indore; NABL testing report reveals a major disclosure — Indore hospital water contamination: E. coli and coliform risk.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, NABL-certified testing in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, found drinking water in six public hospitals contaminated with pathogenic E. coli and coliform bacteria. Six hospitals—MY Hospital, PC Sethi, Cha Cha Nehru Children’s Hospital, Super Specialty, Mental Hospital, and District Hospital—showed significant biological contamination, despite a 1,000-liter purification system run by Samvedana NGO. Water at MTH, Ban Ganga, and MR TB Hospital was deemed safe for consumption. Issues identified include dirt around water coolers and malfunctioning emergency-unit systems; at Cha Cha Nehru, unsanitary conditions around water coolers were linked to infections in newborns. With some water dispensed via vessels due to broken coolers in Mental and District Hospitals, the risk of enteric infections rises for neonates, ICU patients, and post-operative patients. MGM Medical College’s nodal officer notes regular HICC testing and corrective actions when deficiencies are found."

triage.headline_ja: インドール市内の主要病院6施設の水道水から糞便由来細菌検出、NABL検査報告で判明――大腸菌・大腸菌群汚染リスク
triage.triage_reason: 病院内の水質汚染（大腸菌・大腸菌群）が検出され新生児感染との関連が示唆されているが、明確な感染症アウトブレイクとしての確認はなく、局所的な施設管理問題の性格が強いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水系感染リスクはあるが、感染症アウトブレイクというより病院インフラ・衛生管理の問題として報道されている。新生児感染との関連は示唆段階であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : شبح الإيبولا يثير الرعب .. انتشار واسع وسريع للوباء في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: The Ebola specter sparks fear .. wide and rapid spread of the outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, United Nations warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with about 2,500 deaths in the previous three months. The current spread now covers a land area larger than France, and deaths surged with half occurring in the last 20 days, indicating an outbreak expanding faster than response capacity. The epicenter is in northern and eastern DRC, where weak health systems and deteriorating security complicate response. Armed groups' ongoing activity hinder access for medical and relief workers, complicating surveillance, contact tracing, and containment efforts. The outbreak was declared on 15 May as the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC, though health-response teams believe transmission began weeks prior. Ebola transmits via blood or bodily fluids of infected individuals or corpses; rapid detection, isolation, and meticulous contact tracing are essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信：エボラの脅威が恐怖を呼ぶ…コンゴで広範かつ急速な流行拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が国連により急速拡大・死者急増（過去3か月で約2500人）と警告されており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクいずれも高い重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 『発生地域』にフランスが含まれているが、これは流行地域の面積比較（フランスより広い）を指すもので、実際の発生国ではないため除外した。武装勢力の活動により対応が困難化し、国際支援の必要性が極めて高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: More than 16,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrive in Ebola-hit DRC
article.articleSummary: More than 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) late Friday as the 17th Ebola outbreak—declared May 15 and described as the deadliest in the DRC’s history—drags on with thousands of deaths. WHO said a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses will be delivered. The outbreak has struck the north and east, in areas with weak state presence, limited health infrastructure, and long-standing armed conflict. Ervebo is approved against the Zaire strain, but the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating in the DRC may not be fully covered; early animal data suggest some protection, though human efficacy remains uncertain. The article notes vaccine arrivals amid ongoing outbreak response and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が続くコンゴ民主共和国に16,000回分以上のエルベボワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪とされる第17次エボラ流行が拡大を続け、数千人の死者が出ており、WHOによるワクチン配布など国際的な対応が進行中であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 流行株（Bundibugyo株）に対するErvebo（Zaire株用）の有効性が不確実である点が特筆される。武装紛争地域での対応の困難さも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Baguio records 125 mild COVID‑19 cases, no deaths
article.articleSummary: 125 COVID-19 cases in Baguio City as of Aug 17, with 120 recoveries and five active cases, all mild. Most infections were mild and the majority of residents affected were vaccinated; 99% of recovered patients were vaccinated. A substantial share of cases occurred among health workers under regular testing for infection prevention. No Cicada COVID-19 subvariant has been detected in Baguio. Across the Cordillera Administrative Region, DOH tallies 184 cases from January–August 2026, with Baguio accounting for 129, followed by Benguet (39), Mountain Province (7), Kalinga (4), Apayao (2), Ifugao (2), and Abra (1). Officials urged continued vigilance around seniors, children, pregnant women, and people with comorbidities, citing vaccination as protection against severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市で軽症COVID-19が125例、死亡者なし
triage.triage_reason: 全例軽症で死亡者なし、ワクチン接種者が大半を占め重症化抑制が確認されており、異常な変異株の検出もないため、通常の流行状況として見送り。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節的・地域的な通常発生報告であり、新規変異株や重症化増加の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov Sulteng libatkan perguruan tinggi berantas penyakit tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Sulawesi Provincial Government engages universities to combat tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Central Sulawesi Governor Anwar Hafid launches the Berani Magaya program to eradicate tuberculosis (TB) in Palu and across the province, involving seven universities (Universitas Tadulako, Universitas Alkhairat, Universitas Tompotika Luwuk, Universitas Muhammadiyah Palu, Universitas Widya Nusantara, Poltekkes, STIK Indonesia Jaya) and health units (RS Untad, Lab Kesda Sulteng, Puskesmas) in a cross-sector effort. The initiative, titled Berantas infeksi TB, Mahasiswa JaGa and SaYang Keluarga, aims to make Central Sulawesi TB-free within three years, emphasizing collaboration with local governments and higher education institutions. Data show Palu City with the highest detected TB cases at 1,075, followed by Parigi Moutong (546) and Banggai (510); the remaining ten districts are under 500, underscoring gaps in case finding. Attendees at the launch included Deputy Ministers Akhmad Wiyagus (Home Affairs), Fauzan (Economic/Tech), and Benjamin Paulus Octavianus (Health).

triage.headline_ja: 中スラウェシ州政府、結核撲滅に向けて大学を動員
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの立ち上げに関する行政広報であり、異常な発生や急激な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域流行病であり、本記事は対策プログラムの開始を報じる通常の公衆衛生施策ニュース。症例数の増加や異常なアウトブレイクを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: ปศุสัตว์โคราช ประกาศเขตโรคระบาดพิษสุนัขบ้า ต.หัวทะเล 1เดือน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima Livestock Office declares rabies outbreak zone in Huathale Subdistrict for one month.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak zone declared in Huathale Subdistrict, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand, for one month from 18 Aug 2569 to 17 Sep 2569 after dogs in Ban Nong Song Hong village tested positive. The temporary zone covers surrounding villages with defined north/south/east/west boundaries. Prohibitions include moving dogs or cats out of the zone without veterinary permission and restricting animal entry/exit without authorization; suspected cases must be reported promptly; carcasses must not be moved without permission; residents should cooperate with inspectors. Citizens urged to monitor pets closely, avoid contact with suspicious dogs/cats, and report immediately. From 1 Jan 2569–21 Aug 2569, 32 rabies-infected animals identified in Nakhon Ratchasima. One human death recorded; 218 high-risk contacts, 195 fully vaccinated, 23 awaiting vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ナコンラチャシマ畜産局、フアタレー郡で1か月間の狂犬病流行地域を宣言
triage.triage_reason: タイの一地域における狂犬病流行で人的死亡例が1件あるが、狂犬病はタイで既知の風土病であり異常性は低く、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも低いため、続報を注視するレベルと判断。
triage.notes: 地方畜産局によるルーチン的な狂犬病流行地域宣言。人的死亡1例、動物32件感染、高リスク接触者218名（うち195名ワクチン接種済）。地域限定的措置であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh Covid-19 cases rise in Assam since June; experts rule out severe threat
article.articleSummary: RF.5 Covid-19 variant driving fresh cases in Assam since June 2026, with infections largely flu-like and no evidence of severe disease. In upper Assam, around 80-90 positive cases were reported in July and August. RF.5 is an Omicron subvariant arising from the JN.1 lineage; state sequencing of the variant has not yet been carried out. Currently, three viruses are circulating in Assam: Influenza A, Influenza B and Covid-19. Last Covid-19 cases in Assam were recorded in December 2025. The uptick began at the end of June 2026; experts say Covid-19 has become a recurring viral illness with variants likely to trigger periodic waves. Higher risk groups include senior citizens, pregnant women and people with diabetes, hypertension or kidney disease. Authorities urge calm; outbreaks are largely localised clusters, aided by hybrid immunity from prior infections and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州で6月以降新型コロナウイルス感染症の症例が増加、専門家は重大な脅威ではないとの見解
triage.triage_reason: 軽症例が中心で専門家が重大な脅威を否定しており、局所的なクラスターにとどまるため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: RF.5（JN.1系統のオミクロン亜系統）による軽症例の増加。重症化は確認されておらず、当局は落ち着いた対応を呼びかけている。高リスク群（高齢者、妊婦、基礎疾患保有者）への注意喚起はあるが、社会的関心の高まりや国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi records 1,777 swine flu cases in 2026: Health officials reviews preparedness as seasonal influenza tightens its grip
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 H1N1 cases in 2026 among 2,392 Influenza-A infections; on Aug 20, 159 new influenza cases included 114 H1N1, with the total H1N1 tally reaching 1,777. Year-to-date H1N1 cases are more than seven times higher than the 229 recorded by the same point last year. H1N1 is now a seasonal influenza virus, not a novel ‘swine flu’ strain, though the label persists. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, muscle aches and fatigue; severe illness can involve pneumonia, breathing difficulty or hypoxia, particularly in young children, older adults, pregnant women, and those with chronic conditions. Delhi authorities, led by Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda, reviewed surveillance, testing, treatment capacity and hospital readiness; no bed shortages were reported, but districts were urged to intensify ILI/SARI screening under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme. Precautions include hygiene, vaccination (WHO 2026-27 includes updated H1N1) and early antivirals for high-risk or severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで2026年にH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）症例1,777件を記録：季節性インフルエンザの拡大を受け保健当局が対応体制を確認
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が前年比7倍に急増しているが、病床不足はなく国内の季節性インフルエンザ対応の枠内で管理されており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため、フルRRAではなく継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1は既に季節性インフルエンザとして定着しており、今回の増加は国内サーベイランス強化の一環として報告されている。病床不足なし、国際的な波及や渡航制限の兆候は現時点で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 奪2千多條人命！剛果伊波拉疫情瀕臨失控 7萬劑疫苗送抵金夏沙救援
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 lives lost! Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on the brink of spiraling out of control as 70,000 vaccine doses arrive in Kinshasa for relief efforts.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached a critical phase, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country—while transmission concentrates in the north and east amid fragile health infrastructure and armed-group disruptions. The first batch of Ervebo vaccines (16,250 doses) arrived at Kinshasa's airport Friday night, received by Health Minister Samuel Kamba. WHO plans a total of 70,000 vaccine doses, allocating 50,000 to frontline healthcare workers and 20,000 for clinical trials. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus, but the current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with limited evidence of cross-protection. Additional vaccines—Moderna and Oxford candidates in trials, and a promising Singapore Hillman Laboratory vaccine—are under development. Ongoing international support aims to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 2000人以上の命を奪う！コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫病が制御不能寸前、7万回分のワクチンがキンシャサに到着し救援
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例5,290件、死者2,516人に達する大規模エボラ流行が制御不能寸前とされ、WHOによる大規模ワクチン投入など国際的対応が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 現行流行はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）によるもので、既存のErvebo（ザイール株用ワクチン）との交差防御は限定的とされる点に注意が必要。武装勢力による活動妨害で対応が困難化している。

article.articleHeadline: Universitas Tadulako luncurkan Berani Magaya percepat eliminasi tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tadulako University launches Berani Magaya to accelerate tuberculosis elimination.
article.articleSummary: Universitas Tadulako in Palu, Central Sulawesi, launched the Berani Magaya program (Berantas Infeksi TB, Mahasiswa Jaga dan Sayang Keluarga) to accelerate tuberculosis elimination in the region. Rector Prof. Amar said TB elimination is a shared societal responsibility, with universities delivering solutions through education, research, service, and community empowerment. The program involves 1,073 students and 155 lecturers from seven universities in Central Sulawesi, under the KITA Sulteng consortium coordinated by LLDIKTI Region XVI, with initial focus on Palu City, Poso Regency, Banggai Regency, and Tolitoli Regency. Berani Magaya aims to directly assist TB patients and families via mentoring, education, treatment-adherence monitoring, and transmission prevention, emphasizing empathy, confidentiality, and stigma-free engagement. TB is curable with proper treatment; stigma must be countered. The initiative aligns with Indonesia’s objective to be TB-free by 2030 and was attended by deputy ministers from Health, Home Affairs, and Higher Education.

triage.headline_ja: タドゥラコ大学、結核撲滅を加速する「ブラニ・マガヤ」プログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの開始に関する広報的な記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は大学主導の啓発・治療支援プログラムの発足を報じるものでアウトブレイク情報ではないため、対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Wave Draws Fresh Attention in Delhi, JP Nadda Reviews Influenza Trends and Healthcare Readiness, Symptoms & Precautions You Must Take
article.articleSummary: Delhi sees rising H1N1 influenza cases, prompting JP Nadda to review influenza trends and healthcare readiness. In 2026 Delhi has recorded 1,777 H1N1 cases overall, with 114 new cases reported on August 20. H1N1, a subtype of influenza A transmitted via respiratory secretions, remains a substantial portion of respiratory illnesses in the country, necessitating timely detection, testing and treatment to curb spread. Common symptoms include fever and chills, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue, headache, and in severe cases breathing difficulties. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, respiratory etiquette, and seeking medical consultation for persistent symptoms; vaccination may reduce severity in vulnerable populations. Health authorities maintain surveillance and a laboratory network to monitor the outbreak, while Delhi’s healthcare preparedness—beds, critical care capacity, drugs, and testing—continues to be assessed to ensure readiness against rising cases.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1流行が新たな注目を集める、JPナッダ氏がインフルエンザ動向と医療体制を点検、症状と予防策について
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例増加は例年見られる現象であり、重症度や異常性、国際的拡大の明確な兆候はないが、感染拡大の継続性と当局の監視・対応が続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1はインド国内で季節性に流行するインフルエンザA亜型であり、政府による監視・医療体制点検が行われているが、重症例や死亡数、異常な拡大の詳細情報は記事に含まれていない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 on the rise in Delhi: 1,777 cases reported, authorities step up vigilance - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 H1N1 infections among 2,392 influenza-A cases this year, with H1N1 now the predominant strain. Health authorities have stepped up surveillance and hospital preparedness as seasonal influenza rises. The Delhi government notes no shortage of beds or medicines and monitors cases through the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) with daily ILI/SARI reporting via the IDSP-IHIP portal. District officers are instructed to strengthen screening, reporting and monitoring; guidelines cover patient assessment, ventilator support, mask use and home care. Dr Dang's Lab reports dozens of H1N1-positive cases and rapid molecular testing yields results within hours. Precautions urged include respiratory hygiene and masks in crowded places; high-risk individuals should seek timely testing. AAP raises alarm over rising cases, noting high fever, cough and flu-like symptoms among schoolchildren.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1が増加：1,777件の症例が報告され、当局が警戒を強化 - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の増加であり、当局は病床・薬剤不足なしで対応できているため深刻性は低いが、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続や政治的関心（AAPの警鐘）があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)のデリーでの増加報告。病床・医薬品不足はなく、当局のサーベイランス強化で管理されている。AAP（政党）による警戒発言があり社会的関心はあるが、IHR基準には該当せず、重症度の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情嚴峻 6成死在治療中心外 急需醫護支援
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is severe; 60% die outside treatment centers; urgent need for medical staff support.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest and deadliest on record, with border controls extended 90 days to November 28, including a ban on entry for residents and a 21‑day self-quarantine for travelers from affected areas. MSF warns the epidemic is spreading rapidly in communities, and over 60% of deaths have occurred outside Ebola treatment centers, meaning many die at home or in the community before care. Response teams operate in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with MSF treating over 2,000 patients and more than 800 confirmed Ebola infections since the outbreak began. North Kivu shows particularly high mortality and rising distrust toward the response. Trish Newport, MSF Ituri Emergency Project Manager, calls for trained healthcare workers in treatment centers and in communities, plus expanded training and support from WHO, UN agencies, MSF, and the DRC Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ疫情深刻化、死者の6割が治療センター外で発生、医療支援が急務
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最大規模の流行となり、国境管理強化や渡航制限措置が取られている。国際的拡大リスク・重症度・異常性すべてが該当し、WHO等の国際支援要請もあることからPICKUP相当。
triage.notes: MSFが史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行と警告。800人以上の感染確認、死亡者の6割が治療センター外で発生。国境90日間管理延長、21日間の自己隔離措置あり。WHO・国連機関・DRC保健省への支援要請あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Impfdosen in der DR Kongo eingetroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine doses arrived in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains among the deadliest, with over 5,290 infections since May and more than 2,500 deaths across northern and eastern provinces, including Ituri where Bunia airport is closed to commercial traffic, contributing to a liquidity crisis. Transmission is by direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms ranging from fever and muscle pains to diarrhea, internal bleeding and organ failure. The WHO reports a vaccine delivery: 16,000 doses of Ervebo arrived in Kinshasa, part of a planned 70,000-dose shipment. Of these, 20,000 will support a third-phase efficacy trial against the Bundibugyo variant, while 50,000 are allocated to frontline medical personnel. Ervebo is proven for the Zaire strain; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven. The UN Ebola coordinator notes 160 infections among health workers, 43 deaths, and ongoing calls for more funding amid security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンがコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,290人以上の感染、2,500人以上の死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株による流行で、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が未確認である点、医療従事者感染160人・死亡43人、空港閉鎖による流動性危機など複数の懸念材料あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ülke tarihinin en ölümcül salgını: 2 binden fazla kişi hayatını kaybetti! Hâlâ tedavi ve aşı bulunamadı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country's deadliest outbreak in history: More than 2,000 people have died! There is still no treatment or vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is amid its 17th Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri and North Kivu with Bunia and Mongbwalu impacted. The Bundibugyo virus variant has caused 4,945 cases and 2,325 deaths, the fastest-growing outbreak to date. In the last 24 hours, 101 new cases and 33 deaths; more than 1,000 recoveries, 730 still hospitalized or in quarantine. WHO notes the virus spreading at an extraordinary speed; last week recorded 579 cases and 304 deaths. First suspected case involved a healthcare worker in Bunia who died April 24. Official outbreak declaration occurred on May 15 after delays; early tests were negative because initial assays targeted the Zaire strain, with Bundibugyo confirmed later. No approved vaccine or treatment; trials ongoing in Ituri. Challenges include unpaid health workers, security threats, misinformation, and access barriers, hampering response.

triage.headline_ja: 国史上最も致死的な流行:2,000人以上が死亡!未だ治療法・ワクチンは見つからず
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が進行中で、致死率・感染速度ともに深刻かつ異常であり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが異例の速さでの拡大を指摘。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で、治安・誤情報・アクセス問題が対応を阻害。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes siapkan 16 X-ray untuk perkuat deteksi TB di Sulteng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health prepares 16 X-ray units to strengthen TB detection in Central Sulawesi
article.articleSummary: 16 portable X-ray units will be deployed to Central Sulawesi (Sulawesi Tengah), including Palu, to strengthen active detection of tuberculosis (TB). Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus announced the units, each weighing about 3 kilograms and rechargeable, enabling field use and on-site laptop-based result display. The arrival is expected no later than September 2026. Central Sulawesi previously lacked such X-ray capacity; the move aims to broaden screening beyond self-presentation at facilities and reach hard-to-access areas. Nationwide, 278 X-ray units have been distributed to bolster diagnostic capacity. In 2025, TB detections in Central Sulawesi were about 10,066 cases with a treatment success rate around 98%. The program emphasizes screening household contacts of TB patients to interrupt transmission and accelerate TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、中スラウェシ州のTB検出強化のためX線装置16台を用意
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるTB対策強化に関する行政施策のニュースであり、異常性・緊急性はなく、通常の公衆衛生プログラムの一環である。
triage.notes: 治療成功率98%と良好な数値であり、対策強化は既存プログラムの拡充に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongą pasiekė pirmosios vakcinos nuo Ebolos viruso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo has received the first Ebola vaccines.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has received the first 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine, with 70,000 doses expected in total. The shipment was flown to Kinshasa’s airport at night, and the World Health Organization (WHO) announced the delivery, coordinated by the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision. Twenty thousand doses will support a third Ervebo efficacy trial against the Bundibugyo strain, while 50,000 doses are reserved for frontline healthcare workers battling the outbreak. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, but transmission likely began weeks earlier, spanning northern and eastern provinces where medical care is limited by ongoing conflict. The United Nations says Ebola has killed more than 2,500 people in the country. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever and muscle pains, followed by diarrhea and, in severe cases, internal bleeding and organ failure. In Africa, Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in the last 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにエボラウイルスの初のワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中で、死者数が多く、WHO主導でワクチン配布が行われており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関与が明確なため。
triage.notes: エボラはDRCで既知の疾患であり地域的に「異常」ではないが、2500人以上の死者が報告されており重大な公衆衛生上の懸念。紛争地域での医療アクセス制限も流行拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉蔓延民主剛果　無國界醫生：逾6成死者在治療中心外
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Doctors Without Borders: more than 60% of deaths occurred outside treatment centers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak is spreading rapidly in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of August 16, WHO data show 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, with UN officials saying the outbreak is 'out of control.' Doctors Without Borders (MSF) reports that since the outbreak began, they have treated over 2,000 patients and confirmed Ebola in over 800 cases. Disturbingly, MSF notes that over 60% of deaths have occurred outside treatment centers and far from facilities, indicating substantial community transmission and unmet support. In the past week, MSF says deaths rose to roughly one every 30 minutes. Ituri Province MSF program manager Trish Newport calls for deployment of trained staff to treatment centers and affected communities, with intensified infection control and safe patient isolation, and community-centered response. Taiwan extended border controls with the DRC by 90 days to Nov 28; Uganda's measures will be lifted if no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ拡大、国境なき医師団：死者の6割超が治療センター外で発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO・国連が「制御不能」と表明する大規模エボラ流行であり、国際的な渡航制限措置も既に発生しているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは新規症例がなければ措置解除予定とされ、現時点で発生国としての確証はないため除外。台湾は対象国境管理措置を報じているが対象国リストに含まれず、発生国でもないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली-NCR में तेजी से पैर फैला रहा स्वाइन फ्लू! जानें H1N1 किन लोगों को सबसे ज्यादा खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu spreading rapidly in Delhi-NCR! Find out which people are at the greatest risk from H1N1.
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR and parts of India are witnessing a rise in swine flu, or H1N1. In Delhi-NCR, 1,777 H1N1 cases were reported during July–August 2026, up from 229 in 2025. A 62-year-old woman from Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, died after testing positive for H1N1; she had treatment at an Indore private hospital, returned home on Aug 18 against doctors' advice, and died next day in Ujjain. Health authorities issued a hospital notice and formed a team to investigate the death; a positive H1N1 result alone does not prove flu caused the death. H1N1 is influenza A (A(H1N1)pdm09), transmitted via droplets, with fever, dry cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, fatigue, and body aches; vomiting or diarrhea occurs in some cases. High-risk groups include the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with chronic illnesses. Antivirals, vaccination, good hygiene, and seeking care for severe symptoms are advised.

triage.headline_ja: デリー・NCRでスワインフル（H1N1）が急速に拡大！最も危険にさらされる人々とは
triage.triage_reason: デリーNCRおよびマディヤ・プラデーシュ州でH1N1症例が前年比で大幅増加し死亡例も報告されているが、死因確定は未了で国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、既知の季節性インフルエンザである点から現時点ではWATCHとし続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 死亡例はH1N1陽性であったが、死因が本疾患によるものか調査中とされており因果関係は未確定。症例数の急増（229件→1,777件）は季節性インフルエンザの流行拡大を示唆するが、国際的波及や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosna epidemija širi se neviđenom brzinom: Do sada je umrlo više od 2500 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Deadly Epidemic Is Spreading at an Unprecedented Speed: So Far More Than 2,500 People Have Died.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has killed more than 2,500 people by Aug 22, 2026. The epidemic spans an area larger than France and is the deadliest, outpacing the health system. About 160 health workers are infected, 43 dead; attacks on responders and facilities hinder the response; ambulances burned, centers assaulted. UN warns funding is precarious: $30.5 million from Central Emergency Response Fund was allocated but may run out within weeks amid aid cuts. DR Congo halted commercial flights, delaying cash deliveries to thousands involved in the effort. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or drugs; several experimental therapies are under trial. Transmission is by direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people, live or dead. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak, behind 2014–2016 West Africa (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with 11,310 deaths; Congo reached 2,000 deaths within three months of declaration.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的な感染症が前例のない速さで拡大：これまでに2,500人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が2,500人以上の死者を出し、承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、資金不足や対応者への攻撃で対応が困難となっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: フランス・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは流行地域の広さの比較や過去の2014-2016年流行との死者数比較のために言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Poonam Dhillon hospitalised with dengue, health update comes amid CINTAA row
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-22, veteran actress and CINTAA president Poonam Dhillon has been hospitalised at Mumbai’s Lilavati Hospital after being diagnosed with dengue. Dhillon is reportedly recovering and has been admitted for several days, with journalist Vickey Lalwani confirming she told him she was recuperating and wishing her a speedy recovery. The health update comes amid a CINTAA controversy involving mass resignations and allegations against Dhillon, which she has denied. The report centers on her dengue diagnosis and hospitalization alongside the ongoing dispute within the actors’ association, rather than detailing symptoms or treatment. No case counts or fatalities are provided.

triage.headline_ja: プーナム・ディロン、デング熱で入院 CINTAA騒動の渦中で健康状態を報告
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人がデング熱に罹患したという単発の人物ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常性・拡大リスク・社会的関心（公衆衛生的な意味での）は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱自体はインドで流行している疾患だが、本記事は個人の著名人の入院に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Germogli crudi sotto accusa negli Usa: 55 casi tra E. coli e Salmonella, l'allerta investe 15 Stati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raw sprouts under scrutiny in the United States: 55 cases of Escherichia coli and Salmonella, the alert extends to 15 states.
article.articleSummary: US FDA reports an outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts with 55 people sick across 15 states as of 21 August 2026, including four hospitalizations and no deaths. Cases comprise 46 infections with Shiga toxin–producing Escherichia coli, seven with Salmonella Agona, and two with both pathogens. Separately in Europe, EFSA and ECDC describe a multi-country Salmonella Bovismorbificans ST377 outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts; 109 cases in ten EU/EEA countries plus the United Kingdom between January and May 2026, with 18 hospitalizations and Finland recording a death and a probable second. Investigations trace contamination to alfalfa seed lots sourced from India, passing through Italian suppliers before distribution. Sprouts’ warm, moist germination conditions promote pathogen growth; washing is insufficient. Cooking sprouts until steaming hot reduces risk; risks are higher for children, the elderly, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. No confirmed link between US and EU outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で生アルファルファもやしが原因の疑い：大腸菌とサルモネラで55例、15州に警戒拡大
triage.triage_reason: 米国15州とEU/EEA・英国にまたがる複数国規模のアルファルファもやし由来の大腸菌・サルモネラ集団感染で、入院例・死亡例（フィンランド）が報告されており、IHR基準の重大な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大の2基準に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 汚染源としてインド産アルファルファ種子が言及されているが、実際の発症例は米国およびEU/EEA諸国・英国で確認されており、インド国内での発症は報告されていないため対象国リストには含めなかった。米国・EU諸国は対象国リストに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Virus Zika di Bali CDC AS Terbitkan Travel Alert Level 2
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Zika virus in Bali; U.S. CDC issues Travel Alert Level 2.
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, the U.S. CDC issued Travel Alert Level 2 for Bali, Indonesia, due to Zika virus transmission risk. The Level 2, 'Practice Enhanced Precautions', advises travelers to exercise extra vigilance, with emphasis on pregnant women and those planning pregnancy because Zika can cause serious fetal complications. Zika is primarily transmitted by infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes—the same species that spreads dengue and chikungunya. Common symptoms include fever, rash, joint pain, and conjunctivitis, though many infections are asymptomatic. Indonesian health authorities are monitoring the situation, and Bali-specific case counts are under validation to determine current spread at tourism sites. Travelers are advised standard preventive measures: insect repellent, long sleeves and pants, protective mosquito nets or tightly sealed air-conditioned rooms. Local authorities and Bali’s tourism sector are urged to improve environmental hygiene and mosquito source reduction; updates will follow official data releases.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島でジカウイルスに警戒、米CDCが渡航警戒レベル2を発令
triage.triage_reason: 米CDCがバリ島(インドネシア)に対しジカウイルス感染リスクで渡航警戒レベル2を発令しており、渡航制限・国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国はCDCによる渡航警戒発令元であり感染発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。バリ島の症例数は検証中とされ、実際の流行規模は不明。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: تفشي "إيبولا" يتسارع في الكونغو و2500 وفاة خلال 3 أشهر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Ebola outbreak accelerates in the Congo, 2,500 deaths in 3 months.
article.articleSummary: United Nations warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with 2,500 deaths in the past three months, about half of them in the last 20 days. The UN Ebola Response Coordinator said transmission has become widespread, outpacing the ability of response teams to contain it. The Democratic Republic of the Congo declared the seventeenth Ebola wave on May 15, with officials suggesting infections had been spreading for weeks before the official announcement. The statement highlights a rapidly expanding outbreak that challenges surveillance, case finding, isolation, and community engagement, as of August 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が加速、3か月で2500人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 国連が公式にエボラ流行の急速な拡大と多数の死者を警告しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 国連エボラ対応調整官が伝播が制御能力を超えて拡大していると発言。第17波として2026年5月15日に宣言された流行が急速に悪化している。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Are Rising Again: Symptoms, Risks, Prevention And All You Need To Know
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 confirmed H1N1 cases as of 2026, with rising swine flu activity amid changing monsoon weather. H1N1, known as A(H1N1)pdm09, is resurging while health authorities flag H3N2 and its variants as additional seasonal threats. Symptoms overlap with cold, COVID-19 and other respiratory infections, including fever, chills, persistent cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, body aches, fatigue; children may have nausea, vomiting or diarrhoea; severe illness can cause shortness of breath requiring urgent care. Transmission rises in crowded, poorly ventilated indoor spaces; rainy conditions keep people indoors, and waning immunity plus low influenza vaccination uptake increase vulnerability. The 2026-27 Northern Hemisphere flu vaccine includes protection against H1N1, H3N2 and influenza B. Authorities urge annual vaccination, especially for older adults, young children and healthcare workers, plus early detection, prompt treatment, surveillance, hand hygiene, masks in crowds, ventilation, and self-isolation when sick.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1感染者が再び増加中：症状・リスク・予防法など知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例増加が報告されているが、例年見られる季節性流行の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2）のデリーにおける流行状況を伝える健康啓発記事。感染者数増加はあるが、重症度や異常性についての具体的データは限定的。モンスーン時期の季節的傾向として報告されており、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : réception à Kinshasa de 16 520 doses de vaccin contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Arrival in Kinshasa of 16,520 Ebola vaccine doses - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the DRC received the first batch of Ervebo (RVBO) Ebola vaccine doses at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa. The initial 16,520-dose tranche is part of a 50,120-dose delivery expected 21–24 August 2026, funded by Gavi. Doses were manufactured in Germany by MSD and routed through Switzerland, Luxembourg, and Belgium before arrival. The shipment aims to strengthen the government's Ebola response with partner support. The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, officially declared on 15 May 2026, characterized by rapid spread of the Bundibugyo strain, for which no human-approved vaccine previously existed. WHO and the ICG have authorized urgent deployment of Ervebo. The vaccine, originally developed against Zaïre Ebola, is undergoing Phase 3 trials to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo, prioritizing frontline health workers.

article.articleHeadline: ONZ: epidemia eboli w DRK obejmuje obszar większy niż Francja i dalej się rozprzestrzenia | Nauka w Polsce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola epidemic in the DRC covers an area larger than France and continues to spread | Science in Poland
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded to an area larger than France, with over 2,500 deaths. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis, cited by AFP, reports fatalities rising daily, about half in the last 20 days, and deaths outpacing response. In three months, the outbreak surpassed the 2018–2020 eastern DRC epidemic in deaths (2,299/3,381 cases). UN humanitarian head Tom Fletcher notes roughly one death every 30 minutes. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the bundibugyo variant driving this wave, though WHO says DR Congo will receive 70,000 doses of Ervebo, effective in prior outbreaks. Funding for humanitarian actions is secured only for a few weeks and may run out without additional funds. Distrust of medical facilities contributes to over 70% of patients dying in communities rather than treatment centers, with many presenting late.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：DRCのエボラ流行はフランスより広い地域に拡大、さらに拡大継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当。国連・WHOが関与する大規模アウトブレイクであり社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: フランスは流行地域の広さを比較する目的でのみ言及されており、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。bundibugyo変異株による大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療薬不足、資金不足、コミュニティでの死亡率が高い等、深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Tedavisi de aşısı da yok! 2 binden fazla kişiyi hayattan koparan salgın hızla ilerliyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no cure or vaccine! An epidemic that has claimed the lives of more than 2,000 people is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo becomes the country’s fastest, deadliest crisis. In about three months it has caused 2,325 deaths among 4,945 confirmed cases, with Ituri province as the epicenter and six eastern provinces affected, including Bunia and Mongbwalu. The WHO warns of unprecedented transmission; last week recorded 579 cases and 304 deaths, and 101 new cases with 33 deaths in the last 24 hours. About 730 people remain in hospital or quarantine, while recoveries exceed 1,000. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; initial tests were negative because early kits detected only the Zaïre strain, delaying confirmation until May 15. MSF urges rapid scale-up amid misinformation and threats to health workers. Survivors can harbor the virus for months to years in eyes, CNS, and testes, necessitating an 18‑month follow-up program.

triage.headline_ja: 治療法もワクチンもない！2000人以上の命を奪った感染症が急速に拡大

triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はザイール株用の初期検査キットでは検出できず、確認が遅延した点が異常性を高めている。生存者における長期ウイルス保有（眼・中枢神経・精巣）に伴う18か月フォローアッププログラムの必要性も特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में बढ़ा स्वाइन फ्लू का खतरा, एच1एन1 के 1,777 मामले; इन लक्षणों को न करें नजरअंदाज | delhi-swine-flu-h1n1-cases-1777-symptoms-prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu risk has increased in Delhi, 1,777 H1N1 cases; do not ignore these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Delhi is experiencing a surge in H1N1 swine flu with 1,777 confirmed cases to date, including 114 new infections on August 20. As of August 6, 1,344 cases were recorded, indicating an addition of 433 cases in about two weeks. A review meeting with Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda and Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Singh discussed rising cases, affected areas, and hotspot surveillance; Delhi government hospitals will have adequate capacity and dedicated H1N1 wards to curb transmission. The outbreak is substantially higher than last year’s 229 cases by the same period. Experts point to monsoon-related temperature shifts and humidity influencing influenza activity. High-risk groups include the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and individuals with heart, lung, or diabetes conditions. Common symptoms are fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, and fatigue; seek medical care if breathing difficulties arise. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, rest when ill, distancing, and influenza vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi sees rise in H1N1 cases: Know symptoms, treatment and prevention - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 H1N1 cases this year, part of 2,392 influenza-A infections, making H1N1 the predominant influenza strain in the capital. H1N1, or swine flu, spreads mainly via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms typically emerge 3–5 days after exposure and include fever, chills, cough, sore throat, headache, fatigue, and muscle aches; in children, warning signs include difficulty breathing, poor fluid intake, fever with a rash, or confusion. Diagnosis relies on clinical assessment with targeted flu testing. Most healthy individuals recover with rest, fluids, and self-care; fever and body aches may be managed with acetaminophen. Severe illness may require antiviral treatment, such as oseltamivir or zanamivir, ideally started early. Prevent spread through standard hygiene: cover coughs and sneezes, wash hands, avoid touching face, stay home when ill, and avoid sharing utensils. Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen, are severe, or persist.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染例が増加：症状・治療・予防法について
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の通常の流行状況を伝える一般的な健康情報記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す要素が見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 44 ca bệnh giun rồng tại Việt Nam: Cảnh báo nguy cơ từ nguồn nước tự nhiên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 44 cases of Guinea worm disease in Vietnam: Warning about the risk from natural water sources.
article.articleSummary: 44 cases of Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) have been documented in Vietnam since 2020, with Lao Cai Province reporting 27 cases, Phu Tho 14, and Thanh Hoa 3. On August 19, 2026, a patient at Dang Van Nguu Hospital was diagnosed, raising the national total to 44. Transmission is linked to natural water sources in midland/forested areas where people drink from streams; the parasite is acquired via water containing infected Cyclops water fleas. Consumption of undercooked wild animals such as frogs, snakes, and other wildlife may contribute. Surveillance is ongoing but remains challenging and largely passive; authorities call for stronger surveillance, community education, and improved water, sanitation, and animal management. Measures include secure household water, wastewater management, deworming of dogs/cats, and behavior changes to avoid drinking natural water in forest settings. Key questions remain about Vietnam-specific species and reservoirs.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでギニア虫症（メジナ虫症）44例確認：自然水源からの感染リスクに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ギニア虫症は世界的根絶計画の対象疾患であり、非流行国とされるベトナムでの発生・感染経路不明という点で異常性が高く、当局も監視強化を呼びかけているためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 累計44例は2020年からの蓄積数であり、単一の急性アウトブレイクではない。感染源となる種・保虫宿主が未特定である点が公衆衛生上の懸念材料。WHOのギニア虫根絶プログラムとの関連で国際的関心を集める可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: There is no treatment and no vaccine! The epidemic that has taken more than 2,000 people's lives is rapidly spreading.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-moving and deadliest in the country’s history. As of 2026-08-22, 2,325 deaths among 4,945 cases, with about 730 in hospitals or quarantine and over 1,000 survivors. In the last 24 hours: 101 new cases and 33 deaths; weekly totals 579 cases and 304 deaths. The outbreak spans six eastern provinces, with Ituri as epicenter; Bunia hospital cases and Mongbwalu origin traces back to February; first known victim was a healthcare worker who died April 24, and the emergency was declared May 15. No approved vaccine or treatment; trials are underway in Ituri. Diagnostic delays and false test kits detecting only the Zaire strain fueled spread. Health workers face unpaid-wage strikes, threats, and misinformation. An 18-month WHO Survivor Program notes virus persistence in eyes, CNS, and testicles, creating relapse or sexual transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: 治療法もワクチンもない！2,000人以上の命を奪った流行が急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラの大規模流行が発生し、死亡者2,000人超、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなくIHR基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 史上最速・最多死亡のエボラ流行とされ、承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、診断キットの不備や医療従事者のストライキ等、対応能力にも懸念がある。WHOによる生存者フォローアップ・治験実施中。国際的な支援・監視が急務。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Rise In India: Simple Precautions To Protect Yourself From The Viral Swine Flu
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza A (swine flu) is rising in India, with cases across several states and children among the affected. Experts say there is no immediate alarm, but vigilance is advised, especially for vulnerable groups such as children with asthma. Symptoms resemble other flu strains and can include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, muscle aches, fatigue, headaches, and nausea; vomiting and diarrhea are more common in children. No specific case or death counts are provided. Prevention focuses on annual flu vaccination and antivirals under medical guidance. Practical steps: cover coughs and sneezes, wash hands, avoid touching the face, limit close contact with the sick, and stay home when unwell. This report reflects ongoing seasonal flu risk as of 2026-08-22.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie: DR Kongo hat die ersten 16.000 Dosen Ebola-Impfstoff erhalten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: DR Congo has received the first 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, DR Congo received the first 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in Kinshasa as part of a planned 70,000-dose rollout. The outbreak, officially reported on May 15, has spread across multiple provinces in the north and east amid conflict and fragile health systems. Ervebo is validated only against the Zaire ebolavirus strain; Bundibugyo variant circulating in the country necessitates a reserve: 20,000 doses for efficacy testing and 50,000 for frontline healthcare workers. More than 2,500 people have died, with transmission via bodily fluids and symptoms ranging from fever to organ failure. The delivery marks a milestone but not a final solution in a crisis Africa has faced for decades, with ongoing field testing and emergency intervention.

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉已夺2516人命　逾1.6万剂疫苗运抵刚果（金）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed 2,516 lives; more than 16,000 vaccine doses have arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo—As of 22 August 2026, the current Ebola outbreak has 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, the 17th outbreak in DRC since it began on 15 May. The surge is concentrated in the northern and eastern regions amid weak health systems and ongoing armed conflict. Over 16,000 Ervebo vaccine doses arrived Friday night in Kinshasa, with the WHO planning a total of 70,000 Merck Ervebo doses for the country (20,000 for clinical trials, 50,000 for frontline workers). Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus and is not specifically approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though early data suggest possible cross-protection from animal studies. Two Bundibugyo-focused vaccines are in human trials (Moderna’s mRNA vaccine and an Oxford University candidate). A separate rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine is under development by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore. Ebola spreads via contact with body fluids.

article.articleHeadline: ହୋଟେଲରୁ ଖାଇବା ପରେ ଯୁବକ ଗୁରୁତର | Nilagiri Food Poisoning | Youth Hospitalised After Eating at Hotel

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo has received the first batch of vaccines against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo received its first Ebola vaccine doses as part of outbreak response: 16,520 Ervebo doses arrived at Kinshasa's N'djili International Airport, with a further 50,120 doses expected between 21-24 August. The WHO and Africa CDC said the International Coordination Group approved an immediate 70,000-dose initial allocation of Ervebo to the government. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus; its efficacy against Bundibugyo virus remains uncertain. Of the doses, 20,000 will support a phase 3 trial assessing efficacy against Bundibugyo, and 50,000 will go to frontline health workers. The vaccine arrival comes amid active transmission. As of 19 August, the country reported 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, a case fatality rate of 47.6%. The outbreak was declared on 15 May and is the largest and deadliest in the country, and second-largest globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行に対する第一便のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（致死率47.6%、5,290症例、2,516死亡）が継続中であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが認められIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 本流行はコンゴ史上最大・最悪規模であり、ザイールエボラウイルス用ワクチン(Ervebo)の効果が確認されていないBundibugyoウイルス株に対する第3相試験も並行実施中である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में इबोला: तेजी से फैल रहा संक्रमण, मृतकों की संख्या 2,500 के पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: rapidly spreading outbreak, death toll surpasses 2,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating. Africa CDC data as of August 21, 2026 show 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, with authorities estimating many more infections undetected (only 30–40% of cases identified). The Bundibugyo ebolavirus is responsible; no approved vaccine or therapy exists. The outbreak has reached six provinces and 56 health zones, with Bas-Uele reporting two new cases. Early symptoms can be milder than other Ebola types, delaying hospital care. Ongoing armed conflict in eastern DRC, widespread displacement, cross-border movement, and distrust complicate control. Contact tracing remains weak: fewer than 10% of new cases are among monitored contacts, far below the 90–95% target for outbreak control. Most deaths occur in the community (97% as of Aug 17). WHO warns the outbreak could surpass the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic if not contained.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大、死者数が2,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目(重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク)が該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当。WHOが2014-16年西アフリカ流行を超える恐れを警告するなど社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の流行のみが述べられており、アンゴラでの症例発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में इबोला: तेजी से फैल रहा संक्रमण, मृतकों की संख्या 2,500 के पार - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Rapidly Spreading Outbreak, Death Toll Surpasses 2,500
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, August 22, 2026 - Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading rapidly. As of August 21, Africa CDC reports 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, with only 30-40% of cases detected. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo virus; no approved vaccine or therapy exists. Symptoms may be milder than other Ebola types, delaying hospital presentation. Transmission now reaches six provinces and 56 health zones, with Bas-Uele province reporting two new cases. Ongoing conflict, displacement, population movement, and distrust hinder control. About 97% of August 17 deaths occurred outside hospital settings. By week 13, current infections are roughly 10 times those of the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak at the same stage, and deaths about sevenfold higher. If not controlled, WHO warns it could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, surpassing 2014-16 (over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ:急速に拡大する感染、死者数2,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の感染者5,290人・死者2,516人に達し、6州56保健地区に拡大、WHOが史上最悪の流行になる可能性を警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC(バスウエレ州、キンシャサ含む)でのエボラ流行を主題としており、アンゴラは対象国リストとして言及されているが発生地としての具体的記述はないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、院外死亡97%など制御困難な状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, sospiro di sollievo in Trentino: il test è negativo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a sigh of relief in Trentino: the test is negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola was ruled out in a person who returned to Trentino, Italy, after a stay in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Following the appearance of symptoms, public health authorities activated precautionary measures and initiated an investigation as a suspected case. Biological samples collected in Trentino were sent to Luigi Sacco Hospital in Milan, the designated reference center for Ebola testing. Laboratory analyses at Sacco did not detect the virus, and the Ministry of Health officially confirmed the negative result. With this, the suspected case is closed and Ebola infection is excluded. No confirmed cases or deaths are reported in connection with this episode. The episode underscores the importance of travel history in triggering screening, while authorities monitor for potential importations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、トレンティーノで安堵：検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・トレンティーノでの疑い例はエボラ陰性と確定しており、DRCを含む対象国での実際の発生事例ではないため見送りと判定する。
triage.notes: 疑い例はイタリアで検査され陰性が確定。DRCでの具体的な発生・症例情報は記事に記載されていないため、DRCも対象国として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: negativo il test effettuato su caso sospetto emerso in Trentino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the test carried out on a suspected case that emerged in Trentino was negative.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Italy's Ministry of Health said an Ebola test performed at Milan's Sacco Hospital on samples taken in Trentino from a person returning from travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo was negative. The patient, who displayed symptoms, was tested accordingly. The negative result excludes an active Ebola infection at this time. Through the Department of Prevention, the Ministry remains in contact with local health authorities and continues to monitor the evolving situation. The case is linked to travel from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and authorities are maintaining vigilance for potential developments related to travelers. No further details about the patient's status or additional testing were provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:トレンティーノで発生した疑い例に実施した検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでの疑い例はエボラ検査の結果陰性であり、感染は否定された。対象国であるDRCは渡航歴として言及されるのみで、現地での発生事例ではないため懸念要素なし。
triage.notes: 検査結果は陰性でエボラ感染は否定されている。DRCは患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。
