article.articleHeadline: 1,777 cases, zero deaths: The science of H1N1, the surge in Delhi and how it differs from Covid-19
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 H1N1 cases with zero deaths, amid a global context of influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. Pandemic declared June 11, 2009; the pandemic phase ended August 10, 2010, after which the strain circulated as seasonal H1N1 alongside H3N2 and B/Victoria. The first year of circulation worldwide is estimated to have caused about 284,500 respiratory and cardiovascular deaths. R0 estimates for the pandemic strain cluster around 1.3–1.7 (median ~1.46); earlier analyses placed 1.4–1.6. By contrast, ancestral SARS-CoV-2 has a higher R0 (~2.5; range 1.8–3.6), with Omicron driving higher effective transmission. Influenza’s serial interval is ~3 days, enabling rapid spread, aided by efficient household transmission among children. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets; aerosols can extend indoor spread; surfaces may harbor the virus for up to 24 hours. GI symptoms (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea) are more common with H1N1 than older strains. Standard public health measures apply.

triage.headline_ja: 1,777症例、死者ゼロ：H1N1の科学、デリーでの急増、そしてCovid-19との違い
triage.triage_reason: デリーで季節性H1N1インフルエンザの症例増加が報告されているが死亡者はゼロであり、既知の病原体による通常の季節性流行の解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性H1N1インフルエンザの科学的解説記事であり、デリーでの症例数（1,777例、死亡ゼロ）を紹介しつつCovid-19との比較を行う教育的内容。新規または異常な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 逾1.6萬劑伊波拉疫苗運抵民主剛果　疫情已致2516死 - 國際新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine have arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the outbreak has killed 2,516 people.
article.articleSummary: More than 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the country confronts its deadliest Ebola outbreak. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, with the virus believed circulating weeks earlier, mainly impacting northern and eastern regions amid weak control and severely under-resourced health facilities amid long-standing armed groups. The World Health Organization said the country will receive a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses; 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 prioritized for frontline workers and healthcare personnel. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus (Zaire) strain and is not specifically confirmed for the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating; preliminary animal data suggest some protection. As of latest figures, 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: 1.6万回分以上のエボラワクチンがコンゴ民主共和国に到着、感染は既に2,516人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、死者2,516人・確定症例5,290人に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響とWHOによる大規模ワクチン支援が行われている。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行で、通常使用されるErvebo（Zaire株対応）が現在流行しているBundibugyo株に対して有効性未確認である点が懸念材料。武装勢力の存在により医療アクセスが困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo dobio više od 16.000 vakcina protiv ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo received more than 16,000 Ebola vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo received more than 16,000 Ebola vaccine doses as it battles the largest outbreak in its history. About 16,250 doses of Ervebo arrived at Kinshasa International Airport from a package of 70,000 doses promised by the World Health Organization and partners; more doses are expected early next week. The current epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The virus spreads easily and can go undetected because its symptoms resemble malaria and other diseases. Ervebo is licensed to protect against Ebola and has proven effective in prior outbreaks; WHO says it can offer some protection against Bundibugyo. Since February, the outbreak has caused 2,516 deaths and 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが1万6000回分以上のエボラワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（死者2,516人、確定症例5,290人）が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、WHOによる国際支援も行われているため。
triage.notes: 本流行はブンディブギョ株（Bundibugyo Ebola virus）によるもので、承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない。症状がマラリアに類似するため検出が困難であり、疫学的拡大リスクが高い。WHOおよびパートナーが7万回分のワクチン供給を約束しており、国際的な支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases rise in Manila to 50 amid flooding
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Manila’s San Lazaro Hospital have risen to 50, with two deaths amid persistent flooding from heavy rains. Nationwide confirmed cases reach 3,760, with authorities warning the total may climb in coming days. San Lazaro Hospital, the DOH’s national infectious-diseases referral center, has opened an express lane for leptospirosis patients. In Iloilo Province, at least 10 leptospirosis deaths were reported over the past eight months, with the toll doubling versus the same period in 2025, according to local media. Residents are urged to take prophylaxis or preventive antibiotics if exposed. A total of 88 cities and municipalities have declared a state of calamity due to the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones. Hardest-hit areas include Pampanga, Bataan, and Bulacan, where extensive flooding has submerged villages, evacuated residents, and agricultural damage (≈P1.4 billion).

triage.headline_ja: マニラで洪水の中、レプトスピラ症患者が50人に増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症患者・死亡者が増加しており、政府が非常事態を宣言するなど社会的・行政的関心が高いため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水後に季節的に発生する疾患であり人-人感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、死亡者数増加と広域での被害（88の市町村が非常事態宣言）から国内公衆衛生上の関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes RI: Sulteng masuk enam provinsi penemuan kasus TB tertinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister of the Republic of Indonesia: Central Sulawesi among six provinces with the highest TB case detections.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Indonesia: Central Sulawesi is among six provinces with the highest TB case detection in 2025, reporting 8,419 cases from an estimated 10,066 (83.6%), with about 90% of detected cases treated. As of 16 August 2026, Central Sulawesi ranks eighth nationally, with 4,770 cases from an estimated 9,968 (47.9%). District-level detection is led by Tojo Una-Una (296/461, 64.2%), followed by Morowali (426/723, 58.9%), Palu (1,062/2,066, 51.4%), and Sigi (352/690, 51%). Other districts show lower detection, including Parigi Moutong (541 cases, 46.9%), Poso (330, 44.5%). Health officials warn that high detection and treatment alone cannot reduce transmission if spread persists at home; emphasis on screening household contacts and providing preventive therapy. National efforts include TB screening at 53,335 locations; Central Sulawesi will conduct activities at 508 locations across 13 districts.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健副大臣:中スラウェシ州、結核症例発見数最多6州の一つに
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の症例発見率に関する定例的な行政報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す要素は見られない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は国内保健当局による症例発見率向上の取り組みに関する定例報告。突発的なアウトブレイクではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 一旦接触就是Ⅲ级暴露！携带大量病毒，现在正是高峰期，多地出现_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Any contact is a Level-III exposure! Carrying a large viral load, now at its peak, appearing in many regions — NetEase Mobile.
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Beijing as bat intrusions into homes rise this summer. From May 1 to Aug 18, 2026, Fengtai District Fire Rescue logged 203 bat-disturbance calls, nearly double the 102 recorded in the same period last year. Urban ecological improvements and warm, rainy conditions are boosting bat activity; East Asian bats roost in building gaps and vent ducts, entering apartments via unsealed air-conditioning openings or torn screens. Direct contact with a bat is categorized as Level-III exposure (highest risk) for rabies, even without obvious wounds. A recent case involved a person struck in the face by a bat, treated with five rabies vaccines and six-dose passive immunization around the exposure site. Immediate guidance: rinse exposed areas with soap and running water for about 15 minutes, disinfect with iodine, and seek urgent evaluation at a rabies post-exposure clinic for PEP. Do not handle bats; ventilate rooms and seal gaps.

triage.headline_ja: 接触すればIII級曝露！大量のウイルスを保有、今がピーク期、各地で発生
triage.triage_reason: 北京でコウモリの住宅侵入が増加しているという注意喚起記事であり、実際の狂犬病アウトブレイクや確定症例の急増は報告されていない。個別の曝露事例の予防啓発が主目的。
triage.notes: 記事は北京市内でのコウモリ目撃・侵入件数の増加（消防出動件数の統計）と狂犬病曝露時の対応ガイダンスを伝える啓発記事。狂犬病の確定症例数や集団発生の報告はなく、季節的なコウモリ活動増加に関する公衆衛生広報の域を出ない。

article.articleHeadline: फिलीपींस की राजधानी में बाढ़ के बाद बीमारी का संकट, तेजी से बढ़ रहा लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis Rapidly Spreading as Health Crisis After Flood in Manila
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis rapidly spreading in the Philippines following heavy rains and floods, with Manila’s major infectious diseases hospital reporting 50 cases and 2 deaths. The Department of Health notes 3,760 cases nationwide to date, with numbers likely to rise as floods persist. In Iloilo province (Central Philippines), about 10 leptospirosis deaths occurred over the last eight months, with current-period fatalities already doubling those in 2025 for the same interval. San Lazaro Hospital, the national infectious-diseases referral center, opened an express lane for leptospirosis patients. Civil Defense reports disaster declarations in 88 cities and municipalities due to the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones. Pampanga is the hardest hit, affecting more than 1 million people and causing about 1.4 billion pesos (roughly 22.68 million USD) in agricultural losses; Batangas evacuated around 8,000 residents, and Bulacan’s Santa Maria bridge was closed after flooding. The government has issued an official disaster emergency declaration.

triage.headline_ja: マニラで洪水後にレプトスピラ症が急速に拡大、健康危機に
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後にレプトスピラ症患者が全国で3,760例、複数の死亡例が報告されており、政府が災害緊急事態を宣言するなど公衆衛生上の影響が深刻であるため。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は人-人感染しない水系感染症であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、洪水継続による曝露拡大と死亡例増加が懸念される。フィリピン国内の季節性アウトブレイクとして毎年発生するが、今回は規模・死亡者数が前年を上回っている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Редок сој, илјадници мртви и неплатени лекари: Пет големи прашања за новата епидемија на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Rare Strain, Thousands Dead and Unpaid Doctors: Five Big Questions About the New Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches 4,945 confirmed cases, about 2,325 deaths, and roughly 1,040 survivors. Approximately 730 patients are hospitalized, with 850 listed as missing, creating a hidden transmission risk. The outbreak is driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain, in conflict-affected Ituri and North Kivu, where contact tracing covers only about 12% of contacts (target 95%). Authorities have shifted to door-to-door case finding amid disrupted logistics: Bunia airport closed to commercial flights; frontline workers paid largely in cash, with strikes possible. Despite pledges of $518 million, only about half has been disbursed. Two vaccines are in trials; Ervebo (Zaire strain) may offer cross-protection and reduce mortality. Local laboratories are conducting testing. Mortality is around 47%; officials hope village-focused efforts yield gains within three months, though ending by December is unlikely, with South Sudan monitoring for spillover after West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll.

triage.headline_ja: 希少株、数千人の死者、未払いの医師たち：新たなエボラ流行に関する5つの大きな疑問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で希少なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が拡大し、致死率約47%、接触追跡率も目標を大きく下回るなど、深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、国際的拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性も認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）のエボラ流行に焦点を当てている。スーダン・アンゴラは監視対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。空港閉鎖・資金不足・行方不明患者850人など複数の懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: फिलीपींस की राजधानी में बाढ़ के बाद बीमारी का संकट, तेजी से बढ़ रहा लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis Spreading Rapidly as Disease Crisis Follows Floods in Manila, the Capital of the Philippines.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 22, 2026, Leptospirosis is spreading rapidly in the Philippines after floods hit Manila. In Manila, cases at a major infectious-disease hospital have reached 50 with two deaths. The Department of Health (DOH) has opened an express lane at San Lazaro Hospital for leptospirosis patients. Nationwide, 3,760 cases have been reported and the tally is expected to rise. In Iloilo Province (Central Philippines), about 10 deaths occurred in eight months, with fatalities reportedly doubling versus 2025. Authorities urge immediate prophylaxis or preventive antibiotics for those exposed. The Civil Security Office says 88 cities/municipalities are in disaster due to the Southwest Monsoon and tropical cyclones. Worst-affected: Pampanga, Batangas, and Bulacan; Pampanga has more than half of villages flooded, about 1 million people affected, agriculture losses around P1.4 billion. Batangas has declared disaster; ~8,000 evacuees. In Bulacan, flood damage closed a bridge in Santa Maria.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンの首都マニラで洪水後にレプトスピラ症が急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン全土で3,760例、複数の死亡例が報告され、政府が特別対応（エクスプレスレーン開設等）を取っており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 洪水後の季節性レプトスピラ症流行であり病原体自体は新規性がないが、症例数・死亡者数の増加と広範な洪水被害（パンパンガ、バタンガス、ブラカン州）により公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）收到首批埃博拉疫苗 将评估保护效果-新闻中心-北方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo has received the first batch of Ebola vaccines and will assess protective efficacy.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo received the first batch of Ebola vaccines (Ervebo, rVSV-ZEBOV) for Zaire ebolavirus, with efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus unproven. The initial 16,520 doses arrived in Kinshasa on Aug 21; about 50,120 more are expected Aug 21–24. The WHO-led allocation plan dedicates 70,000 Ervebo doses: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo, and Ervebo’s protective effect against it is unconfirmed though early lab/animal data suggest possible benefit. UN Ebola Emergency Coordinator Julian Haines warned Bunia, Ituri Province, of exponential growth and funding/logistics constraints. As of Aug 19, there are 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, with 1,152 recoveries; 160 health workers infected (43 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチンの初回分を受領、防御効果を評価へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが継続中で、死者2,516人・確定患者5,290人に達し、国連が指数関数的拡大を警告するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的対応の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 現行の流行はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるもので、既存のエルベボワクチン（ザイール株対応）の有効性は未確認。WHO主導で第3相試験用2万回分と医療従事者向け5万回分の配分計画が進行中。資金・物流面の制約が国連担当者により指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Ajak Mahasiswa Untad Perangi Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Wiyagus Urges UNTAD Students to Fight Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged Universitas Tadulako (Untad) students in Central Sulawesi to lead TB control efforts, outlining four roles: act as first-screening agents within families; accompany TB patients to prevent treatment interruption and reduce stigma; drive digital campaigns and innovative research; and engage directly in villages through the Kuliah Kerja Nyata (KKN) program. He praised Untad’s Berani Magaya initiative by the Faculty of Public Health as evidence of youth commitment to public health. While student involvement is vital, provincial and district governments must also implement TB services per the Minimal Service Standards, given geopolitical and supply-chain uncertainties affecting medicines. TB response cannot rely solely on the Ministry of Health; a “super team”—central government, local authorities, universities, students, and communities—must collaborate. Untad’s campus-based innovations should be replicated to accelerate TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣ウィヤグス、タドゥラコ大学の学生に結核撲滅を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性疾患である結核に対する啓発・政策的呼びかけの記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 政府高官による結核対策の啓発活動に関する記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常発生の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國收到首批伊波拉疫苗　將評估保護效果
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has received its first batch of Ebola vaccines and will assess their protective efficacy.
article.articleSummary: First batch of Ebola vaccines arrives in Kinshasa as the Democratic Republic of the Congo prepares to test protective efficacy against the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The health ministry said 16,520 doses reached the capital on Friday, with more than 50,000 additional doses expected in coming days. There are no vaccines or specific therapies approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and early lab and animal data suggest vaccines approved for Zaire ebolavirus may offer some protection. The World Health Organization has allocated 70,000 doses of Zaire ebolavirus vaccine for this response: 20,000 for phase 3 trials to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and 50,000 for frontline health workers and other responders. The effort aims to gauge efficacy against the current outbreak while protecting frontline staff as vaccination campaigns scale up.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、初のエボラワクチンを受領し、防御効果を評価へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で承認薬・ワクチンのないブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが継続しており、WHOが緊急にワクチンを大量配布するなど国際的関与が既に生じているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスアウトブレイクへの対応（ワクチン配布・第3相試験）を報じるもの。ザイール型ワクチンの当該株への有効性は未確立であり、WHOによる7万回分の配布と第一線医療従事者への接種計画が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 中國COVID-19疫情達高峰平台期 開始下降
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 pandemic has reached a peak plateau and begun to decline.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China reached a peak plateau in early to mid August 2026 and has begun to decline, with infections predominantly mild. The trend is more pronounced in southern regions, according to the China CDC. No variants detected that pose major public health risks, and the fluctuations have not disrupted overall medical services. The National Health Commission and China CDC spokespersons noted the year’s pandemic dynamics showed cyclic waves but limited clinical severity. In September, flu vaccination programs will roll out nationwide, as the autumn-winter season also brings higher activity of varicella (chickenpox), rhinovirus, norovirus, and enteroviruses causing hand, foot, and mouth disease, with schools a focal point for infection control. No information on imported/exported cases. The emphasis remains on routine surveillance and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のCOVID-19流行はピークプラトーに達し、減少傾向に転じ始めた
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の流行動態であり、重症度は低く、医療体制への影響もないため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は軽症中心でピークを過ぎ減少傾向。新規変異株の公衆衛生リスクも確認されておらず、通常の季節性感染症対策（インフルワクチン接種、水痘・ノロウイルス等への注意喚起）の一環として報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo receives 1st batch of vaccines to contain Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo receives the first batch of 16,520 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to help contain the outbreak, with more than 50,000 additional doses expected by Monday. The World Health Organization said 70,000 more vaccines would be supplied from the global stockpile for a Phase 3 trial to assess the vaccine’s impact on Bundibugyo virus and for frontline health workers; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease (Zaire ebolavirus). Confirmed infections in the current outbreak reach 5,290 cases with over 2,500 deaths. MSF warns communities are not receiving adequate support, calling for urgent training of health workers and community leaders on case detection, referrals, and infection prevention and control. The epidemic affects 56 health zones across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo, outbreak declared mid-May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行対策のためワクチン第1便を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例5,290例・死亡2,500人超、56保健地域に及ぶ大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 今回の流行はブンディブギョウイルス（Bundibugyo virus）による可能性が示唆されており、通常のザイールエボラウイルス用ワクチン（Ervebo）とは異なる株のため、Phase3試験用ワクチンが別途投入されている点に注意。MSFは地域社会への支援不足を指摘しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Poonam Dhillon Health Update: Veteran Actress Hospitalised in Mumbai, Diagnosed With Dengue
article.articleSummary: 64-year-old Bollywood veteran Poonam Dhillon has been hospitalised at Mumbai's Lilavati Hospital after a dengue diagnosis. As of 22 August 2026, she is recovering; journalist Vickey Lalwani said she confirmed improvement, with no serious complications disclosed. Dhillon is president of the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA). Her illness coincides with an internal leadership dispute within CINTAA, after eight elected executive members resigned earlier this month amid governance concerns. Upasana Singh, CINTAA General Secretary, has alleged lack of transparency and unilateral decisions, while former treasurer Deepak Parashar and senior vice-president Padmini Kolhapure have also issued allegations against Dhillon; Dhillon has rejected some claims as offensive. FWICE has announced 12 September as the date for fresh CINTAA elections, though CINTAA has disputed aspects of the developments surrounding its administration. Dhillon and Kolhapure maintain they act in CINTAA's interests while focusing on her dengue recovery.

triage.headline_ja: プーナム・ディロン、健康状態を更新：ベテラン女優がムンバイで入院、デング熱と診断
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人が単発でデング熱に罹患した事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は著名人の個人的な健康状態とCINTAA内部の組織対立に関する内容で、デング熱の流行や公衆衛生上の懸念とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية تتلقى لقاحات إيبولا وسط تفشٍ غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Receives Ebola Vaccines Amid an Unprecedented Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Over 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the country confronts its largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba notes Ervebo has been used in prior outbreaks, including 2018–2020. UN response lead Julian Harneys warned the outbreak is accelerating. The World Health Organization has allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses to DRC: 20,000 for a Phase III trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and 50,000 to protect health workers and frontline staff. Government data report 5,290 confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths, with the outbreak across six provinces. This wave surpasses the 2018–2020 epidemic in case counts, marking the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、前例のない規模のエボラ流行の中でワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定感染5,290例、死亡2,516例、6州に拡大）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOがErvebo ワクチン70,000回分（第III相試験用20,000回分、医療従事者保護用50,000回分）を割り当て。2018-2020年流行を症例数で上回り、史上最大規模と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Entwarnung: Ebola-Verdachtsfall im Trentino hat sich nicht bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All clear: Ebola suspected case in Trentino has not been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: All clear: Ebola suspected case in Trentino has not been confirmed. In Trentino, an adult who had traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo developed symptoms compatible with Ebola; the Italian Ministry of Health's precautionary protection and health protocol was activated on Thursday. The patient was isolated at home; biological samples were collected by health service staff and sent to Milan's Luigi Sacco Hospital for testing. Results from the Milan lab were negative, excluding an Ebola virus infection. The integrated health facility in Trentino confirmed the negative result and stated no evidence of Ebola infection. The precautionary measures were part of the standard procedure for a suspected case and have since been terminated.

triage.headline_ja: 解除:トレンティーノのエボラ疑い例は確認されなかった
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・トレンティーノでのエボラ疑い例は検査の結果陰性であり感染は確認されなかった。対象国での発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の懸念も解消済み。
triage.notes: 疑い例はイタリアで発生し検査により陰性が確定。DRCへの渡航歴があるが実際の感染発生国はイタリアであり、対象国リストに該当する発生国はない。

article.articleHeadline: फिलीपींस की राजधानी में बाढ़ के बाद बीमारी का संकट, तेजी से बढ़ रहा लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस | Leptospirosis cases rise in Philippine capital amid flooding
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis cases rise in Philippine capital amid flooding.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases rise to 50 at Manila's San Lazaro Hospital, with 2 deaths, amid torrential rains and floods. San Lazaro, the DOH-run national infectious-diseases referral center, opened an Express Lane for leptospirosis patients. The DOH reports 3,760 cases nationwide to date, with numbers expected to climb. In Iloilo Province in the Central Philippines, about 10 deaths occurred in the past eight months, doubling the toll vs 2025 for the same period. Officials urge prompt use of prophylaxis or preventive antibiotics if infection is suspected. Civil Defense says 88 cities and municipalities have declared disaster due to the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones. Pampanga, Batangas, and Bulacan are hardest-hit; Pampanga reports widespread flooding affecting nearly 1 million people and 1.4 billion pesos in agricultural losses. Batangas: about 8,000 residents evacuated; Bulacan's Santa Maria Bridge closed due to flooding.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンの首都で洪水後にレプトスピラ症が急増
triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴いレプトスピラ症の症例・死亡者数が増加しており、全国で3,760例に達するなど公衆衛生への影響と政府対応（DOH・民間防衛）が確認されるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年の台風・モンスーン季に頻発する既知の疾患であり、異常性は低いが、症例数増加・死亡例・広範な洪水被害により継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола виходить з-під контролю: спалах ризикує стати найсмертоноснішим в історії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is out of control: the outbreak risks becoming the deadliest in history.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is worsening. Official counts show 5,290 confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths, but authorities and WHO Africa agencies estimate only 30–40% of cases are detected. Ebola coordinator Julien Garneis notes that half of the fatalities occurred in the last 20 days, with transmission in the north and east increasing in geometric progression. Contact tracing remains severely weak, with fewer than 10% of infections identified among known contacts; control is typically considered feasible at 90–95%. The outbreak is believed to have started in February in the mining town of Mongbvalu, though an official declaration came on 15 May. Challenges include ongoing conflict, sanitation and infrastructure gaps, and distrust of the health system, fueling misinformation and delayed care. The UN stockpile aims to deliver 70,000 Ervebo doses, with preliminary data suggesting possible protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. If trends persist, the outbreak could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (>11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラは制御不能に：この流行は史上最悪の死者数となる恐れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者・死者数が急増し、接触者追跡が機能不全で国際的拡大や史上最悪規模となるリスクが高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRCでの流行のみを主題としており、Angolaでの発生は記載がないため除外した。致死率や検出率の低さから実際の被害規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: DRC gets 16,520 Ebola vaccine doses amid deadly outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC received 16,520 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses in Kinshasa as authorities race to contain an outbreak that has killed more than 2,500 people and spread across six provinces. An additional 50,000 doses were expected by Monday, with 70,000 total from the global stockpile: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial testing protection against the Bundibugyo strain and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo targets the Zaire strain, but the current outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccine exists; early data suggest possible cross-protection, prompting a large human trial. Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak was declared May 15 and has reached 56 health zones in Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo. Confirmed infections exceed 5,290 with over 2,500 deaths. UN warns exponential growth; MSF urges expanded training. Trials include Moderna and Oxford vaccines; Hilleman Laboratories’ rVSV Bundibugyo candidate is under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、致死的アウトブレイクの中でエボラワクチン16,520回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6州56保健区に拡大、感染者5,290人超・死者2,500人超の大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行はBundibugyo株が主体で、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo、Zaire株対象）の有効性が不明なため第3相試験を実施中。UNは指数関数的拡大を警告、MSFは訓練拡充を要請しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se descontrola en la República Democrática del Congo con 2.500 muertos en solo 100 días
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spirals out of control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with 2,500 deaths in just 100 days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared 100 days ago, has caused 2,500 deaths, with half in the last 20 days. The epidemic now covers terrain larger than France, while access to affected zones is hampered by violence against health workers and attacks on ambulances in the eastern region where conflict endures. Health workers are heavily affected: 160 infections and 43 deaths among responders; more than 260 assaults in six months, eight attacker fatalities. Ambulances have been vandalized or burned, and 60-km trips can take up to three hours. The UN aims to boost hospital capacity from about 900 beds to 3,000 within three months; funding of about $80 million is nearly exhausted. Around 50,000 vaccine doses have been given to frontline staff; vaccination must accompany surveillance and community engagement. Nearby: South Sudan, Central African Republic, Burundi, and Uganda are increasing preparedness to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が制御不能に、わずか100日で2,500人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による大規模死亡者数（100日で2,500人）、医療従事者への攻撃による対応困難、周辺国への越境拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にスーダン・フランス・中央アフリカ共和国・ブルンジ・ウガンダが含まれるが、記事本文ではこれらは越境拡大への備えを強化している周辺国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。対象国リストにはDRC以外（南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、ブルンジ、ウガンダ）は含まれないため除外。資金不足（$80M枯渇間近）や病床拡充計画（900→3000床）は国際支援の必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Тревога в Конго: Започват спешна ваксинация срещу ебола, болестта се разпространява по-бързо от мерките за овладяването ѝ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Congo: Emergency vaccination against Ebola begins, the disease is spreading faster than containment measures.
article.articleSummary: Emergency vaccination against Ebola begins in the Democratic Republic of Congo as authorities struggle to contain the deadliest outbreak in the country's history. WHO warns transmission in northern and eastern regions is expanding exponentially, with the outbreak spanning a territory larger than France and nearly 2,500 deaths since it was declared three months ago; about half of fatalities have occurred in the last 20 days. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Ervebo vaccination (protective against Zaire ebolavirus) offers no proven protection against Bundibugyo. A clinical trial will use 20,000 doses of Ervebo to assess cross-protection, while 50,000 doses will be reserved for frontline health workers. Save the Children notes at least 180 children have lost one or both parents. Security disruptions and local distrust, plus M23 rebel controls in North Kivu, hinder response. Two travelers tested positive in M23-controlled territory; cross-zone movement will be halted for a month.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで警報：エボラ出血熱に対する緊急ワクチン接種開始、感染は封じ込め対策より速く拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、死者数急増・地理的拡大・渡航制限措置が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: フランスは流行地域の広さの比較対象として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。北キブ州はDRCに含まれる。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で既存ワクチン（Ervebo）の交差防御効果が不明な点が特に異常性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）收到首批伊波拉疫苗 将评估保护效果
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo has received its first batch of Ebola vaccines and will evaluate protective efficacy.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has received the first batch of Ebola vaccines to address the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, the nation’s deadliest to date. An initial shipment of 16,250 Ervebo vaccines arrived by air on August 21 at Kinshasa, with over 50,000 more doses expected by August 24 and a total of about 70,000 doses planned. Ervebo, developed by Merck, targets Zaire ebolavirus; its efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is being evaluated, as no specific vaccine or therapy exists for this strain. The outbreak, centered in Ituri Province (Bunia) and extending into northern and eastern regions, has caused thousands of deaths. As of August 19, 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, with 1,152 recoveries; 160 health workers infected, 43 of whom have died. WHO notes rapid case growth and urgent need for funding to sustain response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチンの初回分を受領し、防御効果を評価へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行が継続中で、5290例・2516死亡、医療従事者感染も多数発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株は既存ワクチン（Ervebo、ザイール株対象）の有効性が未確認であり、専用治療法も存在しないため、今後の疫学的推移とワクチン効果評価の続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تتسلم أكثر من 16 ألف جرعة من لقاح "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 16,250 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine amid a spiraling outbreak caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The doses arrived at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa late Friday as part of a 70,000-dose package announced by the World Health Organization and partners, with more expected next week. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed specific treatment or vaccine, and it can spread rapidly and be hard to detect because its symptoms resemble malaria. Ervebo, approved for Ebola outbreaks, has shown effectiveness in past eruptions and may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, according to WHO. As of Friday, the outbreak has produced 5,290 laboratory-confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths, an unprecedented transmission trajectory potentially surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemics, which killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン1万6000回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）満たし、致死率の高い希少株による前例のない規模の流行が進行中でWHOによる国際支援も行われているため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、確定感染者5,290人、死者2,516人と2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性がある前例のない規模。マラリアと症状が類似し検出が困難な点も懸念材料。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では発生国として言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола выходит из-под контроля: вспышка может стать самой смертоносной в истории
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spiraling out of control: the outbreak could become the deadliest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating toward what could be the deadliest in history. Confirmed data show 5,290 cases and 2,516 deaths, but authorities estimate only 30-40% of cases are detected. A WHO Ebola coordinator says half of all deaths occurred in the last 20 days, with north and east spreading geometrically. Contact tracing remains weak: fewer than 10% of infections are identified among known contacts; control targets are 90-95%. The outbreak may have begun in February in the mining town Mongbwalu, with official declaration on May 15. Challenges include armed conflict, sanitation and infrastructure problems, and distrust in health services leading to misinformation and reliance on traditional medicine. 70,000 doses of Ervebo from UN stock await deployment; efficacy against Bundibugyo virus is not proven, though preliminary data hint at protection. If dynamics persist, deaths could exceed 11,000, surpassing 2014-2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能に：この流行は史上最悪の致死的アウトブレイクになる可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が加速し、致死率が高く、封じ込め能力（接触者追跡率10%未満）が著しく不足しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー上ではDRCのみが主題であるため除外した。WHOによるワクチン(Ervebo)70,000回分の展開待ちなど、国際的対応が既に進行中であり緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ארגון הבריאות העולמי: התפרצות האבולה הנוכחית בדרך להיות הקשה בהיסטוריה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The current Ebola outbreak is on track to become the worst in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at an unprecedented pace, with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the United Nations warning that the current outbreak could become the worst in history. Africa CDC and Congolese authorities report that the outbreak has not yet peaked, and, at the current transmission rate, it is expected to be larger and more deadly than the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO):現在のエボラ出血熱の流行は史上最悪になる見込み
triage.triage_reason: WHO・国連が史上最悪の流行になる可能性を警告しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO・国連・Africa CDCが史上最悪の流行になる可能性を警告しており、コンゴ民主共和国での感染拡大が継続中。ピークに達していないとの報告あり。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu scare: Why Delhi is seeing uptick in H1N1 cases; symptoms to watch out for and how to stay safe
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR is seeing a spike in Influenza A (H1N1) infections, with 2,392 Influenza-A cases this year and 1,777 confirmed H1N1, per the Delhi health department; 114 H1N1 cases were recorded on Thursday. Symptoms resemble seasonal flu and include fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches, and fatigue; some patients report cold, watery eyes and general weakness. H1N1 is a respiratory virus spread person-to-person; authorities urge good hand hygiene and mask use in crowded or high-risk settings, timely testing, and isolation after a positive result. Most infections are mild and resolve with supportive care, though antivirals may be prescribed if started early or in high-risk individuals. Elderly, immunocompromised, and those with underlying conditions should seek prompt medical care. Health authorities are strengthening hospitals to manage the seasonal increase.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザ警戒:デリーでH1N1症例が増加傾向、注意すべき症状と予防法
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ株）の症例数が増加しているが、多くは軽症で既知の病原体であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、記事では大半が軽症と報告。デリー保健当局が病院体制を強化しているが、重症化や死亡例の具体的言及はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 alert: Health ministry lists symptoms to look for as Delhi crosses 1,700 cases
article.articleSummary: Delhi crosses 1,700 H1N1 cases as MoHFW urges early recognition of swine flu symptoms. A Health Ministry X post lists fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches and fatigue, with lethargy, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, joint/muscle pain, and diarrhoea as common symptoms. Transmission is via respiratory droplets and close contact; prevention emphasizes staying home when ill, covering coughs/sneezes, regular handwashing, improved ventilation, and mask use in crowded indoor settings. Delhi government calls for vigilance and timely treatment, advising medical consultation and against self-medication. Union health minister JP Nadda reviewed Delhi’s preparedness for influenza and vector-borne diseases as the city records 2,392 influenza A cases this year, including 1,777 H1N1 infections, underscoring ongoing outbreak management in the capital.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1警報：デリーの感染者数が1,700人を超え、保健省が注意すべき症状を発表
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者が1,700人を超え、保健省・保健大臣が対応を強化するなど社会的・行政的関心が高く、持続的な曝露とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるためフルRRAへの移行を検討する。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとしてインドで毎年流行する既知の疾患であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、症例数の増加とヒト-ヒト感染リスク、行政・メディアの高い関心からWATCH以上の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, arrivate oltre 16mila dosi di vaccino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, more than 16,000 vaccine doses have arrived.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, received over 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant, the claim to the most severe Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The outbreak has caused 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed cases. A total of 70,000 doses have been allocated: 20,000 for use in a clinical trial and 50,000 for frontline health workers and responders. Efficacy against this Bundibugyo-associated outbreak remains to be confirmed. The arrival of vaccines supports outbreak control and vaccination capacity, with distribution to frontline personnel and ongoing clinical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ、1万6千回分以上のワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高い大規模エボラ流行（5,290症例中2,516死亡）が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約47.6%と非常に高く、ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン有効性は未確認。国際支援（ワクチン供給・臨床試験）が既に行われている点からも国際的関心の高い進行中の大規模流行と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Doença do Lito: Creutzfeldt-Jakob tem ligação com vaca louca? Entenda condição
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lito's Disease: Does Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease Have a Link to Mad Cow Disease? Understand the Condition.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-22, a Brazilian influencer's wife disclosed that her husband, 59-year-old Lito Sousa, has Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD). CJD is a rare, prion neurodegenerative disease that is progressive and fatal. Early symptoms include dementia, memory loss, and tremors, followed by other neurological and multifocal signs. The disease occurs when the normal cellular prion protein (PrPC) misfolds into the disease-causing form (PrPSc); prions accumulate in the brain, promoting spongiform changes and neuronal death. With widespread brain dysfunction, patients develop severe cognitive and motor decline leading to death. The report situates CJD among prion disorders and notes discussions of a potential link to mad cow disease (bovine spongiform encephalopathy). The Ministry of Health in Brazil is cited in describing the condition.

triage.headline_ja: リト氏の病気:クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病は狂牛病と関連があるのか?病態を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 個別の著名人1名のCJD罹患に関する解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生や国際的拡大リスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: 散発性CJDは孤発性疾患として世界的に一定数発生するものであり、本記事も個人の症例紹介・疾患解説が主旨。BSEとの関連は一般的な情報提供であり、実際の集団感染や動物由来感染の証拠は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La République Démocratique du Congo reçoit les premières cargaisons de vaccin contre Ebola au milieu d'une épidémie accélérée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first shipments of the Ebola vaccine amid an accelerated outbreak
article.articleSummary: 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the country faces a widespread Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization allocated 70,000 doses for DRC: 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The current outbreak is the 17th in the DRC, with 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, and UN response coordinators warn that transmission is accelerating. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but its effectiveness against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently circulating in the DRC is not yet determined, prompting WHO to call for large-scale clinical trials to evaluate protection. The shipment signals intensified vaccination efforts amid ongoing transmission, including protection for frontline staff and evidence gathering through trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、感染拡大が加速するエボラ流行の中でワクチンの初回輸送分を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(症例5,290、死亡2,516)が拡大加速中であり、国際的なワクチン対応が展開されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 現在流行中の株はBundibugyo型であり、既存ワクチンErveboの有効性が未確定であるため、大規模臨床試験の実施が求められている点は重要な追加リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Lunda-Sul regista primeiro caso de varíola dos macacos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lunda-Sul records first case of monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed monkeypox (Mpox) case in Lunda-Sul province, Angola. A 42-year-old national truck driver presented with widespread vesicular lesions and was seen at Lunda-Sul General Hospital. Diagnostic samples were sent to Luanda, and mpox was laboratory-confirmed. Health authorities activated epidemiological surveillance to monitor the patient’s clinical evolution and identify direct contacts. The patient transports goods between Lunda-Sul, Moxico-Leste, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with exposure possibly linked to road-side animal meat consumption, though the infection source remains under investigation. The patient is clinically stable and receiving medical care. Officials intensified contact tracing and reinforced surveillance, training health workers to boost response capacity. Public guidance urges avoiding direct contact with suspected lesions and seeking care for compatible symptoms; cross-border vigilance near DR Congo is strengthened.

triage.headline_ja: ルンダ・スル州で初のサル痘（Mpox）症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: アンゴラ・ルンダ・スル州での初のMpox症例確認であり、越境トラック運転手を介したDRCとの往来という国際拡大リスクが示唆されるため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）に2項目該当する。
triage.notes: 発生国はアンゴラ（対象国リスト外）。患者はDRCとの国境地帯を往来するトラック運転手だが、DRC国内での発生・感染確認は記載されていないため、DRCはverified_locationsに含めない。感染源（路上での動物肉摂取の可能性）は調査中であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Virus pericolosi in laboratorio, il rischio che riapre il caso biosicurezza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous viruses in the laboratory, the risk of reopening the biosafety case.
article.articleSummary: Bat-borne coronavirus HKU5-CoV-2, a merbecovirus related to MERS, can use the human ACE2 receptor and infect various human cells in culture, signaling a potential spillover risk even if not currently capable of causing a new pandemic. A Lancet Microbe review (2000-2021) identified 309 laboratory-acquired infections and 16 accidental pathogen releases, suggesting that even elite facilities are prone to errors and that reporting may be incomplete. The debate focuses on experiments that enhance dangerous traits—transmission or virulence—and weighs surveillance and preparedness against the risk of catastrophic accidents. In the United States, a July 20, 2026 policy sets bans, risk assessment requirements, oversight, and possible suspensions for federally funded high-risk research. Regarding COVID-19's origin, WHO's 2025 SAGO report favors zoonotic spillover but cannot exclude a laboratory incident due to data gaps from China. The lesson: monitor viruses in nature and tighten laboratory biosafety.

triage.headline_ja: 研究室内の危険なウイルス、バイオセキュリティ問題再燃のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、コウモリ由来コロナウイルスの研究リスクや過去の実験室感染事例、米国のバイオセーフティ政策、COVID-19起源論争に関する総説・政策議論記事であり、新規の感染症発生シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、研究室バイオセーフティやCOVID-19起源に関する政策的・学術的議論を扱ったもの。特定国での新規アウトブレイクの記述はないため、対象国リストへの該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Do Konžskej demokratickej republiky dorazilo vyše 16-tisíc dávok vakcíny proti ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) received over 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, with 16,250 doses landing at Kinshasa's airport as part of a 70,000-dose shipment manufactured in Germany. The vaccine is being tested against the current Bundibugyo strain circulating in the country and is also intended to protect health workers and frontline staff; WHO says 20,000 doses will support a clinical study and 50,000 doses are allocated for frontline personnel. The outbreak is the deadliest on record in the DRC, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths to date. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire ebolavirus lineage, not for Bundibugyo; preliminary animal studies suggest some protection. The WHO notes this vaccine has been used during the 2018–2020 epidemic, while two other vaccines targeting Bundibugyo are in clinical development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国に1万6千回分以上のエボラワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（5,290症例、2,516死亡）のエボラ（Bundibugyo株）流行が進行中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためIHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 既存のワクチン（Ervebo）はZaire株用でBundibugyo株には未承認、動物実験で一部防御効果が示唆されているのみ。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。史上最大規模の流行であり、既にWHO・国際機関が関与していることから継続的な監視とフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ramai CDC AS Keluarkan Travel Alert soal Zika di Bali, Ini Bantahan Kemenkes RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC issues travel alert regarding Zika in Bali; Indonesian Ministry of Health's rebuttal.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention issued a Travel Health Notice Level 2 for Bali, Indonesia, due to increasing Zika cases among travelers returning from Bali, advising enhanced precautions. The Indonesian Ministry of Health rebutted, stating no Zika cases detected in Bali Province and that sentinel arbovirosis surveillance (dengue, Zika, chikungunya) and the 21-hospital Emerging Infectious Diseases (PIE) syndrome surveillance have not identified any Zika cases there. The ministry noted earlier reports of Zika among tourists after Bali travel in an ECDC bulletin (week 16, 11–17 April 2026) involving travelers from France and Germany, but the bulletin did not specify Bali-visited locations. No evidence of local Zika transmission in Bali as of 22 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CDCがバリ島のジカ熱に関する渡航警戒情報を発表、インドネシア保健省が反論
triage.triage_reason: 米国CDCがバリ島渡航者のジカ熱増加を理由に渡航警戒（レベル2）を発出した一方、インドネシア保健省はバリでの症例確認を否定しており、情報の食い違いと国際的な渡航者を介した拡大懸念があるためフルRRAでの精査が必要。
triage.notes: 米・独・仏は渡航者側の国であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外。バリ（インドネシア）でのローカル感染は保健省により否定されているが、CDCの渡航警戒発出という国際的動きがあるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 1 100 patients guéris d'Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,100 patients recovered from Ebola in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has seen more than 1,100 recoveries among about 5,200 laboratory-confirmed cases. At a press briefing in Bunia on August 21, authorities reported nearly 2,500 total deaths since the May 15 declaration, with a case fatality rate around 47%. About 62% of fatalities occur outside medical facilities, a factor sustaining transmission, and MSF notes an Ebola-related death roughly every 30 minutes last week. Since the outbreak was declared, the Congolese government and partners have strengthened the response with treatment centers, isolation units, mobile laboratories, and ambulances deployed to major affected zones, complemented by field teams and community relays for care, awareness, and prevention. MSF emphasizes community acceptance as essential to end transmission, urging local leaders to promote early detection, rapid care-seeking, and adherence to prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でエボラから回復した患者が1,100人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで致死率約47%、約5,200例の確認症例と2,500人の死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: MSFなど国際機関が対応に関与しており、地域社会での死亡（施設外死亡62%）が感染持続の要因とされている。既に大規模な進行中アウトブレイクであり継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: UNO schlägt Alarm: Ebola-Pandemie breitet sich rasant aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Sounds the Alarm: Ebola Pandemic Spreading Rapidly
article.articleSummary: Seven more health zones in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report first Ebola infections: Gombari (Haut-Uélé), Lubero (North Kivu), and Bafwasende, Kabondo, Tshopo, Wanie-Rukula, and Buta. Since the outbreak began on May 15, 5,290 people have been infected, 2,516 have died, 1,152 recovered, and about 840 remain in isolation or hospital. The case fatality rate is 47.6%. Contact tracing coverage stands at 82.9%. Ituri province remains the hardest hit, accounting for more than 80% of confirmed infections and about 80% of deaths, with geographic spread continuing. The United Nations warns of a critical funding shortfall; resources will last only a few weeks. Aid workers urgently need international support to treat patients, identify contacts, and curb further transmission amid expanding transmission zones.

triage.headline_ja: 国連が警鐘：エボラ・パンデミックが急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が7つの新たな保健ゾーンに拡大し、致死率47.6%、資金不足も深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 5月15日の発生開始以来、感染者5,290人、死者2,516人、致死率47.6%。イトゥリ州が最も深刻で感染の80%以上を占める。国連は資金不足を警告し、数週間で資源が枯渇する恐れがあると指摘。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: １万６０００回分超のワクチン到着　エボラ熱拡大で -- コンゴ：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 16,000 vaccine doses arrived as the Ebola outbreak spreads — Congo: Jiji.com
article.articleSummary: On Aug 21, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) received 16,250 doses of the German-made Ebola vaccine Ervebo as the Ebola outbreak continues to spread in central Africa. The World Health Organization had announced on Aug 20 that a total of 70,000 doses would be delivered to Congo. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire (EBOV) strain of Ebola, but the currently circulating Bundibugyo strain is not approved for; however, animal studies suggest some protective effect against other strains. The AFP report from Kinshasa notes the arrival of doses and does not cite specific case or death counts in this article. The outbreak location is the DRC, with ongoing transmission, and the vaccine deployment aims to bolster outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 1万6000回分超のワクチン到着　エボラ熱拡大で ― コンゴ：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が継続・拡大しており、WHOが7万回分のワクチン供給を発表するなど国際的な対応が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数・死亡者数を報告していないが、WHOによる大規模ワクチン供給（計7万回分）と流行継続の記述から、進行中の重大なアウトブレイクであることが示唆される。流行株（ブンディブギョ株）は既存ワクチン（エルベボ）の承認対象外である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ورود بیش از ۱۶ هزار دوز واکنش ابولا به کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrival of over 16,000 Ebola vaccine doses in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on Friday, delivered to Kinshasa International Airport as part of a 70,000-dose shipment from the WHO and partners; more doses are expected early next week. The outbreak currently spreading fastest in history is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola and has been effective in past outbreaks. The health ministry notes that Bundibugyo infection can resemble malaria, complicating detection. The shipments aim to bolster vaccination efforts amid the Congo Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴに1万6千回分以上のエボラワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）のアウトブレイクで承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがなく、WHOによる大規模ワクチン支援が行われている重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスはマラリアと症状が類似し検知が困難との指摘あり。承認済み治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない点が異常性・重症度の観点で重要。

article.articleHeadline: Poonam Dhillon hospitalised after testing positive for dengue, currently recovering- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Poonam Dhillon, veteran Indian actor and president of the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA), has dengue and is hospitalised at Lilavati Hospital in Mumbai, as of Aug 22, 2026, where she has been in care for several days and is now recovering. The diagnosis, shared via social media, places her case amid ongoing industry tensions. Dhillon’s hospitalisation occurs amid a dispute within CINTAA, with general secretary Upasana Singh accusing Dhillon and vice president Padmini Kolhapure of dictatorial management, noting resignations and allegations of show-cause notices for dissenters. Singh also questioned the use of personal email addresses for official correspondence, urging the use of the association’s official email system to ensure transparency and accessibility of documents.

triage.headline_ja: プーナム・ディロン氏、デング熱陽性判明後入院、現在回復中 - Moneycontrol.com
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人のデング熱罹患に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報がないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 個人の罹患事例であり、インドにおけるデング熱の集団発生・流行状況を示す情報は含まれていないため、国レベルの発生地域としては特定しない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國接收首批伊波拉疫苗｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives first batch of Ebola vaccines | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo received 16,520 doses of Ebola vaccine in Kinshasa to address the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The vaccines will be used to evaluate protection against the new virus strain and prioritize frontline health workers for vaccination. Over the coming days, more than 50,000 additional doses are expected to arrive to strengthen containment. There is no strain-specific vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo yet; early laboratory and animal data suggest Zaire ebolavirus vaccines may offer some cross-protection. The World Health Organization has allocated 70,000 doses of Zaire-type vaccine: 20,000 for Phase 3 trials to assess protection against Bundibugyo, and 50,000 for frontline workers. Officials emphasize vaccination must be combined with other control measures, and they urge public vigilance and adherence to guidance to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、初のエボラワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの新規株によるアウトブレイクが発生し、WHOが緊急ワクチン配布・第3相試験を実施するなど国際的対応が進行中であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常事態と判断される。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスは既存のザイール株ワクチンの交差防御効果が不明確であり、株特異的な治療法・ワクチンが未確立の点で特に懸念が高い。フルリスク評価による詳細確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Symptoms On The Rise: Health Ministry Issues Advisory, Doctor Says "No Need To Panic
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) is rising in India this monsoon season, prompting the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to issue a public advisory via the National Health Mission. The advisory lists symptoms: fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches and fatigue, urging early recognition and medical consultation at the nearest health centre. Dr. Randeep Guleria notes that India experienced a major H1N1 outbreak in 2009 and that cases tend to rise during the monsoon months; current numbers are somewhat higher than usual but not cause for alarm. Most infections are mild and self-limiting, with fever, sore throat and cough common; body aches and cough may linger weeks after fever. Elderly or vulnerable individuals may require hospitalisation if the illness progresses. The messaging emphasizes vigilance without panic to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザの症状が増加：保健省が注意喚起、医師は「パニックの必要なし」と発言
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1増加で保健省が注意喚起を出しているが、専門家は深刻でないとしており、IHR基準やWPRO基準の明確な該当は限定的。続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1増加であり、保健省が公式アドバイザリーを発出しているものの、専門家は例年より多い程度で深刻ではないとコメントしている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Alarmı: Can Kaybı 2 Bini Aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alarm in Congo: Death Toll Has Surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) escalates with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths reported as of 22 August 2026, marking one of the country’s heaviest Ebola crises. Declared in May, cases initially centered in Ituri Province and by mid-August spread to six provinces and 54 health zones. The rapid transmission and high mortality are challenging response efforts, with health systems strained by conflict, access barriers, and misinformation. There is no approved vaccine or treatment specifically for Bundibugyo; existing Ebola vaccines under evaluation for cross-protection and new therapies are being considered. Diagnostic delays—early tests targeted other Ebola types—facilitated spread. Healthcare workers remain at high risk amid personnel and equipment shortages. Authorities emphasize early case finding, rapid isolation, and strengthened cross-border surveillance as international health organizations intensify support and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ警報：死者数が2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株エボラが5,290症例・2,516死亡と大規模拡大し、6州54保健地区に拡散。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的支援も動員されている重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がBundibugyo株に対して存在せず、診断遅延が拡散を助長。医療従事者への感染リスクも高く、国境を越えたサーベイランス強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تتلقى أولى شحنات لقاح إيبولا وسط تفشٍ متسارع - هبة بريس
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first shipments of Ebola vaccine amid a rapidly accelerating outbreak - Hiba Press
article.articleSummary: Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) Ebola vaccine shipments arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the country experiences a rapidly accelerating Ebola outbreak. About 16,000 doses reached the DRC on Friday, with the World Health Organization allocating 70,000 doses for the country: 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. This is the seventh Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Authorities report 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths to date, while UN outbreak coordinators warn of faster transmission. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus species; its effectiveness against the currently circulating Bundibugyo strain is unconfirmed, prompting WHO to call for wide clinical trials to evaluate protective efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、急速に拡大するエボラ流行の中でエボラワクチンの初回出荷を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（5,290症例、2,516死亡）が急速に拡大しており、既存ワクチンの有効性が不確実な新規株（Bundibugyo株）が流行していることから、深刻性・異常性・国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: More than 16,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrive in Ebola-hit DR Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 16,000 doses (16,250) of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in Kinshasa late Friday as part of a WHO-backed delivery to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid its deadliest outbreak. Of 70,000 pledged doses, 20,000 will be used in a late-stage trial to test Ervebo’s effect on the Bundibugyo strain, which currently circulates in the country and has no approved vaccine or treatment; the remainder is allocated to frontline health workers. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire strain. Early animal data suggest possible protection against Bundibugyo, but human efficacy remains unproven. Since the outbreak was declared mid-May, more than 2,500 people have died among roughly 5,300 confirmed cases, with infections spreading exponentially. Africa CDC data indicate transmission could triple current levels. Containment is hampered by armed conflict, delays in case identification, and weak eastern DRC infrastructure. Additional doses are expected next week.

triage.headline_ja: 16,000回分以上のエルベボ・ワクチンがエボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者2,500人超、感染5,300人超）で、新規株（Bundibugyo）への対応や国際的なワクチン支援が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、有効性が未証明の段階でのトライアル実施中。武力紛争によって封じ込めが困難な状況が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC reçoit des vaccins contre Ebola en pleine épidémie sans précédent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC receives Ebola vaccines amid an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo - The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is described as the largest and fastest in its history, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths across six provinces. More than 16,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrived to bolster response; the World Health Organization has allocated 70,000 doses to DRC, including 20,000 for a Phase III clinical trial. Ervebo has been used in prior large outbreaks (2018–2020). UN Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis cautioned that the outbreak was accelerating. The vaccination push aims to reduce transmission and support ongoing research into the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、前例のない規模のエボラ流行の中でワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大・最速とされるエボラ流行が発生し、5,290症例・2,516死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害があり、国際的な対応（WHOによるワクチン配布)が行われていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約47.6%（2,516/5,290）と高く、6州にまたがる拡大が確認されている。WHOが70,000回分のワクチンを配分し、うち20,000回分は第III相臨床試験用。UNエボラ調整官は流行拡大が加速していると警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू-मलेरिया से बचने के लिए MCD का बड़ा कदम, रेलवे ट्रैक पर दौड़ी मॉस्किटो टर्मिनेटर ट्रेन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MCD Takes a Major Step to Prevent Dengue and Malaria: Mosquito Terminator Train Runs on the Railway Track
article.articleSummary: Delhi's MCD and Northern Railways launched the Mosquito Terminator Train 2026 at New Delhi Railway Station to curb malaria and dengue by spraying anti-larval agents along track-side water-collecting spots. The 75-km operation will cover rail corridors and surrounding areas, deploying power spray tanks to the sides of tracks. Planned routes include New Delhi–Sahibabad; Adarsh Nagar–Badli; Delhi Junction–Delhi Shahdara; Hazrat Nizamuddin–Lajpat Nagar; Sarai Rohilla–Patel Nagar–Safdarjung; Kishan Ganj–Sadar Bazaar–Delhi Cantt; and Palam–Gurgaon–Faridabad–Okhla–Tuglakabad. The campaign runs through September 2026. Dengue infects about 390 million people annually worldwide, underscoring the public health rationale of reducing breeding sites and protecting Delhi from vector-borne diseases such as malaria and dengue.

article.articleHeadline: Sospiro di sollievo in Trentino: negativo il test per Ebola sul paziente rientrato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sigh of relief in Trentino: Ebola test negative for patient who returned from Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Italy reported a suspected Ebola case in Trentino. The patient, who had returned from travel in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and presented with symptoms, underwent testing. The Ebola swab test, performed at Milan's Sacco Hospital on samples collected in Trentino, returned negative. The Ministry of Health noted the patient’s symptoms prompted testing and stated it remains in contact with local authorities to monitor the situation. There is no confirmation of Ebola, and authorities continue to track the evolution of the case. The report underscores ongoing vigilance for travel-related infections; no further details on contact tracing or exposure were provided. All information released by the ministry emphasizes precaution and ongoing surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Do Konžskej demokratickej republiky dorazilo vyše 16-tisíc dávok vakcíny proti ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine have arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo received over 16,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine (16,250 delivered at Kinshasa airport) toward a 70,000-dose shipment manufactured in Germany. The country faces its deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed cases. The World Health Organization says 20,000 doses are for a clinical study and 50,000 for healthcare workers and frontline staff. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire ebolavirus strain but not yet for Bundibugyo, the strain currently circulating. Preliminary animal data suggest partial protection. WHO recently urged extensive human trials to assess protection against Bundibugyo, while two other vaccine candidates targeting this strain are in development. The campaign prioritizes frontline workers and outbreak response in Kinshasa and beyond.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To confront the deadly virus... 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine reach the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: First batch of over 16,000 Ervebo doses arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) at Ndjili International Airport, as part of an urgent international effort to contain the 17th Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in the country. As of the latest government report, 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed cases have occurred. The outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, is spreading in northern and eastern regions amid armed conflict and weak health infrastructure. WHO said DRC will receive 70,000 Ervebo doses (Germany-made), the only vaccine with formal approval; efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is not yet confirmed, though animal data hint some protection. Ervebo has been used previously (2018–2020). Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers.

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Titip 4 Pesan ke Mahasiswa Untad untuk Percepat Penuntasan TB di Sulteng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Wiyagus Delivers Four Messages to UNTAD Students to Accelerate Tuberculosis Elimination in Central Sulawesi
article.articleSummary: TB elimination efforts in Central Sulawesi are highlighted as Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus delivers four messages to UNTAD students. The messages urge students to act as screening agents within families, to support patients to prevent treatment interruption and reduce stigma, to lead digital campaigns and innovative TB research, and to engage directly with villages through the Kuliah Kerja Nyata (KKN) program. Wiyagus applauds Untad's Berani Magaya initiative as a model of youth-led public health action. He stresses cross-sector collaboration among universities and local governments (provincial, regency, and city) to implement TB control per Standar Pelayanan Minimal. He notes geopolitical uncertainties affecting drug supply and calls for a prepared, multi-sector “super team.” He hopes campus-based TB innovations can be replicated to accelerate elimination.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 Cases Surge | 1,777 Swine Flu Cases Reported as Nadda Reviews Situation
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) infections in 2026, with 114 new cases on August 20, per Delhi government data reviewed on August 21. The capital’s surge follows monsoon rainfall and humid, changing weather that amplify seasonal respiratory infections. Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda has reviewed H1N1 preparedness, focusing on hospital beds, critical-care capacity, oxygen-supported beds, ventilators, medicines, and testing capacity, while authorities tighten surveillance and early detection. Health officials say the situation is being closely monitored and readiness is being strengthened across facilities. Doctors advise individuals with persistent or severe respiratory symptoms to seek medical attention promptly. The update underscores reinforced diagnostics, surveillance, and supply chains to manage the growing outbreak in Delhi.

article.articleHeadline: From symptoms to precautions: 4 questions about H1N1 spread, answered by experts
article.articleSummary: Delhi sees a sharp monsoon surge in H1N1 (Swine flu) with 1,777 H1N1 infections among 2,392 Influenza-A cases in 2026, per August 21, 2026 Delhi government figures. H1N1 is the dominant Influenza-A strain, with reports also from Mumbai, Bengaluru and Keralam, and about 34 confirmed H1N1 cases in recent weeks. Early H1N1 symptoms mimic seasonal fever but are typically higher and may progress to breathlessness, chest discomfort, persistent cough, and, in severe cases, bluish lips, drowsiness, or reduced urine output in children; fever not subsiding within 48 hours warrants hospital testing. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, avoiding close contact, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated areas, and avoiding face-touching. Hydration and rest are advised. Annual influenza vaccination can reduce risk of severe illness, though effectiveness varies.

article.articleHeadline: Philippine capital sees rise in leptospirosis cases amid flooding
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases at San Lazaro Hospital in Manila reach 50 with two deaths amid widespread flooding from persistent heavy rains. An express lane for leptospirosis patients has been opened at the national infectious-disease referral center. Nationwide cases total 3,760, with numbers expected to rise. In Iloilo Province, at least 10 leptospirosis deaths occurred in the past eight months, double the toll for the same period in 2025. Health authorities urge exposed residents to take prophylaxis or preventive antibiotics. A total of 88 cities and municipalities have declared a state of calamity due to the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones. Hardest-hit: Pampanga, Bataan, Bulacan. Pampanga: more than half villages submerged, nearly 1 million people affected, about 1.4 billion pesos (~$22.68 million) in agricultural damage. Bataan: around 8,000 evacuated. Bulacan: Santa Maria bridge closed due to flood damage.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症の症例・死亡者数が増加しており、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、政府機関による対応（避難、非常事態宣言、予防投薬の呼びかけ）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: フィリピンでは季節性の洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症流行は毎年発生する既知の公衆衛生課題だが、今回は全国3,760症例・複数州での死亡・88自治体の非常事態宣言など規模が大きく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Leptospirosis spike in Quezon City
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Quezon City, Philippines, spiked with 52 cases in one week after heavy rains and habagat-driven floods. As of Aug 20, 2026, total cases reached 213, up from 161 a week earlier, with 24 deaths (up 4). District 2 bore the heaviest burden with 69 cases; Barangay Commonwealth led with 25, followed by Batasan Hills (14) and Payatas B (11). The University of the Philippines campus in District 4 reported 9 cases this year. District 2 accounts for 37.5% of fatalities (9). Of all cases, 168 (79%) are 21 years old and above; males account for 171 cases. Transmission is via rat urine contaminated with leptospira in floodwaters, entering the body through wounds, eyes, nose or mouth. Symptoms to monitor include fever, headache and body aches, vomiting, chills, jaundice, and red eyes. Public is urged to follow precautions.

article.articleHeadline: "Thủ phạm" của hơn 60% ca nhiễm trùng hô hấp cấp tính ở trẻ nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Culprit Behind More Than 60% of Acute Respiratory Infections in Young Children
article.articleSummary: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of hospitalization and death among children under 1 year globally, responsible for over 60% of acute pediatric respiratory infections. Data presented at a press briefing in Ho Chi Minh City on August 22, organized by Vietnam’s Ministry of Health Center for Health Communication and Education and Sanofi-Vietnam, estimate about 2.2 million RSV-related hospitalizations and roughly 66,300 infant deaths each year worldwide. In the first two years of life, about 90% of children are infected with RSV, and infections can cause bronchiolitis and pneumonia; severe disease in infancy increases risk of wheeze, asthma, and reduced lung function later. The first year is a critical protection window, with strategies including vaccines (which require time to become effective) and monoclonal antibodies that offer immediate protection after administration, especially for 6–12 month olds.

article.articleHeadline: Difusión de medidas sanitarias para la prevención de la triquinosis en distintas regiones del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dissemination of sanitary measures for the prevention of trichinellosis in different regions of the country.
article.articleSummary: Senasa (Argentina’s National Service for Agri-Food Health and Quality) conducted a territorial outreach campaign on trichinellosis across major Argentine provinces as of 2026-08-22, delivering talks, presentations, and educational materials to producers, food processors, students, and the general public. Activities occurred in towns including General Madariaga and Tornquist (Buenos Aires); Puerto Esperanza (Misiones); Nogoyá and Santa Elena (Entre Ríos); Realicó and Santa Rosa (La Pampa); Río Colorado and General Conesa (Río Negro); Sarmiento (Chubut); Río Gallegos (Santa Cruz); Rosario (Santa Fe); plus Córdoba and Mendoza. The campaign emphasized prevention of Trichinella infection via consumption of undercooked or raw pork products. Training with bromatology offices in Salto (Buenos Aires) and Puerto Madryn (Chubut) supported inspectors and students. Mendoza and Córdoba hosted technical meetings; emphasis for small/medium pork producers on sanitation, animal nutrition, and meat analysis by Artificial Digestion. Recent cases have been reported; winter increases transmission risk. Contact +54 9 11 35859810 or the Trichinellosis quick guide.

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Cases Rise In Delhi, Health Ministry Urges Early Recognition Of Symptoms | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) cases are rising in Delhi, with no deaths reported so far. As of 22 August 2026, H1N1 accounts for the largest share of roughly 2,000 Influenza-A cases recorded in the capital. The Delhi government has assessed the city’s seasonal disease situation and authorities have stepped up surveillance and preparedness to manage the surge. The Health Ministry urges early recognition of Swine Flu symptoms to enable timely testing and treatment. The report notes a public figure, Shabana Azmi, has been diagnosed with swine flu, illustrating ongoing transmission risk in the city. Details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are not provided. The situation signals increasing circulation of H1N1 within Delhi’s Influenza-A activity and highlights the need for continued public health vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで豚インフルエンザ(H1N1)感染者が増加、保健省が早期受診を呼びかけ
