triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの一環としてのH1N1増加であり、死亡例は報告されていない。著名人(Shabana Azmi氏)の感染が報道され社会的関心を集めているため、続報の推移を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Surge In India: Should You Get Tested For Every Fever?
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) surge across India in Aug 2026. A 60-year-old woman died in Indore, Madhya Pradesh on Aug 19. Delhi reports nearly sixfold rise in cases versus last year; Bengaluru sees a school where 500+ students and 21 staff ill; Meerut records seven cases. Health ministries across Haryana, Chandigarh, and Uttar Pradesh issue advisories. Transmission via droplets from coughing/sneezing and touching contaminated surfaces; infectious starting a day before symptoms and lasting up to 7 days (10 days for children). Diagnosis via RT-PCR from nasal/throat swab. High-risk groups: children under 2, elderly over 65, pregnant women, people with chronic disease or weakened immunity; crowded settings. In testing guidance, AIIMS Delhi official says not every fever requires testing; if fever >102-103 F, breathing difficulty, or persistent/worsening symptoms, seek testing. Not a pandemic like COVID-19, but authorities urge precautions.

triage.headline_ja: インドで豚インフルエンザが急増：発熱のたびに検査を受けるべきか？
triage.triage_reason: インド複数州でH1N1感染が急増し死亡例や学校での集団感染が報告されており、政府機関が注意喚起を行うなど社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の株だが、デリーでの前年比6倍増加、バンガロールの学校での500人以上の集団発症、インドール市での死亡例など、複数州にまたがる異常な増加が確認されている。パンデミックには該当しないと当局は述べているが、continued monitoringが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эбола: За три месяца заразились 160 медработников, 43 из них умерли
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: 160 healthcare workers infected in three months, 43 of them died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding geometrically, UN reports. Since May 15, when the outbreak was declared, 5,290 cases have been confirmed with 2,516 deaths; 1,152 people have recovered, and about 840 remain in isolation or in hospital. Case fatality rate 47.6%; 82.9% of contacts under monitoring. In three months, 160 healthcare workers have been infected and 43 have died. Frontline staff face violence: attacks on personnel, ambulances set alight and health facilities assaulted. Six eastern provinces where transmission is concentrated also lack essential social and governmental services, hampering outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行:3ヶ月で医療従事者160人が感染、うち43人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.6%の大規模エボラ流行が拡大中で、医療従事者への感染・攻撃も発生し、公衆衛生・治安両面で深刻な状況。IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 5,290症例・2,516死亡、致死率47.6%と極めて深刻。医療従事者への暴力や施設への攻撃も報告され、対応が困難な状況。国連が報告している大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Trentino: test negativo per sospetto caso di Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trentino: negative test for a suspected case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test in Trentino, Italy, for a person returning from travel in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, produced a negative result. The diagnostic test was conducted at Milan’s Sacco Hospital after the individual developed symptoms that raised local concerns. The Italian Ministry of Health, via the Department of Prevention, remains in active contact with territorial authorities and continues close surveillance of the situation. The negative Ebola result is a relief and underscores the effectiveness of Italy’s monitoring and rapid-response procedures. There are no confirmed Ebola cases or deaths reported; the episode is being used to reinforce public health vigilance, especially for infections arriving from high-risk regions. Rapid testing and ongoing monitoring are emphasized as essential to maintaining health security, with authorities continuing to monitor for any new developments.

triage.headline_ja: トレンティーノ:エボラ出血熱疑い例の検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例は検査で陰性が確認されており、実際の感染事例は発生していない。イタリアでの発生ではなく、DRC渡航歴者のスクリーニング事例であり公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 検査結果は陰性であり、イタリア・DRCいずれにおいても実際の感染事例としての確認はない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題はイタリアでの疑い例検査（陰性）であり、DRCでの発生を報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Poonam Dhillon Hospitalised After Being Diagnosed With Dengue At Lilavati Hospital
article.articleSummary: Poonam Dhillon, veteran actress and CINTAA president, has been hospitalized in Mumbai after being diagnosed with dengue. She is admitted to Lilavati Hospital and has been under treatment for several days, with reports that she is on the road to recovery. The update was provided by journalist Vickey Lalwani, who said she is recovering and expected to be back home soon. The article does not include details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or any ongoing outbreak, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases. Fans and colleagues have been posting wishes for her speedy recovery. This report is dated 2026-08-22.

triage.headline_ja: プーナム・ディロン、リラヴァティ病院にてデング熱と診断され入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人のデング熱罹患に関する報道であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報がないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 個人の症例報告のみで、地域における感染拡大やアウトブレイクの兆候は記事内に記載されていない。デング熱はインドの対象国リストに含まれるが、本記事は単一の著名人の入院事例に限定されるため公衆衛生シグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: மதுரை: டெங்கு, மலேரியா தடுக்க குடிநீர் பாதுகாப்பு, கொசு ஒழிப்பு - ஆட்சியர் உத்தரவு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madurai: Dengue, Malaria Prevention, Drinking Water Safety, Mosquito Eradication — District Collector's Order!
article.articleSummary: Madurai district authorities issued a strict preventive order to curb dengue, malaria and waterborne diseases, following a health department briefing chaired by District Collector Nishant Krishna on 21 August 2026. The measures require safe drinking water from water treatment and storage tanks with chlorine-treated supply and regular checks to ensure quality. They mandate adequate mosquito-disease vector control staff to intensify all-out efforts against mosquitoes, identify stagnant rainwater and sewage-prone pockets, remove standing water and promptly clear discarded items such as old tires and plastic goods that harbor larvae. Public awareness campaigns on safe water storage, boiling or safe consumption of drinking water, and sanitation are emphasized. Schools and health facilities should establish fever wards; if children exhibit fever, they must report to nearest primary health center. Inter-departmental coordination is urged to pre-empt monsoon-related breeding.

triage.headline_ja: マドゥライ：デング熱・マラリア予防のための飲料水安全対策と蚊の駆除 ― 郡長が命令！
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア予防のための行政による通常の予防的対策であり、異常な増加や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン前の予防的対策に関する行政通達であり、実際の症例数増加や集団発生の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo orders Ebola testing of bodies before burial
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo authorities require Ebola testing of bodies in morgues before release for burial to curb the latest outbreak declared in May. In North Kivu, morgue staff must obtain official clearance after Ebola test results; families must wait for samples to be collected and tested prior to burial. Officials say the measures detect infections that might otherwise go unnoticed and prevent funerals from becoming transmission points, given the virus can remain highly infectious in the bodies of those who died. Health workers are also informing families to promote safer burial practices while allowing culturally appropriate ceremonies. The outbreak began in Kasai Province and has spread rapidly; WHO and partners are expanding surveillance, vaccination, and treatment. Tighter corpse handling, early detection, and community awareness are aimed at breaking transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、埋葬前の遺体エボラ検査を義務化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが拡大中で、WHOと国際パートナーが対応にあたっており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはカサイ州で始まり北キブ州まで拡大していると記載されており、複数州にわたる拡大が示唆される。WHOおよびパートナーによるサーベイランス・ワクチン接種・治療の拡大が進行中。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Government issues advisory as swine flu cases rise in Delhi-NCR
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) cases rise in Delhi-NCR, prompting a Ministry of Health advisory. The advisory directs people to seek medical attention if they develop symptoms including fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches, or fatigue. Delhi has reported 1,777 H1N1 cases through August 20, indicating ongoing transmission in the National Capital Territory of Delhi and surrounding areas. The notice underscores heightened swine flu activity in Delhi-NCR, issued as cases rise in August. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection source, or imported/exported cases. No death figures are reported in the brief. Guidance targets people in Delhi-NCR. Published 2026-08-22.

triage.headline_ja: デリー首都圏で豚インフルエンザ症例増加、政府が勧告を発出
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例が1,777件と増加し政府省庁が注意喚起を発出しているが、死亡数や重症度、異常性に関する情報が不足しており、既知の病原体による季節的流行の可能性が高いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、インドでは例年季節的な流行が報告される。死亡数・重症度・検査確定方法などの詳細情報が記事に欠けており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri dorong mahasiswa kesehatan di Sulteng aktif atasi TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Home Affairs Minister urges health students in Central Sulawesi to actively tackle TB.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Deputy Home Affairs Minister Akhmad Wiyagus urged health students in Central Sulawesi to actively tackle Tuberculosis (TB). He called them to serve as first-line screeners within families, guiding relatives with a cough longer than two weeks to use the Free Health Check program (CKG). He emphasized supporting TB patients to ensure regular, complete medication and to avoid stigmatizing those diagnosed. Students should conduct digital campaigns and research via social media to promote TB elimination, and integrate activities into community service (KKN), public devotion, and student organizations to help puskesmas and health cadres perform active case finding, including reaching remote desa in Central Sulawesi. Government data indicate a sizable gap in detecting TB; Palu City leads with 1,075 cases, followed by Parigi Moutong (546) and Banggai (510), with other districts under 500.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣、中スラウェシの保健学生に結核対策への積極参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策の啓発・政策的呼びかけに関する日常的な報道であり、突発的なアウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病である結核の症例数把握・対策強化に関する行政・啓発活動の記事であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Receives First Shipment of Ebola Vaccine Amid Surging Outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in Kinshasa, the first tranche of a 70,000-dose pledge from WHO and partners intended for frontline health workers; 20,000 doses will back a late-stage trial evaluating Ervebo’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo is approved for Zaire strain, while the remaining 50,000 are for frontline use. The outbreak, the deadliest in DRC’s history, has recorded over 2,500 deaths among nearly 5,300 confirmed cases, with transmission not yet peaked and potentially tripling the current rate per Africa CDC. Declared mid-May and believed to have begun weeks earlier, the outbreak is hampered by ongoing eastern DRC conflict, delays in case identification, and limited infrastructure. Health Minister Samuel Kamba notes Ervebo was used on a large scale during 2018–2020; more vaccine deliveries and trial results are awaited. (As of 2026-08-22)

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、感染急拡大の中でエボラワクチンの最初の出荷を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、死者2500人超・感染者5300人近くに達し、感染拡大がピークに達していないためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、東部紛争や医療インフラの制約により対応が困難。WHO主導のワクチン配布・臨床試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri dorong mahasiswa kesehatan di Sulteng aktif atasi Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Home Affairs Minister urges health science students in Central Sulawesi to actively tackle Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Deputy Home Affairs Minister Akhmad Wiyagus urged health science students in Central Sulawesi to actively accelerate TB elimination. Speaking at Tadulako University in Palu, he asked students to act as first-screening agents within their families, guiding relatives with coughing for more than two weeks to use the Free Health Check Program (CKG). He stressed combating stigma toward TB and ensuring patients adhere to treatment until completion. Students should lead digital campaigns and innovative research via social media, and leverage study programs (KKN), community service, and student organizations to assist puskesmas and health cadres in active case finding, extending to remote villages in Central Sulawesi. Government data show a substantial detection gap: Palu tops with 1,075 TB cases, followed by Parigi Moutong (546) and Banggai (510); ten other districts remain under 500.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣、中スラウェシの保健系学生に結核対策への積極参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する啓発・教育活動に関する通常の行政広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 内容は結核撲滅に向けた学生動員・啓発活動を促す行政広報であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D de vacinação: Padilha rebate movimento contra obrigatoriedade em SC e cita 'maior surto de sarampo em 35 anos' nos EUA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination D-Day: Padilha rebuts movement against mandatory vaccination in Santa Catarina and cites 'the largest measles outbreak in 35 years' in the United States.
article.articleSummary: On 22 Aug 2026, Brazil launches the Dia D Multivacinação nationwide, with the SUS offering 20 vaccines to recover vaccination coverage. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha defends mandatory child vaccination, warning that opting out endangers classmates and communities. He cites the United States' current measles outbreak—the largest in 35 years—with spread to Canada and Mexico, and notes Brazil recorded 38 imported measles cases in 2025 from the US and Bolivia, plus early July clusters in São Paulo’s Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo (about 20 cases). Brazil had eliminated measles in 2024 after a 2019–2020 surge that reached 20,000 cases in São Paulo. Vaccines include BCG; Hepatitis A and B; Pentavalent; DTP; Polio; Rotavirus; Pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (10- and 20-valent); Meningococcal C/ACWY; Influenza; Covid-19; Yellow fever; MMR; Varicella; HPV4; Dengue tetravalent. Target: children and adolescents under 15; active foci extend vaccination to ages 6 months–59 years. Florianópolis has 35 vaccination sites; bring the vaccination card.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種の日：パジーリャ保健相、サンタカタリーナ州での義務化反対運動に反論し、米国の『35年で最大の麻疹流行』を引用
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでは麻疹排除後に輸入症例（2025年38件）とサンパウロ州グアルーリョス等での小規模クラスター（約20例）が発生しているが、大規模流行には至っておらず、記事の主眼は全国的ワクチン接種キャンペーンと政策論争にある。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダ・メキシコ・ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事はブラジル国内の麻疹輸入例・小規模クラスターへの対応として全国ワクチン接種キャンペーン（Dia D）とワクチン義務化を巡る政治的論争が主題。麻疹排除後の再燃リスクとして継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo enfrenta múltiplas emergências sanitárias além do surto de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Faces Multiple Public Health Emergencies Beyond the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Measles and cholera outbreaks in DR Congo’s North and South Kivu intensify as the Ebola response consumes resources. Since May 2026, Ebola relief dominates health work, but malaria remains the leading morbidity nationwide, exacerbated by displacement that increases mosquito exposure. From January to July 19, 2026, the country logged over 108,643 suspected measles cases and 1,394 deaths, with more than 50,827 cases concentrated in North and South Kivu. Cholera accounts for over 35,464 suspected cases and 1,051 deaths nationwide, 14,819 of which are in the two provinces. MSF runs six measles interventions in Shabunda (South Kivu) and Walikale (North Kivu), treating over 12,050 patients and vaccinating over 283,150 children. It also treats cholera in Bukavu, Shabunda, and Goma, with over 2,410 patients treated. Funding shortfalls threaten sustained access, risking reduced malaria support in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行以外にも複数の公衆衛生緊急事態に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応にリソースが集中する中、麻疹・コレラが北・南キブ州で大規模に流行し死者数も多く、資金不足により対応能力が逼迫しているため、複合的な公衆衛生危機としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ流行の陰で麻疹（108,643例、1,394死亡）とコレラ（35,464例、1,051死亡）が全国規模で拡大しており、特に北・南キブ州に集中。MSFが対応しているが資金不足によりマラリア対策も含め持続的な支援体制が脅かされている。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में इबोला का कहर, मृतकों की संख्या 2,500 के पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the DRC, death toll tops 2,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) accelerates with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths reported by 21 August; true totals likely higher as only about 30–40% of cases are detected. Driven by Bundibugyo virus, there is no approved vaccine or treatment, and symptoms may be milder than other Ebola strains, delaying care. Ongoing eastern DRC conflict, displacement, and distrust complicate containment, with spread across six provinces and 56 health zones, including Bas-Uele where two recent cases were identified. Contact tracing is severely weak, with fewer than 10% of new cases linked to monitored contacts (target 90–95%). On 17 August, 97% of deaths occurred outside hospitals. If the current pace continues, this outbreak could surpass the 2014–16 West Africa Ebola crisis (about 28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ猛威、死者数2,500人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州56保健地区に拡大し、死者数2,500人超・致死率高く、ワクチン未承認かつ接触者追跡機能不全で国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく除外。Bundibugyoウイルス株による感染で、致死性が2014-16年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela refuerza atención médica contra la oncocercosis en comunidades indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela strengthens medical care against onchocerciasis in indigenous communities.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela’s Ministry of Health deployed medical teams to 14 indigenous communities in Amazonas state to strengthen care and advance elimination of onchocerciasis, a parasitic disease transmitted by blackfly bites. Conducted with the Amazon Research Center (SA-CAICET), the operation will benefit about 944 people from the Yanomami and Ye’kwana ethnic groups. The strategy includes distribution of medications, medical evaluations, and epidemiological surveillance in areas with limited healthcare access. A rapid-response protocol will enable air transfers for patients needing specialized care from La Esmeralda to Puerto Ayacucho, the Amazonas capital. Onchocerciasis can cause severe skin lesions and vision impairment, potentially leading to blindness in advanced stages. The article does not specify current case counts in the attended communities.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、先住民コミュニティでのオンコセルカ症対策の医療体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ政府によるオンコセルカ症排除に向けた通常の医療活動の報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はなく、対象国にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における先住民コミュニティ向けのオンコセルカ症排除プログラムであり、対象国リスト（ブラジル等）は発生地域として付与されているが記事の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 一针覆盖三型毒株！瑞普生物牛羊三价口蹄疫疫苗正式上市-新闻中心-北方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One shot covers three serotypes! Ruip Biotech's cattle and sheep trivalent foot-and-mouth disease vaccine officially launched
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-22, Ruip Biotech Co., Ltd. officially launched Ruifejing Tri-valent Foot-and-Mouth Disease Inactivated Vaccine, co-developed with the National Animal Disease Prevention and Control Center core team. The vaccine protects cattle and sheep against three circulating serotypes—O Ind2001, A SEA97, and SAT1—addressing the inadequacy of traditional bivalent vaccines. Marketed as 'one shot covers three serotypes,' it uses a five-level ultra-purification system with CIP/SIP online sterility control, suitable for pregnant dams and weaned calves. Following multi-regional field trials and robust safety/stability data, it obtained an official production license. Experts note that multivalent vaccination and high-purity purification can reduce stress-related losses and costs. The product targets northern pasture areas, large dairy farms, meat sheep operations, and cross-province flocks, with broad domestic demand; ongoing surveillance will guide iterations, per President Xu Lei.

triage.headline_ja: 一針で3血清型をカバー！瑞普生物の牛・羊用三価口蹄疫ワクチンが正式発売
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は口蹄疫の新規発生ではなく、ワクチン製品の市場投入に関する商業的発表であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は口蹄疫の発生事例ではなく、家畜用ワクチンの製品発売告知であるため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Quem é Lito Sousa e o que é a doença de Creutzfeldt-Jakob
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Who is Lito Sousa and what is Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.
article.articleSummary: Lito Sousa, a 59-year-old Brazilian aviation influencer from Ceará, has been diagnosed with prostate cancer and Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (DCJ). His wife, Mila Seidl, says he remains conscious and can interact with family but has motor deficits including left-arm weakness; doctors urge making the most of the current window. A home-care setup is in place as they pursue an international clinical trial in the United States beginning October 20, 2026. DCJ is a neurodegenerative prion disease and a transmissible spongiform encephalopathy. Early symptoms include dementia, memory loss, tremors, visual disturbances, behavioral changes, ataxia, and myoclonus, with rapid progression. Diagnosis relies on neuropathology; preliminary testing may include EEG, MRI, CT, CSF 14-3-3, and PRNP sequencing. In Brazil, DCJ has been a notifiable disease since 2005.

triage.headline_ja: リト・ソウザとは誰か、クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病とは何か
triage.triage_reason: これは単一個人の症例に関する人物紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示すものではない。CJDは既知の散発性疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクもない。
triage.notes: 記事は著名な個人1名の孤発性クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病（プリオン病、非伝染性の孤発例）についての人物特集記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。疾患名タグ（豚コレラ、BSE）は記事内容と無関係で誤タグと思われる。ブラジル（セアラ州）が発生地域だが、対象国リストのBrazilに該当する事案でも公衆衛生シグナルとしての意義はない。

article.articleHeadline: Lito tem home care aprovado enquanto família busca novas possibilidades de tratamento de doença rara Creutzfeldt-Jakob
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lito has home care approved as his family seeks new treatment options for the rare Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Brazilian aviation influencer Lito Sousa with Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease (a rare prion neurodegenerative condition) has secured home-care coverage, enabling 24‑hour multiprofessional support at home. The approval, announced by his wife Mila Seidl, supports ongoing comfort while pursuing experimental therapies and international trials, with Harvard indicating a potential October admission; they are on a waiting list. Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease (CJD) is a rare, progressive brain disorder with sporadic, hereditary, and iatrogenic forms. The Brazilian Ministry of Health notes prions cause the disease, diagnosed via MRI, EEG, CSF 14-3-3 protein, and PRNP genetic sequencing, though definitive confirmation is post-mortem. No cure exists; about 90% die within a year. Symptoms include memory loss, cognitive decline, tremors, motor incoordination, speech and vision disturbances, insomnia, and behavioral changes.

triage.headline_ja: リト氏、在宅医療の承認を得る一方、家族は希少疾患クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病の新たな治療法を模索
triage.triage_reason: 個人の症例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や集団感染を示す情報はなく、既知の孤発性プリオン病の個別ケースと考えられる。
triage.notes: 疾患名に牛海綿状脳症・豚コレラが付与されているが、記事はブラジル人個人のクロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病（孤発性プリオン病）に関するもので、動物由来感染症や集団発生とは無関係。地域情報にUnited Statesが含まれるが対象国リスト外であり、また記事の主題はブラジルの個人事例。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampión en Perú: Minsa emite alerta epidemiológica por incremento de casos y refuerza medidas de prevención
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Peru: MINSA issues an epidemiological alert due to an increase in cases and reinforces preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: MINSA issued an epidemiological alert for measles amid a 2026 rise in cases, ordering intensified surveillance, detection, and rapid response across public, private, and mixed health facilities in 25 regions. The aim is early case identification and reduced transmission, especially where active transmission or high dissemination risk exists. The National Center for Epidemiology, Prevention and Control of Diseases (CDC Peru) reports 1,747 confirmed cases through epidemiological week 33, led by Puno (1,264) and Arequipa (292); Cusco, Lima, and Madre de Dios are also affected. The government extended the health emergency for 90 days under Supreme Decree 013-2026-SA due to local transmission in Puno and elevated risk of spread to Lima Metropolitan Area, Arequipa, Cusco, and other regions (Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Callao). IPRESS must enforce strict triage to separate fever-plus-rash patients from waiting areas, while prioritizing vaccination of health workers to maintain services.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーで麻疹流行：保健省(MINSA)が症例増加を受け疫学警報を発令、予防策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例が1,747件に増加し、政府が90日間の保健緊急事態を延長するなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生イベントであり、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生国はペルーであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないため verified_locations は空配列とした。発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、記事本文でブラジルへの言及はなくペルー国内の地域名（誤認識の可能性）であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : quatre patients guéris quittent le CTE de Katwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: four recovered patients leave the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: Eight people left the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Katwa, Butembo, on 21 August 2026: four survivors declared cured and four others admitted as suspects but subsequently ruled out after negative tests. Most reported voluntary admission after feeling unwell, highlighting rapid health-seeking for Ebola symptoms. A cured patient—whose eight family members were also declared cured after care at the ETC—urged the community to seek timely treatment, reject rumors, and encourage youth participation in the outbreak response. Health authorities reiterated urging anyone with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or other Ebola-compatible signs to seek care immediately, noting that delays due to fear can lower survival chances. On 19 August 2026, UNICEF donated 16 vehicles to strengthen decontamination logistics. Across affected provinces, 37 patients have been cured, totaling 1,152 since the outbreak began; Haut-Uele Province capacity increased, with Wamba and Isiro zones expanding hospitals to 130 beds. As of 5,290 positive cases and 2,516 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：カトゥワの治療センターから回復患者4名が退所
triage.triage_reason: 既知の大規模エボラ流行（累計5,290症例、2,516死亡）の継続報告であり、重症度・拡大性・国際支援ニーズ（UNICEF支援等）からWPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高いためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（コンゴ民主共和国、北キブ州・オートウエレ州）に関する継続的な状況報告。新規の異常事態ではないが、累計死者数・症例数が非常に大きく、国際支援（UNICEF）も継続的に行われているため引き続き監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi records 1,777 H1N1 cases; health ministry lists symptoms to watch for as flu infections rise across India | Today News
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, Delhi has recorded 1,777 H1N1 cases this year, including 114 in a single day, as influenza activity rises across India. The Health Ministry lists fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, runny nose, fatigue, lethargy, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, joint and muscle pain and diarrhoea as key symptoms and urges medical consultation for persistent illness. H1N1 is the predominant influenza subtype in Delhi this year; H3N2 was predominant last year, with two seasonal peaks typically seen Jan–Mar and post-monsoon. In Mumbai, 309 H1N1 cases were recorded between June 1 and August 15, while Bengaluru reports rising influenza-like illness among children and Chennai paediatric centres report daily H1N1 detections. Tamil Nadu’s Influenza-A totals reached 7,421 cases and 88 deaths by Aug 17 (May 526/6; June 2,050/26; July 2,899/31; Aug 1,476/21). Authorities emphasize masks, respiratory hygiene, handwashing and avoiding self-medication; Delhi reports adequate admission capacity.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染者1,777人を記録、インド全土でインフルエンザ感染増加につき保健省が注意すべき症状を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1/H3N2)の流行であり例年のパターン内だが、複数都市で症例数増加と一定数の死亡が報告されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの毎年の流行パターン内であり、デリーは病床対応能力が十分と報告。タミルナドゥ州で88人の死亡が報告されているが、これは季節性インフルエンザとして例年見られる範囲内の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: В Демократическую Республику Конго поступила первая партия вакцины против лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo received the first batch of the Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Brussels, August 22 — The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) received the first batch of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo, totaling 16,200 doses, to help combat the ongoing Ebola epidemic. The shipment was reported by Associated Press. The article notes this is the initial tranche of vaccine doses allocated to aid the DRC’s response efforts. No additional details on case counts, deaths, or outbreak progression are provided in the report, and there is no information on deployment dates or recipient regions within the DRC. The report underscores international support for outbreak control, highlighting Ervebo’s role as a licensed Ebola vaccine. The information source is AP, with the dateline indicating the report originated from Brussels.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国にエボラ出血熱ワクチンの初回分が到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患であり、DRCで進行中のエボラ流行に対する国際支援（ワクチン供給）が報じられており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関与が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン供給に関する続報であり、症例数・死亡者数・流行地域等の詳細情報は不足している。既存のエボラ流行に対する対応の一環と見られるため、フルリスク評価で最新の疫学状況を確認する必要がある。ベルギー（ブリュッセル）は報道発信地であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine as it grapples with unprecedented outbreak
article.articleSummary: Congo has received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine as the country grapples with the fastest Ebola outbreak in history. The doses arrived at Kinshasa’s N'djili International Airport on August 21, 2026, as part of a 70,000-dose tranche pledged by the World Health Organization and partners announced on August 20, 2026. More doses are expected early next week to bolster response efforts. The report, filed from Bunia, Congo, highlights rapid international support and vaccine deployment amid the unprecedented outbreak, though it does not provide local case counts, fatalities, or infection sources. This rapid vaccine deployment reflects ongoing efforts to curb transmission across the outbreak’s scope.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、前例のないエボラ流行に対応するため1万6000回分以上のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速とされる前例のないエボラ流行が進行中であり、WHOによる大規模ワクチン投与など国際的対応が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数・死亡者数・感染源については言及しておらず、ワクチン配布の進捗に焦点を当てている。「史上最速の流行」との表現から重大性・異常性が高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट के बैगा अंचल में बीमारी का कहर, मौतों के आंकड़े पर विवाद
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of disease in the Baiga belt of Balaghat, controversy over death toll figures.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district's Baiga belt in Madhya Pradesh faces an outbreak of malaria and measles across numerous villages in the Birsa block. Official government data record eight child deaths, while opposition Congress alleges 19, highlighting alleged undercounting as families describe unregistered losses. Reported cases include Mangli, a seven-year-old from Gathiya village who died after ambulance arrival on August 11; Baran Singh's six-year-old Ronu, who died at home after fever and dysentery before reaching hospital; and five-year-old Rianish from Ghummar who died August 20. Authorities have not accepted these deaths in the tally. Laboratory-confirmed measles infections have been found in affected children who missed routine immunization; malaria is also reported. A measles-rubella vaccination drive begins August 20 for children 9 months to 10 years. Health surveillance continues; 207 hospitalizations, 163 recoveries, 44 in hospital, 3,329 tests with 704 positives. Contention over nutrition support and ration distribution persists, with local MLA demanding accountability.

triage.headline_ja: バラガートのバイガ地域で疫病猛威、死者数を巡り論争
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・マラリアの複合アウトブレイクにより多数の子供が死亡し、政府発表と野党主張の死者数に大きな乖離が生じるなど社会的・政治的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 対象地域はインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州バラガート県のバイガ族居住地域。ワクチン未接種の子供を中心に麻疹・マラリアが拡大しており、8月20日から麻疹風疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されている。死亡者数を巡り政府データと野党（会議派）主張の間に大きな乖離があり、政治的논争となっている。

article.articleHeadline: وصول أكثر من 16 ألف جرعة من لقاح إيبولا للكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrival of more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 16,000 doses of the Merck Ebola vaccine Ervebo arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the country battles the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history. Declared the seventeenth outbreak on May 15, the event has spread across northern and eastern provinces with weak health systems and multiple armed groups active. The World Health Organization announced a shipment of 70,000 doses of Ervebo, the only vaccine with formal approval, manufactured in Germany. Ervebo is approved against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo, the strain currently circulating, remains unconfirmed. From Bunia, officials warned the virus is spreading rapidly, now covering an area larger than France. The outbreak has caused over 2,500 deaths, with about half occurring in the past 20 days and fatalities rising daily.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国にエボラワクチン16,000回分以上が到着
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模とされるDRCのエボラ流行（死者2500人超、感染拡大中）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ドイツ・フランスはワクチン製造国および流行範囲の比較対象として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。流行株（Bundibugyo）に対するワクチン有効性は未確認である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: केंद्र सरकार का बड़ा अलर्ट! दिल्ली में H1N1 केस बढ़ने के बाद बताया कैसे पहचानें Swine Flu के शुरुआती लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Government's Big Alert! After H1N1 cases rise in Delhi, officials explain how to identify the early symptoms of Swine Flu.
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, Delhi reports 2,392 influenza A cases this year, with 1,777 due to H1N1 (Swine Flu). The central MoHFW has issued an alert to recognize early symptoms and seek medical advice promptly to prevent progression. Early symptoms include fever, persistent cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches and fatigue; some cases include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and joint/muscle pain. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and close contact. Authorities advise staying home if ill, covering nose/mouth when coughing or sneezing, hand hygiene, and mask use in crowded or indoor settings. Severe symptoms or breathing difficulty warrant immediate medical consultation; self-medication should be avoided. The National Centre for Disease Control provides official influenza guidance for home care and masks.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府が緊急警戒！デリーでH1N1感染者増加、スワインフルーの初期症状の見分け方を説明
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）症例が急増し、中央保健省が公式警戒を発表するなど政府・社会的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の国内感染増加であり、国際的拡大や重症例の詳細情報は記事に含まれていないため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ألف جرعة من لقاح "إيرفيبو" تصل إلى الكونغو لمكافحة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A thousand doses of the Ervebo vaccine reach the Congo to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 16,250 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at Ndjili airport, part of a 70,000-dose shipment announced by WHO to combat the current outbreak—the deadliest in the country’s history. The outbreak, the 17th in the DRC, was announced May 15, though transmission began weeks earlier and has affected northern and eastern regions amid fragile health systems and ongoing conflict. Ervebo is approved against Zaire ebolavirus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo, now circulating, is unproven, though animal data hint partial protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Congo reports 5,290 confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths; UN Ebola coordinator Julian Harnais warned of accelerating transmission. Elsewhere, Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford University are developing vaccines, while Hilleman Labs (Singapore) advances an rVSV-Bundibugyo candidate. Ebola has killed over 15,000 in Africa in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策用「エルベボ」ワクチン1000回分（記事文中では16,250回分）がコンゴに到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪とされる第17次エボラ流行で、確定感染5,290例・死亡2,516例に達し、WHOが7万回分のワクチン供給を主導するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な対応が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの第17次エボラ流行（史上最悪規模）とワクチン供給に関するもの。シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点（Hilleman Labs）として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株の流行拡大により既存ワクチンの有効性が不明である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Aru: plus de soixante personnes sensibilisés aux mesures de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Aru: More than sixty people sensitized to preventive measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, in Aru's Ingbokolo area of the Adi health zone, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 60 people were trained on Ebola virus disease prevention. The outreach by the Association de filles-mères (AFM) and partners aims to strengthen community understanding (Zone B) and encourage early adoption of measures to limit spread. Participants were instructed in regular handwashing, use of alcohol-based hand rub, environmental hygiene, physical distancing, and avoiding smoked meat during this period. Although the Adi health zone is not currently affected by Ebola, attendees committed to applying the lessons and sustaining community sensitization. The initiative is part of International Alert's Nashiriki Masikilizano 2 project, funded by the European Union, supporting innovative women-led actions and combating rumors that Ebola exists and kills.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:アルで60人以上が予防対策について啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事は予防啓発活動の実施報告であり、Adi保健区は現在エボラの影響を受けていないと明記されている。新規症例や流行拡大を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はEUおよびInternational Alertが支援する予防啓発プロジェクトの活動報告であり、対象のAdi保健区は現在エボラの影響を受けていないと明記されている。DRC国内の既存エボラ流行の文脈における予防活動と考えられるが、本記事自体は新規発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: ഡൽഹിയിൽ ഇൻഫ്ലുവൻസ കേസുകളിൽ വൻ വർധന; പ്രതിദിനം 159 രോഗികൾ, പകുതിയിലേറെയും എച്ച്1എൻ1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Significant rise in influenza cases in Delhi; 159 patients per day, more than half were H1N1.
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, Delhi reports a sharp rise in influenza cases, with 159 cases recorded on August 20, including 114 H1N1. Cumulative H1N1 infections reach 1,777; influenza A total is 2,392, with overall influenza cases at 2,602. In response, Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda, Delhi Health Minister Dr. Pankaj Kumar Singh, and senior officials reviewed preparedness, emphasizing vigilance, surveillance, hospital bed and critical-care capacity. Authorities urge continued infection control: masks in crowded places, regular handwashing, and avoiding touching eyes, nose, or mouth; self-medication is discouraged. H1N1 is an influenza A subtype causing fever, cough, sore throat, shortness of breath, and body aches; severe symptoms occur in about 10% of cases. Oseltamivir is used for treatment (5 days) and prophylaxis (10 days) under medical guidance. Home care: seek help promptly, stay home until recovery, minimize contact, and cover coughs.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでインフルエンザ症例が急増；1日あたり159人、その半数以上がH1N1
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1を含むインフルエンザ症例が急増し、保健大臣ら政府高官が対応会議を行うなど社会的・政治的関心が高まっており、WPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）にも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1亜型）の国内感染拡大事例。既知の病原体であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低いが、症例急増と政府高官の対応から国内的な注目度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế: Tăng cường giám sát, hạn chế thấp nhất ca tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: Strengthen surveillance to minimize rabies-related deaths.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major public health threat in Vietnam. The Ministry of Health’s Preventive Medicine Department calls on provincial health authorities to strengthen community communication, exposure surveillance, and timely management ahead of World Rabies Day on 28 September 2026. Activities emphasize community and school outreach on bite risks, prevention, wound washing, and prompt post‑exposure prophylaxis (PEP) with rabies vaccine and immunoglobulin when indicated. Agencies should coordinate with veterinary services, monitor exposure cases, apply risk‑assessment protocols, and ensure proper PEP to minimize deaths. From January to June 2026, Vietnam reported 34 rabies deaths, down 10 from the same period in 2025, with 23 fatalities in the Southern region. WOAH/OIE data: 99% of human rabies cases stem from dog bites; over 95% of deaths occur in Asia/Africa; >80% of cases in rural areas; about 40% of deaths are children. In Lam Dong province, a suspected rabid dog bit five people, underscoring continued risk.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省:狂犬病による死亡を最小限に抑えるため監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の風土病であり、政府の対策強化に関する定期的な広報活動の色合いが強いが、継続的な死亡例の発生と啓発活動が続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムの風土病であり、死亡数は前年比で減少傾向。世界狂犬病デー(9/28)に向けた啓発・監視強化の呼びかけ記事であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。ラムドン省での犬咬傷事例が個別に言及されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: क्या कोरोना की तरह देश में तेजी से फैल रहा है Swine Flu ? देखिए H1N1 से जुड़ी पूरी रिपोर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Swine Flu spreading rapidly in the country like the coronavirus? See the complete report related to H1N1.
article.articleSummary: In Delhi, H1N1 influenza cases have surged this year, with 1,777 laboratory-confirmed infections reported; hospitals are on alert, though no fatalities have occurred so far. Swine flu, caused by influenza A(H1N1), was first identified in 2009 in Mexico, with a Science report detailing its genome assembled from segments of swine, poultry, and human influenza viruses. It was later named influenza A(H1N1) 2009 as human transmission increased. The World Health Organization declared a pandemic on June 11, 2009, ending the pandemic phase on August 10, 2010. Since then, H1N1pdm09 has been part of seasonal influenza A strains. A 2012 Lancet Infectious Diseases study estimated about 284,500 pandemic-related deaths in the first year, largely from respiratory and cardiovascular illnesses. The piece notes the spread is slower than SARS-CoV-2, and existing immunity and vaccination may blunt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスのように豚インフルエンザ（スワインフル）が国内で急速に拡大しているのか？H1N1に関する完全レポート
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1確定症例が1,777件に急増し、病院が警戒態勢を取るなど社会的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09株の感染増加であり、死亡例は報告されていない。メキシコは2009年パンデミック起源の歴史的言及であり、現在の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉致民主剛果逾2500死 世界衛生組織擬提供7萬劑疫苗 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 2,500; WHO plans to provide 70,000 vaccine doses.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's city of Goma is confronting a rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Over the past three months, more than 2,500 people have died, with half in the last 20 days. The outbreak is the largest in DRC’s history. About 160 healthcare workers have become infected and 43 have died; more than 260 attacks on medical staff have been recorded in six months, with eight killed. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. The World Health Organization will supply 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline workers. Cases have been confirmed near the DRC–Central African Republic border. CAR faces humanitarian crises, and the UN has released $3 million to strengthen Ebola prevention there.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により2500人以上が死亡、WHOが7万回分のワクチン提供を計画
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者2500人超、医療従事者への大規模感染・攻撃、国境を越えた拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国（CAR）国境付近でも症例が確認されているが、CARは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチンに承認された特効薬がなく、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種に対するフェーズ3試験が計画されている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola už zasáhla území větší než Francie. WHO se rozhodla pro experiment s vakcínou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has already affected an area larger than France. The WHO has decided to conduct a vaccine trial.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused more than 2,500 deaths and over 5,000 confirmed cases. The outbreak covers an area larger than France, with half of recent fatalities occurring in the last twenty days. WHO will deploy 70,000 doses of Merck vaccine, approved against the Zaire strain; preliminary data suggest partial protection against Bundibugyo. The current epidemic is the deadliest in the DRC’s history, surpassed only by the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016, which recorded over 28,000 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Ebola emerged in 1976 in what is now DRC. There are five strains: Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, Reston, and Zaire; three cause severe disease in humans. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, and bodily fluids, endangering healthcare workers and prompting calls for better funding and supplies; the virus may also affect animals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行地域はフランスの国土面積を超える規模に。WHOはワクチンの試験的導入を決定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」の2つが該当し、DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける現行のエボラ流行（史上最悪規模、2500人以上死亡、5000件以上の確定例）を主題としている。フランス・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは面積比較や過去の2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の言及であり、現行の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola se torna o mais letal da história e mortes continuam aumentando
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak becomes the deadliest in history and deaths continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo becomes the deadliest in the country's history. As of August 15, 2026, there are 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Declared in May 2026, the current epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a variant for which there is no licensed, specific vaccine or approved therapy. About 47% case fatality rate, driven by delays in case identification and treatment initiation. The eastern DRC region is affected, marked by conflict, displacement, and weak health access, hindering surveillance, contact tracing, and leading to distrust of treatment centers. The WHO considers the risk very high and is expanding surveillance, diagnostics, and patient care while vaccine candidates and treatments are under evaluation. Uganda has reported cases but transmission has been contained. The global record for Ebola deaths remains the 2014–2016 outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, about 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が史上最悪の致死状況に、死者数が増加し続ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が同国史上最悪の致死数となり、WHOがリスクを非常に高いと評価している。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争地域での対応困難など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例は封じ込め済みと記載されているため、DRCのみを主たる発生地域として検証。シエラレオネ・リベラ・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去最悪流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho amplia diagnóstico e fortalece ações de enfrentamento às hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho expands diagnosis and strengthens actions to combat viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil reports expanded viral hepatitis detection and care through broader testing, vaccination, and follow-up by the municipal health network. In 2025, residents recorded 215 hepatitis B, 133 hepatitis C cases, plus 1 hepatitis A case and 1 hepatitis B+D coinfection. Compared with 2024, hepatitis B infections rose from 173 to 215 (+≈24%), while hepatitis C declined from 141 to 133 (−≈5.7%). Geisa Brasil, director of the Health Surveillance Department, notes the rise in hepatitis B cases likely reflects expanded testing and diagnostic capacity rather than a transmission surge. Viral hepatitis can be asymptomatic long-term, so increased testing enables identification and linkage to care, treatment, and monitoring to prevent disease progression. Surveillance, Primary Care, and referral services operate in an integrated manner to strengthen identification and management of infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・ヴェーリョ、診断を拡大しウイルス性肝炎対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 検査体制拡充による診断数増加であり、当局も感染拡大ではなく検出能力向上と説明しており、国際的懸念や異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 地域の公衆衛生活動報告であり、検査拡大による症例数の見かけ上の増加が主因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: बरसात जनित बीमारियों के कारण अस्पतालों में मरीजों की संख्या बढ़ी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of patients in hospitals has risen due to monsoon-related illnesses.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon fluctuations in Shravasti have increased outpatient visits at the Community Health Centre Ikauna. OPD registrations reached 580 on Friday and 540 on Saturday, with patients primarily presenting with cold symptoms, cough, throat infections, allergies, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and dehydration. Dr. Ankit Agarwal links the surge to temperature swings that accelerate viral infections, especially among children, the elderly, and those with weak immunity; fever and water-borne diseases are noted risks in this season. Doctors are counseling preventive measures, including drinking boiled water and maintaining hygiene. Distant patients arriving in crowds have strained health services. Dr. Ashish Srivastav notes rising monsoon-related viral infections and diarrhea, advising boiled water, freshly cooked meals, and avoidance of openly sold street foods.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンに関連する疾患により病院の患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーン関連疾患（風邪、下痢等）によるOPD患者増加であり、原因不明の重篤な集団感染ではなく、通常の季節変動の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン季節に伴う一般的な感染症（風邪、下痢、脱水症状等）の報告であり、特定の病原体や異常な集団発生は確認されていない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Surges in Delhi: Health Ministry Lists Symptoms as Doctors Warn of 'Second-Highest Wave' Since 2009
article.articleSummary: H1N1, a strain of Influenza A causing respiratory infection, is surging in Delhi as health authorities warn of a 'second-highest wave' since the 2009 pandemic. The virus, though infamous in 2009, remains a circulating seasonal strain. Respiratory- and critical-care specialist Dr. Rajesh Chawla notes H1N1 typically resurfaces in Delhi during the pre-monsoon and monsoon seasons. With changing viral strains, population immunity can be limited, increasing susceptibility. Transmission occurs through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes, and can spread via contaminated hands and close contact, he told Times Now. The Health Ministry has listed symptoms for H1N1, underscoring the ongoing outbreak in the region as of 2026-08-22.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1が急増：保健省が症状を公表、医師らは2009年以来『2番目に大きな波』と警告
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザA型）の患者増加が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度データが記事に示されておらず、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の再流行として保健省が症状情報を発表した段階の記事であり、症例数・重症度・死亡者数等の定量的データが欠如している。続報で規模や重症度が明らかになった場合、フルリスク評価への格上げを検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Congo recibe más de 16,000 dosis de vacuna contra el ébola ante un brote sin precedentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine in response to an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine as it confronts what health authorities describe as the fastest Ebola outbreak in history. The shipments landed at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa on Friday night, part of a 70,000-dose allocation announced by the World Health Organization and partners. Health authorities expect additional vaccine doses early next week to bolster vaccination campaigns targeting contacts, health workers, and other frontline responders. The arrival underscores an intensified international response to curb transmission, with vaccination serving as a central strategy in outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、前例のない流行を受けエボラワクチン16,000回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の「史上最速」とされる流行に対し、WHOと国際社会が大規模ワクチン供給で対応しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態でIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は『史上最速』のエボラ流行と表現しており、WHOと国際パートナーによる70,000回分のワクチン配布計画の一部としてキンシャサに到着したことを報じている。詳細な症例数・死亡者数・地理的拡大範囲は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola quarantine hindering response: aid workers
article.articleSummary: As of Aug. 22, 2026, Canada’s 21-day mandatory quarantine for travelers returning from Ebola-affected areas—Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan—is due to expire Aug. 29, with a government review ongoing. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing in history, with Africa’s top public health body reporting more than 5,000 infections and over 2,500 deaths; Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on July 28 after 20 infections and 2 deaths, while South Sudan has reported no cases. The policy has hindered aid work, with MSF reporting 11 Canadians canceling deployments as of Aug. 20 and 23 Canadians previously involved in the DRC Ebola response. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids, not airborne, and incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days. Critics say the blanket travel restrictions lack scientific basis, while officials cite risk reduction and early detection as aims of the measures during interim review.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ隔離措置が対応を妨げている:援助関係者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（史上最速拡大のアウトブレイクで5,000人超感染・2,500人超死亡、渡航制限措置も発生）し、国際支援の必要性や社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC由来のエボラアウトブレイクとそれに伴うカナダの渡航者隔離政策。ウガンダは7月28日に終息宣言済み、南スーダンは症例報告なしのため、対象国リストにも含まれず除外。カナダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 중국서 코로나19 다시 확산"...국내 코로나 지표도 증가세 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 resurges in China... Domestic COVID indicators are also on the rise, raising concerns.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in China, with July 2026 new confirmed cases exceeding 522,000, 487 severe cases and 1 death. Among patients with respiratory symptoms, COVID-19 positivity rose from 8.2% (Jun 29–Jul 5) to 21.2% (Jul 27–Aug 2) across 1,041 sentinel hospitals, per China CDC surveillance, though authorities do not foresee a pandemic-scale outbreak. In South Korea, respiratory-virus monitoring shows SARS-CoV-2 detected in 9.1% of samples from 106 institutions during the 33rd week (Aug 11–17, 2026), up from 3.2% in week 30, with weeks 31–32 at 5.9% and 5.7%. Taiwan reports rising cases with temporary vaccine shortages in some areas. Experts warn outbreak size is hard to predict and stress securing initial vaccine supplies, recalling past year’s vaccine stockouts that impeded elderly vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でCOVID-19再拡大…国内(韓国)のコロナ指標も増加傾向で懸念
triage.triage_reason: 中国・韓国・台湾で同時にCOVID-19の陽性率・症例数が急増しており国際的拡大がみられる上、ワクチン供給不足という社会的関心事項も存在するため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 重症化率・致死率は低いが、中国・韓国・台湾で陽性率が急上昇しており、台湾では一部地域でワクチン供給不足も報告されている。季節性の再流行と見られるが、多国での同時拡大とワクチン供給懸念から継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Onde último caso de raiva humana ocorreu em MS, fronteira recebe campanha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where the latest human rabies case occurred in MS, the border receives a campaign.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign targets dogs and cats in Corumbá and Ladário, Mato Grosso do Sul, on the Brazil–Bolivia border, starting 22 August 2026, with parallel actions in Assis Brasil, Epitaciolândia, Brasiléia (Acre), Cáceres (Mato Grosso), and Guajará-Mirim (Rondônia). Conducted by the Ministry of Health, the campaign distributes vaccines and information materials and strengthens integrated rabies surveillance in border areas with high cross-border animal movement. Brazil has had no human rabies cases from dog-transmitted variants AgV1/AgV2 in a decade. The most recent human case in Mato Grosso do Sul was in 2015 in Corumbá (38-year-old man bitten by a dog; died after hospital care). Rabies persists in wildlife—bats, primates, foxes. From 2016–2026, 37 human cases in Brazil were sylvatic: bats (22), primates (7), cats with bat variant (4), foxes (2), a dog (1), a bovine (1).

triage.headline_ja: MSで最後の狂犬病人体感染が発生した国境地帯でワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な動物向け狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、犬媒介型による人での感染は10年間発生なし。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内であり、新規の感染急増や異常事態を示すものではない。ボリビアとの国境地域での野生動物由来（コウモリ等）狂犬病サーベイランス強化が主目的。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تتسلم أكثر من 16 ألف جرعة من لقاح إيبولا وسط تفش غير مسبوق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine amid an unprecedented outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives over 16,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine amid an unprecedented Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. A 16,250-dose shipment arrived at Ndjili International Airport, Kinshasa, as part of a 70,000-dose pledge by WHO and partners, with more doses anticipated next week. The current outbreak, the fastest in Ebola history, is caused by the rare Bundibugyo lineage with no licensed treatment or vaccine. As of Friday, 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths have been reported. Ervebo is licensed for use against Ebola and has shown efficacy in past outbreaks; WHO says it may provide some protection against Bundibugyo. Transmission is not yet at a peak and could triple the current rate per Africa CDC data. Containment challenges include armed conflict, attacks on medical staff and facilities, population displacement, and fragile infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、前例のない流行の中でエボラワクチン1万6000回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率の高い前例のないブンディブギョ株流行として社会的関心も高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 5,290確認症例、2,516死亡（致死率約47.6%）と非常に高い致死率。ワクチンの有効性は未確立（Bundibugyo株に対する交差防御は不明）。武力紛争等により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands of Ervebo vaccine doses arrive in Ebola-stricken DRC
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, with 5,375 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths reported across six provinces. The outbreak, the fastest in Ebola history, risks surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa toll of more than 11,000. Ervebo vaccines, licensed for the Zaire strain, began arriving in Kinshasa, with 16,250 doses delivered to N'djili International Airport and a total of 70,000 doses expected from WHO and partners; more doses are expected early next week. The vaccine’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo is not proven, though WHO indicates potential partial protection. Transmission remains high and detection difficult due to symptom overlap with malaria. Containment is hindered by armed conflict, attacks on medical staff and facilities, underpaid responders, population displacement, and fragile infrastructure, complicating contact tracing and mass movements.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大のコンゴ民主共和国に数千回分のエルベボワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大なエボラ流行（まれなブンディブギョ株、致死率高、武力紛争下での対応困難）であり、国際的な注目・支援も明確なため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリー中では流行国として言及されていないため verified_locations から除外した。ワクチンはザイール株用でブンディブギョ株への有効性は未証明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : ces guérisons qui redonnent confiance à la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: these recoveries that restore confidence in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with notable recoveries at the Ebola Treatment Center in Katwa, near Butembo. On August 21, 2026, eight patients left the Katwa ETC: four were declared cured and four others, initially admitted as suspects, tested negative and were discharged. A survivor treated at the center and eight of his family members were also declared cured. Health authorities urge rapid care for fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or other Ebola-compatible symptoms to counter fear and misinformation. Logistics support has strengthened the response, including 16 UNICEF-provided vehicles for decontamination delivered by August 19, and newly converted 130-bed capacities in health zones of Wamba and Isiro in Haut-Uele. Cumulatively, 1,152 people have recovered; 5,290 tested positive and 2,516 deaths have been reported as of August 21, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：対応への信頼を取り戻す回復者たち
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は累計陽性5,290人・死亡2,516人と極めて深刻な規模であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限リスク）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は回復者の増加や物資支援（UNICEF提供車両、Wamba・Isiroでの130床新設）など、対応の前向きな側面を報じているが、累計症例数・死亡者数は依然として大規模であり、流行は継続中。既知の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報道であり、フルRRAでの経過確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: لمواجهة الفيروس القاتل.. 16 ألف جرعة من لقاح إيبولا تصل الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To confront the deadly virus... 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine arrive in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived amid Africa’s deadliest outbreak to date. The World Health Organization said Congo will receive a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses, the only vaccine officially approved. Ervebo is active against Zaire ebolavirus, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the strain now circulating—remains unproven. Early animal data suggest some protection against Bundibugyo, yet human efficacy is unestablished. The Congo’s latest report, as of 22 August 2026, lists 5,290 confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths. WHO vaccine experts urged large-scale human trials to determine protection against Bundibugyo. Vaccines targeting Bundibugyo are in clinical trials; Moderna is developing an mRNA vaccine, Oxford is pursuing another candidate, and Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore is accelerating development of the rVSV-Bundibugyo vaccine for trials. The virus remains deadly, with more than 15,000 Africa-wide deaths in five decades.

article.articleHeadline: Kongo har mottatt over 16.000 doser vaksine mot ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo has received over 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: First 16,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine have arrived in Kinshasa as part of an initial shipment for the Kongo outbreak in eastern Congo, with 16,250 doses arriving in the capital on Friday and 70,000 more expected from WHO and partners. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved specific treatment, and its rapid spread produces malaria-like symptoms. Ervebo, approved for Ebola, has shown effectiveness in prior outbreaks; WHO says it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo virus. In the eastern Kongo outbreak, there have been 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths, and the trajectory appears to be worsening beyond the 2014-16 West Africa Ebola epidemic that claimed about 11,000 lives.

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine preparedness for Bundibugyo virus and lessons learned - npj Vaccines
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda in May 2026 is the largest on record. The most affected areas are Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces (DRC) and Kampala and Wakiso (Uganda); cross-border transmission prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. By Aug 7, 2026, >4,200 BDBV-confirmed cases with 1,916 deaths in DRC and 20 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda; numbers continue to rise amid armed conflict and large displacement, with limited testing initially. BDBV, a close relative of EBOV and SUDV, causes severe hemorrhagic fever with a 2–21 day incubation and historically high CFRs (~32% in Uganda, 2007–08; ~55% in DRC, 2012). Transmission occurs via contaminated body fluids. The article highlights vaccine preparedness, noting EBOV vaccines Zabdeno/Mvabea (Ad26 prime, MVA boost) with EBOV prophylaxis indication and ERVEBO (rVSV-EBOV-GP) for rapid immunity, underscoring the need for proactive, data-ready countermeasures specific to BDBV.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルスに対するワクチン準備態勢と教訓 - npj Vaccines

article.articleHeadline: Philippines floods: Philippines: Leptospirosis cases surge amid heavy rains, floods
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis surge amid Philippines floods: Iloilo Province reports deaths at double the rate of the same period in 2025, while Manila’s San Lazaro Hospital—national infectious disease referral center—has 50 leptospirosis cases and two deaths. Widespread flooding from persistent heavy rains drives transmission. San Lazaro Hospital has opened an express lane for leptospirosis patients. Local authorities advocate prophylaxis or preventive antibiotics for those exposed to floodwaters. Reports cited local media via Xinhua (TV5). Published 2026-08-22.

article.articleHeadline: Kongo dostalo první dávky vakcíny, která se v minulosti osvědčila proti ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo received the first doses of a vaccine that has previously proven effective against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-22, Congo faces an Ebola outbreak with 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths. More than 16,000 vaccine doses have been delivered; Congo will receive a total of 70,000 doses, though the vaccine is not specifically for the Bundibugyo variant, WHO says it may offer some protection. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, and the delivered doses will also support research into effectiveness against this variant. The outbreak is spreading rapidly across six provinces, with UN Ebola chief Julien Harneis warning that it is advancing faster than response capacity. Experts warn it could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (over 11,000 deaths). Conflict between government and rebels and attacks on health workers hinder control efforts. Ebola transmits via contact with an infected person or contaminated material, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and muscle pains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが過去にエボラに効果を示したワクチンの最初の投与分を受け取る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例5,375人、死亡2,557人に達する大規模エボラ流行が6州に急速拡大しており、対応能力を上回るペースで進行、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株である点も含めIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo dostalo prvé dávky vakcíny, ktorá sa v minulosti osvedčila proti ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo received the first doses of a vaccine that has previously proven effective against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Congo continues to accelerate, with six provinces reporting intense transmission. Over 5,375 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths have been recorded. The UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warned the epidemic is spreading faster than authorities can respond. The Congo has received more than 16,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine proven effective in previous outbreaks; a total of 70,000 doses will be delivered and used to study effectiveness against the Bundibugyo variant. The vaccine is not specifically approved for Bundibugyo, and there is no approved treatment or vaccine for that variant. Ongoing challenges include armed conflict between the government and rebel groups controlling key cities and attacks on health facilities, hindering response. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and bleeding, and transmission occurs via direct contact with an infected person or contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが過去にエボラに有効性を示したワクチンの初回投与分を受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模アウトブレイクが6州で急速に拡大し、死亡者2,557人・確定症例5,375例を超え、武力紛争が対応を妨げているため、IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、武力紛争による対応困難がリスクを増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | 16 ألف جرعة من لقاح إيبولا تصل إلى الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine arrive in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: August 22, 2026 — In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 16,250 doses of Merck's Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived as the country battles the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. Declared May 15 as the 17th DRC outbreak, spread is likely weeks old, hitting northern and eastern areas with weak state presence and frail health infrastructure amid long-running conflict. WHO says 70,000 Ervebo doses will be delivered: 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The country has 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths. Experts warn whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo is uncertain; data from animal studies suggest possible protection, while human trials are being urged. Trial efforts are complemented by Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford vaccine programs, and Singapore's Helman Labs accelerating an rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine for eventual human testing.

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: CCZ de Araçatuba realiza feira de adoção e exames de leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Araçatuba's Zoonosis Control Center holds an adoption fair and tests for leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Eight dogs—four adult males and four puppies—will be at Araçatuba, Brazil's Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) adoption fair on Saturday, August 22, 2026, from 14:30 to 19:00, as part of the Band Pet Show - Tudo de Bom organized by Band Paulista. Eight dogs were rescued after situations of mistreatment or abandonment. Alongside adoptions, the CCZ is offering free tests for early diagnosis of canine visceral leishmaniasis. The event takes place at Store 3 of Supermercado Rondon, Avenida José Ferreira Baptista, 2,300, in the Ipanema neighborhood. The fair provides an opportunity to adopt these dogs and screen for leishmaniasis.

article.articleHeadline: Sarampión en Perú: Minsa emite alerta epidemiológica por aumento de casos y riesgo de propagación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Peru: Ministry of Health issues an epidemiological alert due to an increase in cases and risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Peru prompts epidemiological alert AE-CDC-007-2026 as cases rise across 24 departments. Through epidemiological week 33 of 2026, 1,747 confirmed cases; Puno leads with 1,264, Arequipa 292, with Cusco, Lima and Madre de Dios also affected. To curb transmission, the government extended the health emergency for 90 days via Supreme Decree 013-2026-SA, citing local transmission in Puno and risk of spread to Lima Metropolitana, Arequipa, Cusco and additional regions (Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac and Callao). Minsa intensifies measles vaccination among health facility staff—doctors, nurses and all personnel, prioritizing high-exposure areas (emergency, triage, outpatient services, ICUs, hospitalization, operating rooms, laboratories). Health facilities are to implement differentiated triage and immediately isolate anyone with fever and rash to reduce waiting-room transmission. Emphasizes surveillance, early detection, vaccination and strict infection-control measures to contain spread given high transmissibility and gaps in vaccination coverage.

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'Ebola hors de contrôle, l'ONU en alerte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola Out of Control, UN on Alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 2,516 deaths among 5,290 cases since the outbreak began on May 15, 2026, with 1,152 recoveries and about 840 patients still isolated or hospitalized. The case fatality rate stands at 47.6%, and contact tracing is at 82.9%. Bunia, in Ituri province, remains the epicenter, with the outbreak spreading exponentially; roughly half of recent deaths occurred in the last 20 days. Funding is nearly exhausted, with current resources covering only a few weeks, and two years of budget cuts have reduced humanitarian capacities by more than 30%. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warns that delays in funding and action will worsen mortality, hamper containment, and raise costs, calling for immediate international mobilization. The United States has provided $80 million to support hospitals, secure burials, and fight the virus, but the UN deems this insufficient given the scale.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラが制御不能に、国連が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.6%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが指数関数的に拡大しており、国連が国際的な緊急動員を呼びかけている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: 米国の資金援助や地理座標にUnited Statesが含まれるが、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。資金不足により状況悪化の懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: احتواء التفشي الأشد فتكا لـ"إيبولا" لا يزال ممكنا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Containment of the deadliest Ebola outbreak remains possible
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with key input from Bunia and surrounding communities. By 21 August 2026, there were 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths across 56 health zones, marking the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. The surge began about 100 days earlier after confirmation of Bundibugyo virus, triggering a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the World Health Organization, and a parallel alert by Africa CDC. Ongoing insecurity from decades of conflict has displaced more than 1 million people, complicating response efforts. Frontline responders include health workers providing care, laboratories identifying the virus, and contact-tracing teams; community health workers and burial teams are pivotal for rebuilding trust, countering misinformation, guiding families to care, and ensuring safe, dignified burials. Emphasis on community-led response underscores faster, more effective containment.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最も致死的なエボラ流行、封じ込めはなお可能
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言された大規模エボラ流行で、症例数・死亡者数が非常に多く、紛争による人口移動や治安不安定が国際的拡大リスクを高めているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言およびAfrica CDCによる並行アラートが発出済み。紛争による100万人超の避難民発生が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak battle ramps up with first batch of 70,000 vaccines
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The first batch of 70,000 vaccines has arrived; 16,250 doses landed at N'djili International Airport, Kinshasa, as part of a WHO- and partner-sourced shipment, with more doses due early next week. The Ervebo vaccine, licensed to treat Ebola, may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. As of Friday 21 August 2026, the outbreak has 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, and is spreading at an unprecedented rate, on track to surpass the West Africa deadliest 2014–2016 outbreak; transmission has not peaked and could triple. Containment is hampered by armed conflict, attacks on medical personnel and facilities, a mobile and displaced population, and weak infrastructure. Symptoms appear 2–21 days after infection and start flu-like (fever, fatigue, muscle aches, sore throat, headache); later vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, rash, bruising, jaundice, and possible bleeding. UK risk is low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行対策強化、7万回分のワクチン第一便が到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCでバンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が5,290症例・2,516死亡と過去最悪級の規模に拡大しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないバンディブギョウイルス株による流行で、武力紛争や医療従事者への攻撃、住民の移動により封じ込めが困難。西アフリカ2014-2016流行を超える規模に達する見込みで、感染者数はまだピークに達していない。UKやAngolaは発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв лихорадки Эбола возросло до 2 557 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the death toll from Ebola fever has risen to 2,557 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains an active outbreak, with the death toll rising to 2,557 according to the National Institute of Public Health of the DRC. The report indicates the outbreak spans six provinces and 56 health zones affected by the epidemic. There are 5,375 confirmed cases, of which 1,167 have recovered and 737 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. The case fatality rate stands at 47.6%. Ongoing response efforts are underway across the affected areas, reflecting sustained transmission and a heavy burden on public health systems. All figures are reported as of August 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が2,557人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6州56保健地区にわたる大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、致死率47.6%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためIHR基準に複数該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch nach 100 Tagen weiter nicht unter Kontrolle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak after 100 days still not under control.
article.articleSummary: As of 100 days after the Ebola outbreak was announced in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, over 5,000 cases and more than 2,500 deaths have been recorded. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the epidemic is far from under control and represents the second-largest Ebola outbreak, spreading faster than any prior. In week 13 since disclosure, confirmed cases were nearly tenfold those of the 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak at the same stage, with deaths more than sevenfold higher; the West Africa outbreak totaled over 11,000 deaths. A large undercount is suspected; experts note cases and fatalities are likely higher, with far over 2,000 deaths since the start. The 17th Congo Ebola outbreak was officially announced in mid-May and now spans six provinces, expanding from Ituri. MSF runs seven treatment centers (≈430 beds, 1,400 staff) across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Insecurity and transport restrictions hinder response; the upcoming rainy season may raise malaria, cholera, and measles.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、発生から100日経過も依然として制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模エボラ流行が発生し、5000症例・2500人以上の死亡、6州に拡大しWHOも深刻な警告を発しており、IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事は第17回コンゴエボラ流行（イツリ州発、北キブ・南キブ・チョポ州等6州に拡大）に関するもの。マラリア・コレラ・麻疹は雨季による二次的懸念として言及されており、主題ではない。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تستقبل 16,250 جرعة من لقاح إيبولا بعد 2,516 وفاة - نافذة مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 16,250 doses of the Ebola vaccine after 2,516 deaths - Egypt Window
article.articleSummary: DRC receives 16,250 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine at N’djili airport as part of the response to the 17th outbreak in northern and eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths. WHO says 70,000 Ervebo doses will follow, but access in hard-to-reach areas may limit impact; 50,000 doses are earmarked for frontline health workers. The vaccine is proven against the Zaire strain, but effectiveness against Bundibugyo—the current circulating strain—is unconfirmed, though early animal data offer cautious optimism. WHO recommends human trials with 20,000 doses to assess protection against Bundibugyo. Other vaccines (Moderna, Oxford candidates) and a VSV-based vaccine from Hilleman Labs are in development. Experts warn vaccines alone cannot end the outbreak in conflict-affected, under-resourced regions without trust, surveillance, safe burials, and rapid case isolation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、2,516人の死者を経てエボラワクチン16,250回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行は確定症例5,290件・死者2,516人に達し、循環株（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン有効性が未確認であるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態でありIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 現在流行中の株はブンディブギョ株であり、既存のErvebo（ザイール株用）ワクチンの有効性が未確認である点が特に懸念される。紛争地域・アクセス困難地域での対応の難しさも指摘されている。
