article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में स्वाइन फ्लू के बढ़ते मामलों के बीच स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने कसी कमर, कहा- अस्पतालों में नहीं है बेड, डॉक्टरों और दवाओं की कमी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid rising swine flu cases in Delhi, the health department rolled up its sleeves, saying there are no beds in hospitals and a shortage of doctors and medicines.
article.articleSummary: Delhi registered 2,392 influenza A infections this year, including 1,777 H1N1 (swine flu) cases. On Thursday alone, 114 H1N1 cases were reported. Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh said the city is fully prepared to tackle rising seasonal influenza, after a review meeting chaired by Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda on preparedness for seasonal influenza and vector-borne diseases. Health department data for Thursday show 159 influenza cases, of which 155 were influenza A: 114 H1N1, 2 H1, 1 H3, and 38 other influenza-A. There were also four influenza-B cases. The title notes concerns about hospital bed shortages and limited doctors and medicines, underscoring urgent public-health pressures in Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例増加、保健当局が対応強化—病院で病床不足、医師・薬剤不足の指摘
triage.triage_reason: デリーで季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1中心）症例が急増し病床・医療資源逼迫が報じられているが、季節性流行自体は例年発生する事象であり異常性・国際拡大の明確な根拠はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優位）の症例増加と医療キャパシティ逼迫に関する国内報道。重症例・死亡数の具体的データはなく、国際的拡大の兆候も見られないためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: The number of patients increased : भारतात H1N1 चा वाढता संसर्ग; स्वाइन फ्लूपासून बचावासाठी महत्त्वाच्या उपाययोजना
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of patients increased: Rising H1N1 transmission in India; Important measures to prevent swine flu
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, India is witnessing a rise in H1N1 (swine flu) cases across multiple states, including children. Experts say there is no immediate cause for alarm, but vulnerable groups—especially children with asthma and other susceptible individuals—should exercise heightened caution. H1N1 is an influenza A virus responsible for outbreaks since the 2009-10 pandemic and typically causes fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, body aches, chills, and fatigue; vomiting and diarrhea can be more common in children. Preventive measures emphasized include covering the mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, hand hygiene with soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizer, avoiding touching the face, maintaining distance from the ill, and staying home when sick. Annual flu vaccination is encouraged and can help protect against major influenza strains including H1N1. For severe symptoms, follow medical advice and seek antiviral treatment as appropriate.

triage.headline_ja: 患者数が増加：インドでH1N1感染が拡大；豚インフルエンザ予防のための重要な対策
triage.triage_reason: インド複数州でH1N1（季節性）感染者増加が報告されているが、専門家は差し迫った警戒不要としており、重症化や国際的拡大の情報はない。既知の季節性インフルエンザであり情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり、記事は主に予防啓発が目的。専門家コメントでも重大視されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Aux abords de Kinshasa, stopper Ebola sur le fleuve Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the outskirts of Kinshasa, halting Ebola on the Congo River.
article.articleSummary: More than 2,500 deaths have occurred in the Democratic Republic of Congo during its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain and declared May 15. As of 22 August 2026, Kinshasa (≈17 million people) has no confirmed cases, but authorities monitor river transit along the Congo River. At the Bende-Bende port in Maluku, river passengers from the East and North undergo temperature checks, symptom screening, and contact data collection, with disinfection of boats to prevent importation. Kisangani reports about 15 suspected cases; the river corridor sustains high importation risk given heavy river traffic. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; clinical trials are underway, and 70,000 doses of the Zaïre/Ebola vaccine Ervebo have been sent to DRC to evaluate its impact on Bundibugyo. Thirty suspected cases tested negative since early August. The WHO has warned the outbreak is far from under control.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ近郊、コンゴ川でエボラ拡大を阻止する取り組み
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）で死者2,500人超、キンシャサへの拡大リスクが指摘されており、WHOも「制御には程遠い」と警告するなどIHR基準を複数満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: 承認されたブンディブギョ株用ワクチン・治療法は無く、Ervebo（ザイール株用ワクチン）7万回分をDRCに送付し効果を評価中。キサンガニでは疑い例約15件、コンゴ川流域の交通量が多く輸入リスクが高いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Россия поможет Южному Судану предотвратить распространение Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia will help South Sudan prevent the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Russia is examining humanitarian aid to South Sudan to prevent Ebola spread. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo—countries bordering South Sudan—as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with regional risk assessed as high. South Sudan’s health ministry currently estimates its readiness to handle a possible outbreak at 65%, and there are no travel restrictions for Russian citizens entering the country. As of the latest data, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 2,300, with over 5,000 confirmed cases. The United Nations notes a rapid growth of the epidemic, underscoring cross-border risk to other nations.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、南スーダンにおけるエボラ拡大防止を支援へ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがウガンダ・DRCのエボラ流行をPHEICと宣言し、DRCでは死者2,300人超・症例5,000人超と深刻化。国境を越えた拡散リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの人道支援と南スーダンの備えを主題としているが、実際の感染拡大の中心はDRC（死者2,300人超、症例5,000人超）。ウガンダ・スーダン・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南スーダンも対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: लक्षण एक जैसे, लेकिन बीमारी अलग! H1N1, H3N2 और डेंगू में क्या है फर्क? जो मिलकर दिल्ली में मचा रहे आतंक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms are the same, but the diseases are different! What is the difference between H1N1, H3N2, and dengue, which are wreaking havoc in Delhi?
article.articleSummary: Delhi is currently dealing with simultaneous outbreaks of H1N1 (swine flu), H3N2, and dengue as the season shifts. H1N1 and H3N2 are influenza A viruses with overlapping early symptoms: high fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headaches, body aches, and fatigue, with possible breathlessness. Dengue is mosquito-borne and presents with high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital eye pain, intense muscle and joint pains, fatigue, and sometimes a red skin rash; platelet counts may fall, but low platelets alone do not determine severity. Because symptoms overlap, doctors rely on tests for accurate diagnosis. Alarm signs warrant urgent care: difficulty breathing, chest pain, persistent vomiting, extreme weakness, fainting, or abnormal bleeding from the nose or gums. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics; timely testing and appropriate treatment are essential to reduce complications for H1N1, H3N2, and dengue in Delhi and neighboring areas like Noida.

triage.headline_ja: 症状は同じでも病気は違う！H1N1、H3N2、デングの違いとは？デリーで猛威を振るう感染症
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザA(H1N1/H3N2)とデング熱に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増などの新規性・緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性感染症（H1N1、H3N2、デング熱）の症状の違いを説明する医療啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や重症度、拡大状況のデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil teve mais de mil suspeitas da doença Creutzfeldt-Jakob em 16 anos | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil had more than a thousand suspected cases of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease in 16 years | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease (CJD), a rare fatal prion disease, caused Brazil to record 1,576 suspected notifications from 2005–2021. São Paulo led with 512, followed by Paraná (189) and Minas Gerais (158). Most cases occur in adults 55–74. CJD features rapid cognitive and psychomotor decline: ataxia, tremors, myoclonus, memory loss, dementia, language and vision disturbances, fatigue, and sleep changes. About 85% are sporadic, 5–15% hereditary, and <1% iatrogenic; in very rare cases, bovine spongiform encephalopathy–related beef is implicated. Not transmitted by casual contact. No therapy reverses progression; ~90% die within a year of onset; care is multidisciplinary and palliative. Brazil’s Notifiable Diseases Surveillance has tracked these notifications since 2005.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで過去16年間にクロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病の疑い例が1000件以上
triage.triage_reason: 2005〜2021年の過去の症例統計に関する報告であり、新規の異常発生や急性のアウトブレイクを示すものではないため。
triage.notes: CJDは孤発性が大半（85%）で、BSE関連は極めて稀と明記されており、ヒト-ヒト感染も否定されている。過去の疫学統計データの報告であり、緊急性のあるシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: plus de 5.300 cas, l'ONU alerte sur une propagation "exponentielle"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: More than 5,300 cases, the UN warns of an 'exponential' spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) surpasses 5,300 confirmed cases and over 2,550 deaths, with 5,375 cases and 2,557 fatalities reported across six provinces as of Aug 2026. Global case fatality stands at 47.6%; 1,167 patients have recovered. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warned the epidemic is growing exponentially, with half of deaths occurring in the last 20 days and the outbreak spreading beyond earlier fears, covering an area larger than France and advancing faster than the response. Declared May 15, the outbreak is the deadliest in DRC history and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Health workers have suffered 160 infections and 43 deaths; frontline ambulances and facilities have been attacked amid security and funding challenges. WHO has mobilized 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses (20,000 for a phase 3 trial, 50,000 for frontline use); 16,520 doses arrived in Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:症例数5,300人超、国連は「指数関数的」拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が指数関数的に拡大しており、致死率47.6%、医療従事者への感染・攻撃も発生。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFrance、Angolaが含まれるが、記事では流行範囲の広さの比較対象（フランスより広い面積）として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。フランス・アンゴラは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 6,7 Juta Orang Indonesia Idap Hepatitis B, Ini Gejala dan Cara Cegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6.7 Million Indonesians Have Hepatitis B: Here Are the Symptoms and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces substantial hepatitis burden with about 6.7 million people infected with hepatitis B and 2.5 million with hepatitis C. Among hepatitis types, B and C are most common in the country and can progress to chronic infection or liver cancer. Hepatitis A and E spread via contaminated food or water, while B and C transmit through blood and other body fluids; hepatitis D can infect only those with hepatitis B and can worsen disease. Prevention differs: hepatitis B vaccination is available and emphasized for newborns and high-risk adults; Hepatitis C has no vaccine, so prevention centers on avoiding exposure to infected blood and shared syringes, razors, and unsterile equipment. Treatments vary: A and E typically self-resolve; hepatitis C is curable in over 95% of cases with early treatment; hepatitis B and D require long-term, guideline-based care. Early detection and vaccination are urged to reduce hepatitis burden.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア人670万人がB型肝炎を罹患：症状と予防法
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性疾患負担に関する啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既存の慢性B型・C型肝炎の統計と予防啓発を目的とした一般health記事であり、突発的な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rientrato l'allarme Ebola in Trentino: negativo il test sul caso sospetto del paziente tornato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola alarm in Trentino has subsided: the test for the suspected case of the patient who returned from the Congo was negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in Trentino subsided after tests on a suspected case returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were negative. A patient who had recently traveled from DRC was isolated in Trentino after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola. Samples were taken in Trentino and analyzed at the Sacco Hospital in Milan; the laboratory results were negative for Ebola. The Italian Ministry of Health stated that the alarm is over, but will remain in contact with local authorities and continue monitoring the situation. The Department of Prevention notes ongoing surveillance and coordination with territorial contacts. No confirmed cases or deaths reported. The incident underlines vigilance for travelers returning from high-risk areas and the need for prompt isolation and testing when symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: トレンティーノでのエボラ警報解除:コンゴから帰国した患者の疑い例の検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例は検査の結果エボラ陰性であり、確定症例・死亡例もなく、公衆衛生上の脅威は既に解消されている。
triage.notes: 本記事はイタリア(トレンティーノ)における疑い症例が陰性であったという内容であり、DRCでのエボラ発生を裏付ける情報は含まれていない。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCについても本記事内でエボラ流行の事実は確認できないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo si diffonde in modo esponenziale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo spreads exponentially.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding exponentially, with more than 2,500 deaths, about half in the last 20 days, according to UN Ebola chief Julien Harneis speaking from Bunia, the outbreak's epicenter. This wave is the largest Ebola epidemic in DR Congo's history and is spreading faster than any previous outbreak. Latest figures describe exponential growth, with the virus now affecting a geographic area larger than France and outpacing the capacity of the response. The remarks, delivered to journalists in Geneva, underscore the scale of transmission and the critical containment challenge as the outbreak widens beyond initial response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が指数関数的に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが指数関数的に拡大し2,500人以上が死亡、DRC史上最大規模の流行かつ拡大速度も過去最速であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 国連エボラ対策責任者がジュネーブで発言した内容であり、発生国はDRCのみ。ジュネーブ・スイス・フランスは発言場所や規模比較のための言及であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : à Goma, l'épidémie d'Ebola met la vie culturelle à l'arrêt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Goma, the Ebola outbreak puts cultural life on hold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has led to a ban on public gatherings in Goma, suspending concerts, festivals and other cultural events. Goma is a major cultural hub, hosting events such as Festival Amani, Musika Na Kipaji, the Goma Dance Festival and Kivu Fashion Week. After disruptions from the 2025 seizure of the city by M23 rebels, Ebola now imposes a new halt. The crisis has wide social and economic repercussions: livelihoods of dancers, musicians, hosts, technicians, producers, and related sectors like hotels and shops suffer, and investors have fewer incentives to fund new projects. Market vendors report slowed activity. While no new cases are reported in Goma, the outbreak continues to spread in the eastern provinces, stressing health teams in a war-weary region with millions displaced; Ebola adds another social, cultural, and economic blow to Goma.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ゴマではエボラ流行により文化活動が停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当しやすい重篤な疾患であり、東部DRCで流行が継続し公衆衛生・社会経済に広範な影響を及ぼしているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ゴマ市内では新規症例は報告されていないが、東部州全体で流行が継続中。紛争・避難民問題と重なり保健システムへの負荷が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）收到首批埃博拉疫苗　將評估效果 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC receives first batch of Ebola vaccines; will assess effectiveness | Telecom
article.articleSummary: DRC health authorities announced on Aug 21 that the first batch of Ebola vaccines arrived in Kinshasa to tackle the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The vaccine Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo is being assessed. The initial shipment includes 16,520 doses, with 50,120 more expected Aug 21–24. The WHO said the international stockpile will allocate 70,000 doses: 20,000 for a three-phase trial to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. So far, DRC reports 5,290 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,516 deaths, with 1,152 recoveries as of Aug 19. Bunia, the Ituri province capital, is the outbreak's epicenter; 160 health workers have been infected, 43 of them dead. Ongoing security, transport, and health-system challenges hinder containment. The outbreak was declared May 15 and is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、初のエボラワクチンを受領　効果を評価へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、確定5,290例・死亡2,516例という大規模アウトブレイクであり、WHOが国際備蓄ワクチンを投入する事態のため、フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクで、既存ワクチンErvebo（Zaire型用）の有効性評価が必要な特殊事例。医療従事者160名感染・43名死亡と院内感染拡大や治安・輸送面の課題が指摘されており、封じ込めの難易度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 16 000 doses de vaccin contre Ebola, une lueur d'espoir face à l'épidémie - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine, a ray of hope amid the outbreak - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: DRC receives 16,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine in Kinshasa to counter resurgence in the east and northeast. The health ministry, led by Samuel-Roger Kamba, notes that this batch could save up to 16,000 lives and builds on experience from 2018-2020. Ervebo offers about 97.5% efficacy in trials, a critical tool against Ebola which can kill up to 90% of infected individuals. Vaccination is paired with preventive measures: barrier gestures, improved hygiene, and strict contact tracing. Logistical challenges, including maintaining cold chain in remote areas, are highlighted. The campaign targets affected provinces with front-line workers and vulnerable populations. The move underscores Ebola as a public health and regional stability issue, emphasizing international cooperation and health system resilience, as doses begin administration on the ground on August 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラワクチン1万6千回分、流行に立ち向かう希望の光 - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部・北東部でエボラ出血熱が再燃しており、致死率の高い疾患であることに加え、国際的なワクチン供給・支援が行われている点からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン配布に関する内容だが、背景として東部・北東部でのエボラ再燃が述べられている。国際的拡大の具体的証拠は記事中に明記されていないため『不明』とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, allarme rientrato in Trentino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, alarm subsided in Trentino.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Trentino, Italy, proved negative after testing at Luigi Sacco Hospital in Milan, confirming no infection in the adult who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The alarm showcases rapid surveillance triggered by potential importation of a high-risk disease. The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in Central Africa began in spring 2026 in the DRC and has expanded to six provinces as of 16 August 2026, with about 5,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and around 2,400 deaths (case fatality ~47%), the largest Ebola outbreak documented in the DRC. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo virus; care relies on early, intensive supportive measures. Transmission is not airborne; spread occurs through direct contact with blood or body fluids, with infection typically starting after symptoms appear. The Trentino incident demonstrates health surveillance at borders for imported infections.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、トレンティーノでの警戒は解除
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はイタリアでの疑い例陰性だが、背景にあるDRCのブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイクは6州に拡大し約5000例・致死率47%とDRC史上最大規模であり、国際的拡大リスクも顕在化しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: イタリア（Trentino/Milan）の疑い例は陰性確定し輸入感染ではないが、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク自体が重大リスクであり、渡航者を介した国際的拡散の懸念が示された事例として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Virus RSV: Tác nhân phổ biến nhất gây viêm phổi ở trẻ nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV virus: the most common cause of pneumonia in young children.
article.articleSummary: RSV (respiratory syncytial virus) is the leading cause of pneumonia and other acute respiratory infections in infants worldwide, including Vietnam, accounting for more than 60% of ARI cases in newborns and young children. By age two, about 90% of children are infected with RSV. It is the top reason for hospitalization in children under 1 year, with roughly 2.2 million hospitalizations and 66,300 deaths globally each year. All infants under 1 are at risk, especially those born prematurely or with congenital heart disease; severe RSV can lead to recurrent wheeze, asthma, and reduced lung function. Experts stress protection in the first year, including maternal protection strategies and monoclonal antibodies for infants to provide protection. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health has placed RSV in the Group B infectious diseases list requiring surveillance from 2026-07-01 to strengthen monitoring and prevention, per insights from Ho Chi Minh City infectious disease specialists.

triage.headline_ja: RSVウイルス：乳幼児の肺炎を引き起こす最も一般的な病原体
triage.triage_reason: RSVは既知の一般的な小児感染症であり、本記事は疫学的解説・啓発記事であって、異常な集団発生や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、ベトナム保健省が2026年7月からB群感染症としてサーベイランス対象に加えたという制度的情報が含まれるが、急性の異常発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: San Lazaro Hospital records 3 leptospirosis deaths in 12 days
article.articleSummary: San Lazaro Hospital in Manila has recorded at least three leptospirosis deaths since August 10, including a fatality on August 22, 2026. The hospital is treating 60 leptospirosis patients, with 22 new admissions and 19 in severe condition. One patient, RR, waded through floodwaters last Monday before developing fever and shortness of breath. A 14-year-old transferred from Gat Andres Bonifacio Medical Center to San Lazaro for dialysis due to acute kidney injury (elevated creatinine and BUN, anuria) after floodwater exposure. Severe leptospirosis can affect kidneys, liver, and respiratory system, with mortality up to 50% in multi-organ dysfunction. DOH Secretary visited; incubation ranges from about 2 to 60 days, typically 5–15 days. Nationwide, the DOH reports 3,760 leptospirosis cases as of Aug 17; dengue cases total 111,302. San Lazaro’s leptospirosis ward capacity is 120 beds, currently 60 occupied (50%); East Avenue Medical Center is at 119% occupancy with dengue/leptospirosis. Public advised to avoid floodwaters, wear boots, and bathe/shower promptly after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ラザロ病院、12日間でレプトスピラ症による死者3人を記録
triage.triage_reason: マニラで洪水後のレプトスピラ症による死亡例・重症例が増加し、病院病床の逼迫（東エイベニュー医療センターは119%占有）や保健省長官の視察など行政的関心も高いため、フルRRAでの精査が妥当。
triage.notes: 洪水を契機とした季節性のレプトスピラ症流行だが、死亡例・重症例の増加と病床逼迫、デング熱との同時流行が公衆衛生上の負荷を高めている。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国内の医療体制への影響は継続的に監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo capital wary of Ebola nightmare
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, declared May 15, has spread to six provinces with about 5,000 recorded cases and over 2,500 deaths. Kinshasa, a city of nearly 17 million, remains without confirmed cases but is under intensified screening as ferry tracers from Kisangani (roughly 15 cases since May 15) arrive at the Bende-Bende jetty in Maluku. 100 days into the outbreak, UN experts describe it as the deadliest and fastest-spreading in DR Congo’s history. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment. Incubation is 2–21 days. INRB reports 30 suspect cases negative since early August at the checkpoint. If a case reaches Kinshasa, officials warn it could be catastrophic; response is hampered by mistrust and corruption.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の首都、エボラの悪夢を警戒
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪・最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が6州に拡大し約5000症例・2500人超の死亡が報告されており、ワクチンのないBundibugyo株が首都キンシャサ（人口約1700万人）に到達する恐れがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療法のないBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率が高く、首都への波及が懸念される。不信感や汚職により対応が困難とされ、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情肆虐 1700萬人口首都嚴防病毒入侵 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic ravages Congo; Kinshasa, the 17-million-population capital, tightens defenses against viral intrusion - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed more than 2,500 lives among roughly 5,000 confirmed cases in about 100 days, making it the deadliest on record. Kinshasa, a city of about 17 million, tightens defenses and erects checkpoints to block spread from the Maluku—Bende-Bende port, 70 km northeast of the capital. Thousands travel by wooden boats along the Congo River, turning the river into a frontline for containment. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain currently circulating has no vaccine or specific therapy. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warns the outbreak is expanding exponentially. Frontline health workers face distrust, with some passengers denying the virus exists and refusing screening. Since early August, 30 suspected cases tested negative; concern remains that a confirmed case entering Kinshasa could trigger catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が猛威、人口1700万人の首都キンシャサがウイルス侵入を厳重警戒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、致死率・感染者数とも過去最悪規模で首都への拡大懸念がある重大なエボラ流行のため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 約100日間で確認症例約5000件、死者2500人超という過去最悪規模のエボラ流行。ワクチン・特効薬のないブンディブギョ株が流行しており、首都キンシャサへの流入阻止が急務。国連エボラ調整官が指数関数的拡大を警告しており、住民の不信感による検疫拒否など制御困難な要素も存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ação contra o Aedes aegypti mobiliza equipes e moradores em Brasília de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Action against Aedes aegypti mobilizes teams and residents in Brasília de Minas.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, health teams and residents mobilized in the Vale das Palmeiras neighborhood and central Brasília de Minas to combat Aedes aegypti. Led by the municipal Health Department and the Municipal Center for Environmental Surveillance and Zoonoses, the operation focuses on preventing dengue, chikungunya, and zika by eliminating mosquito breeding sites and applying larvicidal treatment in standing water. Inspections targeted homes to identify and eliminate breeding habitats; focal larvicide applications were conducted in water containers. The program also included outreach at the bus station (rodoviária) with informational materials and dialogue with travelers and residents. Coordinated actions involved Environmental Surveillance, Primary Health Care, and Tax Enforcement, emphasizing community participation to remove water-holding receptacles that serve as mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジリア・デ・ミナスでネッタイシマカ対策、チームと住民が動員
triage.triage_reason: デング・チクングニア・ジカを予防するための通常の蚊対策活動を報じるもので、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の記載がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な蚊駆除活動の報道であり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。Angolaは記事本文に主題として登場せずBluedotの地域付与の誤りと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud despliega operativo para erradicar la oncocercosis en 14 comunidades indígenas del estado Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Deploys Operation to Eradicate Onchocerciasis in 14 Indigenous Communities of Amazonas State
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, the Ministry of Health deployed medical teams to 14 Indigenous communities in Amazonas state (Yanomami and Ye’kwana) to eradicate onchocerciasis, a chronic parasitic infection transmitted by blackflies. Conducted with the Amazonian Research Center SA-CAICET, the operation targets 944 people, though no case counts are disclosed. The strategy combines immediate distribution of essential medicines to the community health network with ongoing medical evaluations to sustain epidemiological control where traditional services do not reach. A rapid-response protocol includes air bridges from La Esmeralda to Puerto Ayacucho’s main airport to manage emergencies or specialized cases. Onchocerciasis is caused by a river-borne filarial worm and can cause severe skin disease and visual impairment that may progress to blindness; the initiative aims at eradication and health-network strengthening in Yanomami and Ye’kwana communities.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州の先住民14コミュニティでオンコセルカ症根絶のための活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における既知の風土病（オンコセルカ症）に対する定例的な保健活動であり、新規性・緊急性・国際拡大リスクは認められない。また対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州であり、対象国リスト（Brazil含む）には該当しない。記事内のBrazil/Mexico記載はBluedotの地理タグ誤付与と判断。オンコセルカ症は既知の風土病であり、今回の活動は根絶キャンペーンの一環と見られる。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Swine Flu Cases Surge: What Is H1N1, How Does It Spread? Check Symptoms and Precautions
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a surge in H1N1 (swine flu) infections, with 1,777 cases in 2026 as of 22 August, and 114 new cases recorded on 20 August. The rise coincides with the monsoon season, when humidity and crowded, poorly ventilated spaces facilitate transmission. H1N1 is an influenza A virus spread mainly via respiratory droplets; contaminated hands and surfaces can also spread it. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, chills and fatigue; some may have nasal congestion, vomiting or diarrhea. Most infections are mild, but pneumonia or, rarely, ARDS can occur. High-risk groups include young children, older adults, pregnant women and those with chronic conditions. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, avoid touching face, cover coughs, ensure ventilation, and mask in crowded settings; testing may be used to confirm diagnosis, and vaccination may be advised for high-risk individuals per medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで豚インフルエンザ症例が急増：H1N1とは何か、どのように感染するか？症状と予防策を確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1感染増加でモンスーン期に一致した予想範囲内の傾向であり、大部分が軽症とされるためIHR基準の該当は少ないが、人口密集・換気不良によるヒト-ヒト感染拡大の可能性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）のモンスーン期における通常の増加パターンとみられ、重症例や異常な広がりの報告はない。継続的な症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Aux abords de Kinshasa, la riposte pour stopper Ebola sur le fleuve Congo : 'Si un seul cas arrivait à Kinshasa, ça serait une catastrophe' - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the outskirts of Kinshasa, the response to stop Ebola along the Congo River: 'If even one case were to reach Kinshasa, it would be a catastrophe' - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches its 17th outbreak in history, with more than 2,500 deaths after three months. The port of Bende-Bende near Kinshasa is a major entry point for river-borne travelers as hundreds disembark daily from the Congo River from the East and North regions, where transmission remains highest. Health officials conduct screening at the river border; officials like Yves Matwa emphasize pre-emptive precautions and releasing travelers with no symptoms. Three dugout boats carrying goods arrived at Bende-Bende from Kisangani, a northeastern river city, where about 15 Ebola cases have been reported since the outbreak began. The proximity to Kinshasa raises concerns that a single imported case could trigger a catastrophic spread.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ近郊で、コンゴ川沿いのエボラ拡大を食い止めるための対応：『もし一人でもキンシャサに感染者が到達すれば、それは大惨事になる』
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ流行（第17次流行）が3か月で2,500人以上の死者を出しており、首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ川を経由した人流によるキンシャサへのエボラ拡大リスクに焦点を当てており、既に大規模な死者数（2,500人超）を伴う深刻な流行であることから高優先度のシグナルと判断。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में बदला इन्फ्लुएंजा वायरस का पैटर्न, इस साल H1N1 सबसे ज्यादा प्रभावी - delhi flu pattern shifts h1n1 dominates over h3n2
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi influenza virus pattern has changed; this year H1N1 is the most prevalent - Delhi flu pattern shifts, H1N1 dominates over H3N2.
article.articleSummary: Delhi’s seasonal influenza pattern shifts in 2026, with Influenza A H1N1 now dominating over H3N2. As of August 20, 2026, Delhi reported 2,392 influenza A cases: H1N1 1,777; H3N2 138; H1 37; other A types 440. Influenza B accounted for 210 cases (Victoria lineage 200, others 10). Combined influenza A and B total: 2,602. On August 20, 159 new influenza cases were recorded, of which 155 were influenza A, and 114 were H1N1, making up about 72% of that day’s influenza activity. Health authorities continue monitoring influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory illness (SARI). Experts emphasize that H1N1 is part of seasonal flu and should not be treated as a pandemic. Early antiviral treatment within 48 hours can reduce severity, especially in young children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities; antibiotics are reserved for suspected bacterial infections. AIIMS Professor Dr. Naval Vikram advises prompt care.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのインフルエンザ流行パターンが変化、今年はH1N1がH3N2を上回り優勢に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、専門家もパンデミックとして扱うべきでないと明言している。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザのサーベイランス報告であり、専門家がパンデミックではないと明言。通常の季節変動の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo capital wary of Ebola nightmare
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo drives heightened Kinshasa vigilance, with river port checks at Bende-Bende as hundreds travel daily from Kisangani and other affected zones. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, roughly 5,000 cases have been recorded across six provinces and more than 2,500 deaths, making it the deadliest in DR Congo’s history; about 15 Kisangani cases have been reported. Kinshasa, nearly 17 million people, has no confirmed cases yet. Incubation is 2–21 days, enabling post-arrival tracking. Each traveler’s contact details and points of departure and arrival are noted; screening tents, temperature checks, and symptom screening accompany disinfection of boats and protective gear for crews. About 30 suspect cases have tested negative at the Bende-Bende checkpoint since early August. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, and UN officials say the outbreak is growing exponentially.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の首都、エボラの悪夢を警戒
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最多の死者数（2500人超）を記録するエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が指数関数的に拡大しており、首都キンシャサへの伝播リスクが高い。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特効薬が存在せず、UN当局者は指数関数的増加を指摘。キンシャサ（人口約1700万人）への流入監視体制が敷かれているが、確定症例は未報告。6州で約5000症例、2500人超の死者はDRC史上最悪の流行規模。

article.articleHeadline: خدعة أوليج .. طبيب روسي يكشف مفاجأة بشأن فيروس إيبولا الجديد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oleg's Hoax: A Russian doctor reveals a surprise about the new Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 2026 centers on Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common species. WHO data show over 5,000 confirmed cases and more than 2,500 deaths, the largest outbreak in DRC history, surpassing 2018–2020 totals. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo; vaccines and treatments are in development. Congo has begun receiving Ervebo doses (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine), with part allocated to clinical research to test cross-protection, but WHO warns efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven and it cannot substitute a targeted vaccine. Containment is challenged by conflict zones, large population movements, weak health systems, and difficult contact tracing, with many new cases among people not on surveillance lists. Early suspicion, isolation, testing, and exhaustive contact tracing are critical. Dr. Oleg Abakumov warns the real issue is not a miracle treatment but acting swiftly before the picture fully unfolds.

triage.headline_ja: オレグの詐欺:ロシア人医師が新しいエボラウイルスについて驚きの事実を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルス種による過去最大規模のアウトブレイク（症例5,000人超、死者2,500人超）が発生しており、有効なワクチン・治療法が未確立で、紛争地域・人口移動により国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 本記事はアラビア語メディアによる報道で、DRCにおけるBundibugyoエボラウイルスの史上最大規模アウトブレイク（2018-2020年を上回る）を扱う。既存Zaire株用ワクチン(Ervebo)の交差防御効果は未証明であり、WHOも代替不可と警告。紛争・人口移動・監視体制の脆弱性が封じ込めの障害となっている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: തലസ്ഥാനത്ത് എച്ച്1എൻ1 ആശങ്ക പടരുന്നു; ഒറ്റ ദിവസം റിപ്പോർട്ട് ചെയ്തത് 114 കേസുകൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 scare spreads in the capital; 114 cases reported in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a rising H1N1 influenza outbreak with 114 new cases in the last 24 hours, elevating the year-to-date tally in the capital to 1,777. The central health ministry has issued urgent precautionary directives as transmission accelerates. Authorities cite shifting weather and temperature fluctuations as contributing factors. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, and individuals with comorbidities. Reported symptoms encompass high fever, vomiting, severe cough, sore throat, intense body pains, headache, extreme fatigue, and shortness of breath. Citizens are advised against self-medication and to seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear. Nationally, hospitals are instructed to maintain heightened vigilance and ensure testing capacity. To curb spread, officials reiterate mask usage in public or crowded places and reinforce infection-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 首都デリーでH1N1インフルエンザの懸念拡大、1日で114件の新規感染報告
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者が急増（年間累計1,777例）し、中央保健省が緊急対応指示を出すなど政府の関心が高まっており、季節外要因による感染拡大が疑われるためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の病原体で季節性インフルエンザの一種だが、デリーでの急増と気候要因による非典型的な拡大パターン、保健省の緊急対応指示が見られるため注視が必要。重症例・死亡者数などの詳細情報は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Chegada de vacinas Ervebo marca tentativa de contenção do surto de Ébola - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Arrival of Ervebo vaccines marks an attempt to contain the Ebola outbreak - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: DRC receives over 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine to curb the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Kinshasa airport welcomed 16,250 doses as authorities warn the epidemic is accelerating. Since officially declared on May 15, the outbreak has produced 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, amid fragile health infrastructure and persistent armed-group clashes in the north and east that hinder containment. Ervebo, the only Ebola-approved vaccine, was developed in Germany by Merck and is believed effective against the Zaire strain but there is no full confirmation of cross-protection against Bundibugyo, which is circulating in DRC. DR Congo’s health minister Samuel Roger Kamba emphasized its use, noting prior deployment in 2018–2020. The WHO allocates 70,000 doses for the country: 20,000 for clinical trials, 50,000 for frontline workers. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warns the situation is growing exponentially.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エルベボワクチンの到着、エボラ流行封じ込めへの試み
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（第17次）が5,290症例・2,516死亡と深刻化し、指数関数的拡大が指摘されている。武装勢力の衝突により封じ込めが困難であり、WHO・UNが緊急対応を行っている重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による衝突が北部・東部で封じ込めを妨げており、流行株（Bundibugyo）に対するEr vebo有効性の完全確認は未了。国際的な人的・物的支援（WHOワクチン7万回分配分）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Spravodajstvo - Do Konžskej demokratickej republiky dorazilo vyše 16-tisíc dávok vakcíny proti ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News - More than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine have arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 2,516 deaths from 5,290 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo mark the country’s deadliest outbreak. A shipment of 16,250 Ervebo vaccines arrived at Kinshasa, part of a planned 70,000-dose delivery produced in Germany. The World Health Organization says 20,000 doses will support a clinical study, with 50,000 doses for health workers and frontline staff. Ervebo is approved against the Zaire ebolavirus strain but not against Bundibugyo, which is currently circulating in the country. Preliminary animal data suggest potential protection. DR Congo’s health minister, Samuel Roger Kamba, notes the vaccine’s prior large-scale use during the 2018–2020 epidemic. WHO has this month urged broader human trials to assess protection against Bundibugyo; two other vaccines targeting Bundibugyo are in clinical development.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース - コンゴ民主共和国に1万6千回分超のエボラワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者2,516人）が継続しており、既存ワクチンが未承認の新変異株（Bundibugyo）が流行するなど異常性・重篤性が高く、国際的な支援・ワクチン供給が行われているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 現在流行中のエボラ株はBundibugyoで、既存承認ワクチン（Ervebo）はZaire株用であり有効性が未確立。WHOは同株に対するワクチン臨床試験の拡大を要請しており、今後の展開を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda o diagnóstico da Doença de Creutzfeldt-Jakob e a diferença para o 'mal da vaca louca'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the diagnosis of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease and how it differs from mad cow disease.
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD), a rare, rapidly progressive prion neurological disorder, affects the central nervous system. In distinguishing it from mad cow disease (bovine spongiform encephalopathy, BSE), most CJD cases are sporadic—about 85% worldwide—while hereditary, iatrogenic, and variant forms linked to bovine agents exist. Global incidence is roughly 1–2 cases per million people per year. In Brazil, early diagnosis is challenging due to limited access to RT-QuIC testing; clinicians rely on clinical assessment, MRI, EEG, and CSF analysis to distinguish CJD from other rapidly progressive dementias. Symptoms include memory loss, behavioral changes, tremors, and impaired motor coordination, with rapid progression and limited survival. Notable discussion followed the diagnosis of influencer Lito Sousa, emphasizing the difference from mad cow disease and the need for differential diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病の診断と『狂牛病』との違いを理解する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既知のまれな孤発性疾患であるCJDの一般的な解説記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な集積を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: インフルエンサーの診断報道をきっかけにした一般向け解説記事で、感染症アウトブレイクとしての性質はない。CJDは伝染性ではなく散発性疾患であり、BSE（狂牛病）との違いを説明する内容。

article.articleHeadline: وصول أكثر من 16 ألف جرعة من لقاح إيبولا إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrival of more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is contending with the most deadly Ebola outbreak the country has seen. As of the latest government data, 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths have been reported, with the outbreak advancing in northern and eastern regions amid weak health infrastructure and ongoing conflict. A shipment of 16,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses arrived, with 70,000 more expected soon; of these, 20,000 will support clinical trials and 50,000 will be deployed to frontline health workers. Ervebo’s efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain is not yet confirmed; preliminary animal data suggest some protection, and human trials are underway to determine effectiveness. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, though transmission likely started weeks earlier. Other vaccine efforts (Moderna mRNA, Oxford-based approaches, and rVSV Bundibugyo from Hilleman Laboratories) are in development to address Bundibugyo risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン1万6000回分以上がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,290症例・2,516死亡）が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: コンゴ史上最も致死的なエボラ流行（第17回目）で、Bundibugyo株に対するErvebo有効性は未確認。ワクチン供給や国際協力が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 5,300 as UN warns outbreak "growing exponentially"
article.articleSummary: By Aug 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak had 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths across six provinces, with 1,167 recoveries and a 47.6% case fatality rate. Declared May 15, it is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. UN Senior Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis warned the epidemic is growing exponentially, with half of all deaths in the past 20 days and the outbreak spreading to an area larger than France. Frontline responders face insecurity, poor roads, and attacks on health facilities, with funding shortages and 160 health workers infected (43 dead). International support is increasing: WHO said 70,000 Ervebo doses were approved for immediate release (20,000 for a Phase 3 trial, 50,000 for frontline workers); first batch of 16,520 arrived in Kinshasa, while Bunia, Ituri province, hosted briefings.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、症例数5,300人超え 国連が「指数関数的増加」と警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.6%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクがDRC史上最悪の規模に達し、指数関数的拡大・国際支援増強が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなく確認できないため verified_locations から除外。医療従事者160人感染・43人死亡、資金不足、治安悪化など対応能力への懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Empresária que morreu após cirurgia plástica tinha infecção antes do procedimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Businesswoman Who Died After Plastic Surgery Had an Infection Before the Procedure
article.articleSummary: Andreia Vieira Gaspar, a 51-year-old Brazilian businesswoman living in Spain, died after six facial cosmetic procedures in Goiânia, Goiás, Brazil. Family reports preoperative infection signals; Spain-based tests reportedly identified bacteria and active infection, shared with the surgical team, but the operation proceeded. She traveled from Spain for six facial interventions, including hairline alterations, repositioning of facial tissues/muscles/chin, removal of excess skin and periocular fat, neck/jaw fat removal, and autologous stem cell treatment. Surgeries lasted more than eight hours. Postoperatively, she developed severe tongue swelling and had difficulty closing her mouth; about six hours later her condition worsened. A medical report cited acute thrombosis and pulmonary infarction as death causes. She died on August 12. The Goiás Public Prosecutor's Office opened an inquiry, with possible involuntary homicide; Cremego and the hospital are reviewing preoperative, surgical, and postoperative care.

triage.headline_ja: 美容整形手術後に死亡した女性実業家、手術前から感染症にかかっていた
triage.triage_reason: 個別の医療過誤・単一死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや感染症アウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は個人の美容整形手術に関連した医療事故・訴訟案件であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。ブラジル(Goiás)で発生しているが、これは対象国リストの疾病サーベイランス対象事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dampak Kemarau Panjang, Ribuan Warga Balikpapan Terjangkit ISPA dan Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Impact of the Prolonged Drought: Thousands of Balikpapan Residents Contract Acute Respiratory Infections and Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza and acute respiratory infection (ISPA) surged in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, amid prolonged drought and heat. From July through mid-August 2026, the Balikpapan Health Office recorded thousands of respiratory cases, placing them among the city’s top 10 illnesses. Influenza totaled 5,861 in July and increased by 3,945 by mid-August. ISPA cases were 1,136 in July and 832 in August. Officials link the rise to daytime temperatures above 30°C and dusty, dry conditions. Public health advice includes wearing masks outdoors (especially for motorcyclists), limiting outdoor activity during peak heat, and maintaining hydration. Residents with respiratory symptoms should seek care at nearby health facilities or primary BPJS clinics. Air quality remains in the safe to good category, with continued monitoring and early warnings if conditions change.

triage.headline_ja: 長期の干ばつの影響、バリクパパン市民数千人が急性呼吸器感染症とインフルエンザに罹患
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の乾燥・高温による通常のインフルエンザ・ISPA増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 気候要因（干ばつ・高温・乾燥）による季節性呼吸器疾患の増加。地域の保健当局が通常の公衆衛生対応（マスク着用、水分補給等）を案内しており、重症例や死亡、ヒト-ヒト感染の異常な広がりの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго прибыла первая партия вакцины от лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First batch of Ebola vaccine arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: First batch of Ervebo Ebola vaccine (16,250 doses) arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, late August 21, as part of a 70,000-dose allocation announced by WHO and partners; a further shipment is expected early next week. The current outbreak in the DRC is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved treatments or vaccines exist, though Ervebo has proven efficacy in prior outbreaks and WHO says it may offer partial protection against Bundibugyo. As of now, 2,557 deaths and 5,375 confirmed cases have been reported, with rapid spread that could surpass the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history (11,000+ deaths in West Africa, 2014–2016). Africa CDC data indicate the peak is not yet reached and cases could triple. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids; control efforts are hampered by conflict, attacks on health workers, and population mobility.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国にエボラ出血熱ワクチンの初回分が到着
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例5,375人・死亡2,557人と規模が大きく、史上最悪規模の西アフリカ流行を超える恐れがあると指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRC国内（キンシャサ含む）の流行のみが言及されており、Angolaへの拡大は本文中に記載がないため除外した。Bundibugyo株には承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、既存のErvebo（本来Zaire株用）が部分的防御効果を持つ可能性がある点も重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर में स्वाइन फ्लू का दूसरा मामला, 62 वर्षीय महिला निजी अस्पताल में भर्ती, स्वास्थ्य विभाग में हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second swine flu case in Indore, a 62-year-old woman admitted to a private hospital, health department in a panic.
article.articleSummary: Second swine flu (H1N1) case reported in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, as a 62-year-old woman is admitted to a private hospital; four days earlier a woman from Ujjain tested positive and died after treatment in Indore and being transported home. Health department on alert with planned hospital meetings. Over the past two weeks, viral fever cases in the city rose by about 20%. Common swine flu symptoms include high fever or chills, persistent cough and sore throat, body and muscle pains, headache and extreme fatigue, and nasal congestion. High-risk groups: over 60, diabetics, kidney patients, and immunosuppressed individuals; advise to stay hydrated (about 3 liters daily) and avoid cold fruits and ice cream if allergic. If fever with cold, cough, and breathing difficulty, swine flu testing is advised; treatment is available; antibiotics not routinely needed for typical viral fever. Check dengue if platelets are low.

triage.headline_ja: インドールで豚インフルエンザの2例目、62歳女性が私立病院に入院、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州インドールでH1N1(豚インフルエンザ)の散発例（2例、うち1例死亡）が報告され、地域の保健当局が警戒しているが、季節性インフルエンザの既知の病原体であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1(豚インフルエンザ)は既知の季節性病原体で、インドールでの散発例（2例、1死亡）は局所的な事象。市内でウイルス性発熱が過去2週間で約20%増加との記載があり、今後の拡大傾向は不明のため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo realiza Dia D de vacinação neste sábado com reforço contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo holds D-Day for vaccination this Saturday with a measles booster.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Sao Paulo state health department launches Day D of the Multivaccination Campaign, with 645 municipalities and 483 city UBSs open 8:00–17:00 to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15. The effort also expands measles vaccination in Sao Paulo city, Guarulhos, and Sao Bernardo do Campo because 23 measles cases have been confirmed in 2026—two imported, 21 linked to importation, source not identified. In these areas, measles vaccine is offered temporarily to people 6 months to 59 years. Sao Paulo city will receive 1,967,300 additional MMR doses across the capital and nearby areas. The campaign runs Aug 3–Sep 1 and provides 20 vaccines, including BCG, Hep B, polio, Rotavirus, pneumococcal, meningococcal, influenza, Covid-19, yellow fever, MMR, varicella, DTP, Hep A, HPV; Pneumo 20 was added in June for under-5 protection. MMR coverage remains below 95%: first dose 77.5%, second 65.5% in 2026 (vs 94%/84.4% in 2025).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ、今週土曜日に麻疹追加接種を含む予防接種の「Dデー」を実施
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹輸入関連症例(23例)への対応としてワクチンキャンペーンが実施されているが、重篤性や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。ただしMMRカバレッジが95%未満であり、感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: 麻疹23例のうち2例が輸入例、21例が輸入関連で感染源不明。MMR接種率が前年比で低下しており(1回目77.5%/2回目65.5%)、地域的な感染拡大リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 16 000 doses contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 16,000 doses against Ebola
article.articleSummary: 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine have arrived in Kinshasa to combat a resurgence of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. With an efficacy of 97.5%, the vaccine has already proven effective during prior outbreaks in the DRC. Healthcare workers and at-risk populations are prioritized for vaccination. Maintaining the cold chain in remote, insecure areas remains a crucial challenge for the rollout. Authorities are pursuing a multidimensional strategy centered on vaccination, public awareness, and follow-up of contacts of cases. The operation underscores the ongoing public health response to Ebola in the DRC, highlighting logistical hurdles and the focus on protecting frontline workers and vulnerable communities as the vaccination campaign expands.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラに対するワクチン16,000回分
triage.triage_reason: エボラの再燃(resurgence)がDRC東部で発生しており、ワクチン展開・接触者追跡が行われていることから、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い既知のPICKUP対象疾患である。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン配布に関する内容だが、DRC東部でのエボラ再燃が背景にあり、既存のアウトブレイク対応の一環。感染者数・死亡者数など詳細情報は本記事には含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : la société civile fustige l'absence des mesures barrières contre Ebola dans certaines écoles - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Civil society denounces the absence of preventive measures against Ebola in some schools - ACP
article.articleSummary: On August 22, 2026, in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, CONEPT-Tshopo denounced the absence of Ebola virus disease prevention measures in several schools as the province faces an Ebola outbreak. Jeanpy Atilenge urged school heads to implement barrier measures, strengthen handwashing facilities, and raise awareness among students and staff to curb transmission. With the 2026-2027 school year starting on September 1, the call emphasized a risk-free reopening. While some schools have opened for registrations, many are graduallyInstalling or reinforcing hygiene provisions, including handwashing points, awaiting further guidance from education and health authorities. CONEPT-Tshopo stressed that full adherence to preventive measures is essential to protect pupils, teachers, and the broader educational community and to enable safe schooling. CONEPT RDC, founded in 2009, advocates education for all.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:市民社会がエボラ出血熱に対する予防措置の欠如を一部の学校で非難 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイクにおいて、学校での予防措置不足が指摘されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たすためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は学校における予防措置の欠如についての市民社会の非難が主眼であり、アウトブレイクの規模・症例数・国際的拡大リスクに関する具体的情報は記載されていない。エボラという疾患特性上、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola quarantine hinders response amid fastest-growing outbreak, aid workers say
article.articleSummary: Mandatory 21-day quarantine for Canadians returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan hampers Ebola response as Africa’s outbreak surges to the fastest-growing, potentially deadliest on record, with WHO citing over 5,000 infections and more than 2,500 deaths. As of Aug 20, MSF reported at least 11 Canadians canceled deployments and 23 Canadians have worked in the DRC Ebola response; the quarantine has forced departures or shortened missions. Public health officials say the measures aim to reduce importation and aid early identification, with a decision on next steps expected before Aug 29. Critics say blanket travel restrictions lack scientific basis and run counter to WHO guidance. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids, not airborne, with an incubation of 2–21 days. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on July 28; South Sudan has reported no cases in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ検疫措置が対応を妨げる、史上最速の拡大を見せる感染爆発の中で援助関係者が指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は感染者5,000人超・死者2,500人超と過去最速・最も致死的な規模に達しており、IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、国際的な渡航制限措置も既に発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、ウガンダは7月28日に終息宣言済み、南スーダンは今回のアウトブレイクで症例なし。カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。渡航制限の科学的根拠を巡る議論があり、WHOガイドラインとの整合性も論点となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 3 pasyenteng may leptospirosis, nasawi sa San Lazaro Hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three patients with leptospirosis died at San Lazaro Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Three deaths among leptospirosis patients were reported at San Lazaro Hospital in Manila, as nationwide cases rise. Since January 1, San Lazaro has documented 142 leptospirosis patients. As of 7 a.m. on August 22, three fatalities have occurred since August 10, including one today. There were 22 new admissions, and 60 leptospirosis patients are currently confined, 19 of them in severe condition. Severe leptospirosis involves vital-organ injury: kidneys requiring hemodialysis, liver jaundice, or respiratory failure needing intubation; mortality for multi-organ dysfunction approaches 50%. Incubation is about 2–60 days, typically 5–15 days. DOH records nationwide leptospirosis cases at 3,760 as of August 17, while dengue cases exceed 111,000 this year. East Avenue Medical Center in Quezon City reports 119% occupancy due to dengue and leptospirosis, while San Lazaro’s Leptospirosis Ward (120 beds) has about 60 occupied. DOH urges avoiding flooding; wear boots, bathe, and wash.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ラザロ病院でレプトスピラ症患者3名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン全国でレプトスピラ症（3,760例）とデング熱（11万例超）が急増し、重症例・死亡例が多数発生、病床占有率が119%に達するなど医療逼迫の兆候があるため。
triage.notes: 毎年雨季・洪水に伴い発生する季節性のレプトスピラ症・デング熱流行だが、今回は病院の病床占有率119%、重症例19名、死亡例3名など医療逼迫の兆候が見られるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 or food poisoning? Vomiting, diarrhoea, and stomach pain could be signs of swine flu; know symptoms and warning signs
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) can present with digestive symptoms alongside classic flu signs. While H1N1 is primarily a respiratory influenza, it may cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain and reduced appetite, particularly in children, and these symptoms can overshadow cough or breathing symptoms, leading to confusion with food poisoning or gastroenteritis. Dehydration is a key risk due to fluid loss from vomiting and diarrhoea, compounded by fever. Transmission occurs via respiratory particles. Some influenza treatments, such as Oseltamivir, can also cause nausea, potentially confounding the picture. Seek medical care if vomiting is persistent, severe abdominal pain, dehydration signs, blood in stool or vomit, difficulty breathing, confusion, extreme weakness, or rapid worsening. At-risk groups include young children, pregnant women, older adults, and those with underlying conditions. Published 2026-08-22.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1か食中毒か？嘔吐・下痢・腹痛は豚インフルエンザの兆候の可能性；症状と警告サインを知る
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、H1N1の一般的な症状解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 具体的な発生・症例数・地域データが無く、健康啓発的な一般記事のため対象国イベントとしては該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Govt to take stock of H1N1 as Karnataka cases cross 4,000
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza in Karnataka, 2026: Karnataka state crossed 4,000 H1N1 cases this year, with Bengaluru accounting for more than 2,000. Total this year 4,125 so far, peaking before September; in 2025, 4,583 cases. Udupi 293, Mysuru 184 cases. Greater Bengaluru Authority area 2,033 cases; Bengaluru Urban district 982; together over half of state's cases. The government plans a health officials’ meeting to assess surveillance and preparedness. A city school was closed after student cases, raising concern over spread in Bengaluru. IDSP official Dr Veena says no panic; surveillance is in place; no mutant strain detected. Transmission via respiratory droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces. Common symptoms: fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches, fatigue. Advisory urges persistent symptoms to seek medical care; hospitals urged to maintain SARI readiness.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州でH1N1感染者数が4000人を超え、政府が状況把握へ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1流行で変異株は検出されておらず国際的拡大の兆候はないが、症例数の増加と学校閉鎖など地域内での感染拡大が続いているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 毎年発生する季節性H1N1インフルエンザの報告であり、変異株の検出なし・パニックなしとの当局コメントあり。ただし症例数増加と学校閉鎖など局地的な感染拡大が見られるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 12-year-old boy dies of cerebral malaria at JSR hospital, kin allege negligence | Ranchi News
article.articleSummary: 12-year-old Harish Biruli from Matamhatu village in West Singhbhum district died of cerebral malaria while being treated at Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical College and Hospital (MGMMCH) in Jamshedpur, late Friday after admission on Thursday with malaria symptoms. He was moved to the paediatric intensive care unit but died despite intervention; his four-year-old sister Jyoti recovered and was discharged. The family alleges negligence, claiming no senior doctor attended him in the PICU; hospital officials deny lapses and say staff regularly monitored him, with an internal review to be conducted. West Singhbhum has reported over 5,000 malaria cases up to the first week of August, averaging 35 infections per day, with health authorities conducting around 5,000 tests daily for the past two months.

triage.headline_ja: 12歳少年がJSR病院で脳マラリアにより死亡、親族が過失を主張 | ランチーニュース
triage.triage_reason: 個別死亡例だが、West Singhbhum地区で1日35例・月5000件超のマラリア感染が継続しており、地域的な流行状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアは既知の風土病であり新規性・異常性は低いが、West Singhbhum地区での感染者数（1日35例、2ヶ月間毎日約5000件検査）は地域的な流行として継続監視の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تتسلم شحنة لقاحات لمواجهة أسوأ تفش لمرض إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo receives a shipment of vaccines to confront the worst Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived at Kinshasa's N'djili International Airport, part of a 70,000-dose package to bolster the Democratic Republic of Congo's response to the worst Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no cure, has caused 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed infections as of Friday, August 21, 2026. WHO notes Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. The outbreak, centered in Ituri Province's Bunia, is spreading faster than earlier waves and could triple current transmission rates. Health workers face violent attacks, with ambulances and clinics targeted, complicating containment. UN response teams warn that funding is rapidly diminishing and urge immediate international support as the epidemic covers an area larger than France and persists as the region's deadliest in history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最悪のエボラ流行に対応するためワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で致死率も高く、拡大加速・治安悪化・資金不足により国際支援が急務であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による過去最大規模のエボラ流行。致死率約47.5%、感染拡大範囲はフランス国土より広い。医療従事者への暴力や資金不足が対応を困難にしており、UNが国際支援を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : réception à Kinshasa du premier lot de 16 520 doses du vaccin Ervebo contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Kinshasa receives the first batch of 16,520 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Kinshasa received the first batch of Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to bolster the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak response declared in May 2026. On August 21, 2026, 16,520 doses arrived at N'djili International Airport, part of a 50,120-dose tranche expected August 21–24, funded by Gavi and manufactured in Germany by MSD, routed via Switzerland, Luxembourg and Belgium. The outbreak remains active across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé, with WHO calling it the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date, reporting over 2,300 deaths and more than 5,000 cases. WHO and partners allocated 70,000 doses from the global stock: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial assessing Ervebo against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The plan uses Ervebo in a two-phase strategy—research (20,000) and compassionate use (50,000)—to accelerate data while reinforcing vaccination, surveillance, patient care and research.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:キンシャサでエボラワクチン「エルベボ」1万6,520回分の第一便を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続中で、死者2,300人超・症例5,000件超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な支援体制（Gavi資金、WHOワクチン配分、国際輸送）も動いているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: スイス・ドイツ・ベルギー・ルクセンブルクはワクチンの製造・輸送経路として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: PMC steps up fogging, anti-larval operations | Patna News
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention in Patna, India, is intensified as Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) expands fogging and anti-larval operations ahead of the dengue season. Fogging runs in two shifts with extra rounds in hotspots such as construction sites, vacant plots, drains, waterlogged areas, markets, malls, offices and apartment complexes; anti-larval spraying targets these zones. With post-monsoon conditions linked to increased mosquito breeding, officials urge use of nets and repellents. About 400 sanitation workers have been trained to identify larvae, operate equipment and apply insecticides, with training covering temephos for larvae, malathion for adult mosquitoes and SOPs. PMC has deployed machines across six circles: New Capital (12 vehicle-mounted, 16 handheld; 28 personnel), Patliputra (13,16;29), Bankipur (9,12;21), Kankarbagh (10,11;21), Patna City (6,8;14), and Azimabad (7,12;19). Handheld machines will be used in narrow lanes.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：パトナ市自治体が防霧・幼虫駆除作業を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節前のルーチンなデング熱予防対策（防霧・幼虫駆除）の実施を報じる内容であり、異常な感染拡大や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節前の予防的な防疫活動（フォギング、幼虫駆除、人員訓練）を報じるものであり、実際の症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Cómo funciona un ensayo clínico en medio del brote de ébola más rápido de la historia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How does a clinical trial work amid the fastest Ebola outbreak in history?
article.articleSummary: MBP134 and remdesivir are being evaluated in the PARTNERS trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for Bundibugyo ebolavirus–positive patients, amid the eastern outbreak centered in Bunia, Ituri. Sponsored by the World Health Organization and coordinated by the National Institute of Biomedical Research (DRC), with the Institute of Tropical Medicine (Belgium) and University of Oxford, the study includes MSF and Africa CDC among partners. Participants are randomized to four arms: MBP134 plus remdesivir; MBP134 alone; remdesivir alone; or standard of care. The trial is conducted at MSF’s Elikya Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, where eligible patients are invited to enroll. MSF provides operational support; however, WHO-led partners design and run the protocol and determine allocation. Primary aim: determine safety and efficacy to inform regulatory approvals and wider use in future Ebola outbreaks, potentially transforming outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速のエボラ流行の最中で臨床試験はどのように行われているのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ州ブニア）で進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）流行は「史上最速」とされ、深刻性と異常性の両方でIHR基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州ブニアで進行中のエボラ流行下での臨床試験（PARTNERS試験）に焦点を当てている。ベルギー・英国は研究協力機関の所在地であり、発生地域には含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela despliega equipos médicos a comunidades indígenas para erradicar la oncocercosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela deploys medical teams to indigenous communities to eradicate onchocerciasis.
article.articleSummary: Onchocerciasis (river blindness) is being targeted in Venezuela's Amazonas state, where health authorities deployed medical teams to 14 Indigenous communities (Yanomami and Ye'kwana) to eradicate the parasitic infection transmitted by blackflies. The operation, conducted with the Amazonian Research Center SA-CAICET, combines immediate distribution of essential medicines with ongoing medical evaluations to strengthen local health networks and ensure epidemiological control in areas outside traditional services. A rapid-response protocol provides airlift links from La Esmeralda to Puerto Ayacucho for emergencies or specialized care, expanding access for about 944 people across these communities. The drive follows concerns that endemic onchocerciasis can cause severe skin disease and vision impairment, including blindness, and reflects broader regional initiatives to eliminate the disease. No specific case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、オンコセルカ症根絶のため先住民コミュニティに医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラにおけるオンコセルカ症（河川盲目症）根絶に向けた既存の医療対応活動であり、新規の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。また対象国リストに該当する国での発生でもない。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における既知の風土病（オンコセルカ症）に対する医療支援・根絶活動を報じたものであり、新規の異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生危機ではない。ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。ブラジルも位置情報に含まれるが、記事の主題はベネズエラであり除外。
