article.articleHeadline: एच1एन1 के मामले बढ़े, लेकिन घबराने की जरूरत नहीं: डॉ रणदीप गुलेरिया - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 cases have risen, but there is no need to panic: Dr. Randeep Guleria - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: As of August 22, 2026, in Gurugram, Dr. Randeep Guleria, former director of AIIMS Delhi, said H1N1 influenza A cases are rising but there is no need for panic; the situation is under control and immunity has strengthened from past outbreaks. The illness presents primarily with fever, followed by runny nose, cough, and cold; in severe cases, body or head pain, vomiting, and abdominal upset may occur. In children, lethargy can appear. Fever typically lasts 4-5 days and then resolves. Warning signs include fever persisting 4-5 days with breathing difficulties, chest pain, persistent vomiting, or low oxygen, which may indicate pneumonia. High-risk groups—very young, elderly, and immunocompromised—are especially vulnerable to complications. Preventive measures: mask-wearing, hand hygiene, covering the mouth when coughing, and minimizing outdoor activity for those with symptoms. ICMR data show monsoon-linked rises, consistent with prior years.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1症例が増加しているが、パニックになる必要はない：ランディープ・グレリア医師
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの増加が報告されているが、専門家は「制御下にあり、過去の流行と同様の傾向」と述べており、特段の異常性や重大な公衆衛生影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 専門家（元AIIMS所長）が季節性の増加であり制御下にあると発言しており、例年のモンスーン期のパターンと一致するとICMRデータでも示されている。緊急性は低いが、季節性流行として継続的な動向注視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma caso de sarampo em Viradouro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms measles case in Viradouro.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"On 22 August 2026, Viradouro continued a multivaccination campaign, with vaccination posts at three Basic Health Units in the city; activities will resume on Wednesday, 26 August, after the city’s anniversary celebrations. Rodrigo Barros, coordinator of Epidemiological Surveillance, said concern over measles has risen in recent days following the confirmation of a positive measles case in Viradouro. Previously, cases were more concentrated in the capital region, but the interior case now draws greater attention to vaccination coverage. The health department is emphasizing immunization to prevent transmission and protect vulnerable groups, coordinating with the ongoing outreach in the three UBS sites and the broader campaign. The report highlights the need for higher vaccination uptake to curb the spread of measles in both urban and interior areas."}

triage.headline_ja: 健康局、ヴィラドウロで麻疹症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州内陸部で麻疹の単発症例が確認され、ワクチン接種率への懸念があるが、大規模流行や重症例の情報はなく現時点では続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 従来は州都地域に集中していた症例が内陸部（ヴィラドウロ）でも確認され、当局はワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化中。症例数・重症度の詳細情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: CDC AS Keluarkan Travel Health Notice Level 2 untuk Bali, Wisatawan Diminta Waspadai Zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC Issues Level 2 Travel Health Notice for Bali, Travelers Urged to Be Vigilant About Zika
article.articleSummary: U.S. CDC issues Travel Health Notice Level 2 for Bali, Indonesia, amid rising Zika cases reported among travelers returning from Bali. Zika virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; most infections are asymptomatic or cause mild illness. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. Symptoms, when present, are generally mild and self-limiting. The alert advises travelers to Bali to exercise heightened precautions and for those returning from Bali to monitor for symptoms. Zika infections pose particular risk to pregnant people and those planning pregnancy, as infection can disturb fetal development, especially in the first and second trimesters. In some cases, Zika has been transmitted sexually. The article focuses on travel-related (imported) cases; no local Bali outbreak details or vaccination options are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、バリ島に対しレベル2渡航健康情報を発出、旅行者にジカ熱への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 米CDCがバリ島に対しジカ熱に関する渡航健康情報レベル2を発出し、渡航者間で感染例が増加していることから、国際的拡大や渡航制限に関わる基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は米国からの渡航者におけるジカ熱の輸入症例増加に基づくCDCの渡航健康情報発出を報じており、バリ現地での大規模流行の詳細は記載なし。United Statesは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC recibe la primera remesa de la vacuna Ervebo para intentar combatir el brote de ébola que asola el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC receives the first shipment of the Ervebo vaccine to help fight the Ebola outbreak ravaging the country.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first shipment of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to help combat an outbreak declared about 100 days ago, with nearly 2,500 deaths and over 5,200 confirmed cases since May 15. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a total of 70,000 doses forthcoming, including 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s impact against the Bundibugyo strain, though protection against this variant remains unproven. WHO data indicate severe adverse events are very rare. The outbreak spans six provinces, led in the north by Ituri, and is hampered by ongoing armed conflict that impedes surveillance. The remaining 50,000 doses will protect frontline health workers. Since the outbreak’s start, more than 160 health workers have contracted Ebola and 40 have died, per UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、国を席巻するエボラ流行対策のためエルベボワクチンの初回輸送分を受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行で約2,500人死亡・5,200人超の感染確認、6州に拡大し医療従事者にも多数の感染が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: WHOによるワクチン供給（Phase 3試験含む）や国連調整官の関与など、国際的な支援・関心が高いことが確認される。武力紛争によりサーベイランスが妨げられている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : le Dr Babah Mutuza dénonce les failles de la riposte et appelle à revoir la stratégie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Dr. Babah Mutuza denounces the shortcomings of the response and calls for a review of the strategy.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in North Kivu’s Beni and Butembo persist, with Dr. Babah Mutuza accusing the response of logistical, communication, and ethical shortcomings. He argues current communications are insufficient and urges engagement of community leaders and high-audience journalists across radio and social media to build trust. He calls for a more decentralized response, with municipalities installing handwashing stations at markets and entry points and displaying alert messages. Mutuza notes personnel turnover, underutilization of expertise from previous outbreaks, and concerns about safe and dignified burial teams charging families $30-50 for post-mortem sampling, while results are sometimes released after burial, hindering contact tracing. He rejects rumors of fabricated cases for funding. A concerted mobilization—from provincial authorities to health workers, media, youth organizations, and the public—is needed to strengthen response and contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：ババ・ムトゥザ博士が対応の欠陥を指摘し、戦略の見直しを訴える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が北キブ州で継続しており、対応体制の不備（連絡体制、埋葬チームの倫理問題、追跡調査の遅延）が指摘されている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大のリスクを有する既知の高致死性疾患であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行に対する対応の欠陥（コミュニケーション不足、埋葬チームの費用徴収、検査結果の遅延など）を批判する内容であり、新規発生ではなく継続中のアウトブレイクに関する続報。フルRRAで最新の症例数・死亡率・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : "الصحة العالمية" توفر 70 ألف جرعة لقاح لمكافحة "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: WHO provides 70,000 doses of vaccine to combat Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO has provided 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to address the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The shipment follows a government request coordinated through the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision. Of the total, 20,000 doses fund a Phase III trial to assess vaccine effectiveness against this strain, for which full protection is not yet defined. The remaining 50,000 doses will vaccinate health-care workers and other frontline staff per WHO guidance. The effort strengthens outbreak response and protects frontline personnel in the DRC. Published 2026-08-22.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信社：WHOがコンゴでのエボラ出血熱対策としてワクチン7万回分を提供
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中であり、WHOが大規模なワクチン支援を行っていることから、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い事案と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ株のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対するWHOのワクチン支援（Ervebo 7万回分）に関するもの。既存のアウトブレイクへの追加対応であり、ワクチンの有効性検証（第III相試験）も含まれる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: एच1एन1 के मामले बढ़े, लेकिन घबराने की जरूरत नहीं डॉ रणदीप गुलेरिया | Dr. Randeep Guleria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 cases rise, but there is no need to panic Dr. Randeep Guleria | Dr. Randeep Guleria
article.articleSummary: H1N1 cases are rising in Gurugram and Delhi, but there is no need to panic, says Dr. Randeep Guleria, former director of AIIMS Delhi. The illness resembles influenza fever, with symptoms of fever, runny nose, cough, and cold; some patients may have body or head pain, nausea, or vomiting, and children may be lethargic. Most recover in about four to five days with care, but fever persisting four to five days with shortness of breath, chest pain, vomiting, or low oxygen can signal pneumonia. High-risk groups—very young, elderly, and immunocompromised—should take extra precautions and monitor for severe signs. Parents should seek prompt medical advice if a child is not eating or is unusually lethargic. Preventive measures include masking, hand hygiene, and covering the mouth when coughing. ICMR data show monsoon-season increases in such cases, this year and last year.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1症例が増加、しかしパニックになる必要はない ― ランディープ・グレリア医師
triage.triage_reason: デリー・グルガオンでH1N1症例が増加しているが、専門家は季節性（モンスーン期）の通常のパターンであり、パニックの必要はないと説明しており、深刻性・異常性ともに低い。
triage.notes: ICMRデータによれば例年モンスーン期にH1N1症例が増加する傾向があり、今回も季節性の範囲内とされている。専門家が明確に「パニック不要」と述べている点から深刻な公衆衛生事象とは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: Imus City urges residents to join daily cleanup efforts to combat dengue
article.articleSummary: Imus City reports a dengue surge with 192 confirmed cases, 46 probable, and 53 suspected as of Aug. 20, 2026, up from 186 confirmed cases on July 29. By Aug. 19, the total confirmed cases stood at 192. Barangays with the highest counts are Buhay na Tubig (25), Bucandala 1 (20), Pasong Buaya II (18), Carsadang Bago 2 (12), and Malagasang 1-G (11). Authorities promote daily cleanup under the Alas-Kwatro Kontra Mosquito program at 4 p.m. to search and destroy breeding sites such as containers, drains, pots, and tires, and caution against relying on fogging alone since eggs and larvae may persist. Public guidance includes using mosquito repellent, wearing long, light-colored clothing, and maintaining a clean environment. Health officer Dr. Ferdinand Mina lists symptoms as high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle/joint pain, vomiting, fatigue, and rash; seek hospital care for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or breathing difficulties. Drinking adequate water is advised.

triage.headline_ja: イムス市、デング熱対策のため住民に毎日の清掃活動への参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な地域的増加であり、地方自治体レベルでの通常の対策活動として報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、通常のエンデミック疾患の範囲内。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年季節的に発生する風土病であり、本記事は市レベルでの通常の予防啓発活動を報じたもの。件数増加は見られるが重症例や死亡者数への言及はなく、地方自治体が独自対応可能な規模と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Eşi Benzeri Görülmemiş Ebola Salgınına Karşı Aşı Seferberliği
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination campaign against an unprecedented Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports its largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in its history, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths, across six provinces. More than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine have been delivered as part of the response. Kinshasa notes Ervebo has been used in earlier outbreaks (2018–2020). The WHO allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses last Thursday: 20,000 for a third-phase trial assessing efficacy against Bundibugyo virus, and 50,000 for frontline health workers. UN Ebola response chief Julien Harneis warned the outbreak is accelerating. The article asserts the current outbreak exceeds the 2018–2020 outbreak in case numbers, with ongoing vaccination campaigns and rapid transmission amid a widening geographic reach to six provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける前例のないエボラ流行に対するワクチン接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行（症例5,290件、死者2,516人、6州に拡大）が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOによる70,000回分のErvebo配布や国連エボラ対応責任者の警告など、国際機関の関与も確認されており、緊急のフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы стала самой смертоносной в истории Конго-Киншасы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has become the deadliest in the history of Congo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo-Kinshasa) has become the deadliest outbreak in the country’s recorded history, according to government data. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak could become the largest on record. So far, the outbreak has infected nearly 5,000 people and caused 2,325 deaths. This toll beats the previous record set by the 2018-2020 Ebola outbreak, which claimed almost 2,300 lives. The outbreak remains centered in the DRC, but authorities warn it could spill over to additional African countries. The article cites government data and WHO warnings today.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がコンゴ・キンシャサ史上最も死者数の多い流行となった
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最悪の流行となり、WHOも史上最大規模になる可能性を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者数約5000人、死者2325人と2018-2020年流行を超える史上最悪の規模。WHOは近隣国への波及リスクを警告しており、DRC以外への拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय की लोगों से अपील, स्वाइन फ्लू के लक्षणों को न करें नजरअंदाज - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry appeals to the public: do not ignore swine flu symptoms.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 22 August 2026 — The Health Ministry has urged the public not to ignore swine flu (influenza A(H1N1)) symptoms. Common signs include fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches, and fatigue. Early identification is emphasized and persistent symptoms should prompt consultation at a nearby healthcare center. If infected, panic is discouraged; manage under medical supervision with proper nutrition. For those with flu-like symptoms, limit contact, wear a mask outdoors or around others, and take extra precautions around the elderly, young children, or people with pre-existing conditions. Cough/sneeze etiquette requires covering with tissue or elbow, frequent handwashing, and regular use of hand sanitizer. The guidance originates from New Delhi and was issued on 22 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が国民に呼びかけ、豚インフルエンザの症状を軽視しないよう訴える
triage.triage_reason: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）に関する一般的な啓発・注意喚起であり、異常な流行や重症化の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 保健省による季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の一般的な症状啓発・予防呼びかけであり、具体的な患者数増加や集団発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la sécurité des équipes de riposte au centre des engagements RDC-Ouganda - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the safety of response teams at the center of DR Congo-Uganda engagements
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-22, in Arua, the Ebola response across the DR Congo–Uganda border prioritized safety of teams, infrastructure, and equipment, per Dr Théophile Ponde, provincial coordinator of the National Border Hygiene Program (FNHF) for Ituri North-East. The cross-border coordination meeting noted that effective outbreak response depends on a secure environment for surveillance, contact tracing, and other response activities in border areas. An August 17 incident in Kandoy, in the Biringi health zone, Aru territory, underscored the need to strengthen protection of frontline workers. Participants urged improved coordination between health services and border-entry authorities, especially in highly mobile corridors between DRC and Uganda. The Congolese delegation also acknowledged Uganda’s commitment and technical/financial support from partners—IOM, WHO, Africa CDC, UNICEF, and Malteser—to joint Ebola control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:対応チームの安全確保がコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ間協議の中心に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症が国境地域で発生し、DRC・ウガンダ間の越境対応が必要とされており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC-ウガンダ国境地帯（Ituri州、Aru準州）でのエボラ対応チームの安全確保に関する会議を報じており、IOM・WHO・Africa CDC・UNICEF・Malteserなど国際機関の支援が言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय की लोगों से अपील, स्वाइन फ्लू के लक्षणों को न करें नजरअंदाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health appeals to the public not to ignore the symptoms of swine flu.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 22 August 2026 — India’s Ministry of Health urges the public not to ignore influenza-like illness, warning Swine Flu (H1N1) symptoms can mimic a common cold amid weather changes. Key signs include fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches, and fatigue. Individuals with persistent or worsening symptoms should promptly consult a healthcare professional; do not panic, follow medical guidance, and maintain nutrition. For those with flu-like symptoms, avoid close contact with others and wear a mask when outside; take extra precautions around elders, young children, or people with preexisting conditions at home. Cough or sneeze into tissue or elbow, replace tissues, and wash hands regularly or use hand sanitizer. Visit the nearest healthcare center for evaluation if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が国民に呼びかけ、豚インフルエンザの症状を軽視しないよう訴える
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザ様疾患（H1N1）に対する一般的な公衆衛生啓発であり、具体的な患者数増加やアウトブレイクの報告はないが、季節性流行の可能性はあるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事は保健省による一般向け注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数、アウトブレイクの規模、地理的拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の周知啓発の域を出ないため、フルRRAへの移行は現時点で不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC et l'Ouganda renforcent la surveillance transfrontalière pour contenir l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC and Uganda strengthen cross-border surveillance to contain the outbreak - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Cross-border Ebola response between the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda was strengthened after a three-day coordination meeting in Arua, Uganda (Aug 22, 2026), led by Dr Théophile Ponde, Ituri province coordinator of the National Border Health Program (PNHF). Officials agreed to bolster surveillance on both sides of the DRC-Uganda border, improve contact tracing and follow-up for individuals crossing the frontier, and ensure continuity of care to prevent gaps in the outbreak response. The coordination also called for rapid sharing of alerts and epidemiological information, especially when a suspected Ebola case or contact is identified across the border. In addition, authorities urged harmonization of risk-communication messages in border communities to reduce rumors and misinformation and to promote community involvement in surveillance. These steps implement the June 23, 2026 bilateral agreement, with follow-up meetings planned in Kampala and Oima, Uganda, to consolidate mechanisms established at Arua.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダが越境監視を強化し流行封じ込めを図る - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた流行が継続中であり、DRCとウガンダ間で越境監視・接触者追跡の強化が必要とされている。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダの国境地域（イツリ州、アルア）における越境エボラ対応を主題としている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands of doses of Ebola vaccine arrive in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo receives more than 16,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses amid the country’s 17th outbreak, declared May 15 and described as the deadliest in DR Congo history. The outbreak has caused 2,516 deaths among 5,290 confirmed cases, with spread focused in the north and east where state presence is weak and health systems are strained. WHO said a total of 70,000 Ervebo doses will be allocated, including 16,250 delivered in Kinshasa, with 20,000 for a clinical trial and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire strain; its efficacy against Bundibugyo in humans is unproven, though animal data hint at some protection. WHO experts advocate a full-scale human trial to test cross-protection. Other Bundibugyo-targeting vaccines in trials include Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford; Hilleman Laboratories is pursuing an rVSV Bundibugyo candidate.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国にエボラワクチン数千回分が到着
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪とされる第17次エボラ流行（死者2,516人、確定症例5,290人）が継続中で、WHOによる大規模ワクチン展開・臨床試験が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対するErvebo（ザイール株用ワクチン）の有効性は未確認であり、追加の大規模臨床試験の必要性が指摘されている点は今後の展開注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, ministero della Salute: "Negativo test caso sospetto in Trentino" Periodico Daily
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Ministry of Health: "Negative test for a suspected case in Trentino" Periodico Daily
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Italy's Ministry of Health announced that an Ebola test on samples collected in Trentino from a person who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and presented symptoms was negative. The samples were analyzed at Milan's Sacco Hospital. Because the patient exhibited symptoms, a diagnostic test was performed. The Ministry, through the Department of Prevention, remains in contact with local health authorities and continues to monitor the evolving situation. The result indicates no confirmed Ebola case at this time; the event is considered imported due to recent travel, and authorities will maintain surveillance and preparedness for any new developments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、保健省：「トレンティーノの疑い例の検査結果は陰性」
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・トレンティーノでの疑い例はエボラ検査陰性と確定しており、対象国（DRC含む）での新規発生や拡大の事実は確認されないため見送りと判定する。
triage.notes: 疑い例はイタリアで発生し検査陰性が確定。DRCでの実際の感染事例に関する情報は記事に含まれておらず、対象国での発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra au Kwango : plus de 1 500 cas et 102 décès dans trois zones - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in Kwango: over 1,500 cases and 102 deaths in three areas - ACP
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Kwango Province, Southwest Democratic Republic of Congo, with 1,532 cases and 102 deaths reported as of August 19, 2026 across three health zones: Popokabaka (744 cases, 25 deaths), Kasongo-Lunda (560 cases, 37 deaths), and Boko (198 cases, 40 deaths). Popokabaka shows some decline; Boko has had no new cases for two weeks, while Kasongo-Lunda remains the active hotspot, with recent deaths linked to interruptions in care and limited prevention uptake. An importation of cases from Angola is reported in Kasongo-Lunda. Provincial health authorities supplied Kasongo-Lunda with a treatment kit (lactated Ringer’s, ORS, catheters, doxycycline, ciprofloxacin, chlorine, zinc, PPE). The public is urged to practice strict hygiene, consume hot, well-cooked foods, and use treated water. The outbreak began May 24 in Popokabaka and was officially declared June 25 after INRB confirmation, later spreading to Boko and Kasongo-Lunda.

triage.headline_ja: クワンゴ州のコレラ流行：3地域で1,500人以上の感染者、102人の死亡 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国クワンゴ州で1,532症例・102死亡（致死率約6.7%）の大規模コレラ流行が継続中で、アンゴラからの越境感染例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にKazakhstan（東カザフスタン州）が含まれるが、記事内容とは無関係の誤タグと判断し除外。Angolaは越境感染源として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 Cases Near 1,800: Is the Rise a New Swine Flu Outbreak? | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: Delhi has reported 1,777 H1N1 cases in 2026, with 114 new infections on August 20, per the Delhi Health Department. The tally is nearly eight times the 229 cases during the same period last year. H1N1 is a seasonal influenza virus, though severe illness remains a concern for high-risk groups. The rise signals sustained transmission of H1N1 in Delhi this year and has prompted the Union Health Ministry to advise individuals with flu-like symptoms to seek medical attention early, especially if symptoms persist or worsen. Public health officials emphasize prompt care to reduce risk of complications and limit further spread among vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染者数が1,800人近くに:これは新たな豚インフルエンザの流行か？
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者が前年同期比約8倍に急増し持続的な感染拡大が見られるが、重症度や国際的拡大に関する情報は不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの一種であるH1N1の症例数が例年より大幅に増加しているが、重症度や死亡者数など詳細情報が不足している。インド保健省が注意喚起を行っている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương phòng bệnh tay chân miệng trước thềm năm học mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently prevent hand, foot, and mouth disease ahead of the new school year.
article.articleSummary: HFMD outbreak in Dong Nai City, Vietnam, totals nearly 9,000 cases with 1 death since 2026, 1.75 times higher than the same period last year. Over 96% are school-age children in preschools. Cases remain elevated during summer break, approaching alert level. The EV71 virus is circulating amid hot, humid weather; delayed parental reporting may raise risk as students return. Ahead of the 2026-2027 school year, authorities urge joint action: schools and local health services should coordinate with district health stations, sanitize classrooms, toilets, toys, and surfaces; share class lists for surveillance; and educate staff and parents. Daily health monitoring is required; suspected cases should trigger immediate isolation and notification of parents and the health station. Enforce the "3 clean" rule—clean eating, clean spaces, and clean hands—and ensure water and soap. Early detection and rapid response are essential to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期を前に手足口病の予防を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: ドンナイ省で手足口病(EV71)の症例が前年同期比1.75倍に増加し警戒レベルに近づいており、新学期開始による感染拡大リスクと行政・学校の強い関心が見られるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性のHFMD/EV71流行であり地域内での管理が可能とみられるが、症例数増加と新学期開始による感染拡大リスク、行政・学校の対応強化要請から社会的関心が高いためピックアップと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều xã, phường ở Đồng Nai đồng loạt ra quân phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many communes and wards in Dong Nai province simultaneously launch dengue fever prevention and control efforts.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-22, multiple communes and wards in Dong Nai province—Long Binh, Tam Hiep, Tran Bien, Trang Dai, Phuoc Tan, Bien Hoa, Loc Quang—launched simultaneous dengue fever prevention and control measures. Campaigns emphasized environmental cleanup, clearing vegetation, collecting waste, inspecting water-holding containers, and eliminating mosquito breeding sites. Health workers intensified home-based guidance, urging residents to cover water containers, change water, dispose of bottles and tires, and eliminate other water-collecting debris; use bed nets and wear long sleeves for protection. Local health facilities strengthened surveillance for suspected dengue cases to quickly detect and respond to outbreaks. Since early 2026, Dong Nai reported over 9,000 dengue cases and 5 deaths, with more than 2,500 outbreaks detected and addressed. With the rainy season at its peak, proactive measures aim to reduce cases and severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省の複数の社・坊がデング熱予防・対策活動を一斉に実施
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ドンナイ省で例年発生する季節性デング熱の予防対策活動に関する記事であり、症例数・死亡数は一定規模だが異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。WPRO基準に複数該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年雨季に流行する風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体による通常の予防対策活動の報道。2026年初頭から9,000例超・死亡5例という数字はあるが、記事の主旨は対策キャンペーンの実施報告であり、突発的な異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC recibe la primera remesa de la vacuna Ervebo para intentar combatir el brote de ébola que asola el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first shipment of the Ervebo vaccine to try to combat the Ebola outbreak ravaging the country.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives the first shipment of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to curb the outbreak declared about 100 days ago. The World Health Organization warns that efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain has not been demonstrated, though laboratory and animal data suggest potential protection. A total of 70,000 doses are expected in the coming days, including 20,000 to support a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s impact on Bundibugyo; the remaining 50,000 will be for frontline health workers. Since May 15, the outbreak has killed more than 2,500 people and infected over 5,200 across six provinces, led by Ituri in the north. Ongoing conflict hampers surveillance and response. More than 160 health workers have been infected and 40 have died. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Gebreyesus confirmed the vaccine rollout plan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、国を襲うエボラ流行への対抗策としてエルベボワクチンの初回出荷を受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者2500人超、感染5200人超、6州に拡大）であり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当し国際的対応（WHOによるワクチン展開）も進行中のため。
triage.notes: 紛争により監視・対応が妨げられており、医療従事者にも多数の感染・死亡が発生。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン有効性は未確認でフェーズ3試験進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Ebola Tops 5,000 Cases; Polio Outbreaks Recede
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths, with Bas-Uélé affected and a 46% case-fatality rate. The WHO emergency declaration remains since May 17, and about 60% of the $115 million response is mobilized. On Aug 20, 70,000 Ervebo doses were allocated to the DRC: 50,000 for frontline workers and 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial; Gavi adds $13 million for vaccine delivery and vaccination in high-risk areas. Ervebo’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven, though preclinical signals exist. Phase 1 vaccine candidates include Moderna and Oxford, with a promising Hilleman Laboratories candidate. Five African countries—Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Uganda, Republic of Congo—have ended cVDPV2 outbreaks, underscoring ongoing surveillance and vaccination needs. Institut Pasteur launches ACT-CHIK vaccine project for Africa with €15.3 million.

triage.headline_ja: 週次保健アップデート：エボラ出血熱が5,000症例を超える、ポリオ流行は減少傾向
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が5,000症例・46%致死率に達し、WHOが緊急事態を宣言中であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事内でガーナ・ギニアビサウ・ブルンジ・ウガンダはポリオ(cVDPV2)流行終息に関する言及であり、エボラ流行の発生地域はDRCのみであるためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Arcos promove seminário sobre Febre Amarela para profissionais da saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arcos promotes seminar on Yellow Fever for health professionals.
article.articleSummary: Yellow Fever seminar held in Arcos, Brazil, gathered health professionals to reinforce prevention, surveillance, and vaccination against the disease. The municipality aimed to broaden knowledge, strengthen preventive actions, and refine response strategies for Yellow Fever in Arcos. Participants deepened technical information and discussed measures for prevention and control. The training emphasized health surveillance to identify risk situations and adopt steps to reduce transmission and protect the population. Vaccination was highlighted as a core preventive tool, with emphasis on guiding the public and monitoring vaccination status to boost collective protection. The seminar represents an investment in health teams, preparing professionals to guide the community and respond to potential Yellow Fever scenarios. Arcos reiterates that information, surveillance, and vaccination are essential for protection and that prevention must be maintained continuously.

triage.headline_ja: アルコス市、保健専門家向けに黄熱病セミナーを開催
triage.triage_reason: 実際の黄熱病発生や症例報告ではなく、予防・監視・ワクチン接種に関する研修セミナーの開催報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は黄熱病の予防啓発セミナー開催に関する内容であり、実際の症例発生や流行を報告するものではないため、対象国リストへの該当有無に関わらずイベントとしての追跡は不要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: DRC capital wary of Ebola nightmare
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates, with authorities fearing spread to the capital Kinshasa. The 17th outbreak, declared May 15, has killed thousands and is spreading across northern and eastern regions where state presence is weak and health systems are strained amid entrenched armed groups. On Friday, more than 16,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine arrived in the DRC, part of a WHO-backed plan to deploy up to 70,000 doses. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain; the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating is not covered, and WHO experts remain uncertain whether Ervebo offers protection against Bundibugyo, though early animal data hint some cross-protection. The focus remains on preventing spillover into densely populated areas and protecting healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の首都、エボラ出血熱の悪夢を警戒
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイクが拡大し、既に数千人が死亡、首都キンシャサへの波及が懸念されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 現在流行しているのはBundibugyo株であり、既存のErvebo(Zaireエボラ株用)ワクチンの有効性が不明である点がリスク評価上の重要な懸念点。武装勢力の存在による保健システムの機能不全も拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 22 August 2026: Health Ministry warns that changing weather can mimic seasonal illness, but persistent flu-like symptoms may indicate swine flu (H1N1). The ministry, via posts on X, lists fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches and fatigue among possible H1N1 symptoms. Do not ignore such symptoms; seek medical advice at a nearby healthcare center. If infected, panic is unnecessary; follow doctors' guidance and maintain nutritious meals. To curb transmission, avoid close contact with others if you have flu-like illness; wear a mask, especially when outside or around others. Extra caution around the elderly, young children, or people with preexisting conditions at home. Cover coughs or sneezes with tissue or sleeve, replace tissues, wash hands with soap and water regularly, and use hand sanitizer.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、国民に対しスワインフルーの症状を軽視しないよう呼びかけ

article.articleHeadline: MP School Food Scare: 38 Children Fall Ill After Kadhi-Rice Mid-Day Meal In Indore; Probe Underway
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, 38 students at a government school in Singhana village, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, fell ill shortly after the kadhi-rice mid-day meal served around 1:30 pm Saturday. Initial cases included stomach ache, dizziness and headache, with others soon developing symptoms. The children were taken to Aurobindo Hospital in Indore; 19 were admitted and kept under observation for about seven hours, with all discharged by 6:30 pm. The school management immediately informed families and sent the ill pupils to hospital. A probe is underway to identify the cause and potential infection source; no laboratory confirmation or specific pathogen is reported. No deaths were reported; no details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: MPの学校で食中毒騒動：インドール市でカディー・ライスの給食後38人の児童が体調不良、調査進行中
triage.triage_reason: 単一校での給食後の体調不良事例であり、全員回復・死亡なし、病原体も未特定で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 食中毒（給食由来）と推定される局所的な健康被害事例であり、感染症のシグナルとしての性質は薄い。学校側の調査結果待ちだが、現時点で公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يتفشى بسرعة في الكونغو الديمقراطية والأمم المتحدة تحذر من نفاد التمويل | الصحافة اليوم - يومية اخبارية جامعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the United Nations warns that funding is running out | Today's Press - a universal daily news newspaper
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding rapidly, with the UN warning that funding for humanitarian and medical response could run out within weeks without additional support. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, 5,290 infections and 2,516 deaths (case fatality ~47.6%) have been reported, with 1,152 recoveries and about 840 patients still in isolation or hospital. The outbreak covers an area larger than France and represents the fastest and widest spread in DRC's history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Response efforts face insecurity, hindered movement, and service gaps, with about 160 health workers infected and 43 killed. WHO lists the DRC risk as very high, though global risk remains low; cross-border transmission to neighboring countries remains a concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大、国連は資金枯渇を警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約47.6%、感染者5,290人・死者2,516人という重大な公衆衛生被害があり、DRC史上最速・最大規模の流行で国際的拡大懸念（越境伝播）もあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHOはDRC国内リスクを非常に高いと評価、世界的リスクは低いとしているが、隣国への越境伝播懸念があり注視が必要。国連は資金不足による対応継続の危機を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho amplia diagnóstico de hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho expands diagnosis of viral hepatitis
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, expanded diagnosis, prevention, and follow-up for viral hepatitis in the municipal health network. In 2025, 215 hepatitis B and 133 hepatitis C cases were recorded among residents; one hepatitis A case and one hepatitis B/D coinfection were reported. Compared with 2024, hepatitis B increased from 173 to 215 (+24%), while hepatitis C decreased from 141 to 133 (-6%). Rapid testing for hepatitis B and C and other sexually transmitted infections is freely available, enabling early detection, counseling, and referral for treatment under the Unified Health System (SUS). Hepatitis B vaccination is freely available, and hepatitis C treatment is provided by SUS with a high likelihood of cure when properly delivered. Prevention emphasizes condom use, avoiding sharing blood-contact items, and prenatal testing. July Yellow strengthens prevention and testing efforts across the city.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョ、ウイルス性肝炎の診断体制を拡充
triage.triage_reason: 定例の公衆衛生プログラム報告であり、慢性的な肝炎対策の拡充を伝える内容で、緊急性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: B型肝炎の年間症例数がやや増加(173→215)しているが、地域の既存医療体制内での通常の検査・予防活動の一環であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D atualiza vacinação infantil e reforça alerta contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day updates on childhood vaccination and reinforces the measles alert
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-22, Brazil held a national D-Day multivaccination campaign. In Brasília's Unidade Básica de Saúde 612 Sul, 10-year-old Noam Medeiros received two vaccines to complete his child vaccination record. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha, who also vaccinated there, described the event as a nationwide update of all 17 compulsory childhood vaccines, including the pneumococcal 20-valent vaccine for children under five. Padilha issued a measles vaccination alert for people from 6 months to 59 years and for workers in tourism hubs—restaurants, hotels, airports, taxi services—highlighting importation risk as measles resurges abroad. Brazil remained measles-free since 2024, but last year reported 38 imported cases linked to U.S. outbreaks. The country previously faced a São Paulo 2019 measles surge of about 20,000 cases that threatened the status. A 91-year-old retiree, Lúcia Araújo, also participated in the vaccination drive.

triage.headline_ja: D-Day、小児予防接種を更新し、麻疹への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルの予防接種キャンペーンと啓発活動に関する内容であり、ブラジル国内で麻疹の実際の発生・流行は報告されていない（2024年以降麻疹フリーを維持）。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施と輸入症例への警戒喚起に関する内容であり、ブラジル国内での麻疹発生は確認されていない。保健省による予防的な注意喚起であるため、疾病発生イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi health dept issues advisory as swine flu cases rise
article.articleSummary: Delhi records rising swine flu (H1N1) in the national capital as influenza cases surge. The city has logged over 2,300 Influenza-A infections this year, including more than 1,777 H1N1 cases up to Friday, with 114 H1N1 reported on Thursday. Total influenza cases reach 2,602 (2,392 Influenza-A and 210 Influenza-B) through Friday; among Influenza-A, 1,777 are H1N1, 37 H1, 138 H3 and 440 other. Influenza-B includes 200 Victoria strain and 10 others. In response, the Delhi government issued a health advisory urging respiratory hygiene, masks in crowded places, handwashing, avoiding touching eyes/nose, not spitting in public, and seeking medical care for fever, cough, sore throat or breathing difficulty. Preparedness includes 35 hospitals under special surveillance, AIIMS and NCDC designated laboratories, and guidelines for testing and treatment, with IDSP‑IHIP monitoring and ongoing public awareness efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Il colera torna a Yangon: oltre 500 ricoveri e una lezione che riguarda anche l'Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera Returns to Yangon: Over 500 Hospitalizations and a Lesson That Also Concerns Europe.
article.articleSummary: Cholera returns to Yangon, Myanmar: since August 9, at least 500 people hospitalized for severe diarrhea; tests detected 149 cholera positives, while the National Health Laboratory confirmed nine Vibrio cholerae infections. The outbreak surged with over 100 admissions on August 13, then declined. A 92-year-old died after hospitalization for diarrhea; authorities cited preexisting cardiac and respiratory conditions as the cause. Cholera spreads via contaminated water and food and can cause profuse watery diarrhea, dehydration, and shock within hours, though early rehydration can save severe cases. The crisis reflects infrastructure collapse after five years of civil war, compromising water, sanitation, waste collection, and access. WHO: by May 31 Myanmar had 205 watery diarrhea cases, 272 by June 28; globally in June, over 47,000 cholera/acute watery diarrhea cases and 354 deaths. The episode shows cholera as a disease of fragile systems; Europe should note prevention starts with water, sanitation, hygiene, and detection.

triage.headline_ja: コレラがヤンゴンで再流行：入院者500人超、欧州にも教訓
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマー・ヤンゴンで500人超の入院とコレラ確定例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とインフラ崩壊による異常事態が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 内戦による水・衛生インフラの崩壊が背景にあり、WHOの統計でも国内での流行継続が示唆される。国際的拡大の兆候は現時点で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: وصول 16 ألف جرعة لقاح إيبولا إلى الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrival of 16,000 Ebola vaccine doses to the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo receives 16,000 Ebola vaccine doses, with 16,250 reported on arrival at Ndjili airport, amid the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is expanding across northern and eastern regions where health infrastructure is severely limited. The World Health Organization says 70,000 doses of Merck’s ERVEBO vaccine—manufactured in Germany and the only vaccine officially approved—will be deployed, with 20,000 allocations for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. ERVEBO is known to be effective against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but its effectiveness against the current Bundibugyo strain remains unconfirmed; preliminary animal data suggest possible protection. Health Minister Samuel Rojie Kamba noted the vaccine’s prior use (2018–2020) as shipments continue to support outbreak response and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴへエボラワクチン1万6000回分が到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行が拡大中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: ドイツは製造国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため除外。流行株はBundibugyo株とされ、既存ワクチン(ERVEBO)の有効性は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Plus de 100 attaques contre le personnel de santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola — More than 100 attacks on healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: Three months after declaring an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, response operations face persistent community mistrust, with over 100 attacks on health workers. Recent incidents include a violent assault on a response agent in Beni and an attack on a team during a funeral in Haut-Uélé. Cross-border support from Uganda has aided care, laboratories, and surveillance, including five ambulances. An ambulance involved in a river incident near Aru was recovered on the 17th. PK51 remains the epicenter and security hotspot. To counter disinformation and slow transmission, authorities emphasize risk communication, community engagement, and a village-centered approach: village chiefs appoint representatives to coordinate vaccination readiness, implement measures, and relay local concerns, ensuring cultural adaptation. Opposition stems from beliefs about Ebola and from disruptions that closed private clinics, highlighting the need for broader community involvement in the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱－医療従事者への攻撃100件超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が3ヶ月続き、医療従事者への100件超の攻撃、地域社会の不信、越境支援の必要性など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Shared risk: Cattle, humans can give each other 'TB' | John Eiron R. Francisco
article.articleSummary: The Philippines should launch a national bovine TB eradication program led by the Bureau of Animal Industry, in coordination with DOH, DOST, and other agencies, to curb zoonotic transmission. A Bukidnon study of 275 slaughtered cattle found 126 positives for bovine TB and post-mortem lesions across ages and sexes, suggesting under-detection. PSA data show 2.52 million cattle as of 2026-03-31, down 1.5% from 2025, with smallholders making up 86.4% and Northern Mindanao and Calabarzon as leading regions. Bovine TB spreads to humans via inhalation or consumption of contaminated products; human TB is primarily caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. In the United States, Mycobacterium bovis accounts for under 2% of human TB cases, reflecting cattle-control programs and pasteurization. Proposed measures include better slaughterhouse surveillance with rapid diagnostics, standardized post-mortem exams, mandatory reporting, PPE for workers, and stronger vet–physician–community coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 共有リスク：牛と人間は互いに結核をうつし合う可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでの牛結核（ウシ型結核）に関する研究結果と政策提言記事であり、急性の感染急増や公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていないが、人獣共通感染症としての継続的曝露と過小検出の懸念があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は突発的アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、フィリピンにおける牛結核の疫学調査結果と国家的な撲滅プログラム設立を求める政策提言記事である。急性のヒト-ヒト感染拡大や国際的懸念は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo recibe primeras vacunas para enfrentar el peor brote de ébola de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo receives first vaccines to confront the worst Ebola outbreak in its history.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo began receiving the first doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to confront the outbreak that has struck since mid-May, with more than 5,200 confirmed cases and about 2,500 deaths. The World Health Organization announced a shipment of 70,000 doses over the coming days: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to evaluate protection against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Evidence from laboratory and animal studies suggests some protection, but effectiveness against Bundibugyo in humans remains uncertain. Serious adverse events are described as rare. Since onset, over 160 health workers have contracted Ebola, with 40 fatalities. The outbreak spans six provinces, especially Ituri in the north, where armed clashes hinder surveillance and care, underscoring the vaccine’s potential as a key new tool for outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最悪のエボラ流行に対処するため最初のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,200例超、死者2,500人超）が継続しており、医療従事者感染や武力衝突による対応困難など、深刻性・異常性・国際的関心のいずれも高いためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 武力衝突下での監視・治療の困難さ、Bundibugyo株への既存ワクチン効果の不確実性が今後の懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes Pastikan CKG dan Tracing TBC Bisa Jangkau Seluruh Masyarakat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister Ensures CKG and TB Tracing Can Reach the Entire Population.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 21-22, 2026, Jakarta, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus inspected integrated Free Health Check Posts (CKG) with tuberculosis (TB) tracing in Rawasari, Cempaka Putih, Central Jakarta, to extend screening and care to residents at the RW level. He praised the provincial health office for extending TB tracing into sub-districts and said the CKG program broadens access to rapid, affordable health evaluation and treatment. The visit also reviewed Remedi portable digital radiography equipment from South Korea, intended to speed diagnosis in hospitals and field settings. Central Jakarta Deputy Mayor Eric P.Z. Lumbun noted strengthening TB tracing as part of Jakarta’s goal to become TB-free and welcomed distribution of Remedi units to sub-district health centers once deliveries begin. Officials urged residents suspected of TB to complete treatment and maintain healthy practices.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣、CKGと結核トレーシングが全住民に届くことを確認
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの視察報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の既存の検診・トレーシング体制強化に関する政府広報であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, zika, chikungunya e Oropouche: saiba diferenças e riscos da automedicação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, Zika, Chikungunya, and Oropouche: Learn the Differences and Risks of Self-Medication.
article.articleSummary: Arboviruses dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and Oropouche circulate in Brazil, presenting with fever, headache, body pains, nausea and malaise. Because symptoms overlap, professional evaluation is essential and lab testing helps identify the virus; do not self-medicate. Dengue typically lasts seven days; a critical phase between days 3 and 5 involves declining platelets and capillary leakage that can cause circulatory shock, abdominal pain, dyspnea, low blood pressure and bleeding signs such as petechiae. Hydration is crucial (about 60–80 mL/kg/day); avoid NSAIDs and acetylsalicylic acid to reduce bleeding risk. The days 5–7 window is particularly critical. Zika often has milder fever with rash and conjunctivitis; infection during pregnancy raises fetal microcephaly risk. Chikungunya features intense, potentially persistent joint pain. Oropouche can mimic dengue early but may lead to neurological symptoms. Vector control against Aedes aegypti is key.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、オロプーシェ熱：違いと自己判断による服薬のリスクを知る
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行性ウイルス（デング・ジカ・チクングニア・オロプーシェ）に関する一般的な症状解説・自己治療への注意喚起記事であり、新規の異常発生や急増を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける複数のアルボウイルス（デング、ジカ、チクングニア、オロプーシェ）の症状比較と自己投薬の危険性に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数増加や新規アウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго отримала понад 16 тисяч доз вакцини від Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo received over 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, part of a 70,000-dose shipment from WHO and partners as the country fights the fastest Ebola outbreak on record, with over 2,500 deaths. The vaccines landed late Friday at Ndjili International Airport, Kinshasa, and more doses are expected next week. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatment or vaccine, though Ervebo is licensed for Ebola and WHO says it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. As of 22 August 2026, 5,375 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths have been reported across six provinces. The African CDC notes transmission is rising and could triple current levels; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak killed over 11,000. An additional 70,000 doses from the International Coordinating Group vaccine stockpile are to be deployed to DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン1万6000回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、5,375例確定・2,557人死亡、6州に拡大しており、稀な株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）で有効なワクチン・治療法が未確立のため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi records 1,777 H1N1 cases as health dept issues flu advisory
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a surge of H1N1 swine flu cases. As of 22 August 2026, the capital has recorded 2,602 influenza cases this year—2,392 Influenza-A and 210 Influenza-B—with 1,777 Influenza-A confirmed as H1N1. Delhi logged 114 H1N1 cases on Thursday, and the same day’s total of 159 influenza cases included 114 H1N1, 2 H1, 1 H3 and 38 other Influenza-A; 4 Influenza-B were reported. Overall, more than 2,300 Influenza-A cases this year include 1,777 H1N1 till Friday. Health officials issued a flu advisory urging respiratory hygiene, masking in crowded places, and prompt medical advice for fever, cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty, body aches or headache. Lab confirmation and surveillance are in place with AIIMS and NCDC as referral labs; 35 hospitals under surveillance; IDSP–IHIP tracks ILI, SARI, influenza and COVID-19.

triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（インフルエンザA）症例が増加し保健当局が注意喚起を出しているが、重症度・死亡者数などの情報が不足しており、既存のサーベイランス体制内で対応されている季節性流行の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D de multivacinação mobiliza o país e reforça proteção contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day of multivaccination mobilizes the country and strengthens protection against measles.
article.articleSummary: On 22 August 2026, Brazil conducted the National Multivaccination Campaign Day (Dia D), mobilizing primary health units nationwide to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15 and ensure access to the 17 vaccines on the SUS calendar. In Brasília, families like 10-year-old Noam Medeiros illustrated uptake. A key feature this year is the introduction of the pneumococcal 20-valent vaccine for children under 5, expanding protection against pneumonia and meningitis. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha emphasized a broad vaccination strategy, not a single immunization. Measles remains a strategic alert; Brazil regained measles-free status in 2024, but vigilance persists amid outbreaks in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Brazil logged 38 imported measles cases last year, contained by high vaccination coverage. The campaign also stresses protection for people aged 6 months to 59 years in high-tourism settings to prevent outbreaks like the 2019 São Paulo event.

triage.headline_ja: 全国一斉ワクチン接種の「Dデー」、国民を動員し麻疹予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの予防接種キャンペーンに関する広報的内容であり、麻疹の現行アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ブラジルは麻疹排除状態を維持しており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのワクチン接種キャンペーンの紹介であり、麻疹アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。米国・カナダ・メキシコでのアウトブレイクに言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル自体は麻疹排除状態を維持しており、輸入症例38件も高いワクチン接種率で抑制されているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola peyvəndinin ilk partiyası Konqo Demokratik Respublikasına çatıb
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first batch of the Ebola vaccine has arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: First batch of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo, 16,200 doses, arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster response to the Bundibugyo strain outbreak. The doses were landed in Kinshasa at N'Djili International Airport, with the World Health Organization and partners pledging to deliver a total of 70,000 doses; further shipments are expected next week. However, WHO clarified that Ervebo’s effectiveness against the Bundibugyo strain has not yet been confirmed in humans; early laboratory tests suggest some protection, but definitive results require additional clinical trials. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo. The virus spreads easily and can be undetected, with symptoms that may be mistaken for malaria. To date, more than 5,200 infections and over 2,500 deaths have been reported, and Africa CDC says the outbreak has not peaked and could be up to three times higher than current figures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの最初のロットがコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイクが5,200人感染・2,500人超死亡と大規模化し、ピークに達していないとされる深刻な事案であり、ワクチン効果も未確認であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、Ervebo(通常のZaire株用)の有効性は臨床的に未確定。症状がマラリアと類似し検出が困難な点も感染拡大リスクを高めている。Africa CDCは実際の症例数が公表数の最大3倍に上る可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RDC, deja a 180 niños huérfanos, casi dos al día
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the DRC Leaves 180 Orphaned Children, Nearly Two Per Day
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) has infected about 800 children and killed over 357, according to Save the Children as of August 5. Since the epidemic was declared on May 15, at least 180 children have lost both parents or guardians (90 boys and 90 girls). Most are with relatives or in state care as longer-term family solutions are sought. Thousands have lost a parent or guardian, heightening risk of abuse, trafficking, and severe psychological harm. Another 114 children (61 boys, 53 girls) are currently separated from their parents and receive support while their parents receive Ebola treatment. Save the Children notes that the 32% figure for deaths with age data is based on available data; the true toll is likely higher. Ituri remains the epicenter in conflict-affected eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、孤児180人発生、1日約2人のペースで増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中で、感染者約800人、死者357人以上と深刻な被害が出ており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 紛争地帯であるイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行が長期化しており、子供への深刻な影響（孤児化、虐待・人身売買リスク）が報告されている。Save the Childrenなど国際NGOが関与しており、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。5月15日の流行宣言以降、継続的な感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D atualiza vacinação infantil e reforça alerta contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day updates on childhood vaccination and reinforces warning against measles.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-22, Brazil launches a national vaccination mobilization with participation from all municipalities and states, updating the pediatric calendar to include all 17 vaccines routinely required for children. For the first time, the campaign adds the pneumococcal 20-valent vaccine (PCV20) for children under 5, expanding protection against pneumococcal diseases such as pneumonia and meningitis. Authorities also issue a measles vaccination alert for individuals aged 6 months through 59 years and for workers in tourist-heavy settings. Targeted environments include restaurants, hotels and inns, bus terminals, airports, taxis, and ride-hailing services, aiming to reduce imported or clustered measles cases in travel hubs and strengthen overall herd immunity in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: Dデー、小児予防接種を更新し麻疹への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の実際の流行や症例急増ではなく、予防接種キャンペーンの実施を伝える定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の実際の発生・流行を報告するものではなく、ブラジル全国での定期予防接種キャンペーン（Dia D）とワクチン啓発活動に関する内容。麻疹症例数や発生状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases surge across Nashik district
article.articleSummary: Dengue and chikungunya surge in Nashik district (Jan–Jul 2026). By end-July, 168 dengue cases (rural 35; NMC 56; MMC 77) and 25 chikungunya cases (rural 4; NMC 9; MMC 12); 16 active dengue infections. Aedes aegypti breeding in stagnant clean water in dense urban areas prompted high-risk village designation. Inspection of 7,44,890 water containers in July found larvae in 75,302 containers. Authorities activated intensified preventive measures, including a target of 10,000 dengue tests in three days, public advisories, and 'One Dry Day' weekly to disrupt breeding. Epidemiologists will map cases geographically and review affected neighborhoods for localized actions. High-level meeting chaired by District Collector Ayush Prasad attended by Nashik Municipal Corporation and MMC officials.

triage.headline_ja: ナシック県でデング熱の症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地方でデング熱・チクングニア熱が季節性に増加しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、地方自治体レベルでの対応で管理可能と見られる。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（郡長主催の会議）による対策強化が行われており、地域レベルの季節性感染症流行と考えられる。重症例数・死亡者数の情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Records 1,777 H1N1 Cases: Govt Issues Health Advisory, Urges Masks, Hygiene
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 2,602 influenza cases this year, including 2,392 Influenza-A (1,777 H1N1, 37 H1, 138 H3, 440 other Influenza-A) and 210 Influenza-B. In the latest update, Thursday saw 159 influenza cases (155 Influenza-A: 114 H1N1, 2 H1, 1 H3, 38 other; four Influenza-B). Health advisory urges respiratory hygiene, mask use in crowded places, handwashing, avoiding touching eyes/nose, seeking prompt medical care for fever, cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty, body ache or headache, and avoiding self-medication. Delhi has 35 hospitals under special surveillance; AIIMS and NCDC laboratories designated for testing. Monitoring and data reporting proceed via IDSP-IDHP/Integrated Health Information Platform with daily bulletins; inter-sectoral coordination Aug 20 emphasized public awareness and IPC measures. H1N1 is the dominant influenza subtype this year in Delhi, with two seasonal peaks expected Jan–Mar and post-monsoon; hospitals report adequate beds, medicines, and equipment, and ongoing awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染者1,777人を記録：政府がマスク着用・衛生対策を求める健康勧告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優勢）の通常の流行パターンであり、病院の対応能力も十分とされているが、症例数が増加しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの年次流行パターンとして予想される事象であり、デリー当局は35病院での監視体制、AIIMSおよびNCDCでの検査体制、十分な病床・医薬品を確保していると報告。重症度（入院率・死亡率）に関する具体的情報は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Rise in swine flu cases in Nashik in Aug; two deaths reported this month
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (influenza) cases rise sharply in Nashik city during August 2026: 57 infections reported from Aug 1–20, with 42 cases in the last 10 days, bringing total since Jan 1 to 85. Five swine flu deaths this year—three in July and two in August—include three rural Nashik district residents treated at private city hospitals and two city residents. Health officials cite persistent monsoon rainfall and cooler temperatures as factors; all deceased had comorbidities. Nashik Municipal Corporation issued an advisory urging preventive measures, especially for senior citizens and those with diabetes, hypertension, or respiratory conditions, to seek prompt medical care if fever, cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulties develop. Hospitals are urged to monitor influenza-like illnesses; avoid self-medication and consult a doctor quickly. No panic; emphasis on awareness and timely precautions during the monsoon-related surge.

triage.headline_ja: ナシクで8月に豚インフルエンザ症例が急増、今月2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例増加で死亡例もあるが、いずれも基礎疾患を有する患者であり、地域限定的かつ例年見られるモンスーン期の増加傾向。国際的な拡大懸念は低いが、症例数増加は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）のモンスーン期増加。死亡例は全て基礎疾患（糖尿病・高血圧・呼吸器疾患）を有する患者。地方自治体（Nashik Municipal Corporation）が予防advisoryを発出しているが、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 2 500 morts, l'ONU redoute une pénurie de financements dans les prochaines semaines - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak has surpassed 2,500 deaths; the UN fears a funding shortfall in the coming weeks.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing the deadliest Ebola outbreak the country has recorded, with 5,290 confirmed cases and more than 2,516 deaths as of August 19, 2026. The 17th outbreak, triggered on May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The response faces insecurity, large population and goods movements, and Africa CDC estimates that only 30–40% of cases are detected. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warned that funds could run out in the coming weeks, threatening the response. On the ground, about 160 health professionals have been infected (43 deaths); more than 260 attacks on health workers and facilities have caused eight health-worker deaths. Bunia airport’s commercial closure compounds logistics; the ECDC counted 837 patients hospitalized in isolation as of August 20, and 82.9% of identified contacts were being followed.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行が死者2,500人を超える、国連は今後数週間の資金不足を懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者2,500人超、感染5,290例）が継続し、ワクチン未承認・治安不安・資金不足など対応能力に深刻な懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行で、医療従事者感染・攻撃、資金枯渇の懸念があり、国際的な支援継続が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 100 days of Ebola: DRC outbreak now fastest growing on record
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is facing an Ebola outbreak described as the fastest-growing on record. Vaccines previously used for other Ebola strains are arriving in the DRC as authorities struggle to contain rapid transmission. Declared nearly 100 days ago on 15 May, the outbreak exceeded 1,000 confirmed cases with 277 deaths five weeks later. By early August, cases and deaths surged dramatically, with deaths rising six-fold. As of 22 August 2026, there are well over 5,000 confirmed cases and more than 2,500 deaths, yielding a 47.6% case-fatality rate. The report notes ongoing transmission and vaccination efforts, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行100日目:DRCの流行が過去最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が発生し、致死率47.6%、5,000例超・2,500人以上の死亡と極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率47.6%、確認症例5,000例超、死亡2,500人超という極めて深刻な状況。ワクチン投入も継続中で、国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Min-salud despliega equipos para combatir oncocercosis en Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health deploys teams to combat onchocerciasis in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela’s Ministry of Health deployed medical teams to 14 indigenous communities in Amazonas state, including the Yanomami and Ye’kwana, to eradicate onchocerciasis (river blindness). The effort, in partnership with the Amazonian Research Center SA-CAICET, combines immediate distribution of essential drugs with ongoing medical evaluations to strengthen epidemiological control where traditional services do not reach. A rapid-response protocol includes air bridges from La Esmeralda to Puerto Ayacucho’s main airport for emergencies or specialized care. The outreach targets about 944 people across these communities; the ministry did not specify how many cases have been recorded. Onchocerciasis is caused by a parasitic worm transmitted by black flies that breed along riverbanks and can cause severe skin disease and vision loss.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州のオンコセルカ症対策のためチームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラの風土病であるオンコセルカ症への既存の対策活動であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではなく、国際的拡大や異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、記事の主題はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における既知の風土病対策であり、対象国での発生ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: 2.516 νεκροί - Έφτασαν οι πρώτες δόσεις εμβολίου
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: 2,516 dead – the first doses of the vaccine have arrived.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is surging in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa). Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there are 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths. A shipment of 16,250 Ervebo vaccine doses arrived in Kinshasa, part of a WHO allocation of 70,000 doses for DRC, with 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed against the Zaire ebolavirus strain but not Bundibugyo, the strain driving the current outbreak. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in clinical trials: Moderna (mRNA) and the University of Oxford. A rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine, described by WHO as most promising, is to be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore). Ebola, transmitted via body fluids, has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：死者2,516人 - 最初のワクチン投与量が到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続し、死者数が2,500人を超える深刻な状況であり、既存ワクチンが対象株に非適合という異常事態も認められるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存承認ワクチン(Ervebo)はZaire株用でBundibugyo株には非適合であり、新規ワクチン開発中との情報あり。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Drought may bring monkeys, mosquitoes, and yellow fever closer to Brazil's cities
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever resurfaced in Brazilian cities beginning in late 2016, with Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo reporting over 2,000 cases and more than 700 deaths. A drought-driven mechanism suggests thirsty howler monkeys and marmosets moved toward urban areas, followed by Haemagogus forest mosquitoes capable of long-distance flight, increasing human exposure. The drought was 9.5% more extreme than a once-in-a-century event, with dry air potentially increasing mosquito biting frequency. A mathematical model including two mosquito species, howler monkeys, marmosets, and people was calibrated to Minas Gerais data. Only the full version—featuring both animal movement and variable biting—reproduced the epidemic, scoring about 0.90 accuracy. Haemagogus dominated transmission; Aedes aegypti infections were rarely detected. Vaccination remained the strongest mitigating factor, though even near-universal vaccination did not fully prevent a second wave; insecticide or conservation alone were insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつがサルや蚊、黄熱病をブラジルの都市部に近づける可能性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2016年に発生した過去の黄熱病流行について、干ばつと動物・蚊の移動を関連づけた数理モデル研究を紹介する科学解説記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は2016～2018年のブラジルにおける黄熱病流行を振り返り、干ばつが野生動物（ホエザル・マーモセット）と蚊（Haemagogus属）の都市部への移動を促進したとする気候科学・数理モデル研究の解説であり、現在の新規感染症イベントを報告するものではないため対象国は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: 16 000 doser vaccin kan erbjuda "visst skydd" mot ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 16,000 doses of vaccine could offer "some protection" against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Over 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine have arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has claimed more than 2,500 lives in Kongo-Kinshasa. There is currently no vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and has proven effective in prior outbreaks. The WHO notes that Ervebo can offer some protection against Bundibugyo. Doses are earmarked primarily for healthcare workers. In parallel, WHO and partners pledged to send 70,000 doses to the DRC, with more doses expected to arrive early next week. These shipments aim to bolster frontline response and protect health workers amid the ongoing Bundibugyo outbreak, as international partners scale up support to the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 16,000回分のワクチンがエボラ出血熱に「一定の防御効果」を提供できる可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクは死者2,500人超に達しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス・アウトブレイク（死者2,500人超）に対するワクチン供給（Ervebo 16,000回分、追加70,000回分予定）に関する続報。ワクチンはザイールエボラウイルス用に承認されているが、ブンディブギョ株には専用ワクチンが存在しない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले बढ़ने पर दिल्ली के स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने परामर्श जारी किया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As swine influenza (H1N1) cases rose, Delhi's health department issued an advisory.
article.articleSummary: Swine influenza (H1N1) cases have prompted an official advisory in Delhi amid rising influenza activity. This year Delhi has recorded over 2,300 Influenza A cases, including more than 1,777 H1N1; on Thursday alone 114 H1N1 cases were reported. By Friday, total influenza cases rose to 2,602: 2,392 Influenza-A and 210 Influenza-B. Thursday’s breakdown showed 159 influenza cases: 155 Influenza-A (114 H1N1, 2 H1, 1 H3, 38 others) and 4 Influenza-B. The health department urged respiratory hygiene, masking in crowded places, avoiding close contact with the ill, not spitting in public, staying hydrated, and seeking medical advice for fever, cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty, or body pains rather than self-medicating. Preparedness includes 35 hospitals under surveillance; AIIMS and NCDC designated as referral labs; guidelines on case definitions, treatment, ventilation, masking and home care; reporting via the Integrated Health Information Platform. A Union Health Minister-led meeting reviewed preparations.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例増加を受け、デリー保健局が勧告を発表
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1を含むインフルエンザA型症例が急増し、保健省高官による対策会議や公式勧告が出されるなど政府・社会的関心が高まっており、持続的曝露・流行しやすさの観点からWPROスクリーニング基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1含む）の症例増加であり、重症度・死亡例に関する明確な情報は本文になし。国レベルでの監視体制強化（35病院での監視、AIIMS・NCDC参照検査機関指定）が既に行われており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Конго отримала понад 16 тисяч доз вакцини від Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo received more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received 16,250 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak that has claimed more than 2,500 lives. Doses arrived at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa as WHO and partners plan to deliver a total of 70,000, with additional shipments expected early next week per The Washington Post. The outbreak, confined to six provinces, reports 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths. Bundibugyo has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, and its symptoms can resemble malaria, complicating diagnosis. Ervebo, licensed for Ebola caused by Zaire ebolavirus, has shown effectiveness in prior outbreaks and may offer some cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Africa CDC warns the outbreak has not peaked and could triple in cases, a trajectory reminiscent of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラワクチン1万6000回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行は死者2,557人・症例5,375人に達し、Africa CDCが今後さらに3倍化する可能性を警告するなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ拡大リスクの高い事例であるため。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文では言及がないため除外した。流行は現時点でDRC国内6州に限定されているが、Africa CDCによる拡大警告があるため国際拡大リスクをYesと評価した。
