article.articleHeadline: महिला की मौत के बाद 66 वर्षीय बुजुर्ग की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव! उज्जैन में स्वाइन फ्लू को लेकर चेतावनी जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 66-year-old man tests positive after a woman's death! Warning issued in Ujjain regarding swine flu.
article.articleSummary: Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh: Swine flu (H1N1) risk is rising in the city. A 66-year-old man from Khachrod tehsil tested positive for H1N1 after his condition worsened and was admitted to a private hospital, then shifted to the Charak Building isolation ward at the district hospital where he is under care. A 10-bed special isolation ward has been prepared in Charak Building, with two specialist doctors deployed for monitoring. Three days earlier, a woman from Rishinagar, Ujjain, died in Indore after swine flu treatment. RMOs Dr. Chinmaya Chincholikar confirmed the patient’s positive result around 8 p.m.; the patient has other comorbidities and remains under supervision. Doctors characterize this as a seasonal flu and urge calm. If symptoms such as fever, cold, cough, or sore throat appear, seek prompt treatment at a nearby hospital rather than self-medicating.

triage.headline_ja: 女性の死亡後、66歳男性の検査が陽性に！ウッジャインで豚インフルエンザに関する警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）として医師が説明しており異常性は低いが、直近の死亡例と新規陽性例があり、地域の重症化動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 医師は季節性インフルエンザと説明し、パニックを避けるよう呼びかけている。地元病院で隔離病棟を設置し対応中で、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。死亡例1件と新規陽性例1件が短期間で発生しており、続報の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud afirmó que llevó atención médica a comunidades indígenas de Amazonas para erradicar oncocercosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health stated that it provided medical care to indigenous communities of Amazonas to eradicate onchocerciasis.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela's Ministry of Health deployed medical teams to 14 indigenous communities in Amazonas state, with the Amazonian Research Center SA-CAICET, to eradicate onchocerciasis and bolster health networks for Yanomami and Ye’kwana peoples. The strategy combines immediate distribution of essential medicines with ongoing medical evaluations to sustain epidemiological control where traditional services do not reach. A rapid-response protocol includes air bridges from La Esmeralda to Puerto Ayacucho’s main airport to treat emergencies or specialized cases, aiming to reach 944 people across the communities. Onchocerciasis is caused by a parasitic worm transmitted by riverine blackflies, causing severe skin disease and vision loss that can lead to blindness. The World Health Organization notes several countries have been certified free of onchocerciasis (Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Guatemala; Niger in Africa), while Venezuela has reportedly suspended mass drug administration in at least one zone.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、オンコセルカ症根絶のためアマゾナス州の先住民コミュニティに医療支援を実施したと発表
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ政府によるオンコセルカ症根絶に向けた既存の保健プログラムの実施報告であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。対象国（ベネズエラ）はリスト対象国にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における先住民（ヤノマミ、イェクワナ族）向けの既存疾病対策プログラムの活動報告。対象国リストに該当する国（Zambia, Philippines等）は含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: غيبريسوس: المجتمعات المتضررة جوهر الاستجابة لتفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghebreyesus: Affected communities are at the heart of the response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo marks 100 days since declaration. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after visiting affected communities, said communities are at the heart of the response, not just part of it. The WHO commits to working with the DRC government, local leaders, health workers, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, and partners to end the outbreak. He called for intensified surveillance, expanded access to healthcare, support for frontline workers, and trust-building in areas with the greatest needs. Joint action could stop transmission and strengthen health security to protect the health and well-being of all people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the future.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス:被害を受けたコミュニティがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対応の中核
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重篤かつ国際的拡大リスクを常に伴う疾患であり、WHO事務局長自らが対応に言及していることから社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 既知のアウトブレイク（発生宣言から100日）の継続報道。新規の異常性は低いが、エボラという疾患特性上PICKUPと判定。既存のRRAがあれば更新情報として扱う。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर में पांच दिन में स्वाइन फ्लू का दूसरा केस, 62 वर्षीय महिला संक्रमित; स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट - indore reports second swine flu case in 5 days health alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Indore, second swine flu case in five days; 62-year-old woman infected; Health Department alert.
article.articleSummary: Indore, India reports its second swine flu case in five days: a 62-year-old woman tested positive and is stable on treatment at a private hospital. Four days earlier, a woman from Ujjain was confirmed with swine flu; she was being treated in Indore, and during hospitalization her family took her to her home in Ujjain, where she died. Health authorities have intensified surveillance as viral fever cases in Indore rose about 20% over the past two weeks and plan meetings with hospitals to coordinate care. Classic swine flu symptoms include high fever, chills, persistent cough, sore throat, headache, fatigue, body and muscle pains, and nasal congestion. High-risk groups include those over 60, diabetics, kidney disease patients, and individuals on certain medications. Advice: stay hydrated, avoid cold items; seek testing if fever with breathing difficulty; antibiotics should not be self-administered; if platelets are low, dengue testing may be considered.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市で5日間に2件目の豚インフルエンザ症例、62歳女性が感染；保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インド国内での季節性豚インフルエンザ(H1N1)の局地的な症例増加と1件の死亡が報告されているが、IHR基準の該当は少なく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低いため、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: インドール及びウッジャインでの季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)様症例の増加と1件の死亡が報告されている。デング熱との鑑別診断も言及されているが、現時点ではデング熱の具体的な発生報告はない。地域保健当局は監視強化と病院との調整を進めているが、外部支援の必要性は言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova smrtonosna epidemija iz Afrike se širi z izjemno hitrostjo: umrlo že več kot 2500 ljudi (FOTO)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Deadly Epidemic from Africa Spreading at an Extremely Rapid Pace: More Than 2,500 People Have Already Died (PHOTO).
article.articleSummary: As of 22 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) faces a deadly Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. More than 2,500 people have died, with the outbreak spanning an area larger than France. The UN warns the disease is spreading faster than health systems can respond, in a country long plagued by conflict that has weakened the health sector. About 160 health workers are infected, at least 43 have died, and attacks on health facilities and ambulances hinder response. There is no approved vaccine or drug for Bundibugyo Ebola; several experimental treatments are under investigation. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected living or dead individuals, underscoring infection-control and safe handling of remains. Funding is insufficient (the UN CERF allocated $30.5 million, likely enough for weeks), and suspension of commercial flights complicates cash deliveries to tens of thousands of responders. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak, after 2014–2016 West Africa, which killed about 11,310 people.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ発の新たな致死的感染症が猛烈な速さで拡大：死者はすでに2500人超（写真）
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が死者2500人超、フランスより広い地域に拡大し、医療従事者感染や資金不足、商業便停止など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFranceとAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文では規模比較（フランスより広い面積）としての言及のみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。Angolaでの発生は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 100 يوم على تفشي إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 100 days since the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-22, the World Health Organization marks 100 days since Ebola was declared in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after visiting affected communities, acknowledged ongoing challenges but highlighted the remarkable daily resilience of communities, stating they are central to the response. He reaffirmed WHO’s commitment to work with the DRC government, local leaders, health workers, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, and partners to end the outbreak. The call emphasizes enhanced surveillance, expanded access to healthcare, stronger support for frontline workers, and trust-building in areas most affected. The collaborative effort aims to halt transmission and strengthen health security to protect the health and well-being of people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo moving forward.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱流行から100日
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRC東部での流行が継続中でWHOも国際支援体制を強化していることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: WHOが100日を機に発表した継続的なアウトブレイク状況報告。既知の進行中エボラ流行だが、致死率の高さと国際的関心の高さからPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana Urged to Broaden Mosquito-Control Efforts Beyond Malaria | South Africa Today
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-22, Ghana marked World Mosquito Day with a call for intensified vector-control interventions to shield the public from mosquito-borne diseases. Health experts warned that Ghana's mosquito-borne disease landscape is changing, with dengue emerging as a growing threat in addition to malaria. They urged broadening the traditional malaria-focused approach to safeguard public health. The message came during a webinar organized by the Vector... in Ghana, emphasizing the need for expanded efforts to combat multiple mosquito-borne infections and to strengthen prevention and control measures at the community level. No specific case counts or outbreak details are provided in the article. The piece underscores a push for integrated, multi-disease vector-control approaches.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、マラリア対策にとどまらない蚊対策の拡充を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊デーに関する啓発的な内容で、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク情報が含まれておらず、緊急性のあるシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの詳細はなく、啓発イベントに関する報道。デング熱の脅威増大への言及はあるが、数値データなし。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में स्वाइन फ्लू के बढ़ रहे मामले, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी की एडवाइजरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Swine Flu Cases in Delhi; Health Department Issues Advisory.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports rising influenza cases, with swine flu (influenza A(H1N1)) leading the surge. This year’s influenza A total exceeds 2,300, and by Friday 1,777+ H1N1 infections had been recorded; Thursday alone added 114 H1N1 cases. On Thursday, 159 flu cases were reported (155 influenza A: 114 H1N1, 2 H1, 1 H3, 38 others). By Friday, influenza A stood at 2,392 and influenza B at 210, totaling 2,602 A and 210 B for the season. Among influenza A, 1,777 are H1N1; 37 H1; 138 H3; 440 others; influenza B includes 200 Victoria lineage and 10 others. The Delhi Health Department issued an advisory: cough hygiene, handwashing, masks in crowds, avoiding contact with respiratory patients, staying hydrated, and seeking medical advice for fever, cough, sore throat, breathlessness, or body pains. Hospitals report no shortages; 35 hospitals under surveillance; AIIMS and NCDC designated two referral labs; IHIP portal for screening and reporting. A meeting with J.P. Nadda affirmed readiness.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例が増加、保健局が注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1インフルエンザ症例が急増し、保健当局が公式アドバイザリーを発出し中央保健相との会合も行われるなど、行政的・社会的関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準（流行しやすさ・持続的曝露）に該当し社会的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優位）の国内増加であり、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、病院の逼迫もない。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数増加と当局の対応が継続しているため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Steirer berichtet von der Lage vor Ort | Kleine Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Styrian reports on the situation on the ground | Kleine Zeitung.
article.articleSummary: As of August 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused more than 2,500 deaths, with confirmed infections around 4,000 in early August and about 5,000 by mid-August, spanning six northeastern provinces and the city of Beni. Treatment centers test suspected cases and provide care, with Doctors Without Borders led by Austrian project coordinator Christoph Friedl coordinating a multinational effort with over 100 Congolese colleagues. The health system remains overwhelmed, and patient transport funds are frequently lacking. The outbreak began in January in Ituri Province and was officially identified on May 15. Containment is hindered by armed conflict and the lack of an approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain. The Congo outbreak is among the largest on record; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic exceeded 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行:シュタイヤーマルク出身者が現地の状況を報告|クライネ・ツァイトゥング
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,000人規模の感染、2,500人以上の死亡という大規模流行が続き、承認ワクチンの不在と武力紛争による封じ込め困難という異常事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文では言及がなく主題ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株に対する承認ワクチンがない点が封じ込めの大きな障害と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ¡LOS CASOS SIGUEN EN AUMENTO! Activan medidas urgentes en Perú: ¿qué enfermedad PREOCUPA al Minsa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases Are Still Rising! Urgent Measures Activated in Peru: Which Disease Concerns the Ministry of Health?
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Peru prompts the Ministry of Health (Minsa) to issue epidemiological alert AE-CDC N.° 007-2026 and extend a 90-day health emergency. By epidemiological week 33 of 2026, 1,747 confirmed measles cases have been reported nationwide, with the highest in Puno (1,264) and Arequipa (292); cases also in Cusco, Lima, and Madre de Dios. Regions at elevated risk include Lima Metropolitan, Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac, and Callao. Measures encompass differentiated triage, immediate separation of fever-and-rash patients, strengthened epidemiological surveillance, intensified vaccination, and protection of health personnel and workers with frequent patient contact; vaccination is expanded to frontline and support staff, especially in emergency, triage, hospitalization, ICU, operating rooms, and laboratories. Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and a facial rash that spreads from the face outward. Seek prompt medical care after exposure or symptom onset to accelerate detection and containment.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者数増加が続く！ペルーで緊急対策を発動:保健省が懸念する疾患とは？
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の大規模発生はペルー国内の事象であり、対象国リストに含まれないため、本トリアージの対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域はペルー国内（Puno, Arequipa, Cusco, Lima等）であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれない。BluedotのロケーションにBrazilが含まれているが、記事の主題はペルーであり、Brazilでの発生は言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo recibió más de 16 mil vacunas para hacer frente al brote de ébola | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo received more than 16,000 vaccines to tackle the Ebola outbreak | Noticias RCN
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo received over 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to address an outbreak exceeding 5,000 cases and 2,378 deaths as of Aug 19, 2026 (Africa CDC: 5,021 confirmed cases, 2,378 deaths). Vaccines arrived Friday night, with WHO planning to deliver more than 70,000 next week. The May 15 declaration marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the northern and eastern DRC, where weak state presence and poor health infrastructure have fueled rapid spread. WHO and Africa CDC warn the epidemic is far from controlled; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for sustained international support to contain it and protect frontline health workers. Notably, there is currently no vaccine or treatment approved for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ流行対策のためワクチン1万6千回分以上を受領 | ノティシアスRCN
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,000例超・死者2,378人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、当該株（ブンディブギョ株）には承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、WHOが国際支援を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約47%（2,378/5,021）と非常に高く、ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない点が特に懸念材料。WHOが翌週7万回分以上のワクチン追加供給を計画しており、事態の深刻さと国際的関与の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Channel 4 News: Rekordně nejrychleji se šířící epidemie eboly | 22. 8. 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Channel 4 News: The fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record | 22 August 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is described as the fastest-spreading on record, currently in its third month and largely confined to that conflict-affected region under M23 rebel control. The transmission pace is being compared to the 2014 West Africa outbreak, which killed over 11,000, though exact case counts are not provided. The Congolese government has deployed the Airbibo vaccine, previously used in past waves, in a bid to provide protection, but there is no vaccine specifically for this Bundibugyo strain (BDBV), and evidence of effectiveness remains uncertain. Clinical signs include bleeding, respiratory distress, and gastroenteritis; suspected cases are confirmed with results in under 24 hours. A hospitalized patient, Dr. Alex Maruzzi, spent 18 days in care and recalls severe illness. Authorities report misinformation amid a fragile health system as they attempt to curb spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: Channel 4 News: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行 | 2026年8月22日
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最速の拡大速度とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が、紛争地域という管理困難な状況下で進行しており、ワクチンの有効性も不確実であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC東部（M23反政府勢力支配地域）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。BDBV株専用ワクチンが存在せず有効性が不確実な点、紛争により保健システムが脆弱な点がリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 infections summer wave grows across US as cases rise
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections are rising in the United States with a summer wave spanning 47 states, according to wastewater signals showing a 105% increase in August vs July. The South and West show the strongest upticks, while overall national activity remains relatively low. Experts expect infections to continue rising during the summer travel season, reflecting COVID-19's seasonal pattern that includes waves in both summer and winter. Hospitalizations and deaths stay comparatively low, and emergency department visits remain very low nationally, though older adults, infants, and immunocompromised individuals face higher risk. Officials urge symptomatic individuals to stay home and advocate masks in crowded indoor settings when infection levels rise. An updated COVID-19 vaccine targeting the XFG variant is expected in September. In China, case counts are rising but most infections remain mild as the latest increase eases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で新型コロナウイルスの夏の流行が拡大、感染者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な夏の流行に関する定例的な報道であり、重症度や医療逼迫の増加は見られず、中国での増加も軽症中心とされているため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国の状況を扱っているが、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国での増加は軽症中心と明記されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : députés nationaux et sénateurs en mission pour sensibiliser la population - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: national MPs and senators on a mission to raise awareness among the population - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is the focus as national MPs and senators from Haut-Uélé undertake an urgent awareness mission in Isiro, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The delegation, on parliamentary holidays at the governor's invitation, says the Ebola outbreak is spreading in the province at an alarming speed and aims to promote close-by awareness in native languages to ensure communities understand the danger. They reaffirm commitment to support provincial authorities in the response in line with President Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo's vision. Upon arrival at Matari airport, the delegation met the vice-governor and proceeded to a working session with the governor, with plans for further awareness visits in each member's electoral base. The report highlights political leadership involvement in outbreak communication, without presenting case totals or laboratory data.

triage.headline_ja: オー＝ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：国会議員・上院議員が住民啓発のため現地入り - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オー＝ウエレ州（イシロ）でエボラ出血熱が『警戒すべき速さで』拡大していると報告されており、国会議員・上院議員が緊急啓発活動を行うなど政治的関心も高く、致死率が高い疾患であることからフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事には症例数や検査データの記載がなく、感染拡大の具体的な規模は不明。政治的関与（国会議員・上院議員の現地訪問）が強調されており、既存のDRCエボラ流行の悪化を示唆する内容。続報での症例数・WHO対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Don't panic, maintain hygiene: NCR on alert after H1N1 spike in Delhi
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports over 1,700 H1N1 positive cases in past weeks, prompting NCR-wide alert including Noida and Ghaziabad. Ghaziabad has three positives so far, 42 tests since Wednesday; Noida district data not recorded yet. Hospitals report rising high-grade fever, cough, sore throat, body aches and fatigue; some patients develop breathlessness, oxygen desaturation or pneumonia, especially with lung disease or comorbidities. Delhi shows a six-fold rise in laboratory-confirmed H1N1 versus the same period last year; true infections likely higher due to untested mild cases. No evidence of a new H1N1 strain or antigenic shift; surge likely multifactorial—monsoon transmission, indoor crowding, susceptible individuals, waning immunity. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masks, avoiding close contact, and avoiding self-medication. Vaccination urged to reduce severe disease; seek early care for breathlessness or persistent fever, particularly for elderly, pregnant, or immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: パニックにならず衛生管理を：デリーでH1N1急増、首都圏（NCR）で警戒

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）のデリー・NCR地域での症例急増。新株ではなくモンスーン期の伝播、室内密集、免疫低下等の複合要因とされる。重症化例は基礎疾患保有者に集中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, la corsa al vaccino: potrebbe essere pronto entro fine anno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the race for a vaccine: could be ready by the end of the year.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with over 5,000 confirmed cases and about 2,500 deaths, making it the largest Ebola epidemic in DRC and second-largest ever. On July 24, the first volunteer received the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine (Oxford/CEPI candidate) as part of rapid development; the outbreak was declared May 15. CEPI funds four vaccine candidates in parallel: the Oxford adenovirus-vector vaccine, an mRNA vaccine, and two rVSV-based prototypes, to avoid bottlenecks if one fails. Production has already begun: Serum Institute of India has produced roughly 620,000 doses, with 4,000 allocated for trials. Trials could begin in September in Congo; by December, a compelling proof of protection may emerge, though field implementation faces safety, cold-chain, and trust challenges. Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) is being evaluated for partial protection but is not a substitute for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ワクチン開発競争：年内に完成の可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が過去最大規模（5000例超、死亡約2500例）に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的なワクチン開発・支援体制も動いているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）としてのみ言及されており、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。英国も同様に発生地としての言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: PMC leads state's civic bodies with 71 chikungunya cases
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya dominates this season, with Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) reporting 71 of 1,096 cases from Jan 1 to Aug 21. PMC is highest among civic bodies; Mumbai 61; Akola 41; Kolhapur 34. Among districts, Palghar leads with 264; Pune 138; Latur 56; Dhule 55. PMC notes a robust sentinel-diagnostic system, yet only 14 of the 71 cases meet central govt confirmation; the rest are suspected. About 29 cases reside within PMC limits, 12 from outside, and 32 have incomplete addresses, with many patients arriving from neighboring rural areas. Authorities intensified action in hotspots and issued notices to institutions with mosquito-breeding spots. Officials emphasize diagnosing more cases, guppy release, awareness, and penalties for breeding spots; migrant workers mean not all cases involve permanent residents. Symptoms include joint pain with fever and rash; dengue symptoms and rare bleeding are highlighted. Treatment is symptomatic: hydration and paracetamol; prevention by eliminating breeding sites and seeking early care.

triage.headline_ja: PMCが州内の自治体でチクングニア熱71症例をリード
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のチクングニア熱・デング熱の通常発生報告であり、既存の監視・対応体制下で管理されているため、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: インド・マハラシュトラ州（プネ、ムンバイ、アコラ、コルハプールなど）における季節性のチクングニア熱・デング熱の流行状況報告。地方自治体による監視・対策（蚊の発生源対策、啓発活動）が既に実施されており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Três Lagoas adota Método Wolbachia para combater arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Lagoas adopts the Wolbachia Method to combat arboviral diseases.
article.articleSummary: Três Lagoas, Brazil, will roll out the Wolbachia Method to curb urban arboviruses, using Aedes aegypti mosquitoes infected with Wolbachia to block transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The initiative, led by Fiocruz in partnership with the Ministry of Health and Wolbito do Brasil, aims to reduce viral spread in the municipality, complementing traditional vector-control measures. Field data from Niterói (RJ) show an 89% drop in dengue, 60% in chikungunya, and 37% in Zika; Campo Grande (MS) reports about a 63% decrease in dengue cases. In Três Lagoas, technicians mapped 12 priority neighborhoods for the initial phase: Paranapungá, Jardim das Acácias, Jardim da Lapa, Bela Vista, Centro, Santa Luzia, Santa Terezinha, Nossa Senhora Aparecida, Vila Guanabara, Osmar Ferreira Dutra, São João, and Vila Zuque. The Ministry selected the city for full implementation, with Mayor Dr. Cassiano Maia optimistic about the project.

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19's summer comeback: What you need to know about latest surge
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is resurging in the United States, with infections rising or likely rising in 47 states. Wastewater surveillance shows a 105% August surge versus July, led by the South and West. Despite low overall activity, experts warn the summer travel season may fuel growth. The virus follows a seasonal pattern with two annual infection peaks, and the current uptick began in July, similar to trends seen since 2022. Hospitalisations and deaths remain comparatively low, though emergency department visits are described as very low nationally; older adults, infants, and immunocompromised individuals stay at higher risk. Officials recommend staying home if symptomatic and wearing masks in crowded indoor settings. An updated COVID-19 vaccine targeting the XFG variant is expected in September. Separately, China’s wave of cases is easing, with most infections remaining mild.

article.articleHeadline: 100 يوم على تفشي إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 days since the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 100 days after the Ebola outbreak was declared in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the World Health Organization marked the milestone on Sunday, as health authorities and partners continue containment efforts in affected areas. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after visiting communities affected by the outbreak, described the scale of challenges facing residents and the exceptional resilience shown amid the ongoing response. The report highlights that containment work is continuing in the eastern DRC and underscores the commitment of international and local actors to manage the outbreak. As of 2026-08-22, the response remains active and focused on limiting transmission in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ出血熱流行から100日
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が100日間継続し、WHO事務局長が現地訪問するなど国際的関心が高く、封じ込め活動が継続中であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHO国際保健規則上常に重大な公衆衛生事象として扱われる。記事には具体的な感染者数・死亡者数の記載はないが、100日間の継続とWHOトップの現地訪問は事態の深刻さを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria, Kala Azar show sharp decline in India: Report
article.articleSummary: India's NVBDCP Annual Report 2025-26 shows strong progress against Malaria, Kala Azar, and Lymphatic Filariasis under national elimination programmes. Kala Azar elimination threshold (<1 case per 10,000 population) was achieved in 2023 across 633 blocks in 54 districts spanning four states and has been sustained. Malaria cases declined 78.15% and malaria deaths 77.60% from 2015 to 2024, with 160 districts in 23 states reporting zero indigenous malaria for three consecutive years since 2022, qualifying for Sub-National Verification for Malaria Elimination. India exited the High Burden to High Impact (HBHI) list in 2024 per World Malaria Report 2025 and remains on track to achieve a 75% reduction by 2025 (70%+ in 2024). Lymphatic Filariasis elimination targets microfilaria rate <1%. In 2025, MDA achieved 94% coverage across 111 districts/696 blocks in 13 states (February); the August round reached 95% in 50 districts/394 blocks in four states, signaling strengthened transmission interruption.

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 surge: hospital footfall increases as doctors flag risks
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza cases surging in Delhi, with OPDs reporting rising patients. This season has recorded 1,777 cases in the Capital, versus 229 during the 2025 monsoon. Most healthy adults recover without major complications, but vulnerable groups—elderly, children, and those with pre-existing conditions—remain at risk for serious illness, and some patients have required ventilator support for respiratory issues. Hospitals have expanded capacity, with dedicated ICUs and seven-day isolation wards being set up; no patient has yet been admitted to the dedicated ICU, per clinicians. Health officials say bed capacity is adequate and the situation is under control. Primary symptoms include high fever, severe body ache, cold and cough, and slight reductions in white blood cell counts and platelets in some cases. Prevention emphasizes annual influenza vaccination, hand hygiene, masking in crowded places, good ventilation, and staying home when symptomatic. Weather changes are cited as a factor contributing to the surge.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, zika, chikungunya e Oropouche: sintomas podem ser parecidos, mas riscos são diferentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, Zika, Chikungunya, and Oropouche: symptoms may be similar, but risks are different.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Zika, Chikungunya, and Oropouche are circulating in Brazil, producing fever, headache, body pains, nausea and malaise, but their courses and risks differ. Infectious-disease specialist Rodolpho Dantas of HUAC-UFCG (Rede HU Brasil) cautions that diagnosing by symptoms alone is risky; medical evaluation is essential. Dengue typically lasts about seven days, with a critical window on days 3–7 when fever may subside as warning signs emerge, including lethargy or agitation, severe abdominal pain, shortness of breath, hypotension, gum bleeding, heavy menses, and petechiae. Platelet drop from days 5–7 requires about 60–80 mL/kg/day of fluids under professional guidance. Avoid NSAIDs/aspirin during suspected arboviral infection due to bleeding risk. Zika is often milder but poses microcephaly risk during pregnancy; chikungunya can cause prolonged joint pain; Oropouche may include neurological symptoms. Prevention combines vector control and personal protection in Brazil.

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela activó operativo integral para erradicar la oncocercosis en 14 comunidades indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela launched a comprehensive operation to eradicate onchocerciasis in 14 indigenous communities.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela's Ministry of Health, with SA-CAICET and local leaders, launched a comprehensive operation in Alto Orinoco, Amazonas, to eradicate onchocerciasis (river blindness) in 14 indigenous communities (Yanomami and Y'kwana) in Alto Padamo and Alto Cuntinamo, targeting 944 people. The plan combines immediate distribution of essential medicines to the Mavaca community health network with periodic medical evaluations to maintain epidemiologic control where conventional services are scarce. A rapid-response protocol provides emergency care and access to specialized treatment via air bridges from La Esmeralda to the main hospital in Puerto Ayacucho. The initiative reinforces a public policy with over three decades of experience protecting health for more than 18,000 residents across Amazonas and Bolívar. Onchocerciasis, caused by Onchocerca volvulus and transmitted by Simulium blackflies, causes intense itching, skin lesions, and potential vision loss; mass ivermectin with at least 80% coverage is the principal elimination strategy per the World Health Organization.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、先住民14コミュニティでオンコセルカ症（河川盲目症）根絶に向けた総合作戦を開始
triage.triage_reason: オンコセルカ症は既知の風土病であり、本記事は数十年来の公衆衛生対策プログラムの一環としての通常業務報告であるため、新規性・緊急性ともに低い。

article.articleHeadline: Caicó entra em estado de alerta, mas Saúde descarta surto de dengue - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caicó enters a state of alert, but Health Department rules out dengue outbreak - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleSummary: Caicó, Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil, is in a state of alert for dengue transmission but not in an outbreak. The Health Department reports increased dengue cases and uses the Ministry of Health’s surveillance criteria. The latest LIRA index (6–9 July) was 4.0%, indicating breeding sites in 4.0% of inspected properties, prompting intensified prevention. In the past week, over 16 dengue cases were confirmed, though underreporting may mask the true burden. A 15‑day operation will deploy five fumacê spray trucks, alongside ongoing source reduction and community inspections for standing water. Access to homes remains essential, with residents urged to allow entry. Dengue vaccination remains available to eligible individuals. No confirmed dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in Caicó. A follow‑up LIRA survey is scheduled for Sept 8–11.

triage.headline_ja: カイコ市が警戒態勢に入るも、保健当局はデング熱の大流行を否定
triage.triage_reason: 保健当局が公式にアウトブレイクを否定しており、通常の季節性デング熱対策の範囲内で重症例（デング出血熱）も確認されていない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの通常のデング熱サーベイランス・予防活動の報道であり、当局は明確にアウトブレイクを否定している。ブラジルでは対象国リストに該当するが、事案の重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Беспрецедентная эпидемия: ДР Конго получила более 16 тыс. доз вакцины от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented epidemic: the DR Congo has received more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received over 16,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine as the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak accelerates. A first batch of 16,250 doses arrived at Ndjili International Airport in Kinshasa, with a total of 70,000 doses anticipated by WHO and partners and additional shipments due soon. The current outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; Ervebo (licensed for Ebola Zaire) may offer partial protection against Bundibugjo according to WHO. The epidemic is expanding rapidly: 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths across six provinces; WHO characterizes it as the third-largest in history, with transmission chains unknown in about 80% of new cases and potential case growth to triple before peaking, per Africa CDC. Conflict, attacks on health facilities, displacement, and weak infrastructure hinder response; the initial epicenter was Ituri province. By end of May, 83 cases were confirmed with only ~21% of contacts traced.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない流行:コンゴ民主共和国がエボラワクチン1万6千回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク)に該当し、WHOが史上3番目の規模と評価する大規模エボラ流行であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、6州にわたり5,375例確定・2,557人死亡。承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、感染経路不明の新規症例が約80%、接触者追跡率も低いため、さらなる拡大リスクが高い。紛争・医療施設への攻撃・避難民発生も対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Безпрецедентна епідемія: ДР Конго отримала понад 16 тис. доз вакцини від Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented epidemic: DR Congo has received more than 16,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has received over 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine as part of a broader campaign to curb a rapidly expanding outbreak. The country expects 70,000 doses in total, with additional shipments anticipated in the coming days; 16,250 doses were delivered to N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy, and diagnosis is difficult due to symptom overlap with malaria. Ervebo, licensed for Ebola prevention and shown effective in prior outbreaks, may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, according to WHO. As of 22 August 2026, the outbreak spans six provinces with 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths; WHO notes cases could triple and emphasizes ongoing conflict, attacks on health facilities, and displacement hindering containment. About 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains; initially concentrated in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない流行：コンゴ民主共和国が1万6千回分以上のエボラワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準も複数該当。死者2,557人・症例5,375人規模で6州に拡大し、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で承認ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、マラリアとの症状類似により診断が困難。新規感染の約80%が感染経路不明であり、紛争・医療施設への攻撃・住民避難が封じ込めを妨げている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय की लोगों से अपील, स्वाइन फ्लू के लक्षणों को न करें नजरअंदाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health appeals to the public not to ignore the symptoms of swine flu.
article.articleSummary: As of August 23, 2026, India's Ministry of Health urged the public in New Delhi, India, not to ignore symptoms of swine flu (H1N1). The advisory lists fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches, and fatigue as possible signs. Those with persistent or worsening symptoms should seek medical advice at a nearby healthcare center; if infected, do not panic and stay under medical supervision with proper nutrition. To reduce transmission, avoid close contact with others, wear a mask when outside or near others, and cover coughs/sneezes with tissue or elbow. Regularly wash hands with soap and water and use hand sanitizer. Extra precautions are advised for the elderly, young children, or people with preexisting conditions. The guidance emphasizes timely recognition and appropriate care under medical supervision.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'Institut national de santé publique annonce la stratégie " 100 % village " - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the National Institute of Public Health announces the '100% village' strategy.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts launch of the '100% village' strategy to bring the response to communities. Announced in Kinshasa on 22 August 2026 by INSP Director-General Dr. Dieudonné Mwamba, the plan shifts focus from health zones to village-level mobilization for case detection, contact tracing, and isolation. Vaccination is a pillar; the DRC currently has 20,750 doses (750 for frontline workers; 20,000 for ongoing trials evaluating the Bundibugyo strain vaccine). Given limited doses, authorities will implement a progressive, targeted approach, starting with a belt around Ituri to curb spread toward neighboring provinces, including Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, and Bas-Uélé. Health workers are prioritized, followed by high-risk contacts and other groups as supplies allow. Emphasis on community engagement, reinforced surveillance, improved care, and safe management of deceased individuals to limit transmission aims to prevent spread from Ituri to other provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：国立公衆衛生研究所が「100%村」戦略を発表

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To confront the deadly Ebola virus... 16,000 doses of the vaccine reach Congo | Alaraby TV
article.articleSummary: 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo as the country confronts the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths. The outbreak is centered in northern and eastern DRC amid deteriorating health services and ongoing armed conflict that hinder access. The 17th outbreak was announced May 15, with estimates the virus had been spreading for weeks. The World Health Organization says Congo will receive 70,000 Ervebo doses in total, including 20,000 for clinical trials and 50,000 for frontline health workers; Ervebo is the only vaccine with formal approval and has proven efficacy against the Zaire strain, though protection against Bundibugyo remains unconfirmed and based mainly on animal data, prompting calls for broader human trials. Other vaccines in development include Moderna’s mRNA candidate and Oxford’s vaccine; Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore is accelerating an rVSV-Bundibugyo vaccine toward human testing.

article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 5,307 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths (case fatality about 47.6%) as of August 20, with 1,167 recoveries and 737 patients in isolation or care; contact tracing stands at 85%. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for roughly 85% of cases, followed by Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé. Diagnostic capacity has expanded from one laboratory to more than 21 facilities, with mobile labs planned to further shorten confirmation times. Nearly 40 treatment centers are in operation or under construction to boost isolation and care. Research targets the Bundibugyo (Zaire) Ebola strain; Ervebo is approved for Zaire, with potential cross-immunity and ongoing trials for a strain-specific vaccine. article.articleHeadline: בשטח בגודל צרפת כולה: התפרצות האבולה בדרך להיות הגדולה בהיסטוריה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In an area the size of France: the Ebola outbreak on track to be the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is on track to become the largest in history, expanding over an area the size of France. As of 2026-08-22, authorities report 5,290 laboratory-confirmed infections and 2,516 deaths. Health officials estimate only 30-40% of actual cases have been laboratory-confirmed, implying a far larger burden. For each confirmed case, about 60 people are exposed, with roughly 19,000 detected direct infections and an estimated 80,000 undetected circulating in the population. The outbreak, formally declared in May in the mining town of Mongbwalo, began possibly February. The pace of transmission has surged, with 13th-week activity tenfold higher in cases and sevenfold higher in deaths than the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, and about 18 times faster than 2018-2020. In three weeks, transmission spread from three eastern provinces to six; many deaths have occurred outside treatment centers, fueling concern and mistrust among communities.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 cases have risen, but there is no need to panic: Dr. Randeep Guleria.
article.articleSummary: As of August 23, 2026, influenza A(H1N1) cases are rising but not a cause for panic, according to Dr. Randeep Guleria, former AIIMS Delhi director. If fever persists 4–5 days with breathing difficulties, chest pain, vomiting, or low oxygen, the illness can be serious and may lead to pneumonia if not treated promptly. Parents should seek care for sleepy or poorly eating children, and anyone with cold-like symptoms should limit outdoor exposure to prevent spread. Precautions include wearing masks, frequent handwashing, and covering the mouth when coughing. High-risk groups—very young, very old, or immunocompromised—should monitor closely. article.articleHeadline: Las infecciones por hongos causan ya más muertes que la malaria y la tuberculosis juntas y la culpa es del ser humano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fungal infections are now causing more deaths than malaria and tuberculosis combined, and the blame lies with humanity.
article.articleSummary: Fungal infections now cause about 3.8 million deaths annually worldwide, up from ~2 million in the 2010s, surpassing malaria and tuberculosis in mortality. Underdiagnosed mycoses, notably those due to Aspergillus fumigatus and Aspergillus flavus, disproportionately affect patients with asthma, tuberculosis, or lung cancer, and complicate pneumonia and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease outcomes. David W. Denning of the University of Manchester, publishing in The Lancet Infectious Diseases, synthesizes data from more than 85 articles across around 100 countries, highlighting the global burden and interactions with HIV/AIDS, where roughly half of AIDS deaths may be fungal-related. A COVID-19-era surge of mucormycosis in India underscores emergent risk. Early diagnosis and effective treatment are critical, yet many countries lack adequate diagnostic capacity, and antifungal resistance is rising. While mortality rises may reflect population growth and better estimation, improvements in detection could reduce deaths in the future.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with Ituri as the epicenter of a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. Declared May 15, 2026; by August 20, 2026 there were 5,300 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths (case fatality 47.6%), 1,167 recoveries and 737 patients in Ebola Treatment Centers. Contact tracing reached 85%. The outbreak spans six provinces—Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele—with Ituri accounting for about 85% of cases. Drivers include population movements around mining sites and infected individuals leaving sites when symptomatic, often misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid; and the transport of corpses, such as a woman’s body moved from Ituri to Kisangani, contributing to spread to Tshopo. Diagnostics expanded to 21 laboratories; nearly 40 treatment centers are operational or under construction. Vaccination stock totals 20,750 doses: 750 for frontline workers, about 20,000 for ongoing trials to evaluate vaccine efficacy against Bundibugyo. article.articleHeadline: 11 مليون إصابة متوقعة بالحصبة حول العالم في 2026.. ما الذي أعاد المرض إلى الواجهة؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11 million measles cases expected worldwide in 2026... What has brought the disease back into the spotlight?
article.articleSummary: 11 million measles cases are projected worldwide in 2026, with outbreaks across Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Most infections will occur in low- and middle-income countries, though high-income nations are also affected. WHO cites Africa and Asia as the center of transmission, yet outbreaks have hit Europe and the Americas as well. Notable affected areas include Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Somalia, Sudan, and Yemen; outbreaks also in Maldives and Zambia, with rising cases in India. Bangladesh reports the year’s deaths exceed 900, worsened by political turmoil since 2024 reducing vaccination uptake. In the Americas, Canada lost measles-free status in November 2025; Mexico and the United States risk doing so too, while Guatemala records over 30,000 cases in 2026. Vaccination remains essential: Europe’s one-dose coverage about 94% and two-dose about 88%; LMICs ~80% and ~70%. COVID-19 disrupted supply/services, underscoring the need for funding and rebuilding trust to reach >95% coverage and protect zero-dose children.

The doses arrived at Kinshasa's N'djili Airport on Friday, part of 70,000 pledged by WHO and partners; more doses are expected early next week. The outbreak across six provinces has 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths. Bundibugyo virus is rare and currently has no approved treatment or vaccine; Ervebo, licensed for Ebola and previously effective, may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. WHO notes potential cross-protection, though evidence is limited. Transmission is surging and not yet peaked, with Africa CDC projecting it could reach up to three times the known rate. Containment faces armed conflict, attacks on health workers and facilities, mobile and displaced populations, and weak infrastructure.

article.articleHeadline: Caso Lito (saiba novidades sobre a doença mais mortal de todas)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case Lito (Learn the latest about the deadliest disease of all).
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) diagnosed in aviation specialist Lito Sousa, 59, in Brazil, highlights a severe, rare prion disease. CJD is a transmissible spongiform encephalopathy caused by prions, producing brain lesions and sponge-like tissue. Forms include sporadic (~85%), hereditary/genetic (5–15%), and acquired/iatrogenic (extremely rare). About 90% die within one year of symptom onset, which begins with rapid cognitive decline, loss of motor coordination, tremors, involuntary spasms, and behavioral or speech changes. No cure exists; care is supportive and palliative. Neuroscientist Fabiano de Abreu Agrela Rodrigues studied a family case; his work feeds into the Genetic Intelligence Project (GIP). Underreporting hampers early diagnosis; after the article, more than five relatives sought testing, with DCJD confirmed in all evaluated cases. Published 22 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: リト氏の症例（全ての病の中で最も致死率の高い病気に関する最新情報）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの孤発性クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病（CJD）の個別症例報告であり、既知の非伝染性（通常接触では非感染性）疾患であるため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定個人（アビエーション専門家）のCJD診断を取り上げた一般向け医療解説記事で、家族内での遺伝性症例（DCJDと推定）についても言及があるが、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクではなく個別の遺伝性疾患事例と考えられる。プリオン病は通常のヒト-ヒト感染経路（接触・飛沫等）では感染しないため、国際的拡大リスクは極めて低い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ébola na RD Congo é já o mortífero de sempre e continua a espalhar-se
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is already the deadliest ever and continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread and is described as the deadliest on record. Since it was declared in mid-May, more than 5,000 people have been diagnosed, with about half of the patients dying in the past two weeks. The virulence of this Ebola strain and the ongoing spread in the eastern provinces are overwhelming the response, and authorities have struggled to contain transmission. The United Nations warns that funds available to fight the outbreak will last only a few weeks, prompting appeals for international aid and donor support to sustain control efforts. Beyond funding, severe shortages of healthcare facilities and personnel, particularly in the war-torn eastern provinces where the outbreak is most active, hinder surveillance and care. The crisis is compounded by decades of conflict limiting infrastructure and access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上最悪の死亡率となり拡大が継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模流行（5000人超診断、致死率高い）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 国連が資金不足を警告し国際支援を呼びかけているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: UFPI e CIATEN fortalecem enfrentamento da Doença de Chagas na Região dos Cocais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFPI and CIATEN Strengthen the Fight Against Chagas Disease in the Cocais Region.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease, in the Cocais region of Piauí, Brazil, was the focus of a meeting on August 19 in Pedro II, organized by UFPI’s Center for Intelligence in Tropical, Emerging and Neglected Diseases (CIATEN). Seven municipalities sent managers, health professionals, researchers and representatives to participate in a Deliberative Dialogue, part of the PPSUS-supported project Síntese de Evidências Sobre Doenças Determinadas Socialmente. The initiative linked synthesized evidence with local context to shape practical health actions for prevention, diagnosis, care and control, with equity at the center due to social and territorial disparities in access. Participants reviewed the evidence, debated feasibility and acceptability, and identified barriers and opportunities for implementation. The outcome was locally adapted directions to inform decision-making, strengthen Chagas disease responses, and translate research into policy and action in the Region of Cocais, through science-to-territory integration.

triage.headline_ja: UFPIとCIATEN、ココワイス地域におけるシャーガス病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではなく、既知の風土病に関する学術的な会議・政策協議の報告であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ピアウイ州ココワイス地域におけるシャーガス病対策のための学術会議・政策対話の報告であり、新規感染発生や急性のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。Brazilは対象国リストに含まれるが、内容が既存の慢性疾患対策プログラムに関するものであるため、緊急シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis dan Tips Pengobatan Sampai Tuntas!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis and Tips for Completing Treatment!
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks second globally in tuberculosis cases, behind India, and aims to eliminate TB by 2030. The Health Ministry prioritizes TB control and strict treatment monitoring to prevent defaults and transmission, extending care from hospitals to primary health facilities. Pulmonary TB treatment lasts six months uninterrupted; extrapulmonary TB (bone TB, tuberculoma cerebri, TB meningitis, etc.) may require up to 18 months, with evaluation for extension. Diagnosis combines clinical assessment with a rapid molecular test to detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis in sputum, supported by radiology. TB is airborne, with transmission most likely in enclosed, poorly ventilated spaces, especially in the first two weeks of untreated cough. After diagnosis, patients should discuss duration and adherence with their physician and sign informed consent for medication adherence. An illustrative case describes a 50-year-old man with smoking and diabetes presenting weight loss and productive cough, MTB detected.

triage.headline_ja: 結核と完治のための治療のヒント！
triage.triage_reason: 一般向け啓発・治療解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の治療法・服薬遵守に関する一般的な啓発コンテンツであり、インドネシアとインドの結核罹患率順位に言及しているのみで、突発的な発生や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ký sinh trùng gây thiếu máu, suy dinh dưỡng ở trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parasites causing anemia and malnutrition in children.
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam's tropical climate, parasites cause anemia and malnutrition in children. The article lists soil-transmitted helminths—Ascaris lumbricoides (roundworm), Trichuris trichiura (whipworm), hookworms, Enterobius vermicularis (pinworm), and Strongyloides stercoralis (threadworm)—along with food-borne liver, lung, and intestinal flukes and various tapeworms. Zoonotic larvae from dogs and cats include Toxocara spp., Gnathostoma spp., Taenia solium larvae, and rat lungworm Angiostrongylus cantonensis, plus other twisting nematodes. Protozoa such as Entamoeba histolytica and Giardia duodenalis cause diarrhea and malabsorption. Disease ranges from abdominal pain and diarrhea to chronic malnutrition, iron-deficiency anemia, stunting, and impaired growth and development; some larvae migrate to liver, lungs, or central nervous system, with ocular involvement possible. Transmission occurs via ingestion of eggs/larvae from soil, water, or undercooked produce, hand-to-mouth contact, and skin penetration. Prevention emphasizes regular deworming, handwashing with soap, wearing shoes, cooking meat thoroughly, washing produce, and proper pet waste management.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもに貧血・栄養失調を引き起こす寄生虫
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な寄生虫症に関する啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントやアウトブレイクの報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、ベトナムにおける寄生虫感染症全般の予防啓発を目的とした一般情報記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes masifkan deteksi dini tuberkulosis lewat CKG khusus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health ramps up early tuberculosis detection via specialized CKG.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health is ramping up early tuberculosis detection through TB-specific Free Health Checks (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG) in Palu, Central Sulawesi. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus announced the measure after coordinating TB handling with the Central Sulawesi Provincial Government in Palu on Saturday, August 22, 2026. The TB-focused screenings are conducted under the CKG program, aiming to identify TB cases at earlier stages through targeted health checks. The report provides no TB case counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources in this brief, focusing on the policy action and intergovernmental coordination to bolster TB detection efforts in Central Sulawesi.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、特別CKG(無料健康診断)を通じて結核の早期発見を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患である結核に対する通常の公衆衛生対策（早期発見プログラム）に関する報道であり、異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は政策的な取り組み（早期発見プログラムの強化）に関するものであり、症例数や感染源、異常な流行状況などの疫学的情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bimba morta per difterite, Garattini: "Serve più scienza a scuola. I medici no vax? Sono inaccettabili
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Little girl dies of diphtheria, Garattini: "We need more science in schools. Anti-vax doctors? They are unacceptable."
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria death in Milan, Italy: Anna Rosa Bartolotta, a young girl, dies; her parents are under investigation for manslaughter over alleged failure to vaccinate against the mandatory diphtheria vaccine. A cousin is symptomatic and tested positive for diphtheria but remains not severely ill due to prior vaccination. Professor Silvio Garattini calls for more science in schools and condemns anti-vaccine doctors as unacceptable. He recalls Andrew Wakefield's fraud, noting lasting drops in MMR vaccination and continued measles outbreaks in Europe and the United States. He cites global anti-vaccination episodes—UK 1853 Vaccination Act, Brazil 1904 antivaccination tensions, Nigeria 2003 polio boycott—and warns the Internet and AI could amplify misinformation. Emphasizes clear, evidence-based communication and the simple, essential role of vaccines in preventing deaths like Anna Rosa’s.

triage.headline_ja: ジフテリアで幼女死亡、ガラッティーニ氏「学校でより多くの科学教育が必要。反ワクチン医師は容認できない」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はイタリア・ミラノでの単発ジフテリア死亡例とワクチン忌避に関する論説であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）における現在進行中の発生事例ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア・ミラノでの単発ジフテリア死亡例と、それを契機とした反ワクチン運動への論説記事。ブラジル（1904年）・ナイジェリア（2003年）は過去の反ワクチン運動事例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストにイタリアは含まれないため、本イベントは対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis symptoms may appear even after 3 weeks since exposure -- expert
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Manila surge after flooding from the Southwest Monsoon (Habagat). As of Aug 23, 2026, San Lazaro Hospital has recorded 60 leptospirosis patients since Aug 10, including 22 new admissions and 19 in severe condition, with three deaths. Most cases are linked to wading through floodwaters. Expert Dr. Rontgene Solante warns symptoms may appear up to three weeks after exposure, with incubation as long as about two weeks. Transmission occurs via contact with floodwater contaminated by urine from infected rodents; entry points include open wounds, the eyes, and the mouth. Reported symptoms include fever, vomiting, nausea, muscle pain, and headaches; severe disease can cause jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, and low urine output. Urge to seek medical attention within seven days of symptom onset, and not to delay beyond 24–48 hours. Prevention includes washing the body with soap and water after exposure and seeking prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症状は曝露から3週間後でも現れることがある――専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: マニラで洪水後にレプトスピラ症患者が急増し死亡例も出ているが、季節性の既知の疾病であり人-人感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低いため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の洪水後に毎年発生するレプトスピラ症の増加であり、既知のパターン。重症例・死亡例があるため引き続き動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine as it grapples with unprecedented outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to surge, prompting vaccine deployment as health authorities label it the fastest outbreak in history. Congo has received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine in Kinshasa's N'djili International Airport, part of a 70,000-dose package announced by the World Health Organization and partners; more doses are expected early next week. The report does not provide current case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or explicit infection sources. It focuses on the logistics of vaccine delivery rather than clinical data. The arrival underscores international support for outbreak response and protection of frontline workers and at-risk populations in Congo, as authorities work to scale up vaccination amid ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、前例のないエボラ流行に対応するため16,000回分以上のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで「史上最速の流行」と当局が表現し、WHOが7万回分のワクチン供給支援を実施するなど、深刻性・異常性・国際支援の必要性が明確に認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数・死亡者数・検査確認状況等の臨床データを含まず、ワクチン物流に焦点を当てているため、詳細な疫学情報については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D atualiza vacinação infantil e reforça alerta contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day updates on childhood vaccination and reinforces the measles alert.
article.articleSummary: During Brazil’s national Multivaccination Day, 10-year-old Noam Medeiros completed his vaccination card at the Basic Health Unit 612 Sul in Brasília, receiving two shots to align with the calendar. The event, led by Health Minister Alexandre Padilha, marked the first nationwide Day to update all 17 vaccines in the pediatric schedule. The campaign also introduced the pneumococcal 20-valent vaccine for children under 5, expanding protection against pneumococcal pneumonia and meningitis. Padilha urged attention to measles vaccination for people aged 6 months to 59 years and workers in tourist hubs such as restaurants, hotels, airports, and taxis, amid concerns over imported cases. Brazil regained its measles-free status in 2024, though last year saw 38 imported cases linked to the U.S. outbreak that also affected Canada and Mexico; no outbreak due to SUS vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 「Dia D」で小児予防接種を更新、麻疹への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の予防接種キャンペーン（Dia D）に関する報道であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。ブラジルは麻疹排除ステータスを維持しており、緊急性のあるシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの広報であり、麻疹の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。過去（昨年）に米国発の輸入症例38件があったことが言及されているが、ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除ステータスを回復しており、SUSワクチン接種によりアウトブレイクは発生していない旨明記されている。米国・カナダ・メキシコは過去の文脈で言及されているのみで、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: parasita da alface que causa diarreia explosiva afeta milhares de pessoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: the lettuce parasite that causes explosive diarrhea affects thousands of people.
article.articleSummary: Cyclospora cayetanensis is driving a cyclosporiasis outbreak in the United States with more than 27,000 infections linked to contaminated lettuce. Infected individuals report explosive watery diarrhea, abdominal cramps, nausea, extreme fatigue, and weight loss; symptoms can persist for weeks with relapses if untreated. Transmission stems from ingestion of water or raw produce washed inadequately, and person-to-person spread is uncommon due to the parasite’s environmental maturation. The outbreak is centered in Michigan and neighboring Midwest states; the United Kingdom has 67 cases in travelers who had visited Mexico and returned in 2026. A suspected lettuce source from Taylor Farms distributed to Taco Bell ties the U.S. outbreak to a retail supply. Brazil faces low import risk as it does not source fresh greens from the U.S./Mexico; diagnosis requires special stool stains or PCR tests, and underdetection is likely.

triage.headline_ja: アラート：レタスに潜む寄生虫が爆発的な下痢を引き起こし、数千人に影響
triage.triage_reason: 米国・英国・メキシコでのサイクロスポーラ症アウトブレイクであり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生は確認されない（ブラジルは輸入リスクが低いと明記されているのみで発生国ではない）。
triage.notes: 発生地域には対象国であるブラジルが含まれるが、記事では『ブラジルは米国・メキシコから生鮮野菜を輸入していないため輸入リスクは低い』と述べられているのみで、ブラジル国内での発生・感染事例は報告されていない。よってverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Four Swine Flu Deaths, 25 Cases Reported Across MP
article.articleSummary: Four swine flu (H1N1) deaths and 25 cases have been reported in Madhya Pradesh so far, with 25 isolated cases from Bhopal, Indore, Ujjain and other districts, per IDSP. A prominent H1N1-linked death occurred on August 19 in a 60-year-old woman from Ujjain who was treated at an Indore private hospital; she was discharged against doctors’ advice on August 18 and died on August 19. The Madhya Pradesh health department has ordered a high-level investigation and issued a show-cause notice to the Indore hospital. The case highlights rising seasonal viral activity during the monsoon months, with rising humidity linked to infections. Authorities are monitoring the situation closely and emphasize timely reporting and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤプラデシュ州全域で豚インフルエンザによる4人死亡、25例報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）による局地的な死亡・症例増加であり、インドでは既知の季節性疾患のため異常性は低いが、州保健当局が調査を命じており継続的な動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性・地域流行が既知であり、モンスーン期に例年増加する傾向がある。州保健局が病院への調査・是正通知を発出しており局所的対応が進行中。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế: Tăng cường giám sát, hạn chế thấp nhất ca tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: Strengthen surveillance to minimize rabies-related deaths.
article.articleSummary: From January to June 2026, Vietnam recorded 34 rabies deaths nationwide, with 23 in the Southern region; Ho Chi Minh City accounted for 5 fatalities in the first six months. To mark World Rabies Day on 28 September 2026, the Ministry of Health’s Preventive Medicine Department urges provincial health authorities to coordinate with veterinary services and implement practical activities, focusing on community and school outreach in high-risk areas and intensified public communications on rabies prevention. Emphasis is on immediate wound washing and seeking medical advice for assessment, post-exposure vaccination, and, when indicated, rabies immunoglobulin (RIG). Surveillance should be strengthened to detect and manage exposures, with proper risk assessment, wound care, and PEP. WOAH/OIE notes: 99% of human rabies from dog bites; over 95% of deaths occur in Asia and Africa; rural areas account for >80%; about 4 of 10 deaths in children. Rabies is nearly always fatal once symptoms appear; prevention hinges on early vaccination and avoiding animal bites.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省:狂犬病による死亡を最小限に抑えるため監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による死亡が継続的に発生している（2026年上半期に34人）が、これは同国で以前から続く地方病的な公衆衛生課題であり、新規または異常な発生ではなく、世界狂犬病デーに合わせた啓発・監視強化キャンペーンの内容である。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで地方病的に存在し、犬咬傷による曝露後予防（PEP）を柱とした既存の国内対策体制が機能している。本記事は世界狂犬病デー（9月28日）に向けた保健省の定例的な監視強化・啓発活動の呼びかけであり、新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。ヒト-ヒト感染がないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-揭开口蹄疫病毒"劫持"宿主能量的秘密
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - Unveiling the Secret of How Foot-and-Mouth Disease Virus Hijacks Host Energy
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) hijacks host energy metabolism in livestock by activating two autophagy pathways that together boost glycolysis and viral replication. Researchers from the Lanzhou Veterinary Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, China, showed that FMDV simultaneously triggers a selective autophagy route dependent on specific host target proteins and mitophagy, creating a robust metabolic drive for infection. When one pathway is blocked, the other maintains high glycolytic flux, illustrating a dual-pathway safeguard that enhances viral survival in pig, cattle, and sheep cells. Reported in Autophagy and published on 23 August 2026, the work identifies molecular targets within host–autophagy–metabolism crosstalk, offering avenues for host-targeted antiviral strategies and the development of small-molecule therapeutics and new animal disease control agents. This finding underscores a novel mechanism by which FMDV leverages host energy systems to sustain propagation, relevant to global livestock health.

triage.headline_ja: 科学网-揭开口蹄疫病毒「劫持」宿主能量的秘密
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は口蹄疫ウイルスの分子メカニズムに関する基礎研究論文報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクやフィールド疫学イベントではなく、公衆衛生的な危機的状況を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はランチョウ獣医学研究所の研究成果を報告する学術記事であり、中国でのアウトブレイク事象の報告ではない。口蹄疫の病毒メカニズムについての基礎研究論文の発表であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Конго получило более 16 тысяч доз вакцины на фоне самой стремительной вспышки Эболы в истории
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo received more than 16,000 doses of vaccine amid the fastest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces the fastest Ebola outbreak in history, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. In six provinces, 5,375 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths have been reported. The outbreak spreads rapidly, with officials warning transmission has not yet peaked and contact tracing is overwhelmed; symptoms can resemble malaria, complicating detection. The Ervebo vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV) has begun deployment: Congo received 16,250 doses, part of a plan to deliver 70,000 doses, with additional shipments expected early next week. The first batch arrived at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa on August 22. There is no approved treatment or vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo; Ervebo may offer some protection. The response is hindered by armed conflict, attacks on health workers and facilities, and population displacement, complicating outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最速のエボラ流行の中、1万6千回分以上のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速とされる大規模エボラ流行(5,375症例・2,557死亡)であり、感染拡大継続・対応体制の逼迫・武力紛争による対応阻害など国際的関心・支援が必要な深刻な公衆衛生事象であるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種エボラウイルスによる流行で、マラリアと症状が類似し検出が複雑化。武力紛争と医療従事者への攻撃が対応を阻害しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Shigellosis cases open up a new AMR challenge in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis in Keralam faces rising antimicrobial resistance, with primary antibiotics for community-acquired cases losing efficacy. KARS-Net data (since 2023) show ciprofloxacin resistance at 96% and ceftriaxone resistance at 36%. Community-acquired AMR now concerns treatment outside hospitals. Clinicians warn that shrinking antibiotic options jeopardizes management of severe dysentery, where patients may progress to septic shock or multiorgan failure; ceftriaxone may be unreliable, forcing consideration of meropenem in critical cases. Shigella transmission remains food- and water-borne, making it a sentinel AMR indicator for community trends. A major outbreak in June this year tallied 225 cases and six deaths across Kozhikode, Malappuram and Wayanad. Keralam has historical ESBL-producing strains and prior MDR patterns; a 2018 Government Medical College Alappuzha study reported 91.6% MDR among isolates and Ceftriaxone/Cefotaxime resistance. Most diarrhoea is self-limiting, but vulnerable groups require antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州で赤痢菌症の症例が新たなAMR（薬剤耐性）課題を提起
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響（225例・6死亡のアウトブレイク）と異常性（高率の薬剤耐性という新たな課題）の2つに該当し、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・ケーララ州における赤痢菌症の薬剤耐性（AMR）進行に焦点を当てたもので、6月のアウトブレイク（225例、6死亡）を背景に、シプロフロキサシン耐性96%、セフトリアキソン耐性36%という深刻な耐性状況を報告している。地域限定的な公衆衛生課題だが、AMRサーベイランスの観点から重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Конго отримало понад 16 тисяч доз вакцини на тлі найшвидшого спалаху Еболи в історії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has received more than 16,000 doses of vaccine amid the fastest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-23, the Democratic Republic of the Congo received 16,250 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine amid an unprecedented Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Six provinces report 5,375 confirmed cases and 2,557 deaths. The first vaccine batch arrived late Aug 22 at N'Djili International Airport in Kinshasa; the WHO and partners aim to deploy about 70,000 doses, with additional shipments expected early next week. Bundibugyo has no approved treatment or vaccine; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease and has shown effectiveness in prior outbreaks, with WHO indicating it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. The outbreak is expanding rapidly, described as the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the region, as health workers struggle to conduct contact tracing amid armed conflict, attacks on medical facilities, population displacement, and weakened infrastructure. This vaccination effort is part of the international response to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最速のエボラ流行を受けて1万6000回分以上のワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速・最多死亡者数のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が拡大しており、国際的なワクチン展開が行われている。IHR基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる史上最速・最多死亡の流行。6州で5,375症例、2,557死亡。武力紛争や医療施設への攻撃、住民避難により接触者追跡が困難。WHOと国際社会がErvebo(通常型エボラ用ワクチン)を展開中だが、ブンディブギョ型への有効性は限定的な可能性。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго доставили первую партию вакцины от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first batch of Ebola vaccine has been delivered to Congo.
article.articleSummary: First batch of Ebola vaccine Ervebo delivered to the Democratic Republic of Congo to help respond to an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Kinshasa received 16,250 doses of 70,000 planned; another shipment expected early next week. Delivery organized by WHO and partners. No vaccine specifically approved for this variant yet, but WHO expects Ervebo to offer some protection; the vaccine has proven effectiveness in prior outbreaks. As of latest data, DRC confirms 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths; authorities call it the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. Transmission is complicated by armed conflict, attacks on health workers, and population displacement; Africa CDC warns the peak may not yet be reached and cases could rise significantly.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにエボラワクチンの第一便が到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（症例5,375件、死亡2,557件）が継続しており、武力紛争や住民避難により制御が困難で、国際的なワクチン支援が行われている重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、現行のErvebo(rVSV-ZEBOV)ワクチンはこの変異株に対して未承認だが一定の防御効果が期待されている。Africa CDCはピーク未到達で症例増加の可能性を警告。

article.articleHeadline: '8 Out Of 10 Positive': Inside Delhi-NCR's H1N1 Hospital Wards
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR is contending with a sharp fever surge mainly driven by H1N1 (Influenza A). Hospital reporting shows high positivity: Amrita Hospital, Faridabad, about eight of ten tested are positive for Influenza A/H1N1; recent OPD rounds show 15–16 of 20 positive; Fortis Faridabad similarly notes 60–70% positivity among flu-like cases. Delhi has recorded at least seven times more H1N1 cases this year than the same period last year (NCDC). The surge began earlier than usual (last 15 days to one month) with high-grade fever, sore throat, and cough, and a growing number developing pneumonia requiring hospitalization (roughly half of positives). Some cases progress to H1N1-related pneumonia; possible changes in circulating strains or environmental factors are under study. Vaccination is reinforced as the best protection. Notable patient example includes a 39-year-old with H1N1-related pneumonia and evidence of household transmission patterns.

triage.headline_ja: 『10人中8人が陽性』：デリーNCRのH1N1病棟の内部事情
triage.triage_reason: デリーNCRでH1N1の陽性率が非常に高く（60〜80%）、昨年同期比7倍の症例増加、季節外れの早期流行、肺炎による入院増加が見られ、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）が複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーNCR（ハリヤナ州・デリー準州含む）における国内的なH1N1流行を扱っており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は報告されていない。ただし症例数の急増・重症化率・早期発生時期は懸念材料であり、続報および公式統計（NCDC等）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Wear masks, avoid crowds': Delhi steps up surveillance as H1N1 cases cross 1,777- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 2,602 influenza cases in 2026 so far, with 2,392 Influenza-A and 210 Influenza-B; H1N1 remains the predominant Influenza-A subtype with 1,777 cases, followed by H3 and H1 subtypes. 114 new H1N1 infections were recorded on Thursday, adding to rising activity as the capital strengthens surveillance. 35 hospitals are under special surveillance; AIIMS and the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) are referral laboratories for testing and monitoring. A public health advisory urges masks in crowded places, respiratory hygiene, cough etiquette, handwashing, and prompt medical consultation for flu-like symptoms. Technical guidelines cover patient categorisation, home-based care, ventilatory support and mask use; facilities are directed to enhance screening and reporting via the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP). IDSP tracks surveillance; authorities claim adequate resources and no bed shortages. Delhi faces expected seasonal peaks; H1N1 currently dominates in Delhi, with H3N2 leading in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 『マスク着用、人混みを避けて』―デリー、H1N1症例が1,777件を超え監視体制を強化

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、デリー市当局は35病院での特別監視、AIIMS・NCDCでの検査体制、IHIPによる報告体制を整備済み。ベッド不足や重症例急増の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 16 Unit Portable X-Ray Segera Tiba di Sulteng, Perkuat Deteksi Dini Kasus TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sixteen Portable X-ray Units to Arrive Soon in Central Sulawesi, to Bolster Early Detection of TB Cases.
article.articleSummary: Sixteen portable X-ray units will arrive in September 2026 to bolster early detection of tuberculosis (TB) in Central Sulawesi, Indonesia. The initiative supports the Sulawesi Tengah provincial government’s target of TB elimination by 2030 and is backed by the Ministry of Health. Governor Anwar Hafid announced the plan during a visit by senior ministry officials on August 22, 2026, stating that easier access to screening will help identify cases sooner and accelerate treatment initiation. Beyond equipment, the province plans district- and city-level TB Task Forces and a provincial TB Task Force to monitor and evaluate program implementation across regencies. Officials stress cross-district coordination as essential to reducing TB burden, noting that TB cases in Central Sulawesi remain high. No specific case numbers or laboratory-confirmed data are provided.

triage.notes: 結核は地域で流行が続く疾患であり、本記事は検査体制強化という平常業務の一環。具体的な症例数や異常な増加を示すデータはない。
