article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu on the rise in Delhi; be cautious if you notice these five symptoms along with fever and cough.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) is rising in Delhi and the Delhi-NCR region. Typical symptoms include fever, runny nose or cough, body aches, and fatigue. As of 12 August 2026, Delhi has recorded 1,449 H1N1 infections, about six times higher than 229 cases at the same point last year, according to the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC). Medical professionals say monsoon humidity is intensifying transmission. In response, major hospitals have begun special preparations to manage the surge. The report underscores vigilance for flu-like illness and notes the outbreak's ongoing spread in Delhi and adjacent areas, with emphasis on early diagnosis, appropriate care, and reporting through public health channels.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでスワインフル（豚インフルエンザ）が急増、発熱・咳とともにこの5つの症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数が前年同期比約6倍に急増しており、異常な流行拡大と医療機関の対応強化が報じられているため、経過確認とリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザだが、前年比約6倍という急増と、モンスーン期の感染拡大要因、病院の特別対応が報じられており、公衆衛生上の注視が必要。重症度・死亡者数の情報は記事内に無く不明。

article.articleHeadline: 한 달 새 52만명 폭발"... 중국 덮친 코로나19 재확산, 한국도 '비상'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 520,000 people infected in a month: COVID-19 resurgence sweeps through China, South Korea on high alert.
article.articleSummary: China experiences a COVID-19 resurgence, with July reported new confirmed cases reaching 522,000. Among those with influenza-like illness seeking outpatient or emergency care, COVID-19 positivity rose to 21.2% for five consecutive weeks. In Korea, the second week of August (Aug 9–15) COVID-19 detection was 9.1%, up about 2.8-fold from 3.2% three weeks earlier. Taiwan reports rising cases and temporary vaccine shortages in some areas due to increased demand. Experts warn that outbreak size is hard to predict and stress proactive vaccine stockpiling and continued personal protective measures. They referenced last year when early vaccination campaigns failed to reach high-risk elderly populations, contributing to vaccine depletion in some cases. The situation underscores the need for coordinated vaccine supply management and adherence to protective practices to mitigate a potential broader regional surge.

triage.headline_ja: 1ヶ月で52万人感染爆発…中国を襲うコロナ19再拡大、韓国も『非常事態』
triage.triage_reason: 中国での大規模なCOVID-19再拡大（月間52万人）に加え、韓国・台湾への地域的拡大とワクチン不足が報告されており、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 韓国・台湾も発生地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国での急増と地域波及、ワクチン供給問題が主な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Swine Flu Cases: Over 2,300 Influenza-A cases reported; what people should know about the latest health advisory
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports rising swine flu (H1N1) cases with a health advisory urging respiratory hygiene and avoidance of crowded places. As of Friday, Delhi has logged 2,602 influenza cases this year: 2,392 Influenza-A (1,777 H1N1; 37 H1; 138 H3; 440 other Influenza-A) and 210 Influenza-B (200 Victoria, 10 others). On Thursday alone, 155 Influenza-A cases were recorded (114 H1N1; 2 H1; 1 H3; 38 other Influenza-A) and 4 Influenza-B. H1N1 dominates Delhi’s influenza tally this year; the capital is preparing with 35 hospitals under special surveillance, AIIMS and NCDC labs designated for testing, and technical guidelines for treatment, ventilation, masks, and home care. Daily monitoring via IDSP-IHIP, with surveillance, reporting, and awareness campaigns across departments; vulnerable groups include young children and the elderly with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: デリーの豚インフルエンザ症例：インフルエンザA型が2,300件を超えて報告、最新の健康勧告について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）を含むインフルエンザA型症例が急増し、当局が病院での特別サーベイランスや健康勧告を発出しており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAへの移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優勢）の症例増加であり、例年見られるパターンの可能性が高い。重症度や死亡者数の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: OPAKI VIRUS SE OTRGAO KONTROLI! Preti da nadmaši najsmrtonosniju epidemiju ikada zabeleženu, lekari se bore da zaustave zarazu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus has spiraled out of control! It threatens to surpass the deadliest epidemic ever recorded, and doctors are fighting to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling the most severe Ebola outbreak in its history, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of August 23, 2026, 5,290 laboratory-confirmed cases have produced 2,516 deaths. The epidemic is spreading rapidly and risks surpassing the deadliest West Africa outbreak (2014–2016) which killed over 11,000 people. Transmission is not yet peaked and could triple in rate. Some symptoms resemble malaria, complicating detection. Campaigns continue to deploy vaccines: a shipment of Ervebo—over 16,000 doses arrived in Kinshasa, with more expected next week, and the World Health Organization anticipates about 70,000 doses in total for the response. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola and may provide some protection against Bundibugyo virus, though there is currently no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. Armed conflict and healthcare disruption hinder control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 凶暴なウイルスが制御不能に！史上最悪の疫病を上回る恐れ、医師らが感染拡大阻止に奮闘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が進行中で、致死率・感染拡大リスクが高く、国際的な支援（WHOによるワクチン供給）も行われているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれず、サマリーでも主題として言及されていないため除外。マラリアはエボラとの症状類似性の文脈で言及されているのみで、独立した流行事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ''중국 코로나 재유행?'' 한 달 52만 명 확진...한국도 3주 만에 2.8배↑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "China's COVID-19 resurgence?" 520,000 confirmed cases in one month... Korea also up 2.8-fold in three weeks.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-23, China reports a COVID-19 resurgence: July's new confirmed cases exceed 522,000 with 487 severe cases and 1 death. Sentinel surveillance from 1,041 hospitals shows influenza-like illness patients testing positive for SARS-CoV-2 at 21.2% between July 27 and August 2, a 13-point rise in five weeks. Despite rising indicators, most cases are mild, and Chinese authorities do not characterize it as a pandemic-scale spread. In South Korea, COVID-19 indicators rise: detection rate among respiratory samples is 9.1% in week 33 (Aug 9–15) across 106 facilities; hospitalizations reach 56 in week 33, a 2.4-fold increase from week 30. Taiwan also experiences temporary vaccine shortages amid spread; the article cautions vigilance for regional transmission and stresses vaccine stock management to ensure elderly uptake.

triage.headline_ja: 「中国でコロナ再流行？」1カ月で52万人確診…韓国も3週間で2.8倍増
triage.triage_reason: 中国・韓国・台湾でCOVID-19陽性率・入院数の上昇が見られるが、大部分は軽症で死亡数も少なく、季節的な再流行パターンの範囲内と考えられるため、現時点ではフルRRAより経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 韓国・台湾も感染増加が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。中国のデータ（52万人確診、死亡1例、重症487例）を主眼として評価した。
